article.articleHeadline: Border travel restricted after 131 die of Ebola in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola (Bundibugyo strain) in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 131 deaths among 543 suspected and 33 confirmed cases, with two confirmed cases reported in neighboring Uganda. Butembo recorded its first two confirmed cases on Monday. Across borders, Uganda restricted movement at Ishasha-Kyeshero; Congolese crossing into Rwanda are stopped at the border. WHO Director-General Tedros declared the Bundibugyo outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, citing rapid spread in a densely populated, violence-affected area; earlier outbreaks in 2018–2020 killed nearly 2,300. Diagnostic capacity is limited to six tests per hour at the INRB Rodolphe Merieux Laboratory in Goma. A panel is evaluating vaccines; Merck’s Ervebo is a candidate but would take about two months to be available. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; average fatality around 50%.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴでエボラ熱により131人が死亡、国境の移動が制限される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な高い致死率と急速な拡大、隣国への既に確認された国際的拡大、国境移動制限実施）。WHO総長が国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の深刻な爆発。543例の疑い患者、33人の確定患者、131人の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダで既に確定患者2例が報告されており、国境での移動制限が実施されている。WHO総長による国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言。前回の2018-2020年の流行で約2,300人が死亡。診断能力が限定的（時間あたり6件）。

article.articleHeadline: Darurat Global Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Ebola Emergency
article.articleSummary: WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. In DR Congo, 131 deaths and over 513 suspected cases have been reported; Uganda confirmed cases after two people arrived from Congo. An MRC Center model suggests more than 1,000 probable cases. WHO warns the outbreak may have been underway for weeks before detection, with unclear exposure pathways. On May 15 national labs in Congo confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus as the culprit, with a 25–50% fatality rate. Ebola species include Zaire, Sudan, and Bundibugyo; fruit bats are natural hosts. Human transmission occurs via contact with blood or body fluids and contaminated objects. No vaccine or rapid test exists specifically for Bundibugyo; current vaccines target Zaire. WHO funds two experimental therapies; approvals await from Congo and Uganda; vaccines for other Ebola species could be tested.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの世界的緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際保健上の懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確認済みエボラアウトブレイク。DRC及びウガンダでの死亡131名、疑い例513名以上、モデル予測では1,000例以上の可能性がある重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの双方を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC(203312)のみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOが正式にPHEICを宣言しており、死亡率25-50%のBundibugyo ebolavirus、既知の治療法・検査法の不足、ワクチンの非可用性など複数の深刻なリスク要因が存在。迅速なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Россия победила "неизлечимый штамм" Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia defeated the "incurable strain" of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Russia's Ebola vaccine is claimed to confer immunity against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, one of the more dangerous variants now circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The assertion was made by Alexander Gintsburg, scientific director of the Gamaleya Research Center in Moscow. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is described as circulating in DRC and Uganda, with the vaccine purported to provide immunity against it. The article presents the claim as a scientist's statement rather than a proven clinical result, and it does not provide outbreak counts, laboratory confirmation, or details about infection sources. This development underscores ongoing international concern about Ebola virus diversity and regional transmission in Central and East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、エボラウイルスの「治療不可能な株」を打ち負かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新株がDRCとウガンダで流行しており、これは深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念である。しかし、記事は科学者の主張に基づく疫学的データを欠いており、実際の流行規模、確認症例数、死亡者数が不明であるため、情報不足のWATCH判定とした。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はDRCおよびウガンダで循環していると記事に明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事はロシアの疫学的声明を報告しており、実際の流行データ（症例数、死亡数、感染源の詳細）が欠落しているため、完全なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: NCAA Issues Ebola Alert, Directs Enhanced Surveillance At Airports - The Ghanaian Chronicle
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, Nigeria’s NCAA has directed airlines, airport operators, and aviation stakeholders to intensify Ebola surveillance at points of entry to curb cross-border transmission from outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. A circular dated 18 May 2026 notes that no Nigerian cases have been confirmed, with authorities coordinating with the Federal Ministry of Health, the NCDC, Port Health Services, and international partners. In the DRC’s Bunia Health Zone, a cluster of severe illness among healthcare workers led to laboratory confirmation of Bundibugyo virus, a strain of the Ebola family. There is currently no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo; treatment remains supportive. Symptoms include sudden fever, severe fatigue, persistent headache, vomiting, abdominal pain, and bleeding such as nosebleeds or vomiting blood. Early detection and prompt reporting are critical to prevent international spread.

triage.headline_ja: NCAがエボラ警告を発令、空港での監視強化を指示 - ガーナ・クロニクル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo エボラウイルスのDRC確認、複数国への波及リスク、ワクチン未承認など重大な懸念あり。国際的警戒体制の構築が進行中。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはBuniaがあるDRC、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は：(1)DRCのBunia Health ZoneでのBundibugyo確認、(2)ウガンダでの並行発生、(3)ナイジェリアの空港警戒体制。対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみが確認確実。ガーナは記事URL由来（thechronicle.com.gh）であり、ナイジェリアはアラート発出国として機能しており両国での政策的関心は高い。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo はエボラ出血熱の重症型、ワクチン未承認、医療従事者への感染確認により重大度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uqandada Ebola epidemiyası səbəbindən 100-dən çox insan karantinə alınıb
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, more than 100 people have been quarantined due to the Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: From May 20, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak is centered in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, which borders Uganda. In Uganda, authorities have quarantined more than 100 people under continuous medical surveillance with routine checks for infection symptoms. Officials say the situation is under control, noting that Uganda’s prior outbreak response experience supports current efforts. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern. In the DRC, more than 500 suspected cases have been identified and over 130 deaths reported; in Uganda, one confirmed infection and one death have been recorded. The proximity of Ituri to Uganda is prompting heightened monitoring and quarantine measures.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ感染症の流行により100人以上が隔離されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な感染症拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済みの多国間エボラ流行事案。
triage.notes: DRC（Ituri州）が主要な発生地域であり、対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダ（対象国ではなく、隔離などの対応国として言及）。DRCで500症例以上・130死亡以上、ウガンダで確認症例1・死亡1。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | بسبب "إيبولا".. البحرين تعلق دخول المسافرين من 3 دول
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | Due to 'Ebola'... Bahrain suspends entry of travelers from three countries.
article.articleSummary: Bahrain's Civil Aviation Affairs will suspend entry of non-Bahraini travelers arriving from South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Uganda, starting Tuesday, due to World Health Organization updates on the Ebola outbreak and evolving epidemiological conditions in those countries. Entry at Bahrain International Airport will be restricted for direct arrivals from the three countries and for travelers who have been there within the 30 days before arriving in Bahrain. Bahraini citizens will still be subject to the health protocols on arrival. The 30-day suspension will begin on Tuesday and will be reviewed continuously, with the country list updated as Ebola spreads and WHO guidance evolves. The announcement emphasizes adherence to official health instructions for all arrivals. Source: Bahrain News Agency (BNA).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱のため、バーレーンが3国からの旅行者の入国を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的な感染リスクがあり、複数国での流行が確認され、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。WHOの勧告に基づく実際の渡航制限措置が実施されている点で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事では南スーダン（South Sudan）、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、ウガンダ（Uganda）からの入国制限が述べられている。提供されたAPIの発生地域リストには広域が含まれているが、検証対象国リストに照合すると、DRC（203312）のみが該当。南スーダンとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。バーレーン（290291）は渡航制限を実施する国であり、感染発生国ではないため除外。スーダン（366755）も記事サマリーの主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Status Darurat Global Ebola, Kemenkes Ingatkan Warga Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Ebola Emergency Status, Health Ministry Reminds the Public to Stay Vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Global Ebola emergency status cited as travel-related cases spread beyond the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with reports in Kampala, Uganda, and Kinshasa, attributed to high population mobility and limited local health facilities. Indonesia’s Ministry of Health (Kemenkes) says the government will continually monitor the global situation and heighten cross-sector vigilance. An outbreak readiness system will be activated, including deployment of field health workers, strengthened traveler screening, and referral procedures to hospitals meeting international standards for passengers showing Ebola symptoms. The measures aim to enhance early detection, rapid isolation, and appropriate care, while coordinating with international partners if needed. Published May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルエボラ緊急事態ステータス、保健省が国民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダで報告）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、渡航関連の拡大リスク、および高い社会政治的関心により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（キンシャサ）およびウガンダ（カンパラ）でのエボラ事例報告が述べられているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。インドネシアは記事の主題ではなく、保健省の監視体制の記述のみのため除外。配信日時が2026年5月であることに注意（将来日付）。

article.articleHeadline: Humaniora kemarin, mitigasi kekerasan hingga kasus Ebola di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yesterday's Humanities: From violence mitigation to the Ebola case in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has not been detected in Indonesia as of 20 May 2026, according to Indonesia’s Ministry of Health, which notes that no laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported domestically and that domestic surveillance remains heightened. Globally, the World Health Organization designated the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa (notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo) as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) due to cross-border spread, high mortality, and ongoing uncertainties about the scale of transmission. In response, Indonesia is tightening surveillance at ports and airports and increasing screening for travelers from affected countries to prevent importation. The Ebola alert underscores international vigilance even where no cases have been identified, emphasizing multi-sectoral readiness and ongoing monitoring of global developments.

triage.headline_ja: 昨日の人道支援：暴力緩和からインドネシアのエボラ事例まで
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアではエボラの確定患者は報告されていないが、中央アフリカ（DRC）での PHEIC 指定と国際的な警戒が高まっており、スクリーニング基準複数該当のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インドネシア国内ではエボラ確定患者なし（2026年5月20日時点）。記事の主要な懸念は中央アフリカ（DRC）での PHEIC 指定と国際的な輸入リスク管理。IHR基準では3つ該当し本来は PICKUP 候補だが、インドネシア自体は患者未発生で情報が限定的なため WATCH に分類。DRC での状況は重篤だが、本トリアージの対象は記事内容に基づくインドネシアでの当面のリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: 3 suspected cases of Diphtheria in Malegaon, 2 deaths
article.articleSummary: Three suspected diphtheria cases have been reported in Malegaon, Nashik district, over the past six days, with two deaths. A 16-month-old boy died on May 13; his elder brother, admitted with similar symptoms three days later, died during treatment the same day. A 1.5-year-old girl, admitted on Monday to Malegaon General Hospital, remains stable on diphtheria‑like symptoms. All three cases originate from the densely populated Chalisgaon Phata area. Throat swabs from the girl have been sent to Kasturba Hospital, Mumbai, for confirmatory testing. Health officials, including state deputy director of health Dr Kapil Aher, say diphtheria is now uncommon in India, and the department is treating the matter seriously with intensified area surveillance. None of the children were immunised; some residents remain reluctant to participate in immunisation. The deceased boys' family migrated from Rajasthan; the girl's family is local.

triage.headline_ja: マレガオンにジフテリア疑い例3件、2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: ジフテリアは予防接種でコントロール可能な疾患であるが、インドで稀とされる中での複数死亡例の発生は異常である。2死亡を含む確認例の報告はIHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事で明示されているように、ジフテリアはインドでは現在稀な疾患であり、複数例の死亡発生は異常性が高い。未接種児童の集中及び免疫接種への住民の抵抗感が報告されており、流行拡大のリスク要因となっている。喉頭スワブの確認検査がムンバイのカストゥルバ病院で実施中である。州保健部門が積極的な地域監視を開始している。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Telat dan Telan 134 Korban Jiwa, Bisakah Ebola Menyebar ke Luar Afrika?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delayed detection and 134 fatalities, can Ebola spread beyond Africa?
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization declares Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to a surge in cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare species, with 536 suspected cases and 134 deaths reported by the CDC. Response is hampered by ongoing civil conflict and weeks of delayed detection. Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks are historically rare, with prior spikes in 2007 and 2012 and roughly 30% mortality. The 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (≈28,600 cases) provides grim context, but global risk remains very low. Cross-border transmission is evident: two people in Uganda are laboratory-confirmed infected, with one death. High-risk neighbors include Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda due to dense trade and travel. Transmission is zoonotic, from fruit bats, underscoring the need for international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 検出の遅れと134人の死亡、エボラはアフリカ外に拡大する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、コンゴでの異常な発生、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、国際的な懸念）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）宣言済み。ウガンダでの確認患者1名死亡を記録。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な亜種）による発生で、検出の遅れと市民紛争による対応阻害が深刻。過去の西アフリカ流行（2014-2016年、約28,600例）との比較文脈あり。ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダへの高リスク拡散の可能性が明示。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、ウガンダ・ルワンダ・南スーダンは対象国外として除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO quan ngại về quy mô và tốc độ lây lan của virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Concerned About the Scale and Rate of Transmission of the Ebola Virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization warns about the scale and speed of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province near the borders with Uganda and South Sudan, with 131 deaths reported. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare EBOV strain identified in 2007; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for this strain, and current vaccines target only Zaire ebolavirus. WHO has declared a PHEIC and will hold an emergency meeting; monitors are tightening, including scrutiny of all passengers on the MV Hondius cruise ship. The virus has spread to neighboring provinces and into Uganda. President Félix Tshisekedi urged calm and stronger response. Singapore’s CDA has intensified border health measures, including 21-day post-arrival monitoring; the U.S. State Department issued Level 4 travel advisories for DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda and advised reconsidering travel to Rwanda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスの感染規模と伝播速度について懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大、死亡者報告、WHO緊急会議予定により、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: DRC（Ituri州）が主な発生地。記事はウガンダへの拡大も言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。シンガポール・米国・南スーダン・ルワンダは対策実施国または情報発信国であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。PHEIC宣言、ワクチン非対応株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）、クルーズ船での監視体制など、多層的な懸念要素あり。

article.articleHeadline: Toàn cảnh dịch bệnh vừa khiến 118 người chết, WHO phải tuyên bố tình trạng y tế khẩn cấp toàn cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overview of the outbreak that has just claimed 118 lives, prompting the WHO to declare a global health emergency.
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Ebola outbreak caused by Orthoebolavirus Bundibugyo strain a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, as cases exceed 300 across Central and East Africa, with at least 118 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri Province, DRC, with Uganda reporting cases; Kinshasa has a suspected case that tested negative, signaling possible spread to the capital. No vaccine specific to Bundibugyo exists; two Ebola vaccines are available: Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) already used in past outbreaks, and Zabdeno (two-dose) for exposed individuals and healthcare workers. A Bundibugyo vaccine remains in preclinical testing. There is no specific treatment; care is supportive. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infectious fluids, placing healthcare workers at highest risk. Public health response includes rapid diagnostics (PCR, RAT), isolation, 21‑day contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement; border closures are not yet required, but enhanced tracing and testing are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 118人の死亡をもたらした感染症の流行概況、WHOが世界的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）によるPHEIC宣言済みの国際的な流行で、300を超える症例と118人の死亡、複数国への国際的拡大、医療従事者への高リスク、国境対策の検討など、明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラの流行は新規で重篤。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）。Ituri州が震源地でKinshasaへの拡大も懸念。対象国リストではDRCのみが明確に該当；Ugandaと Mozambique は発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではUgandaで症例報告ありと記述されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ確認。

article.articleHeadline: Mauá amplia vacinação contra gripe após avanço de casos graves de Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mauá expands influenza vaccination after an increase in severe influenza cases
article.articleSummary: Mauá, Brazil expanded influenza vaccination on May 19, 2026 to everyone aged six months and older, in response to a surge in severe influenza-associated illness. The Municipal Health Secretariat reports a 71.7% rise in influenza-positive SRAG cases from January–April, with 79 cases this year versus 46 in 2025. Of 50 positive samples analyzed, 24 were confirmed as influenza (up from 13/50 in 2025). One death due to influenza B was confirmed in April in a 10-year-old child with no comorbidities; another pediatric death is under investigation. Vaccination previously targeted vulnerable groups; overall coverage remains low (children 6 months–<6 years: 18.35%; pregnant women: 24.43%; elderly: 36.54%; total priority-group coverage 30.74%). The campaign aims to curb transmission during autumn/winter. The vaccine is inactivated, safe, updated annually. Vaccines are available at all 23 UBSs, Monday–Friday starting 8:00, with unit-specific closing times; bring photo ID and vaccination card if possible.

triage.headline_ja: マウア、インフルエンザ重症例増加後にワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザB型の重症例増加と小児死亡が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・異常性）に該当するが、現時点では地域的・限定的な対応段階であり、国際的な拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響の明確な証拠が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルのマウア市でインフルエンザB型の重症例が71.7%増加（2026年1月〜4月）し、小児死亡1件（4月、10歳、基礎疾患なし）が確認。別の小児死亡が調査中。ワクチン接種率が低いため当局が全年齢層への拡大接種キャンペーンを実施。現在のところ地域的課題だが、南半球の秋冬シーズンにおける流行監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Instalan filtros sanitarios en puertos y aeropuertos por brote de ébola - Quadratín
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health screenings installed at ports and airports amid Ebola outbreak - Quadratín
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts health screenings at Jalisco's airports and seaports in Mexico. On May 20, 2026, authorities in Jalisco tighten border health measures ahead of the FIFA World Cup to manage a surge of international visitors, particularly from Africa. Health Secretary Héctor Raúl Pérez said screening will target travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and Mexicans who have visited those regions, enabling immediate isolation (quarantine), clinical monitoring, and treatment as needed. The initiative seeks to rapidly identify individuals with Ebola-like symptoms for isolation and care. The local response aligns with international actions after the World Health Organization issued a global concern alert over rising Ebola cases and deaths in affected African regions. No laboratory confirmation or case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコのハリスコ州の空港と港でエボラウイルス流行に対する衛生スクリーニングを設置
triage.triage_reason: メキシコにおける予防的衛生措置の報告であり、実際のエボラ症例はメキシコでは確認されていない。アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）での流行に対応する国際的関心は高いが、検査確認例数や詳細な流行規模の情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はメキシコでの予防措置であるが、実際の流行はアフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）で発生している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。メキシコは対象国でないため除外。WHOの世界的警告が言及されており国際的関心は高いが、メキシコでの確認症例がないため、リスク評価は限定的。続報（DRCでの具体的な症例数、死亡数、流行動向）を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Американски лекар евакуиран към Германия след заразяване с ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor evacuated to Germany after contracting Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: American surgeon Dr. Peter Stafford, working in a Congo hospital, is evacuated to Germany after contracting Ebola, according to NBC. Stafford, part of a Christian missionary team with his wife and four children who remain under observation in Congo, operated on a patient with severe abdominal pain; the patient died and was buried without an Ebola test. Stafford developed Ebola symptoms and deteriorated despite following medical protocols. He was flown to Germany in a specialized plastic-enclosed transport bed to protect the aircraft crew. The Congo outbreak involves a little-known Ebola strain with no available vaccine or therapy. As of May 20, 2026, 131 people have died and 531 are suspected carriers. The incubation period is up to 21 days, complicating contact tracing. The WHO cautions that the strain's fatality rate is between 30% and 50%.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人医師がコンゴでエボラに感染後、ドイツに搬送される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患の国際的な症例で、公衆衛生への重大な影響、予防接種・治療法がない新規株の検出、国際的な患者移送と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでの発生を主とし、米国人医師の搬送先がドイツである。対象国リストに含まれる該当国はDRCのみ。エボラウイルスの新規株（ワクチン・治療法なし）の検出、致死率30～50%、既に131人死亡・531人疑似患者の報告あり。接触者追跡の困難さと国際的なリスク拡大が重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: HANTAVIRUS: Dinkes Jawa Tengah Minta Warga Tidak Panik, Waspada Tetap Diperlukan, Belum Ada Kasus Positif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Central Java Health Office Urges Residents Not to Panic; Vigilance Still Necessary; No Positive Cases Yet.
article.articleSummary: Central Java Health Office reports no positive hantavirus cases in January–May 2026, urging calm but vigilance. Hantavirus is a rodent-borne zoonosis; reemerging after previously reported cases, last in 2023 at the Demak port, with no new cases since. Transmission occurs via rodent saliva, urine, and feces or inhalation of dried particles; ports and other rodent-dense sites are flagged. Early symptoms include fever, chest or abdominal pain, dysuria, and conjunctival hemorrhage; severe disease can cause bleeding and kidney failure. Diagnosis requires PCR and serology at hospitals. Dinkes Jateng is educating facilities and will mobilize 883 puskesmas through the "Jumat Pintar" program. Eight provincial hospitals are prepared; three main referral hospitals are RS Dr. Adhyatma MPH Semarang, RS Prof. Dr. Margono Purwokerto, and RS Dr. Moewardi Surakarta. No hantavirus vaccine exists; early detection and treatment improve outcomes. Prevention emphasizes hygiene, securing homes against rats, handwashing, PPE in rodent areas, and healthy living.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：中央ジャワ保健局が住民にパニックにならないよう呼びかけ、警戒は必要、陽性症例はなし
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスは重篤な出血熱疾患だが、記事時点では陽性症例がなく、過去の事例（2023年）も局所的である。ただし啓発・準備体制が整備されており、ヒト-ヒト感染性は低いものの齧歯動物媒介の懸念がある。情報が限定的なため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、インドネシア中央ジャワ州（Jawa Tengah）で報告されていることを確認。ハンタウイルスは重症度が高く（出血性疾患、腎不全）、齧歯動物を経由した曝露リスク継続の懸念があり、港湾などの環境リスクが指摘されている。一方、現在のところ陽性症例がなく、最後の確認は2023年（Demak港）である。保健当局による準備体制（883のpuskesmas動員、8つの州病院対応）が整備されており、管理可能性は相応にあると判断。IHR基準は該当なし、WPROスクリーニング基準は3つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）だが、公衆衛生上の顕在的な危機的状況ではないため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: 女腰痛2年 脊髓清出千條寄生蟲 醫驚：像湯裡撈麵條 - 健康
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman with two years of lower back pain: thousands of parasitic worms removed from her spinal cord; doctors were astonished—like pulling noodles from soup - Health
article.articleSummary: Single case in Fujian, China: a 57-year-old woman with two years of lower back and leg pain, progressing weakness, and difficulty walking. She had spinal decompression surgery after an initial misdiagnosis of a CNS tumor, but symptoms recurred. A 10-hour operation removed thousands of white parasitic worms from the spinal cord, described by surgeons as like pulling noodles from soup. Postoperative tests confirmed infection with ‘歐猬疊宮絳蟲’, a parasite historically found in Europe with rising reports in southern China. She received antiparasitic therapy and regained motor strength from 1–2 to 4, now walking with assistance. The case highlights risks from consuming undercooked wild game, drinking unboiled water, or using raw frog meat on wounds, which may enable spinal invasion. Published May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 女性の2年間の腰痛：脊髄から千条の寄生虫が摘出、医師も驚愕「スープから麺をすくうようなもの」- 健康
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の稀な寄生虫感染（脊髄内）であり、異常性と重症度の基準は該当するが、国際的な拡大リスクと公衆衛生的な深刻さについては現時点で限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報告であり、集団発生やアウトブレイク発生の兆候なし。南中国での『歐猬疊宮絳蟲』の報告増加は注視対象だが、現在のところ単発事例。生食や不衛生な水の摂取などの行動由来リスクが主因と考えられる。スクリーニング基準で異常性と重症度が該当するため、継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Cara Mencegah Infeksi Virus Hanta dari Tikus di Rumah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to Prevent Hantavirus Infection from Mice at Home.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus infection has no approved treatment or vaccine. Human transmission occurs via aerosols from rodent carriers (rats and bats) whose excreta (urine, feces, saliva) can spread the virus. Rodents circulate widely in homes, dirty areas, and even laboratories, often asymptomatically shedding virus; humans have no natural immunity. Prevention focuses on interrupting transmission: avoid dry-cleaning areas with rodent contamination, use disinfectants (chlorine, alcohol) and personal protective equipment (gloves, mask), and ventilate spaces for 30 minutes before cleaning. At-risk groups include forestry workers, cleaners of old buildings and sewers, and post-flood settings when rodents invade homes. Exposures occur during cleaning of unused cabins, barns, granaries, garages; home cleaning; construction; pest control; camping in rodent-infested areas. Clinically, Haemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) is linked to Hantaan, Dobrava, Saarema, Seoul, Puumala and is common in Europe/Asia, including Indonesia; Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) relates to Andes and Sin Nombre, mainly the Americas; Andes can spread between humans. Recently, three cruise ship passengers traveling from Argentina to Spain died from Andes virus.

triage.headline_ja: 自宅のネズミからのハンタウイルス感染を予防する方法
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症（出血熱）の国際的な死亡例（アルゼンチン発症→スペイン到着時に死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスク・ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（Andesウイルス）を満たす。社会的関心も高い重篤な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア語メディアでの予防啓発記事だが、実際の事例はアルゼンチン発症→スペイン到着時の死亡（Andesウイルス）を報告。Andesウイルスはヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある点が重要。発生地域にスペイン・アルゼンチンが含まれているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations は Indonesia のみ。ただし国際的な患者移動と死亡が確認されており、グローバルな懸念事項として検出される。

article.articleHeadline: Cluster Sante de la RDC Rapport situationnel - Humanitaire MVE #2 : Épidémie de la maladie à virus Ébola (Souche Bundibugyo) dans le contexte humanitaire (18 mai 2026)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Health Cluster Situation Report - Humanitarian MVE #2: Ebola virus disease outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) in the humanitarian context (May 18, 2026).
article.articleSummary: As of 18 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 33 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 4 confirmed deaths, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Ituri remains the epicenter with 30 cases; North Kivu now has 3 confirmed cases in Goma, Butembo, and Katwa, signaling potential urban spread and heightened mobility risk. The Ministry of Health, through COUSP/INSP, with WHO and partners, is intensifying the response via expert deployment, strengthened diagnostic capacity, established care facilities, and prepositioned supplies. The outbreak occurs in a challenging humanitarian context marked by population displacement, armed-group activity, restricted access, and cross-border transmission risk. Urgent needs include enhanced operational coordination, surveillance, laboratory capacity, patient management, infection prevention and control (IPC), rapid team deployment, and logistics. Two alerts in Kadutu and Shabunda (South Kivu) were investigated and invalidated.

triage.headline_ja: DRC保健クラスター状況報告 - 人道支援 MVE #2: エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）人道支援の文脈での発生（2026年5月18日）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な地域流行、国際的拡大リスク（境界越え）、渡航制限リスク）。確認死亡あり、複数地域での確認症例、人道危機と組み合わされた複雑な流行環境。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルス病の確認患者33例（死亡4例）。イツリ州が震源地（30例）。ノルドキヴ州で都市部（ゴマ、ブテンボ、カトワ）での症例確認による都市伝播リスク。国内避難民、武装勢力活動、アクセス制限による対応の困難性。国境越え伝播リスク。WHO及び関係パートナーによる対応展開中。フルRRAでの詳細リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 【晚間新聞】5月19日完整版 | 俄無人機戰隊 | 埃博拉疫情 | 白宮地下軍事設施 | 新唐人电视台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Evening News May 19 Full Version | Russian Drone Battalion | Ebola Outbreak | Underground Military Facility at the White House | New Tang Dynasty Television
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 131 deaths reported. The report underscores that there is no cure for Ebola, highlighting the grave prognosis and the essential need for effective infection control, supportive care, and outbreak containment. The article, dated May 20, 2026 (Beijing time), provides the fatality count but offers no additional details on total confirmed or suspected cases, onset dates, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or whether cases are imported or exported. The update focuses solely on the Congo Ebola event within the infectious disease context and serves to flag the ongoing public health threat posed by Ebola in Central Africa during this period.

triage.headline_ja: 晩間ニュース 5月19日完全版 | ロシア無人機部隊 | エボラ疫情 | ホワイトハウス地下軍事施設 | 新唐人テレビ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行継続、131人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスクが該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡多数）、流行しやすさ（コンゴでの継続流行）が認められる。フルRRAに進める必要あり。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月20日配信のニュース番組内容。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行状況について報告しており、131人の死亡が確認されているが、総確定患者数、疑い例数、感染源、輸入/輸出感染の有無など詳細情報は記事サマリーに記載されていない。今後の感染者数増加、地域拡大、国際的な影響については追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: '52년만의 월드컵 본선' 민주콩고에...美 '에볼라 입국금지' 예외 | 연합뉴스
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo to reach World Cup finals for the first time in 52 years... U.S. Ebola entry ban exception | Yonhap News
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's national football team qualifies for the FIFA World Cup finals for the first time in 52 years, with the United States granting an exception to its Ebola-related entry ban. A U.S. State Department official said the squad is expected to enter the United States, base a camp in Houston, and begin their group-stage schedule on the 17th against Portugal, moving between the United States and Mexico for matches. Any team members who previously stayed in the DRC within the last 21 days will face strict quarantine and testing, mirroring the treatment of U.S. citizens and residents; general supporters remain subject to the travel ban. Separately, the Ebola outbreak in Africa continues to spread, with 513 suspected cases and 131 deaths in the DRC as of May 19, and WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: 52年ぶりのワールドカップ本選に進出した民主コンゴ…米国が「エボラ入国禁止」の例外認可 | 連合ニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の集団発生がWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言されており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。DRCでの継続的な患者発生と国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのワールドカップ参加に関する米国の入国例外許可であるが、基礎となっているエボラ集団発生（DRCで513疑い患者、131死亡、WHO PHEIC宣言）が重要なシグナル。Bluedot APIが検出した他国（米国、ポルトガル、メキシコ）はワールドカップ参加国であり、エボラの実発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストにはアフリカ域内の他国（ザンビア、ガーナ）は含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: How world failed to stop major Ebola outbreak - AOL
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province centers on the Bundibugyo strain. The death of an unnamed health worker in Bunia on April 24 marked the outbreak's apparent start; officials say a three- to four-week delay in confirmation allowed the virus to spread, fueling one of the largest outbreaks on record. By mid-May authorities warned of more than 500 suspected cases and about 130 deaths, with cases reaching urban areas and crossing into Goma and Uganda. Early tests detected only the Zaire strain, leading to misdiagnosis as malaria and salmonella; samples were not escalated promptly and were later mishandled, arriving in Kinshasa at 17°C instead of 4°C and in too-small quantities. Conflict zone and weak surveillance, plus scarce Bundibugyo tests, hinder containment. Funeral ceremonies amplified spread; border restrictions tightened in response.

triage.headline_ja: 世界がエボラの大流行を防ぐことに失敗した方法 - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（500超の疑い例、130超の死亡）、予想外の株（Bundibugyo）の出現、隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大、国境制限の実施。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。Bundibugyo株が確認されており、初期診断の遅延（3～4週間）と検体の不適切な取り扱い（温度・量の問題）が感染拡大を助長。紛争地域での弱い監視体制、不十分な検査能力、葬儀式典による二次感染が懸念。ウガンダへの越境事例あり。

article.articleHeadline: Trump cuts left region 'dangerously exposed' to fatal virus now infecting hundreds: report
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province faces an Ebola outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. The World Health Organization reports more than 500 suspected infections and over 100 deaths; the outbreak began in April and was declared a public health emergency over the weekend. Funding cuts by the Trump administration in March 2025 reduced early-warning systems, undermining surveillance in the region. The International Rescue Committee, citing Politico, says the Congo operation shuttered health and preparedness work in three Ituri sections, the epicenter of transmission, contributing to a delay in detecting and responding to spread. WHO Director-General Tedros described the scale and speed of the outbreak as alarming.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領の資金削減で地域が「危険にさらされている」：致命的なウイルスが数百人に感染 報道
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生（500以上の疑い患者、100以上の死亡）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予防・検出システムの弱体化による国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的にイトゥリ州での発生を明記。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認の稀少株であり、治療法も限定的。WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。初期警戒システムの削減により検出・対応の遅れが生じた点が懸念される。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ജാഗ്രത: വിമാനത്താവളങ്ങളിൽ പരിശോധനയും നിരീക്ഷണവും ശക്തമാക്കി ആരോഗ്യ മന്ത്രാലയം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola vigilance: Health Ministry strengthens screening and surveillance at airports.
article.articleSummary: With Ebola outbreaks intensifying globally, India's Health Ministry tightens screening and surveillance at airports and ports; no Ebola cases reported in India, and there is no cause for alarm. Following WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus' warning about rapid transmission, India is strengthening preventive measures. In Congo and Uganda, authorities report over 200 suspected cases and 131 deaths; an American national on official travel to Congo has tested positive for Ebola. Indian agencies—National Center for Disease Control, Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme, and ICMR—convened a high-level meeting to assess preparedness. From Ebola-affected regions, international travelers' travel histories will be scrutinized by immigration and airport health authorities to detect potential imported cases and enable swift response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒：保健省が空港での検査と監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国でのエボラ発生、米国人の陽性確認、India全国的な対応措置による。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダで200以上の疑似症例と131人の死亡が報告されている。米国人の陽性確認も記載。インド国内ではまだ症例報告はないが、保健省が全国的な検査・監視強化を実施しており、WHO事務局長の警告を受けた対応。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات إيبولا 30% خلال 24 ساعة ومخاوف من تفشٍ في أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths rise 30% within 24 hours, raising fears of an outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa shows rapid escalation. As of May 20, 2026, about 500 suspected Ebola cases have been reported with 130 deaths, mostly in the Democratic Republic of Congo and a few in Uganda. Thirty infections have been laboratory-confirmed in the current DRC outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccines or treatments exist. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of rising urban transmission, notably in Kampala, Uganda, and Goma in eastern DRC. On protective measures, the United States has imposed a 30-day border closure for non-Americans who traveled through the region in the last 21 days, a move that has sparked controversy. A leader of the Infectious Diseases Society of America contends the policy targets foreigners and may be ineffective. The report highlights concern over urban spread and the lack of medical countermeasures for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス死亡者数が24時間で30%増加、アフリカでの流行拡大の懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイクは公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダ）、未承認ワクチン・治療法の不存在により、国際的な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラアウトブレイクがDRCとウガンダで報告されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。北米・欧州の関心（米国の国境閉鎖）も反映されているが、評価対象外。Bundibugyo株による未承認ワクチン・治療法の不存在が特に重大。速報段階で詳細な情報不足がある可能性があるため、続報監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO to hold emergency committee meeting as Ebola death toll rises
article.articleSummary: Ebola toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has risen to 131 deaths from 513 suspected cases, Health Minister Samuel Kamba said, up from 91 dead out of 350 suspected earlier. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared an international health emergency, and a WHO Emergency Committee meeting was scheduled for Tuesday to review the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. The epicentre is Ituri province on the border with Uganda and South Sudan, with the virus already spreading to neighboring provinces and across into Uganda. A six-ton supply shipment, including personal protective equipment and other medical materials, was set to arrive in the DRC to bolster response. The death toll is provisional, pending confirmation that all suspected deaths are Ebola-related.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死亡者数が増加する中、WHOが緊急委員会開催予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生地域拡大、国際的拡散リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療法なし、複数国への拡散、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはUgandaとSudanも含まれているが、サマリーでは『既にウガンダに拡がった』『ウガンダとの国境地帯』と記述され、DRCが主要な流行地。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが確認された発生国。Bundibugyo株（Zaire株ではない）の出現、ワクチン・治療法欠如、複数州への拡散、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: OMS convoca reunião de emergência para discutir avanço do Ebola na África Central
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Convenes Emergency Meeting to Discuss the Spread of Ebola in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization convened an emergency meeting to discuss a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, centered in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo. The flare has caused at least 136 deaths and over 500 suspected cases. Two confirmed cases have appeared in neighboring Uganda. South Sudan and Rwanda have erected border health checkpoints to screen travelers. An American physician infected in Africa will be transferred to Germany for treatment; there are no approved therapies or vaccines for this Ebola variant. Years of conflict have hampered humanitarian aid and fueled malnutrition, amplifying mortality, while poor sanitation raises transmission risk. The WHO has mobilized personnel, equipment, and supplies; the World Bank pledged funding to bolster the regional response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱の拡大について協議するため緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱による多数の死亡例（136件以上）と急速な拡大、複数国への越境事例、ワクチン・治療薬なしという深刻な状況。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。国際的な関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRCのイトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱の流行が主題。ウガンダでの確認例、南スーダン・ルワンダの国境措置、ドイツへの患者搬送も言及されているが、DRCが中心の発生地となっている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当し、他地域での事例も記載されているが、記事の主題はアフリカ中央部のエボラ流行。ワクチンと承認済み治療薬の不在、栄養不良、衛生状況の悪化が死亡率上昇の要因。WHOが対応を開始し、世界銀行も資金を提供。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 德国将接收一名美籍埃博拉病毒感染者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany to receive an American citizen infected with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, 2026, Germany’s Health Ministry said at the U.S. request that an American physician who contracted Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo will be transported to Berlin for treatment. The patient will be moved via a dedicated aircraft to Charité University Hospital, chosen for shorter flight time and Germany’s Ebola treatment experience. He will be admitted to a special isolation ward separate from routine hospital operations to minimize public risk. Six contacts deemed high risk will also be sent to Germany. This follows ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda; as of May 19, the DRC reported 131 deaths possibly due to Ebola and 513 suspected cases. The transfer denotes an imported/exported case with containment-focused, specialized care in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツがエボラウイルス感染のアメリカ市民を受け入れへ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症であり、DRCでの進行中の流行（131人の死亡、513人の疑い患者）、国際的な患者移送、ドイツへの侵入という国境を越えたリスク要因が複合的に存在。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラウイルス感染患者がDRCで感染し、ドイツ（ベルリン）へ医療目的で移送される事例が述べられている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、かつ記事の主題となっているため verified_locations に DRC のみ含める。Ugandaについても記事内で言及されているが、主たる流行地として記載されており、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Berlin、Germany、USA は発生地が主ではなく転送先・関係国であるため医療移送後の記載であり、新規の発生地として含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Khawatir wabah Ebola, Uganda larang masyarakat saling jabat tangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerned about the Ebola outbreak, Uganda bans people from shaking hands.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Health Ministry bans handshakes and other greeting practices to prevent Ebola transmission after two confirmed cases in Uganda, including one death. Both patients are citizens of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). According to DRC authorities, 131 people have died from Ebola in the DRC; the previous DRC outbreak ended in October 2025. The two Ugandan cases were reported as the outbreak drew international attention, with authorities monitoring the disease dynamics and implementing necessary countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行への懸念、ウガンダが国民の握手を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WHO PHEICが公式宣言されている。DRCとウガンダの両国での確認事例と複数国への拡大、死亡例の報告により、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、DRCでのエボラ流行（131人死亡、前回流行は2025年10月に終了）とウガンダでの2例確認（1例死亡）の両国での発生が明記されている。ただし、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。WHO PHEICが2026年5月17日に公式宣言されており、シグナルトリアージの最高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: [자막뉴스] 나흘 만에 사망자 2배 폭증...'바이러스' 공포의 속도로 전파
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Caption News] Death toll doubles in four days as the virus spreads at an alarming pace.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports roughly 500 suspected Ebola cases and 134 deaths, with only about 30 confirmed due to diagnostic limits; four days earlier the death toll more than doubled. White-tented isolation facilities are being erected around makeshift buildings to house suspected Ebola patients. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Health authorities aim to expand isolation capacity to at least 120 rooms. Adjacent countries have closed borders and tightened border controls; Uganda reports two confirmed cases among Congolese nationals. Analysts estimate total infections could exceed 1,000 when including latent cases. The United States has issued a travel advisory after a Congolese doctor working in the U.S. tested positive; Bahrain, Jordan, and other Middle Eastern nations restrict entry of foreigners from the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: [字幕ニュース] 4日間で死亡者が2倍に急増...ウイルスが恐怖のスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant による大規模流行で、WHOが国際的懸念事項として公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国での確認症例と国際的な感染拡大リスク、国境閉鎖等の対応が示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCが主要発生地域として確認。ウガンダでも確認例（2例）があるが、対象国リストに含まれておらず。米国、ヨルダン、バーレーンは対応国として言及されているが、実際の発生地域はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebola variant はワクチン・治療法なし。4日間で死亡者2倍増は緊急性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: في مكان لم يكشف عنه، أوغندا تفرض الحجر الصحي على أكثر من 100 شخص بعد تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At an undisclosed location, Uganda imposes quarantine on more than 100 people after an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Uganda has quarantined over 100 people as a containment measure for a rare Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain. The quarantined individuals are under monitoring at an undisclosed site, with medical teams screening for fever and other Ebola symptoms. Uganda's officials, including Alan Kasoga, executive director of the Uganda Media Centre and Ebola Taskforce communications lead, said the situation is under control and highlighted the country’s prior outbreak experience informs the response. The outbreak epicenter is in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, near the Uganda border, with warning indicators first detected on May 5; experts believe the virus may have circulated for weeks. DRC authorities report at least 131 deaths and more than 500 suspected cases, raising concerns of regional spread; the World Health Organization warns on the outbreak’s scale and speed.

triage.headline_ja: 未開示の場所で、ウガンダがエボラの流行後に100人以上に隔離を強制
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準も全5項目で該当。エボラウイルスの域内流行拡大シグナルであり、国境を越えた感染確認と広域対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRC東部イトゥリ州がエボラ流行の震源地（131死亡、500+疑似症例）で、ウガンダ国境近辺であり、ウガンダで100人以上が隔離中。Bundibugyo株が確認され、5月5日に初期警告兆候が検出。WHO警告あり、域内拡大の懸念が明確。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCとウガンダのみ。

article.articleHeadline: राहत: इबोला अफ्रीका तक सीमित, भारत में कोई मामला नहीं; WHO ने बीमारी को वैश्विक स्वास्थ्य आपातकाल घोषित किया - ebola confined to africa no cases in india
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Relief: Ebola confined to Africa, no cases in India; WHO has declared the disease a global health emergency.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared the Ebola virus outbreak a global health emergency. Globally, more than 336 cases and 87 deaths have been reported. The outbreak is due to the Bundibugyo strain, first identified in Bundibugyo, Uganda, in 2007. According to the Indian Medical Association, infections are currently concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; India has reported no cases. In response, WHO's declaration prompted enhanced monitoring by India's health department and other agencies. Antimicrobial Resistance Committee Chair Dr. Narendra Saini described Ebola as a severe viral disease with mortality ranging from 25% to 90%. Transmission occurs through direct contact with the blood, vomit, sweat, saliva, and other body fluids of an infected person.

triage.headline_ja: 安堵：エボラはアフリカに限定、インドでは症例なし；WHOは当該疾病を世界保健上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: WHO が Ebola を世界保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として公式宣言しており、IHR Annex2 基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・国際渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。対象国DRC・Ugandaでの集中的な発生が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo, Uganda も地理的に記事に明記されているが、Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事サマリーは DRC と Uganda での感染集中を明確に述べており、336症例・87死亡という深刻な数字が報告されている。WHO の PHEIC 宣言は国際感染症監視の最高レベルの警戒を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola doctor warns outbreak 'much bigger' than public is being told
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in eastern DR Congo has caused 130+ deaths and over 500 suspected cases, with transmission reaching international borders. An American exposed in DR Congo has tested positive and was flown to Germany for treatment, currently in isolation at Berlin's Charité hospital; six high-risk contacts are to be relocated to Europe for strict quarantine. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, and catastrophic bleeding, with potential death within 24 hours. Dr. Craig Spencer, who contracted Ebola while treating patients in Guinea in 2014 with Médecins Sans Frontières, says the current outbreak appears “much bigger” than official counts. He notes his background as an epidemiologist and public-health professor, and comments amid criticisms of WHO responsiveness and US cooperation. The CDC is monitoring the export of an Ebola case to Germany, while authorities push containment measures in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ医師が、公衆衛生機関が伝えているより「ずっと大きい」アウトブレイクだと警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（DRC→ドイツ確認例）、130名以上の死亡と500件以上の疑い例、国際的な感染境界越境があり、IHR基準で3項目以上該当。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ベルリン（ドイツ）での確認例は記事に登場するが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCが主要な発生地域であり、国際的な患者移送（ドイツ）と接触者隔離（欧州）が報告されている。CDC監視下にあり、WHOの対応批判も記載されており、政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: American Doctor With Ebola Evacuated To Germany As Wife And Four Children Are Monitored In Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) is driving an outbreak centered in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with Nyankunde Hospital treating affected patients. The ongoing outbreak has at least 131 deaths and about 531 suspected cases. Dr. Peter Stafford, an American surgeon, developed chills, fever, muscle aches, fatigue and nausea and tested positive for Ebola, then evacuated to Germany in a tube-shaped bed about the size of a coffin to protect the aircraft crew from infection. Stafford’s wife Rebekah, also a clinician, and their four children remain in the DRC under monitoring; another physician, Dr. Patrick LaRochelle, is reportedly exposed and monitored. The initial patient was misdiagnosed with a gallbladder infection; the Ebola infection was confirmed days later. PPE use was extensive among staff. WHO notes incubation up to 21 days and cautions on rapid spread, and this Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: American Doctor With Ebola Evacuated To Germany As Wife And Four Children Are Monitored In Congo
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行（131死亡、531疑い症例）であり、国際的な患者移送、医療従事者への暴露が確認されており、国際的拡大とトレード制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の進行中流行。DRC内Ituri州が主要な発生地域。米国医師の国際移送（ドイツ）はセカンダリイベントであり、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国・ドイツは医療対応地点だが、流行の実際の発生地はDRC。医療従事者への暴露（複数名確認）、ワクチン/治療法なしという要因が高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: New outbreak of Ebola disease
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu) and in Uganda has been declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) but not a pandemic under IHR. By May 16, 2026, eight laboratory-confirmed cases and 80 suspected deaths are reported in Ituri across three zones; two laboratory-confirmed cases (one death) in Kampala on May 15–16 among travelers from the DRC; an American health worker caring for patients in DRC tested positive on May 17. As of May 19, at least 131 deaths and more than 513 suspected cases in the DRC. Nigeria monitors the situation; no confirmed cases. Transmission begins with wildlife to humans and spreads person-to-person via blood, secretions, and contaminated surfaces; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhoea, bleeding; CFR around 50% (historical 25–90%). Response includes enhanced surveillance, IPC, case management, contact tracing, and risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ病の新たなアウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目全てに該当。コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラウイルス病の多数の死亡・疑い症例、PHEIC宣言、国際的な拡大（米国の医療従事者感染）、および国際的な関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州（ブニア、ルワンパラ、モンバワル）。ウガンダからの患者報告もあるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。PHEIC宣言、複数国への波及、米国の医療従事者感染例があり、国際的な感染症危機として認識される重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry Eyes Ebola Outbreak in DRC, Uganda
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, the World Health Organization designated the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), but not a pandemic emergency. New Zealand assesses the current risk as low; the main threat is travel to affected countries. Ebola can cause severe illness but is not easily transmitted. WHO is aiding DRC and Uganda to strengthen response, including point-of-entry screening and infection prevention and control measures. There is no recommendation for automatic airport screening of passengers returning from DRC or Uganda. New Zealand maintains existing border screening and traveller checks for unwell arrivals and will continue to monitor the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がDRCのエボラ爆発に注目、ウガンダも
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC指定の確認済みエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRCとウガンダでのエボラ（Bundibugyo virus）アウトブレイクが述べられており、WHO PHEIC指定を確認。New Zealandは発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーでは影響評価国として言及されており、実際の発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストではウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Trump cuts left region 'dangerously exposed' to fatal virus now infecting hundreds: report
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. As of May 20, 2026, WHO reports more than 500 suspected infections and over 100 deaths. The outbreak began in April, and the WHO declared it a public health emergency over the weekend. The epicenter is Ituri, where the IRC notes funding cuts in March 2025 reduced early-warning surveillance and health preparedness in three sections, leaving the region dangerously exposed. The IRC Congo director, Heather Reoch Kerr, says transmission has likely been underway longer than detected due to surveillance lapses, while WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns that the scale and speed of the outbreak are alarming.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏の削減で地域が「致命的ウイルスに危険にさらされている」状態に—数百人が感染中：報道
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大リスク、国際的な懸念）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。WHO緊急事態宣言済みの高リスク状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（ワクチン未承認）によるエボラ出血熱アウトブレーク。500人以上の感染疑い例、100人以上の死亡報告。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。資金削減による監視体制の脆弱化が感染検出遅延につながった可能性。国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola, Uganda Larang Masyarakatnya Jabat Tangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: Uganda Bans Its People From Shaking Hands
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak resurges in Africa, affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. On May 17, the World Health Organization designated the Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In Uganda, two laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, with one death. The two patients are nationals of the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Ugandan Ministry of Health is monitoring outbreak dynamics, and the government has taken preventive measures, including a ban on handshakes to curb transmission. Nile Post, reporting on May 19, notes ongoing monitoring and response efforts. The PHEIC designation signals international concern and mobilization of resources for containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、ウガンダが国民の握手を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC指定した国際的な感染症危機であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事に載っていないためUgandaのGeoNames IDは別途確認（1159151を使用）。DRCとウガンダ両国での確認症例、死亡例あり。WHOによるPHEIC指定（2026年5月17日）で国際的に高い関心。政府による握手禁止などの即時対策実施。

article.articleHeadline: روبيو: ننوي افتتاح 50 عيادة في الكونغو لمعالجة مرضى إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rubio: We plan to open 50 clinics in Congo to treat Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with the World Health Organization reporting 131 deaths as the virus spreads. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced plans to open about 50 clinics to treat Ebola patients in the DRC, supported by roughly $13 million in aid after previous funding cuts. Access to affected areas is described as difficult due to rural, war-torn conditions. Rubio noted that U.S. actions would rely on the CDC and WHO as references, and that WHO had warned about the outbreak’s scope and rapid spread. The article also recalls that former President Donald Trump signed a decree withdrawing the United States from the World Health Organization last year.

triage.headline_ja: ルビオ国務長官：エボラ患者の治療のためコンゴに50の診療所を開設予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的懸念、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ感染症の継続的な流行で131人の死亡報告があり、米国を含む国際的対応が進行中であるため、フルRRA対象として判定。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUSAが含まれているが、サマリーから実際の患者発生はDRCのみで、USAは支援国としての言及のみ。よってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラは高致死率で国際的関心が極めて高く、WHOの警告やUS政府の直接的な支援表明があり、シグナルの優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Diretor-geral da OMS alerta para propagação da epidemia e justifica emergência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Director‑General warns of the spread of the epidemic and justifies the emergency.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared an Ebola emergency under the International Health Regulations (Article 12) after consultations with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The outbreak concentrates in northeastern DRC’s Ituri province with 30 laboratory‑confirmed cases and has spread to Uganda’s capital Kampala, where two confirmed cases and one death occurred among travelers from DRC. Overall there are more than 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths. Urban transmission has been observed in Goma and Bunia (DRC) and Kampala, with health‑care worker deaths signaling nosocomial transmission. The responsible strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there are no licensed vaccines or therapies. WHO has a field team on the ground, mobilizing personnel, supplies and funds; the Contingency Fund for Emergencies has been topped up by about $3.4 million, bringing total allocations to $3.9 million. Denis Mukwege urged M23 rebels to reopen Goma airport to aid the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO事務局長が流行の拡大を警告し、緊急事態を正当化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国への拡大、都市部での人-人感染、WHOによる国際的健康上の危機宣言がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampalaでの症例報告）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOが正式に国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している極めて重大なシグナル。Bundibugyo Ebola virus株でのワクチン・治療法なし、都市部での院内感染と死亡者が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | أميركا تستثني منتخب الكونغو من حظر السفر المرتبط بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States exempts the Congo national team from the Ebola-related travel ban
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, the United States granted an exemption to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) national football team from an Ebola-related travel ban restricting entry for non-U.S. travelers who were in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days. The DRC squad, the only qualifier among the three, had trained in Europe, potentially placing it outside the ban. If players were physically inside the DRC within the last 21 days, they would undergo strict testing and health monitoring, including isolation, mirroring measures for returning U.S. citizens, but not a full ban. The exemption does not apply to Congolese fans traveling to support the team. A senior State Department official said they expect the DRC team to participate in the World Cup and that the protocol will be similar to post-arrival checks.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ関連の渡航禁止からコンゴ代表チームを除外
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病に関連した渡航制限措置であり、IHR基準では国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限に該当するが、本イベントは既存の流行地域における措置の例外適用であり、新規発生や拡大の警告とは異なる。記事サマリーから明確な新規症例発生や流行拡大の兆候が記載されていないため、情報不足を踏まえ経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ流行地域における渡航制限措置の行政的な例外処置に関するもので、新規の疾病発生やアウトブレイク拡大を報告していない。記事にはDRC内の現在の症例数、発生状況についての言及がなく、対象国はDRCのみ。IHR基準は満たすが、新規発生警告ではなく政策ニュースであるため、実際の流行動向を把握するため経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 【國際要聞】剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情現131死，德國接收一名美籍患者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International News: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 131 deaths; Germany receives an American patient.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda are continuing to spread, with the DRC reporting 131 suspected deaths and 513 suspected infections to date. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed concern about the outbreak’s scale and speed. In Germany, at the request of the United States, an American infected with Ebola in the DRC will be evacuated to Berlin for treatment, housed in a dedicated isolation ward separate from routine hospital operations to minimize public risk. German media identify the patient as a physician who contracted the virus while working; six high-risk contacts are also being transported to Germany. Source: Economic Times News Agency. Publication date: 2026-05-20.

triage.headline_ja: 【国際要聞】コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情で131人死亡、ドイツがアメリカ人患者を受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の多国間での報告であり、WHO事務局長による懸念表明がある。フルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク、およびドイツへの患者移送について述べられている。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。Bluedot APIが付与したベルリン、ドイツ、米国の地域情報は記事主題の発生地ではなく、患者搬送先・国籍情報であるため除外した。WHO事務局長による懸念表明により政府・国際機関レベルの関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Gigitan Hewan Rabies Tinggi, Buleleng Kekurangan Dokter Hewan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Rabies Cases from Animal Bites, Buleleng Lacks Veterinarians.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a major threat in Buleleng Regency, Bali, with about 700 dog-bite rabies cases each month amid a shortage of veterinarians. The district has only 21 veterinarians (18 at animal health centers and 3 in related agencies) for an estimated dog population of more than 27,000. Data from the Buleleng Health Office show rabies-related bites (GHPR) averaging 600–700 per month over the past five years; by March 2026, 2,281 such cases were recorded. One death occurred in 2026 after a bite was not reported to health facilities. Officials say the veterinarian shortfall hampers surveillance and vaccination. The area needs at least 36 field veterinarians to cover nine districts, with a plan to be submitted to the central government. Veterinarians also oversee vaccination against foot-and-mouth disease for livestock.

triage.headline_ja: 犬咬傷からの狂犬病患者が多数、ブレレン県では獣医が不足している
triage.triage_reason: バリ州ブレレン県における狂犬病の継続的な高頻度発生（月700件程度）と死亡例の報告、および監視・予防接種体制の不十分さが確認されている。WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）で複数該当し、国内外へのリスク拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は月700件程度の継続的発生、過去5年間平均600～700件、2026年3月末時点で2,281件が記録されている。死亡例（2026年1例確認）も報告されている。獣医師不足（必要36名に対し現在21名）による監視および予防接種体制の脆弱性が指摘されている。また、口蹄疫ワクチンの接種も獣医師が担当していることから、動物衛生上の重要な懸念事項である。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS alerte sur "l'ampleur" de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC, qu...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns about the 'scale' of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, which...
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization warned of the scale and speed of a new Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with 136 deaths and about 543 suspected cases reported. The epicenter is Ituri province, including Bunia and the Rwampara hospital, where MSF says facilities are saturated and care is delivered without adequate protection. The virus is the Bundibugyo strain; there is no vaccine or specific treatment, so containment relies on barrier precautions and rapid case detection. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Several tonnes of equipment have been delivered. In Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu, fronts with M23 impede response; two more suspected cases were reported in Butembo. Uganda reported one death and one case linked to travelers from DRC; no local outbreak. International aid includes US$13 million and World Bank backing; Denis Mukwege urged M23 to reopen Goma airport to speed aid.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行の「規模」について警告、長期化の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の新規流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国への拡大確認、高致死率。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain、ワクチンなし、特異的治療なし。Ituri州が震源地（Bunia、Rwampara病院）。Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kuvuでも確認。ウガンダでも1死亡1症例（DRCからの渡航者関連）。MSFにより医療施設の飽和状態が報告。M23勢力との紛争が対応を阻害。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。国際支援（米国$13百万、世銀）実施中。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC s'efforce de contenir une nouvelle flambée d'Ebola sur fond d'incertitudes sanitaires et de défis sécuritaires (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC Strives to Contain a New Ebola Outbreak Amid Health Uncertainties and Security Challenges (General Paper)
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces a new Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri’s Bunia, with a rapid rise in suspected cases and uncertainty about origin amid no strain-specific vaccine. At Kinshasa, Health Minister Roger Kamba reported 543 suspected cases, 32 confirmed, and 136 suspected deaths. In Bunia, WHO’s Anne Ancia said no patient zero; transmission linked to a May 5 funeral. Genomic sequencing suggests the circulating virus originates from forest, signaling a new introduction rather than resurgence. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; a variant distinct from Uganda 2007 and 2012 Isiro strains. Vaccines: three candidates under study; Ervebo is considered but availability may be limited and cross-protection remains unconfirmed. The region is conflict-affected; refugees in Ituri and Goma require assistance. Confirmed cases also in Butembo and Goma (North Kivu); Uganda reports two imported cases to Kampala, one death. WHO has declared PHEIC for RDC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、保健の不確実性と安全保障上の課題の中でエボラ新規流行を封じ込めるために努力（一般記事）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。エボラ出血熱の新規流行で多くの確認症例と死亡が報告され、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されている。
triage.notes: WHO PHEICが既に宣言されている。ウガンダ（Kampala）への輸入症例もあるが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。新規導入ウイルス株（Bundibugyo ebola virus）、ワクチン利用可能性の不確実性、武装紛争地域での管理の困難さが追加的な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: 콩고·우간다 '에볼라' 바이러스 확산⋯사망자 급증
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus spreads in DR Congo and Uganda; death toll surges.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as the outbreak expands. Cumulative deaths have surpassed 130 and doubled in four days. In DR Congo's Ituri Province, three health zones—Bunia, Lebamba, Mongbalu—report 8 lab-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths by May 16. Two travelers from DR Congo were diagnosed in Kampala within 24 hours, signaling cross-border spread. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV), for which no licensed vaccine exists. Past BDBV outbreaks occurred in 2007–2008 in Uganda (131 cases, 42 deaths) and 2012 in Isiro, DRC (38 cases, 13 deaths). Urgent needs include diagnostics for BDBV, genome sequencing, infection prevention, safe clinical pathways, contact tracing, community engagement, and expansion of treatment centers; sequencing is crucial to define transmission and determine if spread is sustained or due to multiple introductions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・ウガンダ『エボラ』ウイルス拡散⋯死亡者急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOがPHEICを宣言した確認されたエボラ集団発生で、国境を越えた拡大、死亡者の急増（4日間で倍増し130を超過）が報告されており、国際的な懸念を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの両国でのエボラ拡大が記載されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ列挙。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言しており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）による初めての大規模多国間集団発生である点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: WHO lo ngại về "quy mô và tốc độ" của đợt bùng phát Ebola chết người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO is concerned about the "scale and speed" of the deadly Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan) marks the country’s 17th outbreak. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to the outbreak’s scale and speed. As of May 20, 2026, about 513 suspected cases and 131 deaths have been reported, though not all fatalities are laboratory-confirmed as Ebola because testing is limited. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment; WHO is evaluating experimental vaccines and therapies. Ituri has 30 confirmed cases; Uganda reports 2 confirmed cases in Kampala, including a death linked to movement from the DRC. The virus has reached neighboring provinces and Uganda. Africa CDC has declared an Africa-wide public health emergency. The 2018–2020 DRC outbreak killed about 2,300 of ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行規模と速度に懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的懸念事項であり、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ州が主要な発生地。ウガンダで2例の確定例が報告されているが、DRCからの移動に関連した二次感染であり、DRCが主たる流行地。スーダンは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダと南スーダンのみ隣国として言及されており、スーダン自体の症例報告はなし。WHOが国際的懸念事項宣言、アフリカCDCがアフリカ全域公衆衛生緊急事態宣言。ブンディブギョ株、死亡率は極めて高い（131/513=25.5%）。

article.articleHeadline: Globe at a glance: From PM Modi's caricature row to rising Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, Ebola activity intensifies in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 26 more suspected deaths in the past 24 hours, raising outbreak fatalities to 131. Officials report 543 suspected cases and 33 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC, with neighboring Uganda confirming two cases. The data point to an ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in eastern DRC with cross-border risk to Uganda. The article provides counts but offers no detail on transmission chains, symptoms, or infection sources, and does not mention vaccination status. The situation underscores persistent surveillance and investigation needs in the border region as authorities monitor evolving case numbers.

triage.headline_ja: 世界一目：PM モディの風刺画問題からエボラ患者数の急増まで
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な増加、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。エボラアウトブレイクは極めて高優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダで2例の確認が述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCが対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）に含まれるため、DRCのみ検証対象地域として列挙。高い致死率、急速な症例増加（24時間で26例の疑い死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境事例）が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient in Berliner Charité aufgenommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient admitted to Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected American has been admitted to Berlin’s Charité in the university hospital’s specialized isolation station on the Virchow-Klinikum campus. The patient contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak is expanding, and was transported to Germany after U.S. authorities requested help due to the shorter flight time. The transfer from Uganda used a specially equipped aircraft for highly infectious patients, with the patient moved in a protected vehicle and escorted by police, fire services, and ambulances, arriving shortly before 03:00. Charité’s isolation unit is a closed, segregated facility separate from regular hospital operations to prevent contact with other patients. German Health Minister Nina Warken stated Germany’s readiness and capability to treat highly infectious diseases and thanked those involved in transport and care. Ebola transmits via close contact and body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのシャリテ病院にエボラ患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた症例報告は重大シグナルであり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ベルリンはドイツであり対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。DRCでのエボラ流行中に米国民患者がドイツに国際輸送された重大イベント。高度な感染対策施設での治療だが、国際的な伝播リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo races to contain Ebola as death toll hits 136
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri province has 543 suspected cases, 32 laboratory-confirmed, and 136 deaths as of May 19, 2026. Origin remains unclear: Bunia May 5 death linked to Mongbwalu funeral exposure; sequencing indicates a forest-origin Bundibugyo virus variant, not a resurgence. No specific vaccine exists; Ervebo (Zaire Ebola) is under consideration, with three candidate vaccines under review, though effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unconfirmed. Response focuses on rapid detection, isolation, health-worker protection, and safe burials, amid community resistance. The outbreak unfolds in a fragile setting: 11,000 South Sudanese refugees in Ituri require preventive aid; 2,000+ Rwandan/Burundian refugees in Goma need supplies. Confirmed cases in Butembo and Goma (North Kivu); Goma’s control by M23 hampers surveillance and sample transport. Uganda reports two imported cases in Kampala (one death); Rwanda has border restrictions; WHO declared PHEIC for DRC/Uganda; Africa CDC cites continental security implications.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ熱の封じ込めに急ぐ、死亡者数136人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多数の死亡者（136人）、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ、ルワンダへの波及確認）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、アフリカ大陸での安全保障上の懸念があり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（森林由来）の確認により新規の脅威。ウガンダでの輸入症例2例（死亡1例）、ルワンダの国境制限措置が確認されている。東アフリカ地域での難民人口（南スーダン11,000人、ルワンダ/ブルンジ2,000人以上）がリスク増加要因。M23による支配地域での監視体制の脆弱性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 美, '52년만의 월드컵 본선' 민주콩고에 '에볼라 입국금지' 예외
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US grants DR Congo an exception to the Ebola entry ban for its first World Cup finals in 52 years.
article.articleSummary: US grants the Democratic Republic of Congo an Ebola-entry ban exception for its first FIFA World Cup finals in 52 years. While Washington has barred foreign entrants who have spent up to 21 days in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan amid ongoing Ebola outbreaks, a State Department official said the DRC squad may participate. The team will base in Houston ahead of their group-stage opener vs Portugal and will travel between the United States and Mexico for matches. Any team members who previously spent 21 days in DRC will face the same strict quarantine on returning as other Americans. General fans remain subject to the Ebola entry ban. As of May 19, DRC reports 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 deaths; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, triggering international response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、52年ぶりのワールドカップ本戦出場の民主コンゴに『エボラ入国禁止』の例外措置を許可
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラウイルス病の継続的な流行（513例の疑似患者、131死亡）と、WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）によりIHR基準を複数満たす。国際的な人的移動と関連する懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行に関する米国の入国禁止例外措置についての報道。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。Houston（米国）、Portugal（ポルトガル）、Mexico（メキシコ）は対象国でないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、既にグローバル保健の対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Jalisco se blinda por alerta de ébola; refuerza filtros sanitarios en aeropuertos y puertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jalisco tightens up in response to Ebola alert; strengthens health screenings at airports and ports.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, Jalisco strengthens health screenings at airports and ports to detect suspected Ebola cases, focusing on travelers from African regions. State Health Secretary Héctor Raúl Pérez Gómez said enhanced staffing, expanded screening, and isolation protocols will be implemented. International authorities flag the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as concerns, with the Congolese government reporting 116 suspected deaths and at least 350 suspected cases; outbreaks spreading to Katwa and Nyankunde raise fears of spread in densely populated areas. The World Health Organization warns that sustained human mobility could fuel new transmission if controls are not in place. Surveillance will be tightened for Mexicans returning from Africa with compatible symptoms, and two public hospitals in Jalisco will be designated to treat Ebola-related patients. Symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pain, and bleeding; transmission is via bodily fluids, not airborne. Authorities urge immediate medical care after travel to risk zones.

triage.headline_ja: ジャリスコ州がエボラ警報に対応を強化；空港と港での健康スクリーニング検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生し、350例以上の疑い患者と116人の死亡が報告されている。国際的な拡大リスク（メキシコでの警戒態勢強化）が明確であり、IHR基準の3項目（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域に複数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は：(1) DRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生が主要イベント、(2) メキシコ（ジャリスコ州）は対応措置を講じているにすぎず、実際の発生地ではない。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実発生地として確認される。メキシコは対象国に含まれていないため除外。116人の死亡と350例以上の疑い患者という重篤な状況、密集地域（Katwa、Nyankunde）への拡大報告、WHOによる国際的な懸念表明が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: متحدث الصحة في مصر: بلادنا خالية تماما من إيبولا واتخذنا إجراءات مشددة لمواجهته (فيديو)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Egypt's health spokesperson: Our country is completely Ebola-free and we have taken stringent measures to confront it (Video).
article.articleSummary: Egypt’s health spokesperson Dr. Hossam Abdel Ghaffar said Egypt is Ebola-free and has instituted strict border measures with the World Health Organization to prevent spillover and detect suspected cases early. He said Ebola spreads only by direct contact with bodily fluids of a symptomatic person and is not airborne; fever is an early sign. Health workers are most at risk. Egypt will not impose travel restrictions due to lack of evidence that travelers spread the virus. Measures focus on heightened readiness at ports, airports, and maritime entries, with immediate entry denial for anyone suspected of infection. The statements come as the Congo outbreak prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Uganda reported two confirmed cases in Kampala, including one death among two travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; an American citizen was infected and moved to Germany. Counts will evolve with expanded surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エジプト保健スポークスマン：我が国はエボラウイルス感染症が完全に排除されており、これに対抗するための厳格な措置を講じている（ビデオ）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は IHR2005 Annex2 の4基準をすべて満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での感染例、渡航制限リスク）。DRC、ウガンダで確認事例があり、WPRO スクリーニング基準も複数該当する高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ発症地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。ウガンダでも2症例確認と記載されているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。エジプトはこれら地域からの流入に対する予防措置を講じている状況。WHO による Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) が既に宣言されており、高リスクシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını yayılıyor | Afrika Haberleri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading | Africa News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached dangerous proportions. In Ituri province’s Nyankunde region, the outbreak has killed 118 people, with total cases at 435 as of May 20, 2026. The virus has also affected North Kivu province’s Katwa region, where two confirmed cases have been reported, and the provincial capital Goma records one case. The Ituri outbreak’s re-emergence is cited by government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya, who noted the spread across Nyankunde, Katwa, and Goma. The African Union Commission Chair has called for a continent-wide, united effort to combat the virus, underscoring the urgent need for coordinated public health response in the face of the expanding outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大している | アフリカニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤で予想外の国際流行リスク、死者118人・感染者435人は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、複数州での拡大と国際的な懸念の高まり。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、複数地域での症例確認、アフリカ連合委員会長による大陸規模の対応呼びかけなど、極めて高いリスク状況。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라바이러스병 '관심' 단계 발령...시흥시, 해외여행 시 주의 당부
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease declared at 'Watch' level... Siheung City urges caution for overseas travel.
