article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is currently flagged at a Watch/Attention level in Siheung City, South Korea, amid ongoing outbreaks in Africa. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17 due to clusters in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with South Sudan also a focus. From May 19, Korea designated the Congo DR, Uganda, and South Sudan as Focused Quarantine Management Areas, strengthening entry screening. Domestic risk is considered low, but vigilance remains essential. EVD is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted via contact with blood or body fluids of infected animals or people; incubation up to 21 days, with fever, headache, myalgia, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and unexplained bleeding as key symptoms. Preventive advice includes strict hygiene, avoiding contact with sick individuals and wildlife or animal carcasses, avoiding cave exploration, and refraining from sexual contact in affected regions. Returning travelers must report via Q-CODE or health questionnaire; if symptoms develop within 21 days, report to KDCA at 1339 or Siheung Public Health Center.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病『注意』段階発令...始興市、海外渡航時の注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では3項目（serious_impact、unusual_unexpected、international_spread）に該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した主要な感染症イベントであり、対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での継続的な感染症流行に対する国境検疫強化が実施されている。
triage.notes: 韓国での『注意』段階発令は国内リスクが低いとされているため、記事の主題イベントはDRCおよびウガンダでの流行である。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言を行った重大な公衆衛生イベント。

article.articleHeadline: 시흥시, 에볼라바이러스병 '관심' 단계 발령
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Siheung City Issues Ebola Virus Disease 'Interest' Level
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola virus disease (EVD) persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, prompting WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Siheung City, South Korea, raised an 'Interest' level and activated an Ebola response team; Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency tightened entry screening for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan from May 19. Domestic risk is low, but vigilance remains high. EVD is an acute febrile, hemorrhagic illness transmitted via contact with blood or body fluids of infected animals (bats, monkeys, chimpanzees) or people; incubation up to 21 days. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and unexplained bleeding. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, avoid contact with sick individuals and wildlife, avoid animal blood or meat, avoid cave exposure, and mask in healthcare settings. Returning travelers should report health status via Q-CODE or health questionnaires and seek care if fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding develops within 21 days; contact KCDC at 1339 or Siheung Public Health Center.

triage.headline_ja: 水原市、エボラウイルス病「関心」段階を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言、DRC・ウガンダでの流行継続、韓国の検査強化と対応チーム激活、ヒト-ヒト感染の特性から国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが韓国（Gyeonggi-do、Siheung、Republic of Korea）を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーは韓国での実際の流行を示しておらず、むしろDRC・ウガンダでの流行に対する韓国の対応・警戒強化を述べている。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。南スーダン（Sudan）も記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 강북구, 말라리아 예방 안심키트 지원...위험지역 방문 구민 대상 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gangbuk District provides malaria-prevention reassurance kits to residents who visited high-risk areas - Shin A Ilbo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, Gangbuk District in Seoul launched the Malaria Prevention Peace of Mind Kit Support to help residents planning to visit malaria-risk areas. The program provides 200 free kits to Gangbuk residents and risk-area workers, including domestic sites in parts of Seoul and Incheon, northern Gyeonggi Province, and parts of Gangwon, plus overseas regions in Cambodia, India, Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, and parts of Peru. Each six-item kit contains a preventive guidance leaflet, liquid mosquito coil, mosquito repellent, mosquito patch, arm sleeves, and disinfectant wipes to enable safer outdoor activities and travel. Applications open on May 20 via the Gangbuk-gu Office website; applicants submit an application form, personal data consent, ID copy, and travel or work verification, then receive SMS notification if eligible to collect the kit at Gangbuk Public Health Center. Mayor Lee Soon-hee emphasized rising malaria risk with climate change and urged caution when visiting high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: 江北区、マラリア予防安心キット支援...危険地域訪問住民対象
triage.triage_reason: マラリアリスク地域への渡航住民向けの予防啓発・キット配布プログラムであり、感染症の実際の流行や異常な発生の報告ではない。国内の予防対策イニシアチブに過ぎず、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国ソウルの江北区が実施する予防啓発プログラムの報道であり、実際のマラリア流行やアウトブレイク報告ではない。記事中に患者数、入院者数、死亡者数等の具体的な発生データはなく、あくまで渡航者向けの予防キット配布である。verified_locations には記事で言及された対象国リスト内の国のみを記載したが、これらはプログラムの対象地域であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Why the new Ebola outbreak has put global health experts on alert again
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Eight laboratory-confirmed cases reported so far, with more than 80 suspected deaths under investigation in affected areas. Bundibugyo is rarer than the Zaire strain, and there is no approved vaccine specifically for it, complicating containment as vaccines to date largely target Zaire. Transmission remains by direct contact with infected blood or body fluids, contaminated equipment, or unsafe caregiving and burial practices, not airborne. The outbreak likely originated in eastern Congo’s mining districts and has spread across vulnerable border regions; silent transmission weeks before detection raises concern about wider spread. Healthcare workers are increasingly infected, threatening health systems and routine care in overcrowded facilities, refugee settings, and conflict zones. Early symptoms resemble common viral illnesses, hindering rapid case finding.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ出血熱の流行が世界の保健専門家を再び警戒状態に置いている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症の国際的公衆衛生上の脅威が明確。WHO が国際的懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した重大な事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当するため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、ワクチン非対応株（Bundibugyo株）の出現、医療従事者感染、境界地域での拡大リスク、検出前の無症候伝播など、複数の重大リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: 世足賽／美豁免伊波拉入境禁令 剛果民主共和國進軍世界盃 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup / US waives Ebola entry ban as the Democratic Republic of the Congo advances to the World Cup
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, United States officials announced an Ebola-related exemption allowing the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) football team to travel to the United States for the World Cup, despite a travel ban tied to the Ebola outbreak. The ban previously barred non-U.S. citizens who had been in Ebola-affected areas in the prior 21 days, including the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The DRC team is the only among these three to qualify for the tournament and has trained in Europe, making them eligible for the exemption. Players who had visited the DRC within the 21-day window would undergo stringent screening similar to returning U.S. citizens, not outright entry denial. The exemption does not extend to ordinary DRC fans. This marks the DRC’s second World Cup qualification since 1974.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ／米国がエボラ入国禁止令を免除 コンゴ民主共和国がワールドカップに進出
triage.triage_reason: エボラの新規発生イベントではなく、既存のエボラ関連渡航規制の行政的な免除措置に関する報道。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、管理可能性の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ発生への行政対応（ワールドカップに向けた渡航禁止令の免除）を報じたもので、新規の感染症イベントではない。DRCでのエボラ発生自体の進展ではなく、スポーツイベント関連の政策決定に関するニュース。シグナルとしてはピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: How to Prevent Hantavirus Infection From Rats at Home
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus is a deadly disease transmitted to humans via airborne particles from infected rodents (mice, rats, bats) through urine, feces, or saliva. There is no cure or vaccine, and humans have no natural immunity. In Bandung, Hasan Sadikin General Hospital microbiology specialist Dr. Leonardus Widyatmoko urges interrupting transmission by avoiding risky actions such as sweeping dry rodent droppings and careless disposal of rat carcasses; using disinfectants (chlorine or alcohol) and PPE (gloves, masks). Before cleaning, ventilate for 30 minutes. At-risk workers include forestry workers, old-building cleaners, and drainage workers; post-flood periods increase rodent intrusion into homes. Preventive measures at homes/offices include sealing holes, traps, and protecting food. Clinical signs vary by type: HFRS (Hantaan, Dobrava, Saarema, Seoul, Puumala) in Europe/Asia (including Indonesia) with kidney disorders; HPS (Andes, Sin Nombre) in the Americas, with Andes capable of human-to-human transmission and a recent three-death cruise from Argentina to Spain.

triage.headline_ja: 自宅でネズミからハンタウイルス感染を防ぐ方法
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染は重症度が高く異常な病原体だが、記事は予防啓発が主体で新規発生地の特定が不明確。アルゼンチンからスペイン間の船舶発生が言及されているが、対象国ではなく情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではバンドン（インドネシア）での医学的啓発が中心。アルゼンチン・スペイン間の3死亡クルーズ事例が言及されているが、これらは対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めない。インドネシアでの現在の流行状況の具体的な症例数や拡大状況が不明のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Alarm in Berlin: US-Bürger mit hoch ansteckendem Virus in Charité behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alarm in Berlin: U.S. citizen with a highly contagious virus treated at Charité.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola is being treated in Germany at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin. The patient arrived in Berlin overnight and is treated on Charité's specialized isolation ward at the Campus Virchow-Klinikum, a unit designed for extremely contagious and potentially fatal infections. The Ebola case involves an infection acquired in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where an outbreak is currently ongoing. Transfer from Uganda was organized because of the shorter flight distance to Germany, using a dedicated aircraft and a security escort by police, fire and rescue services; the convoy arrived just before 3 a.m. Berlin time. Health Minister Nina Warken confirmed Germany's support for its partners and that the patient will receive the highest safety precautions and comprehensive care. Ebola spreads via direct contact with body fluids of infected people.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのエボラ警報：高度に感染性の高いウイルスに感染した米国市民がシャリテで治療中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的移送事例。DRCでの流行中の患者がドイツに搬送され、IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な健康影響、異常/予想外の国際移送、国際的拡大リスク）。また管理可能性の懸念と社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは患者がDRCで感染した後、ウガンダ経由でドイツに搬送された事例である。Bluedotで検出された発生地域にはベルリン・ドイツが含まれるが、実際のエボラ流行はDRCで継続中であり、ドイツは医療対応国。verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。高度な感染症危機管理が必要で、国際的なシグナルとして重要度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: México activa alerta de viaje por brote de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico activates travel advisory due to Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mexico's Health Secretariat activates a travel advisory amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the World Health Organization raising the alert to the highest level after 131 suspected deaths and over 500 probable cases in Congo and Uganda. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant drives rapid spread; transmission occurs via contact with infected secretions (blood, saliva) and is not airborne. Early flu-like symptoms can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, renal and hepatic failure, with a fatality rate around 50%. No approved specific treatment or vaccine exists. Laboratory delays occurred when initial tests at Ituri failed to detect Bundibugyo due to reagent shortages; confirmation came after samples were sequenced in Kinshasa. Urban transmission has been noted in Kampala and Goma, with healthcare workers among the fatalities. The SSA notes travel risk based on exposure; authorities provide medical guidelines. The advisory arrives ahead of Congo’s World Cup matches, including June 23, 2026 against Colombia.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがコンゴのエボラ熱の流行により渡航警報を発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ熱は極めて深刻な公衆衛生影響（致死率約50%、131人の疑い死亡、500件以上の例）を有し、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの既存の拡大、複数国での都市伝播）と渡航・貿易制限の懸念（メキシコが渡航警報を発動、コンゴのワールドカップ関連）がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでのエボラ熱の流行とウガンダへの既存拡大に焦点を当てている。メキシコは渡航警報の発動国であり、コロンビアはワールドカップ関連の背景情報に過ぎず、実際の発生国ではない。ウガンダは記事に記載があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる急速な拡大、都市伝播の確認、医療従事者への影響、ワールドカップイベント前の発生など、多重のリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Umumkan Wabah Ebola Jadi Darurat Internasional, Mungkinkah Masuk RI? Ini Kata Pakar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola Outbreak an International Emergency; Could It Reach Indonesia? Experts Say.
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), though not a global pandemic. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. DRC officials report 131 deaths among 513 cases; the US CDC notes two confirmed Ebola cases and one death in Uganda. Ebola spreads through close contact with infected bodily fluids and is not airborne, with transmission occurring relatively slowly. The risk of spread to Indonesia is assessed as low to medium, primarily via international travel, migrant workers, seafarers, or business travelers, and potentially undetected cases. Indonesia is urged to strengthen entry screening at airports and ports, monitor migrant and pilgrimage travel, and ensure health facilities and laboratories are prepared, including verifying 21-day travel histories and absence of fever, bleeding, or known contact with cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の流行を国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言。インドネシアへの侵入の可能性は？専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大、国際的に懸念される疾患（エボラ）であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCとウガンダを中心としたエボラ流行であり、インドネシアへの潜在的リスク評価が含まれている。米国はBluedot APIで抽出されているが、記事サマリーでは米国での患者は言及されておらず、対象国リストにも米国は含まれないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言は国際的に最高レベルの警告であり、即座にフルRRA対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Belum Ada Pengobatan Spesifik untuk Hantavirus, Pemkot Jogja Terbitkan Surat Edaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no specific treatment for Hantavirus; the Yogyakarta City Government issues a circular.
article.articleSummary: Yogyakarta City authorities remind residents to stay vigilant for possible Hantavirus transmission, noting no hantavirus cases in Yogyakarta this year to date. The City Government has issued a Mayor's Circular on Awareness of Leptospirosis and Hantavirus and updated clinical guidance on leptospirosis and hantavirus for physicians and health workers. Cross-program and cross-sector coordination was strengthened, with each community health clinic (puskesmas) ordered to intensify public outreach. There is no specific antiviral treatment for hantavirus; management remains symptomatic and supportive. Fatal hantavirus cases typically involve co-infections rather than hantavirus alone. Data from the Yogyakarta Health Office indicate the disease's record is very minimal in the city. Emphasis on prevention is pivotal to reduce risk despite the absence of confirmed cases so far this year.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスに対する特異的治療はない。ジョグジャカルタ市政府が通知を発行
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジョグジャカルタ）でハンタウイルスとレプトスピラ症の啓発活動が行われているが、現在のところ確認された症例がなく、予防的措置の段階である。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はジョグジャカルタ市が啓発・予防措置を実施している内容であり、現在までのところ確認症例がない段階。ハンタウイルスとレプトスピラ症は人獣共通感染症として流行可能性を持つため、今後の発生状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Larang Warga Jabat Tangan, Khawatir Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Bans Citizens from Shaking Hands, Worried About the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Two laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been detected in Uganda, with one death. Both patients are nationals of the Democratic Republic of Congo. In response, Uganda's Ministry of Health has banned handshakes and other greeting practices to curb transmission. On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization designated the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The Democratic Republic of Congo has reported 131 Ebola-related deaths to date, with the earlier outbreak there ending in October 2025. The Ugandan outbreak underscores cross-border transmission risk and the need for vigilant surveillance and containment measures. Details on the infection source or exposure context were not provided.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ流行を懸念して国民の握手を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC指定、複数国での検査確定例と死亡例、国際的な越境伝播リスク、公開衛生上の深刻な影響が認められ、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラはDRCおよびウガンダで発生が確認されている。DRCはGeoNames ID 203312で対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の主題として越境伝播事例として明記されているため技術上の注記とする。評価上、DRCのみを verified_locations に含めるべき点も考慮されたが、主流の感染症危機管理慣行に基づき、WHO PHEIC指定と複数国確定例の重要性からDRCとウガンダの両国を検証済みとした。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെ​ങ്കി​പ്പ​നി പ​ട​രു​ന്നു; 391 പേ​ർ​ക്ക് രോ​ഗം സ്ഥി​രീ​ക​രി​ച്ചു | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever has spread; the disease has stabilized in 391 people | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News.
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026: In Kollam district, dengue fever has spread with 391 confirmed cases and one death; 59 new cases were reported up to the 17th of this month. The outbreak spans Kollam Corporation areas, including Mayyanad, with poor sanitation cited as a key driver. Aedes aegypti breeding has been intensified by recent high temperatures; a 1°C rise is estimated to raise dengue risk by about 13%. Ongoing intermittent monsoon rains are aiding transmission. Dengue patients exhibit reduced platelets; routine blood tests are advised. Normal platelets range 150,000–450,000 per microliter; hospitalization is advised if platelets fall below 50,000. Prevention emphasizes sanitation, eliminating standing water, covering water storage tanks and containers, destroying larvae, and releasing guppy fish. Indoor use of mosquito coils is recommended. The monsoon may raise risks of waterborne diseases like diarrhea, cholera, and typhoid; drink only boiled water.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が蔓延；391人の患者が確認された | Deepika | インドの最大級マラヤーラム語インターネット日刊紙 | オンラインニュース
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラム州で確認されたデング熱の集団発生（391例、1例の死亡）。密度の高い人口、衛生不十分、蚊媒介感染の特性により流行しやすく、複数のWPRO基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はケーラム州（インド）でのデング熱集団発生を報告。391例の確認例と1例の死亡がある。記事はコレラとチフスについても言及しているが、これらは将来の可能性（モンスーン後）として述べられており、現在の集団発生の主題はデング熱。ケーラム州はインドの対象国に含まれるため verified_locations は India のみ。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情131死！美國、巴林禁3國旅客入境　WHO列緊急事件 | ETtoday國際新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 131 deaths in the Congo Ebola outbreak! United States and Bahrain ban travelers from three countries from entering; WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a severe Ebola outbreak with 131 deaths and 543 suspected, 33 confirmed cases; Uganda has 2 confirmed cases, and Butembo city reported its first two confirmed on the 18th. The Bundibugyo strain has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO Director-General Tedros before an emergency committee meeting. Testing capacity is severely limited (about 6 tests per hour), slowing case identification. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, with an estimated ~50% fatality rate; no approved antivirals or vaccines for Bundibugyo currently, though Merck’s Ervebo vaccine candidate may become available in about two months. A U.S. missionary, Peter Stafford, tested positive and is treated in Germany with six others; the U.S. CDC has mobilized $13 million to respond and to establish 50 rural Ebola treatment clinics. The U.S. bans entry for travelers who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days for 30 days; Bahrain imposes a one-month entry ban for travelers from these three countries. Rwanda reports attempted crossings by Congolese; ongoing international coordination and funding concerns persist.

triage.headline_ja: 剛果伊波拉疫情131死！美國、巴林禁3國旅客入境　WHO列緊急事件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生、WHO緊急事態宣言、複数国への国際的な拡大、米国・バーレーンによる渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: DRC東部での大規模エボラ発生（131死、543疑い例、33確定例）。Bundibugyo株。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。ウガンダでも2例確定、米国でも1例報告。米国・バーレーンが渡航制限実施。検査能力不足が対応の課題。ワクチン・治療薬の供給不足が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: '치사율 90%' 에볼라 변종 공포...나흘 만에 사망자 2배 폭증 - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: '90% Case Fatality Rate' Ebola Variant Fear... Death Toll Doubles in Four Days - Sisa Journal
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is attributed to the Bundibugyo variant, with 131 deaths and 543 suspected cases as of May 19, 2026; 33 cases are laboratory-confirmed. The report cites a feared 90% case-fatality rate for this Bundibugyo variant. In four days, deaths more than doubled as the virus spread beyond the initial Ituri province into North Kivu (Goma and Butembo) and South Kivu, with two additional infections confirmed in Uganda among people linked to the DRC outbreak. The Bundibugyo variant has no licensed vaccine or proven therapy; containment relies on patient isolation and supportive care. Diagnostic capacity in DRC is strained, reportedly around six tests per hour, delaying accurate situational awareness. The WHO declared an International Public Health Emergency on May 19, 2026. This marks the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976; the 2018–2020 outbreak killed about 2,300 people.

triage.headline_ja: 「致死率90%」エボラ変種の恐怖...4日間で死亡者が2倍に急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO International Public Health Emergency宣言済み。致死率90%、わずか4日で死亡者が2倍増加、複数州への急速な地域拡大、ワクチン・治療法未開発の危機的状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの感染例にも言及しているが、サマリーの主題・詳細はDRCに集中しており、ウガンダは「DRC関連の二次的感染」として記載されている。DRCが対象国(GeoNames ID 203312)であるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため除外。WHO公式宣言済みで重大度は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué es el ébola y cómo se transmite? Explicación de nueva alerta internacional por brote en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Ebola and how is it transmitted? Explanation of a new international alert in response to an outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompted the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In the DRC, 131 deaths and 531 suspected cases have been reported, including four health workers. Ebola spreads from wildlife to humans and between people via direct contact with infected bodily fluids (urine, saliva, sweat, feces, vomiting, semen), and exposure to infected animals or bats. Early symptoms are fever, muscle and joint pain, headache, weakness, and sore throat; progression can include bleeding, gastrointestinal symptoms, and organ failure. There is no internationally approved cure; care is supportive. Two vaccines (Ervebo and Zabdeno) are approved for prevention, with vaccines against Sudan and Bundibugyo strains in development. WHO did not impose travel restrictions but urged enhanced surveillance, preparedness, and information sharing. Historically, fatality averages around 50% (range 25–90%), with the 2014 West Africa outbreak at about 71%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱とは何か、どのように感染するのか？アフリカでの流行に対する新たな国際的警告の説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確認済みのエボラ熱流行。DRC、ウガンダでの複数国流行、高い致死率、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、国際的拡大懸念があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）とウガンダでの流行が明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているがサマリー上で具体的な発生の記載がないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、531人の疑い患者、131人の死亡（致死率≒25%）、医療従事者4名の感染が報告されている。ワクチン有、ただしスーダン株・ブンディブギョ株ワクチンは開発中。国際社会の懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲2國爆伊波拉病毒疫情 赴非民眾應提高警覺 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in two African countries; travelers to Africa should be on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the WHO on May 17, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; there is currently no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Incubation can reach 21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, vomiting, and diarrhea, with possible severe bleeding. Cross-border transmission to Uganda has been reported, and outbreaks are reaching densely populated urban areas, complicating control. Domestic risk remains low, but international travel advisories have been elevated; travelers to affected areas should strengthen protection, avoid contact with patients, corpses, wildlife, and unknown meat, and practice hand hygiene and masking. Returnees within 21 days who develop symptoms should seek medical care promptly and disclose travel/exposure history. Taiwan’s health authorities advise vigilance for travelers and monitoring for 21 days post-travel.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ2カ国でエボラウイルス疫情が発生 アフリカ渡航者は警戒を高めるべき
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症のPHEIC宣言、複数国での流行、国際的拡大リスク、高い死亡率が確認された。スクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づきDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。台湾は発生地ではなく報道地点のため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・特異的治療なし、21日の潜伏期、都市部への拡大、国際的渡航勧告の引き上げなど重大な感染症危機の特徴をすべて示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola doctor warns outbreak is 'much bigger' than public think
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is larger than official figures, with the health ministry reporting more than 130 deaths and over 500 suspected cases. An American citizen exposed while working in DR Congo has tested positive and been flown to Germany for treatment, currently in isolation at Berlin's Charité hospital. Dr. Craig Spencer, an American physician and former epidemiologist with Doctors Without Borders, told ABC News the outbreak is much bigger than numbers indicate. He noted past experience in Guinea in 2015 and offered to help. The report ties the outbreak to U.S. and WHO dynamics: President Trump's withdrawal from the WHO is described as leaving the U.S. ill-equipped; the U.S. pledged about £9.7 million (USD 13 million) to build around 50 treatment centres in DR Congo. The WHO reportedly lost about 2,000 staff (roughly a quarter of its workforce) since the pullout.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ医師が「発生状況は公表されているより大きい」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病のDRC発生に加え、米国市民の感染と国際移送、複数国への懸念が示唆されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBerlin, Germany, US, Guineaが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ発生。米国市民の感染と治療のためドイツ（ベルリン）への移送は二次的で、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WHO資金縮小や米国の対応に関する政治的背景も含まれており、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak: Hundreds Of Suspected Cases, No Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 500+ suspected cases and about 130 suspected deaths, with only 30 confirmed so far. The outbreak began in Ituri’s Bunia and has spread to North Kivu (Butembo, Goma); Uganda reports two imported cases. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. No vaccine or therapeutics exist for Bundibugyo virus; candidate vaccines are under evaluation, with Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) considered but not expected to be available for about two months. Initial Bunia tests for the Zaire strain were negative; Kinshasa labs later confirmed Bundibugyo. A potential source traces to a May 5 death in Bunia and a funeral event. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, diarrhea, vomiting, with nosebleeds starting around day five. Response includes >40 WHO staff on the ground and expanded diagnostic capacity, plus emphasis on community engagement to curb transmission. Ituri and North Kivu host over two million displaced people; refugees in Ituri and Goma require sanitation support; the 2018–19 outbreak trauma persists.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ感染症流行：数百の疑似患者、ワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際懸念事項として公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。500例以上の疑似患者、高い致命率（130/500＝26%）、複数国への拡大（DRC＋ウガンダ）が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクで、Zaire株用のErveboワクチンでは対応不可。200万人以上の国内避難民が存在する地域での発生により、複雑な人道的状況に直面。ウガンダへの越境感染（2例）も確認されているが、記事サマリー上ウガンダは主題ではなくDRCが主要な発生地。

article.articleHeadline: 防伊波拉疫情 巴林禁民主剛果等3國旅客入境 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent an Ebola outbreak, Bahrain bans entry of travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and three other countries | United News Network
article.articleSummary: Bahrain imposed a 30-day entry ban on non-Bahraini travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda, effective immediately, with Bahraini citizens exempt. The restriction also covers travelers who have visited any of these countries within the prior 30 days. The measure targets the ongoing Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak centered in these nations. The World Health Organization is convening an emergency committee to discuss the outbreak. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention has designated the DRC- and Uganda-linked EVD situation as an Africa Public Health Emergency. As of the latest figures, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases, while Uganda has recorded 1 death. The ban reflects heightened border controls amid the regional EVD outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大防止のため、バーレーンがコンゴ民主共和国など3カ国からの旅客の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域流行であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外（複数国での同時流行）」「国際拡大リスク（バーレーンが渡航制限を実施）」に該当。さらにWPRO基準でも「重症度（死亡例あり）」「流行しやすさ（多数の疑い例）」「管理可能性（WHOが緊急委員会開催）」に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみが対象国に該当。バーレーンはコンゴ民主共和国、南スーダン、ウガンダからの渡航制限を実施しており、国際的な拡大リスクが明確。

article.articleHeadline: 驻卢旺达使馆提醒在卢中国公民注意防范埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chinese Embassy in Rwanda reminds Chinese citizens in Rwanda to take precautions against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province reports multiple suspected, confirmed, and fatal cases; the World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Rwanda currently has no confirmed cases, but authorities have intensified border screening and vigilance along the DRC border. Ebola spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids of people or animals; incubation 2–21 days, with early symptoms including high fever, fatigue, headache and muscle pains, potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, rash, bleeding, and organ failure. The Chinese Embassy in Rwanda cautions Chinese citizens to monitor outbreak updates, avoid high-risk areas, refrain from contact with confirmed or suspected cases and high-risk animals, minimize unnecessary travel, and seek medical care if symptoms occur. Emergency contacts: Rwanda +250-112; MOFA hotlines +86-10-12308 / +86-10-65612308; Embassy Kigali +250-784825635; kigali@csm.mfa.gov.cn.

triage.headline_ja: ルワンダ駐在中国大使館、ルワンダ在住中国国民にエボラ疫情への対策強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスによる発生でIHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言済みで国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: DRC Ituri州でのエボラ流行が主題。ルワンダは地理的に隣接し防疫措置を強化中だが、記事サマリーではルワンダに確診例がないため verified_locations に含めない。中国大使館による公式警告により社会政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Pasien Hantavirus di RSHS Meninggal, Ini Faktanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus-Infected Patient at RSHS Dies, Here Are the Facts.
article.articleSummary: Bandung, Indonesia: A fatal hantavirus case at Hasan Sadikin Hospital (RSHS Bandung) in 2025 was confirmed as hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS), not hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) linked to Andes virus. Officials clarified the Bandung death is unrelated to the MV Hondius events, where Andes virus is being monitored at RSPI Sulianti Saroso. Andes virus, which causes HPS, is associated with high mortality (up to about 60%) and is more common in the Americas; HFRS predominates in Asia and Europe, including Indonesia, with mortality roughly 5–15%. The report notes HPS results from rodent contact, and that Andes virus is the only hantavirus with documented human-to-human transmission. No connection is indicated between the Bandung case and the MV Hondius outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: RSHS（ハサン・サディキン病院）のハンタウイルス患者が死亡、事実はこれだ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで確認されたハンタウイルス関連の致死例が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（重症度・異常性）に該当するが、当該事例は既知の疾患で国内で管理可能とみられ、国際的拡大のリスクについて情報不足。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはバンドン（インドネシア）での2025年の致死例（HFRS）を主題としており、インドネシア国内で確認されたハンタウイルス感染症。同時にMV Hondius事象でのAndes virus監視が言及されているが、両者は無関係と明記されている。Canary IslandsおよびSpainは発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリー上では主題ではないため除外。HFRS（アジア・ヨーロッパ型）であり、致死率5-15%、現在のところ国内管理可能と判断されるが、Andes virusのヒト-ヒト感染特性に関する記述があり、今後の情報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Pandeglang Perketat Pengawasan Hewan Kurban demi Cegah PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pandeglang Regency Government Tightens Monitoring of Sacrificial Animals to Prevent Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD)
article.articleSummary: Pandeglang Regency tightens surveillance of sacrificial animals ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026 to curb foot-and-mouth disease (PMK) and anthrax amid rising livestock inflows from outside the region. The Agriculture and Food Security Service (DPKP) conducts mass health inspections across 35 subdistrict markets from May 18–26, 2026, deploying 28 staff in seven teams, including nine veterinarians. In addition to physical examinations, animals from outside must present a valid health certificate (SKKH) to enter Pandeglang. Inspections cover large ruminants (cattle, buffalo) and small ruminants (goats, sheep); staff offer on-site first aid and stock vitamin and medicine support. Officials warn swift spread of PMK and anthrax, with anthrax being zoonotic. Past years reported nonfatal, non-human-transmitting issues like conjunctivitis, orf, diarrhea, and flu; traders must comply with health-document procedures to prevent outbreaks and protect farmers and residents.

triage.headline_ja: パンデグラン県政府、豚コレラ予防のための犠牲動物の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける口蹄疫と炭疽病の予防的監視活動の記事。動物衛生管理強化は重要だが、現時点で実際の患者発生や流行は報告されていない。続報の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的監視活動であり、実際の患者発生は報告されていない。口蹄疫とは家畜感染症で、人間への感染は過去の非致死性トピックス（結膜炎、orウイルス感染など）のみ。ザンビアなど他の対象国は記事に含まれていない。Eid al-Adha 2026に向けた動物流入増加時期の予防措置。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ感染拡大にWHO事務局長が「重大な懸念」　今回の流行を憂慮すべき理由
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General expresses "grave concern" over the spread of Ebola infections; reasons to be concerned about this outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spiraling in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, prompting WHO Director-General to call the situation grave. More than 130 deaths and over 500 suspected cases have been linked to the outbreak. On May 17, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; an emergency meeting in Geneva on May 19 highlighted risks of further spread and deaths. Cases have been reported in cities, including Kampala in Uganda and Goma and Bunia in DRC, with health workers among the fatalities. The outbreak began in Ituri province in early May amid conflict-driven displacement; more than 100,000 people have been newly displaced, raising transmission risk. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or treatment. Nutrition crises in Ituri and refugee movements complicate response. US travel advisories were issued for DRC, South Sudan, Uganda, with small disaster teams deployed; it is uncertain if cases are undercounted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大にWHO事務局長が「重大な懸念」　今回の流行を憂慮すべき理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的スプレッドリスク、渡航制限発動）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。PHEIC宣言済みの高リスク事象。
triage.notes: PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が2026年5月17日に宣言済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法なし。100,000名以上の新規避難民が存在し、伝播リスク高い。複数国への米国渡航勧告発令済み。ウガンダでも症例報告あるが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であり、ウガンダは2次的な影響地。Genevaの場所情報はWHO緊急会議の開催地であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: คร.ชี้ไทยใกล้ยุติถ่ายทอดเอชพีวีจากแม่สู่ลูก เร่งสกัด 'ซิฟิลิส' ในวัยรุ่น-สถานการณ์ยังน่ากังวล
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health officials say Thailand is close to ending mother-to-child transmission of HPV; stepping up syphilis control among adolescents, as the situation remains concerning.
article.articleSummary: Thailand is close to ending mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B (HBV) under the WHO Triple Elimination framework by 2030. For HIV, the MTCT rate in infants under 12 months reached 1.14% in FY 2568, with antenatal HIV screening at 99.51% among more than 336,150 pregnant women and ART coverage at 97.45% of HIV-positive pregnant women, meeting the WHO target of ≤2%. Nevertheless, late entry to maternity services and loss to follow-up remain risks, especially in hard-to-reach areas. Syphilis persists as a concern: incidence in ages 15–24 is 147.6 per 100,000, and congenital syphilis at 297.4 per 100,000 live births, far above the 50 per 100,000 target. For HBV, MTCT is about 1%; birth-dose vaccination within 24 hours is 94.7% and complete vaccination 89.89%, with HBIG use rising for infants of infected mothers. Ongoing focus on high-risk pregnancies and data systems is planned for 2569.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健当局、HIV母子感染終息が近いと指摘。青年層のシフィリス対策を急ぐ、状況は依然懸念余地あり
triage.triage_reason: HIV、梅毒、B型肝炎の母子感染制御という既知の公衆衛生課題の進捗報告であり、新規アウトブレイクを示唆するものではない。ただしシフィリスの青年層での流行（15-24歳で147.6/10万）は継続的な監視対象である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はWHO三大感染症排除枠組みに基づくタイの進捗報告（2030年までにHTLV-1、梅毒、B型肝炎の母子感染を排除）である。新規アウトブレイク事象ではなく既知疾患の制御状況の進展報告。シフィリスの青年層流行率は継続的な監視を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient in Berlin gelandet - US-Arzt kommt in Charité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Patient Lands in Berlin — U.S. Doctor Arrives at Charité.
article.articleSummary: American doctor Peter Stafford contracted Ebola in the Congo and arrived in Berlin by air, transported from BER to Charité hospital under a highly protected medical convoy. He is treated on a dedicated Ebola isolation ward at the Virchow-Klinikum campus, a self-contained unit with separate access, ventilation, filtration, and closed wastewater processes, designed to treat up to 20 patients. The Charité team emphasizes no danger to the general population. The Congolese Ministry of Health reports 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 suspected deaths in Congo at this time. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids. In West Africa, the Zaire strain caused more than 11,000 deaths in the 2014–2015 outbreak. The Berlin case illustrates ongoing Ebola activity in the Congo and the international transfer of an imported patient for specialized care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がベルリンに到着 — 米国人医師がシャリテ病院に搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴでのエボラウイルス活動の継続と国際的な患者移送は、明確なシグナル指標である。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベント発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）であり、513疑似症例と131疑似死亡例が報告されている。ベルリンはあくまで輸入症例の治療地点であり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。対象国リストに含まれない欧州の具体的情報（ドイツ）は除外。エボラウイルスは国際的に懸念される高危険度病原体であり、複数の IHR 及び WPRO スクリーニング基準に該当する明確なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Funding cuts led to delayed detection of deadly Ebola outbreak in DRC
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda report a sharp rise in suspected Ebola cases, from 246 to 500 in 96 hours, as of May 19–20, 2026. The outbreak in Ituri province is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. By contrast, the last two major Ebola outbreaks caused by the Zaire strain infected more than 32,000 people and killed over 13,600. Funding cuts starting March 2025 reduced IRC frontline health, surveillance, and outbreak preparedness across eastern DRC, shrinking programming from five Ituri health areas to two and leaving facilities with limited PPE and infection prevention supplies. The surge risks cross-border spread to South Kivu, Uganda, and South Sudan. Authorities urge increased investment in frontline healthcare, surveillance networks, IPC, outbreak preparedness, and community‑based detection and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 資金削減がコンゴ民主共和国の致命的なエボラ感染症の検出遅延につながった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ感染症の急速な増加（246→500例/96時間）、国境を越えたウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療薬なしで公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているイベント発生地はDRC東部（Ituri、South Kivu州）及びウガンダです。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。南スーダン（Sudan）も対象国リストに含まれていません。Bundibugyo株はZaire株よりも致死率は低いが、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため医学的管理が困難である点が懸念されます。資金削減による監視体制の脆弱化が検出遅延を招いた背景も重要です。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Larang Berjabat Tangan Karena Khawatir Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Bans Handshakes Amid Ebola Fears
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in Uganda, with one death, both victims identified as nationals of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). In response, Uganda’s Ministry of Health has banned handshakes and other forms of direct physical contact to curb human-to-human transmission. The government is strengthening surveillance as the Ebola situation in both Uganda and the DRC escalates. The World Health Organization (WHO) on May 17, 2026, designated the Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). In the DRC, authorities report 131 Ebola-related deaths to date, continuing a resurgence after Ebola was previously declared over in October 2025. The Ugandan measures reflect urgent cross-border risk management, with authorities urging the public to reduce physical contact while monitoring for further cases; no details on symptoms or transmission source are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ懸念で握手を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC指定済み。DRCおよびウガンダでの確定例・死亡例があり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響が明白。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生を明示。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC（203312）は対象国リストに含まれ、確定例131名の死亡が報告されている。2026年5月17日にWHOによるPHEIC指定済み。国境越え感染リスク、人間への深刻な影響が確立。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情爆發！民主剛果136死蔓延烏干達 盧比歐轟WHO反應太慢 | 國際要聞 | 全球 | NOWnews今日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak! 136 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, spreading to Uganda; Rubio blasts WHO for slow response | International News | Global | NOWnews Today's News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading to Uganda, with 136 fatalities and 513 suspected cases reported by the DRC health ministry as of May 19. The World Health Organization has expressed concern about the outbreak’s scale and speed of spread. U.S. officials, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, criticized WHO for a delayed confirmation, while the United States pledges initial funding of about $13 million to support up to 50 Ebola treatment centers across the DRC and Uganda, coordinated by CDC and WHO. The State Department emphasized rapid, resourced response in collaboration with global health and humanitarian partners. Access to affected areas is hampered by ongoing conflict and poor transportation infrastructure in this war-torn region. The article also notes the U.S. role in global health funding and WHO’s funding dynamics during the Biden administration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が勃発！民主共和国で136人が死亡、ウガンダに拡大 ルビオがWHOの反応の遅さを非難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的な拡大リスクを持つシグナル疾患であり、米国を含む複数国での社会的・政治的関心が著しく高い。
triage.notes: 記事は民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱の流行とウガンダへの拡大を主題としている。米国は資金提供で支援しているが、発生地は民主共和国（対象国リストに含まれる）のみとする。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。136人の死亡、513人の疑い例、感染が国境を越えて拡大している状況、複数国の政治的関心の高さから、即座のフル Risk Assessment を開始すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca tử vong do dịch Ebola ở Congo tăng lên 131 người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths from the Ebola outbreak in Congo has risen to 131.
article.articleSummary: 131 deaths from the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, with 543 suspected and 33 confirmed cases; two cases detected in Uganda. Butembo recorded the first confirmed cases on May 18. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, prompting international concern; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16, first time he took that step before an emergency committee. Authorities warn the virus could circulate undetected for weeks in densely populated areas. Background: a major 2018-2020 Congo outbreak caused nearly 2,300 deaths. Uganda has restricted cross-border movement at Ishasha-Kyeshero, while people attempting to cross into Rwanda near Goma and Bukavu have been blocked. WHO advises against blanket border closures to avoid uncontrolled cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラアウトブレイク死亡者数が131人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した確認済みのエボラアウトブレイク。国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認例、ルワンダ・ウガンダとの国境制限）が明示されている。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月16日にPHEIC宣言（Tedros事務局長による初の事前宣言）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による感染。ウガンダで2症例確認、ルワンダ・ウガンダとの国境制限実施。2018-2020年の大規模アウトブレイク（約2,300死亡）との比較データあり。記事配信日時が2026年であり、今後のイベント情報のため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF intensifica sus esfuerzos para proteger y apoyar a niños, niñas y familias tras los brotes del virus del Ébola en la República Democrática del Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF intensifies its efforts to protect and support children and families after Ebola virus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF reports 246 suspected Ebola cases and 80 possible deaths in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with two cases in Uganda (one fatal) as of May 18, 2026. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, less common than the Zaire strain; there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment, and circulation is believed to have begun in late April. Ongoing security instability, restricted access, and high population mobility raise transmission risk, threatening children via disrupted health services, nutrition, education, protection, and psychosocial distress. UNICEF has mobilized nearly 50 tons of supplies to Bunia (disinfectants, soap, PPE, water-purification tablets, water storage) and will deploy a rapid emergency-response team for risk communication and community engagement. More than 2,000 community health workers are on the ground; capacity and resources must be expanded for broader reach. A Level 3 Corporate Emergency enables rapid funding, staffing, and cross-border coordination with WHO and Africa CDC to protect children and families.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス流行後、UNICEFが子どもと家族の保護・支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による確認・疑い例多数、死亡事例あり、複数国での流行、ワクチン・治療法なし、セキュリティリスク高。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ州での246疑い例・80死亡例、ウガンダでの2例（1死亡）が主題。ウガンダ（対象国リストにない）は記事に記載されているが、verified_locationsに含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は Zaire株より稀で、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない深刻な状況。セキュリティ不安定性、アクセス制限、人口移動の高さにより伝播リスク高。Level 3企業緊急事態宣言により国際支援体制が整備。

article.articleHeadline: T7News | Taubaté confirma terceira morte por dengue em 2026 e reforça alerta para avanço da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: T7News | Taubaté confirms third dengue death in 2026 and reinforces warning about the spread of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Taubaté, Brazil, reports its third dengue death in 2026 as the city remains in an epidemic since April. The latest fatality is a 54-year-old man from Residencial Estoril; death occurred May 3, with laboratory confirmation recorded on May 13. He joins a previously reported 80-year-old man from Jardim Gurilândia and a 13-year-old adolescent girl from Residencial Estoril as 2026 dengue fatalities. The outbreak has surpassed 1,600 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in 2026, prompting expanded vector-control measures, including intensified fogging, door-to-door visits, large-scale cleaning campaigns, and public awareness efforts. Health authorities warn that severe dengue and dengue hemorrhagic fever cases are overloading emergency services. Emphasis remains on eliminating standing water, keeping water tanks sealed, and regular yard and outdoor area cleaning to curb the Aedes aegypti mosquito transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タウバテ、2026年にデング熱で3番目の死亡を確認し、疾病の蔓延について警告を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。デング出血熱を含む重症例の増加と医療サービスの過負荷、1,600件超の確定症例と3件の死亡による明らかな流行状況がフルRRAを必要とする。
triage.notes: ブラジル・タウバテ市で4月から続くデング流行。2026年に3人の死亡例（13歳少女、80歳男性、54歳男性）と1,600件超の確定症例。重症デングおよびデング出血熱ケースが救急車サービスを過負荷にしている。蚊媒介ベクター制御強化（燻蒸、戸別訪問、清掃キャンペーン）が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: สั่ง สธ.เกาะติด 'อีโบลา' แม้ยังไม่พบในไทย!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Order the Ministry of Public Health to closely monitor 'Ebola' even though it has not yet been found in Thailand!
article.articleSummary: On 20 May 2026, Thailand’s government urged the Ministry of Public Health to closely monitor the Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after the WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. There is currently no Ebola outbreak in Thailand. Ebola is a highly virulent virus transmitted via blood and bodily fluids, including saliva, vomit, stool, and other secretions, particularly from severe cases, and mainly spreads among family members, healthcare workers, or those with close contact with patients or corpses. It is not easily airborne, unlike measles or COVID-19. Early symptoms resemble fever, fatigue, muscle aches, nausea and vomiting; some cases involve abnormal bleeding. Without proper care, case fatality is high. The disease’s identifiable clinical presentation aids contact tracing, isolation, and containment; no Thai laboratory confirmation data is provided, and there is no indication of imported/exported cases in the article.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省に『エボラ』の厳密な監視を指示　タイ国内での発見はまだないが
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生がPHEIC宣言されており国際的な関心は高いが、タイ国内では確認されておらず、実際の発生イベントはDRCのみ。タイはこの記事では監視対象国であり、発生国ではない。DRCの情報のみでは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空。情報続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題であるエボラ発生は民主コンゴ共和国(DRC)のIturi州で発生しているが、DRCは対象国リストに含まれていない(1605651=Thailandのみ対象)。タイは監視国として言及されるのみで、国内発症例はない。DRCがWHOのPHEIC宣言を受けた国際的なシグナルであるが、対象国での検証可能な発生がないため、シグナル化の優先度は下がる。続報でタイ国内での確認例や対象国での発生報告がある場合はPICKUPに引き上げることを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: EBola-Patien in Berliner Klinik angekommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients arrived at a Berlin clinic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus–infected American patient arrived at Berlin's Charité University Hospital for treatment. The man, infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid a strong outbreak there, was admitted to the hospital's Special Isolation Unit at the Virchow-Klinikum campus, a closed, separate facility. Transport to Berlin was organized from Uganda as a flight for highly infectious patients, and the patient was transported in a specially equipped vehicle, escorted by police motorcycles, other police vehicles, firefighters, and ambulances. German Federal Health Ministry confirmed the arrangement; US authorities had asked Germany for help to shorten the flight time. Berlin's handling emphasizes safety with the isolation unit designed to prevent contact with other patients. Ebola is a contagious and life-threatening disease transmitted by contact with body fluids and body contact. Infection sourced in DRC, imported case to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がベルリンの診療所に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する重篤なエボラウイルス症例の国際的な移動。DRCでの流行中に感染した患者がドイツへ医療搬送されており、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク、および深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な感染源がDRCでの流行であり、ドイツへの搬送は医療目的の国際移動。WPRO対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ドイツは対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。エボラは致死率が高く、接触感染する疾患として高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Bans Handshakes After Confirming Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: Uganda bans handshakes after confirming two Ebola cases as of May 19, 2026, including one fatality. The two patients are citizens of the Democratic Republic of Congo. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). DRC authorities report 131 Ebola deaths in the country; the previous DRC outbreak was declared over in October 2025. Ugandan health authorities continue to monitor the disease dynamics and implement transmission-reduction measures, including the handshaking ban.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ症例確認後に握手禁止を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国での確認、死亡例あり、国際的拡大とリスク管理措置の実施が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダのエボラ確認が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため追加。なお、ウガンダのシグナルは地域スクリーニング外であるが、DRC発のアウトブレイク拡大として重要性が高い。WHO PHEIC宣言により明確なシグナル価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola sigue preocupando a la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to worry the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization reports an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with suspected cases exceeding 500 and 130 deaths, plus one fatal case in Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of the Orthoebolaviruses; among the six Orthoebolavirus species, Ebola, Sudan, and Bundibugyo have driven major outbreaks. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns figures will rise as on-the-ground operations expand, including enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory testing. Healthcare workers have died in connection with outbreak efforts. Ongoing conflicts have displaced about 100,000 people, complicating the response amid the absence of vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Transmission to humans occurs via close contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other fluids of infected animals (notably frugivorous bats); humans are infectious only after symptom onset.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の発生がWHOを引き続き懸念させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ熱は死亡率の高い病原体であり、複数国での確認、医療従事者の感染死亡、紛争による人口移動により国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当（重症度、管理可能性等）。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事中で1件の死亡例が言及されているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による発生であること、ワクチン・治療法が未開発であること、100,000人の避難民と紛争による応急対応の複雑化が管理可能性を著しく低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДРК возросло до 136 человек -- министр здравоохранения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in the DRC has risen to 136 — Health Minister.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 136, with 543 suspected cases and 32 laboratory-confirmed infections. As of May 20, 2026, 69 patients are in Ebola treatment centers. The outbreak, declared May 15, is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976, centered in Ituri province with confirmed cases also in North Kivu. The causative virus is Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. On May 17, WHO declared the outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Regional neighbors, including Rwanda, Burundi, and Tanzania, have heightened surveillance, border controls, and readiness measures. Africa CDC also declared the outbreak a PHEIC for DR Congo and Uganda, highlighting continental risk.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ死者数が136人に増加——保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、WHO/Africa CDCによるPHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを示している。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的な社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 5月17日にWHOおよびAfrica CDCがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。周辺国（ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダ、タンザニア）でも境界監視と防疫体制が強化されている。記事はDRCでのアウトブレイクが主題であり、周辺国への波及リスクを言及しているが、confirmed casesはDRCとウガンダに限定されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: David Kershenobich emite alertas por hantavirus, ébola y calor extremo :: Entorno Político
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: David Kershenobich issues alerts for Hantavirus, Ebola, and extreme heat :: Political Environment
article.articleSummary: Mexico issues three epidemiological alerts on hantavirus, Ebola, and extreme heat. As of May 20, 2026, there are no confirmed hantavirus or Ebola cases in Mexico, though surveillance system remains on alert. Hantavirus is a respiratory disease transmitted via contact with rodent waste; about 40 variants exist, with only the Andes (Andina) strain capable of human-to-human transmission. The virus was first identified in Korea (1978) and the United States (1993). Ebola outbreaks remain focused in Africa, notably the Congo and surrounding regions; a travel advisory is in place for travelers to those regions. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids and exposure to bats; symptoms include fever and hemorrhagic manifestations, with high mortality. Airports and entry points are monitored. In 2026, 264 heat-related deaths have been recorded in Mexico; at-risk groups include the elderly, children, pregnant women, and outdoor workers. Recommendations: stay hydrated, wear light clothing, avoid sun 11:00–16:00.

triage.headline_ja: David Kershenobichがハンタウイルス、エボラ、酷熱に関する警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: メキシコが複数の感染症警報を発令しているが、現在メキシコ内での確認症例がなく、情報が限定的である。ただしDRCでのエボラ流行は継続中のため、国際的拡大リスクと社会政治的関心があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコの警報発令が主題であるが、メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCではエボラが継続的に流行している記載があり、対象国リストに含まれるため DRC のみ検証済み地域として含める。メキシコ内での確認症例なしという点が判定を WATCH に引き下げる要因。ただし IHR基準3つ該当かつWPRO基準4つ該当のため、フルRRA実施の可能性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirüs ya da kedilerden halk sağlığı kahramanı yaratmak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Creating a Public Health Hero from Hantavirus or Cats.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, two health crises loom over the WHO Geneva assembly (May 18–23, 2026): hantavirus concerns linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo and re-emerging Ebola outbreaks in Uganda. In DRC, Ebola Bundibugyo has caused 80 deaths to date; Bundibugyo was first identified in Bundibugyo, Uganda (2007), with a 2012 DRC outbreak reaching about 51% case-fatality; there is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, unlike Zaire/EBOV strains. Separately, hantavirus cases tied to a discovery vessel have drawn global attention amid discussions of media influence and public perception. Globally, hantaviruses infect an estimated 10,000–100,000 people annually, mostly in Asia and Europe. In 2025 the Americas reported 229 laboratory-confirmed hantavirus pulmonary syndrome cases and 59 deaths across eight countries; Turkey first documented hantavirus in 2009. Hantaviruses lack a licensed vaccine or specific antiviral therapy; prevention remains exposure avoidance. Myths about cats as public-health heroes are noted as oversimplified.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスまたは猫から公衆衛生の英雄を作る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（ウガンダ・DRC）とハンタウイルスの同時危機、死亡事例あり、ワクチン欠如、WHO総会での優先課題。国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCのエボラ・ブンディブギョ（80死亡）とウガンダのエボラ再発がWHO総会の優先課題として述べられている。ハンタウイルスについては全球統計（米州229症例、59死亡）が記載されているが、具体的な発生国の詳細が不明。Bundibugyo（GeoNames 234178）はウガンダに位置するが、現在の主要発生地はDRCと記述されているため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ワクチン欠如（ブンディブギョ）と同時多発的危機がリスクを増幅させている。

article.articleHeadline: Mortes por gripe e doenças respiratórias graves sobem 26,7% em uma semana em Rio Grande | Zona Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-related deaths and severe respiratory diseases rise 26.7% in one week in Rio Grande | South Zone.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande's South Zone, Brazil, reports a 26.7% weekly rise in deaths from Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI), with fatalities climbing from 15 to 19. Among deaths, 47.4% are from unspecified SARI; influenza and rhinovirus each account for 21.1%, Covid-19 10.5%. In 2026, 152 people have been hospitalized with respiratory illnesses. Influenza vaccination remains below target: 22,493 priority-group individuals vaccinated (41.9% coverage); 33,246 doses administered in other campaign groups. Four health posts—Parque Marinha, Rita Lobato, Profilurb, Vila da Quinta—will keep extended hours through July to boost uptake; other UBS clinics operate 8:00–17:00. Vaccination requires photo ID and either a vaccination card or Cartão SUS app.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデにおけるインフルエンザおよび重症呼吸器疾患による死亡が1週間で26.7%増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）、かつWPRO基準3つ以上に該当。重症化・死亡の増加トレンドと複数の呼吸器病原体の同時流行により、ラピッドリスクアセスメント実施の必要あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ブラジルのリオグランデ・ド・スル州南部地域における重症呼吸器感染症（SARI）による死亡が1週間で26.7%増加し、15件から19件に増加している。インフルエンザ（21.1%）、ライノウイルス（21.1%）、COVID-19（10.5%）が確認されており、複数病原体の同時流行パターンを示唆。当局は予防接種キャンペーンを拡大中だが、対象グループでのカバー率が41.9%に留まっており、管理可能性に関する詳細情報が不足。国際的な拡大リスクについては記事では言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana issues Ebola alert after WHO declares global health emergency over outbreak in DR Congo, Uganda - Ghanamma.com
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, Ghana's Ministry of Health issued an urgent Ebola alert after the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with rising infections and fears of cross-border spread. No Ebola cases have been recorded in Ghana or the West African sub-region. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare variant for which there are no licensed vaccines or approved therapeutic treatments, elevating the importance of prevention, surveillance and early detection. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids, secretions, organs, or contaminated materials. Ghana advocates universal hand hygiene, carrying personal sanitizers, ensuring facilities at events, and seeking prompt care for fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea or unexplained bleeding. Authorities emphasize public communication, international cooperation, and strengthened screening and preparedness to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの感染症集団発生に関して国際的懸念事項として宣言した後、ガーナがエボラ警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラ感染症の大規模集団発生であり、ワクチン/治療法がない稀な変異株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が認められ、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を正式に宣言している点が重要。発生地域にウガンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダは言及されていない（「outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda」という表現は発生地を示しているが、サマリーの焦点はDRCとガーナの警告警報）。対象国リストに基づきDRC（203312）とGhana（2300660）を verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（1269750=インド等ではなく、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外）。稀なBundibugyo ebolavirus変異株、利用可能なワクチン/治療法がないことが管理困難性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تفرض الحجر الصحي على أكثر من 100 شخص لمواجهة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda imposes quarantine on more than 100 people to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has quarantined more than 100 people as part of efforts to curb a rare Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Those under surveillance are at an undisclosed site, with medical teams closely monitoring for signs of infection. Officials say the situation is under control, noting Uganda’s prior epidemic experience has strengthened its response. Alan Kasoga, executive director of the Uganda Media Centre, said the country relies on highly experienced health teams and that those under watch are being treated by trained specialists. The outbreak is currently centered in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a neighbor, highlighting cross-border risk. As of May 20, 2026, 131 deaths and more than 500 suspected cases have been reported. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is accelerating and remains a threat.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ対策として100人以上の隔離検疫を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による稀なアウトブレイク、131名の死亡、500名以上の疑い患者、WHOの警告、国境を越えたリスク、複数国での報告があり、シグナルとして即座にフルRRAに進むべき状況。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (verified through narrative, though not in Bluedot geo list)

triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀で高致死性。DRC東部Ituri州での発生に加えウガンダでの隔離検疫が報告されており、国境を越えた感染リスクが明確。WHO警告あり。死亡数（131）と疑い患者数（500+）が顕著。記事サマリーでウガンダが主要な報告対象国と明記されているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 민주콩고서 급속 확산...의심환자 513명·사망 131명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola rapidly spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... 513 suspected cases, 131 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks are spreading rapidly across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of May 19, 2026, the DRC health ministry reports 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 deaths, with the tally potentially higher if incubating cases are counted; UK-based MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis estimates total infections could exceed 1,000. The Red Cross warns that limited information and weak health systems may allow rapid transmission if early diagnosis is not achieved. The article notes concern for neighboring countries and cross-border spread, underscoring the need for containment measures, laboratory confirmation, and prompt case detection. Specific infection sources and details on imported/exported cases are not provided. Authorities and international partners are monitoring the situation in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが民主コンゴで急速に拡散...疑い患者513名・死亡131名
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は致死性が高く、DRCとウガンダで急速な患者増加と死亡が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと国際的対応の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとUKが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ拡散であり、Ugandaは隣接国として言及されているにとどまる。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に加えた。UK記載は輸入症例の推定分析センター所在地と考えられ、実際の発生地ではないため除外。世界保健機関への通知対象となるシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline:
10:22
                  刚果（金）埃博拉疑似病例升至543例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10:22 DR Congo Ebola suspected cases rise to 543
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with 136 suspected Ebola-related deaths and 543 suspected cases since the latest flare began. Health Minister Kamba announced at a Kinshasa press briefing on May 19, 2026 that the death figures are provisional and under verification, with ongoing investigations to confirm Ebola linkage. Ebola treatment centers are currently caring for 69 patients. The update underscores continued transmission and active surveillance in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centering on Kinshasa, as authorities work to validate suspected cases and respond to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似病例が543例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、流行性）。エボラウイルス病は最高レベルのバイオセキュリティ脅威であり、フルRRAの対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高優先度の感染症。キンシャサを中心とした543例の疑似患者と136例の死亡が報告されている。保健大臣による公式発表により確度が高い。継続的な感染伝播が示唆されており、緊急対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Race on to contain Ebola outbreak | Midday Bulletin 20 May 2026
article.articleSummary: By 20 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by a rare sub-type; the WHO emphasizes isolation of cases and contacts as essential. Suspected deaths total 134 with over 500 suspected cases in eastern Congo, with transmission not detected for weeks. With no vaccine or specific treatment, authorities are expanding contact tracing and building dedicated Ebola facilities to prevent cross-infection. The United States has enhanced entry screening for travelers from Ebola-affected regions and imposes restrictions on non-US passport holders who have been in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. An American doctor infected in DRC is being treated in Germany; experts say the global spread risk remains very low. In Australia, a diphtheria outbreak across central and northern regions totals about 220 cases—roughly 30 times the five-year average—predominantly respiratory disease among Indigenous Australians; authorities plan vaccination and a workforce surge.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大に対する対策進行中 | 2026年5月20日正午速報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス（稀な亜型）とジフテリアの同時多地域発生で、複数国での検証済み発生あり。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生（稀な亜型、疑い死者134名、疑い患者500名以上）と、オーストラリアでのジフテリア集団発生（220例、5年平均の約30倍）の2つの重要な感染症イベントが記事に含まれている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。米国、ドイツ、オーストラリア、ウガンダ、南スーダンは記事に言及されるが対象国リストに含まれない。既に米国による渡航制限が実施されており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS teme por la "magnitud y rapidez" de la propagación del ébola: 134 muertes en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO fears the "magnitude and speed" of the spread of Ebola: 134 deaths in Congo
article.articleSummary: 134 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of May 20, 2026, with confirmed cases in Bunia (Ituri), Goma (North Kivu), and the towns of Mongbwalu, Nyakunde, and Butembo, all housing over a million people. The first death occurred in Bunia. Healthcare workers in PPE and residents wearing cloth masks illustrate ongoing transmission risks in urban settings. The World Health Organization (WHO) is deeply concerned about the outbreak’s magnitude and speed, citing urban case emergence, health worker fatalities, and large population movements. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Authorities have not identified patient zero. An experimental Ebola vaccine developed by Oxford researchers is awaiting shipments from the United States and United Kingdom; vaccination and monitoring will proceed, though experts warn progress will take time.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラの「規模と速度」を懸念：コンゴで134人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行でPHEIC宣言済み、都市部での急速な拡大、国際的対応（ワクチン輸入、WHO関与）が明らかであり、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域に米国・英国が含まれているが、これらはワクチン供給元であり、実際のエボラ患者発生地はDRCのみ。PHEIC宣言済み、WHO公式懸念表明、134人の確認死亡、医療従事者の罹患死亡、都市部での急速伝播（百万人超の人口密集地）、人口移動によるリスク、ヒト-ヒト感染が確認されている。全WPROスクリーニング基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: The fast-spreading Ebola outbreak in central Africa
article.articleSummary: Rapidly spreading Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 516 suspected cases and 33 confirmed, and at least 131 associated deaths; two confirmed cases reported in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Bundibugyo, a less lethal Ebola species (30-40% fatality) named after Uganda’s Bundibugyo province (identified 2007-2008; a 2012 DRC outbreak previously). Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, placing hospital workers at particular risk; a U.S. physician working in the DRC has been infected. Symptoms begin with flu-like illness (fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pain, headache, sore throat), advancing to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and potential multi-organ failure. No approved vaccines or drugs exist for Bundibugro ebolavirus. Response emphasizes rapid case detection, isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, safe burials, and community engagement, mirroring measures used in prior Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカで急速に広がるエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言が発令された国際的に極めて重大なエボラ出血熱の流行。確認症例と死亡例があり、隣国ウガンダへの拡大も報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行が主題であり、ウガンダでの症例報告も記載されているが、ウガンダ（1269750）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。米国医師の感染も報告されているが、発生地はDRC内。WHO による公衆衛生緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）の発令、多数の死亡例、医療従事者への直接的リスク、ワクチン・治療薬の不在といった深刻な要因が複数存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Messico, allerta Ebola: rischio contagio per i Mondiali di calcio - AmeVe Blog
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico, Ebola Alert: Risk of Contagion for the FIFA World Cup
article.articleSummary: Mexico issues an Ebola alert to prevent cross-border contagion during the FIFA World Cup. Health Minister David Kershenobich launched epidemiological surveillance to detect any importation of Ebola, with particular focus on the Democratic Republic of the Congo vs Colombia match scheduled in Guadalajara on June 23. Public health experts warn that the event could become a transmission risk, with Francisco Moreno proposing a 21-day quarantine for players arriving from Africa and even stricter entry bans for supporters from those countries to curb spread. Local authorities stress vigilance across all health facilities and heightened risk assessment as the World Cup draws near. The schedule also features U.S. venues, including Uzbekistan vs Portugal in Atlanta on June 27 and USA vs Portugal in Houston on June 17, illustrating cross-border movement that could affect risk mitigation.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、エボラ警戒：FIFA ワールドカップでの感染リスク
triage.triage_reason: 記事は架空のシナリオ（2026年のワールドカップを前提とした仮定的な警戒）を扱っており、実際の確認されたエボラ発症事例や既存アウトブレイクの報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を実質的に満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は架空の国際スポーツイベント（2026 FIFA ワールドカップ）における仮定的なエボラ感染リスクについて述べているもの。実際の感染事例・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、政治的・社会的な推測シナリオと見なされる。発生地域には DRC が含まれるが、記事本体にエボラの実際の発症事例や確認アウトブレイクの記載がなく、純然たるリスク想定に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。
