article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情失控？WHO升級「全球警戒」美國急禁3國旅客入境 | 國際 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak out of control? WHO upgrades to 'Global Alert' as the United States bans travelers from three countries.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo are escalating: 26 suspected infection deaths were reported in a single day, bringing the toll to at least 136 deaths and more than 514 suspected cases overall. The World Health Organization has upgraded the outbreak to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), indicating a global alert as the epidemic appears to be crossing borders and spreading to other regions. UK MRC modeling suggests actual case numbers could be substantially higher, potentially exceeding 1,000. In response, the United States has barred entry for travelers who have visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days, for 30 days. Taiwan’s CDC advises travelers to avoid contact with bats and primates and to perform 21 days of self-health monitoring after return. Ebola symptoms begin with fever, headache, and fatigue, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and possible bleeding; transmission occurs via infected bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が制御不能？ WHO「全球警戒」に引き上げ、米国が3ヶ国からの旅客入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確定的な流行拡大、WHOによるPHEIC指定、複数国への越境拡大、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には米国、スーダン、ウガンダ、台湾、英国が含まれているが、記事サマリー上で実際の感染症イベント発生地は東部DRC（民主共和国コンゴ）のみ。他国（米国、英国、台湾）は対応措置を取っている国であり、スーダン・ウガンダは越境リスク地域として言及されているが、確定的な流行地は記載されていない。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOによるPHEIC指定と1,000を超える可能性のある症例数は極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情列國際緊急事件 專家：主要透過感染者體液傳染 - 國際 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak declared an international emergency; experts say it is primarily transmitted through the bodily fluids of infected individuals.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak, with Uganda reporting two confirmed cases; as of May 16, the tally includes more than 80 deaths and 246 suspected cases, with 10 laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The virus belongs to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species. Transmission is primarily via direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people; there is no airborne spread. Incubation ranges 2–21 days (average 6–7). The natural reservoir is unknown, with bats suspected. Late detection, healthcare worker fatalities (four) and unsafe burial practices have facilitated spread and cross-border transmission to Uganda. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding contact with suspected cases, steering clear of outbreak zones when possible, self-monitoring after travel, and good hygiene. Taiwan considers import risk very low but has border controls; global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が国際的緊急事態に指定 専門家：主に感染者の体液を通じて感染と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重大な感染症イベント。DRCでの流行が既に国際的に拡大（ウガンダへの越境例あり）し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとTaiwanが含まれるが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行である。Ugandaは2件の確認例により越境例が存在するが、主流行地ではなく対象国リストに含まれない。Taiwanは輸入リスク評価のコンテキストのみで記述され、発生地ではない。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、既に国家間および国際レベルでの対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 강북구, 말라리아 위험지역 방문 구민에 예방 안심키트 쏜다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gangbuk District to distribute malaria-prevention reassurance kits to residents who visited malaria-risk areas.
article.articleSummary: Malaria prevention reassurance kits are distributed by Gangbuk District to residents who visited or will visit malaria-risk areas. As of May 20, 2026, 200 kits will be issued free, one per person. Each six-item kit includes a prevention leaflet, liquid mosquito coil, mosquito repellent, mosquito patch, arm sleeves, and disinfectant wipes to reduce outdoor mosquito exposure. Eligible residents are Gangbuk District residents who have visited or plan to visit malaria-risk areas domestically (Seoul, Incheon in some areas, northern Gyeonggi, parts of Gangwon) or abroad (Cambodia, India, Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, Peru, and others). Applications open May 20; applicants download a form from the Gangbuk-gu Office website, attach required documents (ID, consent, travel proof), and submit in person at the Health Center’s 3rd floor pharmacy or by email. Selected recipients will be notified by text and collect kits at the Gangbuk District Public Health Center.

triage.headline_ja: 江北区、マラリア危険地域訪問住民に予防安心キットを配布
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は江北区による予防キット配布の行政施策であり、マラリアの流行・発生ではなく、既知の地域でのリスク軽減対策である。新規の感染症シグナルではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国を抽出しているが、これはマラリア危険地域としての参考情報であり、実際の発生地域ではない。記事の主題は韓国（江北区）における予防対策施策であり、感染症イベント（流行・発生・異常）ではない。したがってトリアージ対象外。verified_locationsは、記事で言及された対象国リスト内の国のみを列挙。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വ്യാപനം: ഈ രാജ്യങ്ങളിലേക്ക് ഒരു കാരണവശാലും യാത്ര ചെയ്യരുത്; യുഎസ് പൗരന്മാർക്ക് ജാ​ഗ്രതാ നിർദേശം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Do not travel to these countries under any circumstances; advisory for U.S. citizens.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the US State Department issues travel advisories for the Ebola outbreak: Level 4 do-not-travel for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province), South Sudan, and Uganda; Level 3 for Rwanda. South Sudan travel guidance notes extremely limited medical services, with medical evacuation costs and all treatment expenses borne by travelers, who should keep insurance records. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In the DRC’s Ituri province, 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases have been reported, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no medicines or vaccines exist. Ebola spreads from wildlife to humans and between people via blood, vomit, stool, and other bodily fluids, with symptoms including fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and sometimes bleeding. Asianetnews is cited as a preferred source.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス拡大：これらの国への渡航は絶対にしないこと；米国市民への警告勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、WHOが国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、渡航制限が実施中）。複数国での致死的アウトブレイク、医療対応不十分、ヒト-ヒト感染の高リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的記述を検証：DRC（Ituri州）、South Sudan、Uganda、Rwandaが言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。South Sudan、Uganda、Rwandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。ただしDRCでの確認されたアウトブレイク（131死亡、513疑い例、Bundibugyo ebolavirus）とWHOの国際的懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、本イベントは重大シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: അ​മീ​ബി​ക് മ​സ്തി​ഷ്ക ജ്വ​രം ബാ​ക്ടീ​രി​യ​യു​ടെ ഉ​റ​വി​ടം തേടി ആ​രോ​ഗ്യ​വ​കു​പ്പ് | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amoebic brain fever: Health Department in search of the source of the bacteria.
article.articleSummary: A 73-year-old man from Nellikuzhi, Kollam district, died on May 15 after being treated for amoebic brain fever (amoebic encephalitis). The Health Department is urgently tracing the source, conducting home visits and collecting details of places he recently visited. While other parts of the state have reported amoebic fever among pool bathers, the deceased did not regularly swim in public pools and used hot domestic water for bathing. Transmission can occur from water where amoebae proliferate and may enter via facial exposure or through skin wounds on the feet. Authorities are evaluating potential exposure routes; no public advisory has been issued, and laboratory confirmation or a definitive source remains pending. The case underscores ongoing concerns about amoebic infections in Kerala, with active steps underway to identify the infection source.

triage.headline_ja: アメーバ性脳熱：保健省が細菌の感染源を探索中
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Encephalitisの致命例（死亡）が報告され、感染源が不明で調査中。インド（ケララ州）で発生し、IHR基準の「異常性」と「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡）と管理可能性（調査中・情報不足）が該当するため、フルRRAを推奨。
triage.notes: 記事では73歳男性がアメーバ性脳炎で死亡し、感染源が不明のまま調査中とされている。ケララ州では以前からプール利用者の間でアメーバ感染の報告があり、今回は非定型的な暴露経路が示唆されている。感染源特定および追加症例の有無について続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: El Nino Bisa Tingkatkan Risiko DBD dan Malaria pada Anak |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño Could Increase the Risk of Dengue Fever and Malaria in Children
article.articleSummary: El Niño is predicted to begin in May–June–July 2026 in Indonesia, per BMKG. The warming may heighten transmission risk of dengue fever and malaria, particularly for children (per IDAI). Dr. Darmawan Budi Setyanto notes Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector, breeds in clean water rather than rivers; droughts prompt households to store water in buckets and drums, and uncovered containers create prime breeding sites. Higher temperatures also increase mosquito survival indoors, bringing them into homes and increasing human contact. Aedes aegypti eggs can resist desiccation for months, sustaining transmission potential during dry spells. The discussion, held in Jakarta on May 19, 2026, emphasizes climate-related risk, with no case counts or laboratory confirmations cited in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョは子どもにおけるデング熱とマラリアのリスクを高める可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるエルニーニョに伴うデング熱・マラリア伝播リスク増加の警告だが、現在の確定症例がなく、予測に基づく懸念段階。気象変動と媒介蚊生態の関連性は重要だが、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は気象予測（エルニーニョ発生予測）に基づく将来的なリスク警告であり、現在の流行状況を示す症例数や確定診断がない。BMKG（インドネシア気象気候火山局）とIDAI（インドネシア小児科医会）による公式見解として報道されており、政府・保健機関の関心は高い。Aedes aegyptiの生態と温暖化の関係についての科学的議論が含まれている。流行予測段階であり、今後の患者発生報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: รบ.กำชับเฝ้าระวัง"อีโบลา"ใกล้ชิด ยังไม่พบในไทย อย่าตระหนก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Government Urges Close Monitoring of Ebola; Not Yet Detected in Thailand; Do Not Panic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO. As of May 20, 2026, Thailand reports no detected cases. The government advocates close monitoring, coordination with health agencies, and rapid contact tracing, isolation of suspected cases, and bolstering isolation wards, PPE, and laboratory readiness to handle future suspected patients. Early EVD symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, nausea, vomiting, with possible abnormal bleeding; without proper care, mortality is high. Transmission occurs primarily through blood and body fluids of infected individuals and corpses, not via airborne spread. Public health guidance emphasizes routine hygiene and avoiding panic. No information provided on imported or exported cases; authorities will remain vigilant and collaborate with international partners.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がエボラ出血熱の厳密な監視を指示 タイではまだ検出されていない パニックに陥らないこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。WHOがPHEICを宣言している既知のエボラアウトブレイク（DRC）のため、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響がある。タイも警戒態勢を敷いており国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州でのエボラアウトブレイクはWHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、タイは既に警戒態勢を敷いている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、タイも対象国である。記事サマリーでは両国での対応状況が記載されているため、両国を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疑似病例升至543例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 543.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 136 deaths among 543 suspected Ebola cases in the new Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, with 69 patients currently in Ebola Treatment Centers, concentrated in Ituri Province as of May 19, 2026. Community resistance and rumors have delayed reporting; authorities have shipped emergency supplies, expanded treatment centers, and intensified case finding, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and community outreach. AFRO CDC will fund on-site response and expedite evaluation of three Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidates; no licensed vaccine or specific therapy exists for this strain. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Uganda reports two imported Ebola cases (one death) with travel history to the DRC, with no clear epidemiologic link between them. Africa CDC labels the event a regional public health emergency and urges continental action to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似患者数が543例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ種）の確認済み集団発生で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡136例、疑似患者543例）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染2例確認）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも越境感染が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCで発生した新規ブンディブギョエボラウイルス集団発生であり、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン候補の緊急評価が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: EVD Readiness - DREF Final Report (MDRAO013) - Angola
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) readiness in Angola after the DRC outbreak near Tshikapa, Kassai province, close to the Angola border (border length 2,511 km). The trigger was met on 10-06-2025. By December 2025, Angola's Ebola contingency plan (Sept 2025) and DREF support aimed to minimize cross-border transmission; no Ebola cases were reported in Angola by the end of the operation. The DRC outbreak risk factors include heavy cross-border movement: formal crossings 5,000–10,000 daily plus informal routes, and about 5.6 million people at risk along border provinces; Angola hosts around 57,000 refugees from DRC. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; case fatality historically ~50%, worsened by weak IPC, WASH, and health systems. Northern Angola health facilities face equipment and staffing gaps; prior under-immunization (over 700,000 children in 2021). DRC’s outbreak was waning with post-90 day surveillance, maintaining high alert to detect and stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ：エボラウイルス病対策準備 - DREF最終報告書（MDRAO013）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC由来のエボラウイルス病の国境越え脅威が記録されており、両国間の大規模な人的移動と準備体制の構築が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Tshikapa、Kassai州）でのエボラ流行とアンゴラの対策準備が主題。アンゴラは準備体制と難民受け入れの文脈で言及されているが、当該イベント（確認されたエボラ流行）はDRCに限定。2,511km国境での5,000-10,000人/日の正規ルート通行と非正規ルートでの人的移動、約560万人の国境地域リスク人口が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクは明確。DRC outbreak is primary signal source; Angola is border-adjacent surveillance focus.

article.articleHeadline: Người cao tuổi mắc lao phổi có nguy hiểm?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is pulmonary tuberculosis dangerous for the elderly?
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and spread mainly through respiratory droplets, potentially causing severe lung damage and extrapulmonary disease. In older adults, TB is more dangerous due to immunosenescence and common comorbidities such as diabetes, COPD, bronchiectasis, kidney disease, cancer, and long-term corticosteroid or immunosuppressant use. Malnutrition and age-related declines in lung function worsen susceptibility and impair clearance of bacteria. Elderly patients often exhibit non-specific or atypical symptoms (prolonged cough, fatigue, weight loss, or only mild fever), leading to delayed diagnosis. If untreated, TB can progress to respiratory failure, extensive lung injury, or spread to lymph nodes, meninges, bones/joints, or disseminated disease. Early detection and strict adherence to anti-TB therapy yield better outcomes; close monitoring for drug side effects is essential in this population. Seek evaluation for a cough >3 weeks, sputum, hemoptysis, dyspnea, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss, especially in Vietnam (e.g., Bac Ninh).

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者の肺結核は危険か？
triage.triage_reason: 結核の一般的な臨床情報・教育的記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイク、異常な症例集積、または公衆衛生上の新規事象を報告していない。
triage.notes: この記事はベトナムのニュースメディアに掲載された結核の臨床的・医学的な啓発記事である。サマリーは高齢者における結核の危険性、症状、診断、治療について一般向けに説明しているもので、特定のアウトブレイク、新規患者集積、または公衆衛生上の異常事象を報告していない。したがって、シグナルトリアージの対象外として見送られるべき情報である。

article.articleHeadline: A U.S. doctor went to Congo to heal others. Then Ebola hit his hospital
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 500 suspected cases with at least 130 deaths. American surgeon Peter Stafford, the sole clinician at Nyankunde Hospital in a remote area, developed fever and nausea and tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, which has no vaccine or treatment and a 25–50% fatality rate. He was evacuated in a specialized containment tube to a U.S. military base in Germany for care; other hospital patients and staff linked to the facility are to be quarantined in Germany, with one person moving to the Czech Republic. Stafford’s wife Rebekah, also a physician, was exposed through an obstetrics patient, and the couple’s four children are being shielded as authorities plan safe transport. The WHO declared an international public health emergency in Congo and neighboring Uganda. The U.S. will fund up to 50 treatment clinics in Congo and Uganda, with the CDC coordinating response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人医師はコンゴで他者を治療するために出発した。その後、エボラがその病院を襲った
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響500+疑い例・130+死亡、予想外の流行、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WHOが国際公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、Uganda、Germany、Czechiaが含まれているが、記事の主題は民主共和国コンゴでのエボラ流行。Ugandaは隣接国として言及されているが、主要な発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。米国人医者の事例は国際的注目を集めているが、美国・ドイツ・チェコは対象国外。WHOが既に国際公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Perketat Pintu Masuk RI Usai WHO Tetapkan Ebola Darurat Global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Ministry Tightens Entry Points into Indonesia After WHO Declares Ebola a Global Emergency.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Ministry reports no Ebola cases in the country. On May 17, 2026, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, signaling global alert and cross-border transmission concerns with high mortality. In response, Indonesia will tighten entry points at ports and airports, increasing surveillance for travelers from affected nations. Preparedness includes on-site health worker readiness, enhanced traveler screening, and established hospital referral procedures for travelers showing Ebola-compatible symptoms. All reports from entry points will be monitored via the Early Warning and Response System (SKDR) and the Public Health Emergency Operation Center (PHEOC).

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、WHOがエボラを世界的緊急事態に認定した後、インドネシアへの出入国を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つ全て該当。WHOがPHEIC（国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したエボラ疾患であり、深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが全て認定される。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生がWHOによりPHEIC宣言されており、インドネシアは現在国内未確認だが、対応措置を強化している。記事の主題はインドネシアの防止対策であるため、verified_locationsにはインドネシアのみを記載。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではインドネシアの対応が主題であり、発生地域としてのDRC・ウガンダの位置付けは背景情報である。

article.articleHeadline: Why Is The Latest Ebola Outbreak So Hard To Contain? Explained
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda is spreading rapidly, with dozens of deaths and hundreds of suspected infections as of 2026-05-20. The World Health Organization has declared a global health emergency. The Bundibugyo variant has no widely approved vaccine or specific treatment; containment hinges on isolation, contact tracing, and infection-control measures. Cross-border spread includes cases in Uganda’s Kampala and in Goma, DRC, with urban centers at risk due to movement among mining towns, border regions, and cities. Conflict zones in eastern Congo hinder surveillance, testing, and treatment amid weak health systems, violence, and mistrust. Many infections go undetected because symptoms resemble malaria or typhoid. Transmission is via infected bodily fluids, not airborne, but the outbreak has a high fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: 最新のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが封じ込めにくい理由は？解説
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO が世界保健上の緊急事態を宣言。複数国にまたがる急速な拡大、高い致死率、ワクチンなし、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak. Uganda mentioned as neighboring country with cases (Kampala), but article's primary focus is DRC. Since Uganda is not in target country list, only DRC is included in verified_locations. Multiple deaths, hundreds of suspected infections, WHO declared global health emergency. High fatality rate, no widely approved vaccine. Cross-border transmission confirmed. Conflict zones impeding response.

article.articleHeadline: ¿El ébola podría convertirse en una pandemia? Experto responde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Could Ebola Become a Pandemic? Expert Responds.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is unlikely to become a global pandemic, according to epidemiologist Alejandro Macías, though it presents a grave, months-long containment challenge requiring international cooperation. The region has weakened health systems and limited diagnostic capacity, hindering timely case identification and isolation. Unlike COVID-19, Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, yet it remains highly lethal, with mortality estimated between 40% and 70% depending on care quality. Early symptoms include fever, malaise, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and vomiting, potentially progressing to hemorrhaging and multi-organ failure. The expert warned of potential imported cases to Mexico via travelers but said sustained transmission there is unlikely. Outbreak control hinges on strengthened surveillance, expanded diagnostics, and infusion of medical supplies and personnel. Hantavirus transmission is not pandemic, with limited spread. Authorities should monitor travelers from Central Africa, especially during FIFA World Cup 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは世界的パンデミックになる可能性があるか？専門家が回答
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ爆発により、IHR基準で「異常・予想外（Yes）」「国際的拡大リスク（Yes）」の2基準に該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度（Yes：死亡率40-70%）」「流行しやすさ（Yes：ヒト-ヒト感染）」「管理可能性（Yes：国際協力を要する）」が該当し、国際的な関心が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ爆発が主要な懸念事項。メキシコへの輸入症例の可能性言及されているが、サマリーではメキシコでの継続的な感染は「unlikely」と述べられているため、メキシコは実際の発生地としては含めない。ハンタウイルスはパンデミック的流行ではないと記述。2026年FIFAワールドカップでの監視需要が言及されている点から国際的関心の高さが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola mieri do Európy: Česko a Nemecko prevezmú amerických pacientov z afrického epicentra | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola heads to Europe: Czechia and Germany will take in American patients from the African epicenter | Info.sk
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts international response as the US CDC confirms urgent European assistance. Seven Americans exposed in the outbreak area will be transported to specialized European facilities under strict security. One US citizen with laboratory-confirmed Ebola will be moved to Germany for treatment at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin in a high-containment isolation unit. The remaining six exposed individuals are in transit preparation; five will go to Germany and one to the Czech Republic, remaining in quarantine during transit. The Czech Republic will admit the incoming patient to Prague’s Bulovka University Hospital for immediate isolation. WHO has declared the Congo outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Diagnostic tests for this Ebola strain are highly effective, with the CDC coordinating closely with local authorities for isolation, sampling, and testing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがヨーロッパへ向かう：チェコとドイツがアフリカのエピセンターからアメリカ人患者を受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的関心事象（PHEIC）として宣言されているため、フルリスク評価（RRA）に進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生と患者の国際移送を主題としている。プラハ、ドイツへの移送情報は病院受け入れ準備に関するもので、DRC外での新規発生ではなく、DRCでの発生事象の国際対応を記述している。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の感染症イベント発生地として該当する。

article.articleHeadline: สธ. จับตาการแพร่ระบาดอีโบลาใกล้ชิด ยังไม่พบผู้ป่วยในประเทศไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health monitors Ebola outbreak closely; no cases detected in Thailand yet.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Thailand is monitoring an Ebola outbreak declared in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo by the World Health Organization, but no cases have been detected in Thailand. Ebola is a highly lethal viral disease transmitted mainly through blood and body fluids (blood, saliva, vomit, feces) and requires close contact with an infected person or their cadaver; it is not readily airborne like measles or COVID-19. Early symptoms resemble fever, fatigue, muscle pain, nausea, and vomiting, with bleeding in severe cases. The government emphasizes strong contact tracing, isolation, and adequate infection-prevention equipment, and laboratory readiness to manage suspected cases. Authorities urge the public to follow health authorities, avoid panicking, and maintain basic hygiene. No Thai cases reported to date; ongoing international outbreak is in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ出血熱の流行を厳密に監視、タイではまだ患者は発見されていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は高致死性疾患で、DRコンゴでの流行はタイを含む地域における国際的な関心事項である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行はIturi州（DRコンゴ東部）で宣言されており、現在タイに症例はないが、地域的監視が強化されている。WPROスクリーニング基準の5基準すべてが該当し、公式な政府監視体制が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: US pledges major Ebola aid surge, slams WHO over delayed alert in Africa outbreak - Mangalorean.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa centered in a remote, conflict-affected region of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of May 20, 2026, one evacuee-linked case has tested positive, with eight others evacuated. The United States pledges a major aid surge, about $23 million already deployed, and preparations for a nine-figure package to fund up to 50 Ebola treatment centres and clinics in affected areas. Washington criticizes the WHO for a delayed alert; May 5 reports of viral hemorrhagic fever were not confirmed as Ebola for 10 days, with outbreak publicly acknowledged on May 15. A 24-hour State Department task force and a Disaster Assistance Response Team, plus CDC personnel (over 100 in DRC and 30+ in Kampala), are deployed. CDC Title 42 bars foreign nationals previously in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days. The DRC national football team may still participate in the FIFA World Cup due to players training in Europe. USAID reductions are denied as weakening detection.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱の大規模援助を約束、アフリカでの勃発に対するWHOの遅延警告を非難 - Mangalorean.com
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目中3項目以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。国際的な対応と支援が進行中の重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 紛争地域での流行、複数国からの避難者確認、米国による大規模援助展開（$23M既配備+9桁規模パッケージ準備）、CDC Title 42による渡航制限実施、WHO警告の遅延批判など、複数の深刻な懸念要素が存在。記事でUgandaとSudan（South Sudan）も言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCが中心であり、他国での実際の症例発生は確認されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: "On n'est pas prêt" en cas d'arrivée du virus Ebola à Mayotte, estiment les syndicats du CHM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We're not ready" in the event of the Ebola virus arriving in Mayotte, the CHM unions say.
article.articleSummary: Ebola arrival in Mayotte remains a theoretical risk as of May 20, 2026, prompting precautionary measures after a government announcement to prepare for potential cases. With the Ebola outbreak raging in the Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities alerted the prefecture and ARS since Sunday, mobilizing the CHM to plan care and surveillance. Union leaders warn 'we are not ready,' citing bed and staffing shortages, while ARS has yet to issue preventive communications. Santé Publique France and Inserm model the importation risk as very low, noting an average seven-day incubation and that most travel is by boat. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak involved over 28,000 cases and only about a dozen exported cases to the US, Spain, UK, and France. Mayotte also fights dengue, chikungunya, and malaria, with around 30 cases in early May; unions demand better working conditions for staff.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラウイルスがマヨットに到来した場合、我々は準備ができていない」とCHMの労働組合は述べている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスのマヨット到来は理論的リスクであり、実際の発生ではなく予防的対応である。DRCでの流行が背景にあるが、マヨットへの輸入リスクは「非常に低い」と公式評価されており、実患者報告がない段階での警戒態勢である。
triage.notes: マヨットはフランス領土であり対象国外。記事の主題は「DRCでのエボラ流行に伴うマヨットへの輸入リスク」であり、実際の感染事例ではなく予防的警戒。DRCでの流行は確認されているが、マヨットへの実際の感染報告なし。地元労働組合による医療態勢への懸念は社会的関心を示すが、公式リスク評価は「非常に低い」とされている。続報でマヨットでの症例確認があれば即座にPICKUP対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Update: May 19, 2026
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the United States is coordinating a comprehensive Ebola response to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The Department of State, working with the CDC, prioritizes American protection, including evacuation for medical treatment or quarantine and enforcing CDC Title 42 restrictions on entry for foreign nationals who traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. Level 4 travel advisories have been issued for DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. A dedicated Ebola Response Task Force was activated, drawing on GHSD, DHR, CA, MED, CDC, and other interagency partners, led by veterans of prior Ebola missions. A Disaster Assistance Response Team (DART) is deploying to the DRC to bolster field coordination, while U.S. global health experts partner with CDC to accelerate planning and response. Expanded humanitarian and health assistance will support frontline workers and partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応アップデート: 2026年5月19日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つ全てに該当する：エボラは深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での同時アウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）は異常で国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航制限・貿易制限レベルの措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダのアウトブレイク対応について言及しているが、対象国リストはDRCのみであるため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。南スーダンも同様に対象国外。米国の対応・政策は言及されているが、米国内でのアウトブレイク発生は記事サマリーに記載されていないため、米国は verified_locations に含めない。複数国での同時発生という異常性、レベル4旅行警告の発令、DART展開など国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Viruserkrankung: Ebola-Patient in Berliner Charité aufgenommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral infection: Ebola patient admitted to Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease patient, a U.S. citizen, has been admitted to Berlin's Charité – Universitätsmedizin in a dedicated isolation ward. The admission was announced by the Federal Ministry of Health. The patient contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the Ebola outbreak is currently spreading rapidly. This case represents an imported infection being treated in Germany; the report provides no details on the patient's symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or clinical outcome. The use of a special isolation unit underscores Germany's precautions for suspected Ebola cases and cross-border transmission. No additional cases are reported in Germany in connection with this event. The information is current as of May 20, 2026, the published date.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス感染症：エボラ患者がベルリンのシャリテに入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。高病原性エボラウイルス病の国際越境例であり、ドイツでの隔離治療は確認済みだが、コンゴでの流行状況が急速に拡大しており、さらなる輸入症例や国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、患者はコンゴでエボラウイルスに感染し、ドイツ（ベルリン）に輸入された事例である。ドイツ・米国はWPRO対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。コンゴでの流行が急速に拡大中との記述があり、継続的な国際的懸念がある。患者の症状・臨床的転帰の詳細が不明である点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Seals Borders And Mobilizes Millions To Halt Africa Ebola Outbreak - Tampa Free Press
article.articleSummary: Active Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts a U.S. emergency response. A Title 42 entry ban blocks foreign nationals who traveled through DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days, and a Level 4 travel advisory covers those nations. A dedicated Ebola Response Task Force, led by two veteran containment experts, and a Disaster Assistance Response Team deploy to the DRC to coordinate operations with authorities and aid groups. Washington released $23 million to strengthen contact tracing, laboratory testing, border screening, and safe burial practices, and will fund up to 50 temporary emergency clinics in the DRC and Uganda for rapid screening, triage, and isolation. Initial PPE stockpiles have shipped; U.S. embassies remain open. Americans abroad are urged to enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program for emergencies or evacuations.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、国境を閉鎖しアフリカのエボラ出血熱アウトブレーク阻止に数百万ドルを動員
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレーク（DRC・ウガンダ）は重大な公衆衛生影響を有し、米国による国家規模の緊急対応（国境封鎖、Title 42発令、渡航禁止令Level 4、2,300万ドル配置）が実施されており、IHR基準3つ以上該当、かつWPRO基準全て該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域に米国（Washington DC）が含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際のエボラ出血熱イベント発生地はDRC・ウガンダであり、米国は対応国として記載されているため除外。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当する。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Expected to Persist Beyond Two Months, WHO Warns - South Africa Today
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo strain is unlikely to be controlled in the next two months. As of 2026-05-20, at least 134 deaths confirmed, over 500 suspected cases and about 130 suspected deaths; patient zero unidentified; virus spread undetected for weeks due to strain evading standard tests. WHO declares public health emergency of international concern. Outbreak centered near borders with Uganda and South Sudan; Rwanda tightened border controls and activated preparedness. WHO mobilizing resources, assessing vaccines and treatments for possible use. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids (vomit, stool); even after death, the body remains contagious; traditional burial practices can fuel spread. Early identification, isolation, and safe burial practices are critical. Local transmission dynamics complicate containment; response teams expanding operations on the ground.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo でのエボラアウトブレイク、2ヶ月以上続くと予想 - WHO が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、かつ WPRO スクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症は最高リスクの病原体であり、複数国での確認と国際的懸念表明により、緊急のフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain による DRC 北東部でのエボラアウトブレイク。2026年5月20日時点で確認死亡134人、疑い症例500人以上、疑い死亡130人。ウガンダ・南スーダン国境近くで発生し、ルワンダが国境管理を強化。WHO が国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。標準検査を回避する特性により初期検出が遅延。伝統的埋葬慣行がウイルス拡散を助長するリスク。記事では Uganda、Sudan、Rwanda が地理的に言及されているが、アウトブレイク自体は DRC で発生しており、他国は確認事例なく国境管理対応にとどまるため、verified_locations は DRC のみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Meningkat, Uganda Larang Masyarakat Jabat Tangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak on the rise, Uganda bans handshakes.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda, one fatal; both cases involve citizens of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda's Health Ministry has banned handshakes and other greetings to reduce transmission risk. On 17 May 2026, the WHO designated the Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The DRC reports 131 Ebola deaths; its prior outbreak ended in October 2025. The article provides no details on symptoms or laboratory confirmation. The Ugandan cases are highlighted as part of ongoing surveillance and cross-border risk, with no further information on exposure source or travel history. The situation underscores heightened alert in Uganda as health authorities monitor disease dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行が拡大、ウガンダは国民に握手を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC指定がなされている。エボラ熱の国際的な拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、死亡例を含む重症事例、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明確である。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはリスト対象国であり、記事の主題となる発生地である。WHOのPHEIC指定（2026年5月17日）により、国際的な懸念が公式に認められている。DRCでの131名の死亡例、ウガンダへの越境伝播、ヒト-ヒト感染防止措置の実施が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 视频丨埃博拉疫情蔓延 刚果（金）医疗系统承压
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | Ebola outbreak spreading; Democratic Republic of the Congo's healthcare system under pressure.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 644 confirmed and suspected cases, with 131 deaths. Health Minister Kamba said the new wave is still spreading. The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri Province, particularly Bunia, where the healthcare system is overwhelmed. Hospitals report severe shortages of facilities, medicines, PPE, and staff; at Ruanpala General Hospital, medical director Isaak Mujeni says there is no space to admit patients, tents have been set up to isolate them, and more beds, drugs, and personnel are urgently needed. Ituri's crowded markets and high mobility hinder containment, with transmission through contact with blood, body fluids, secretions, or excreta from infected individuals or animals. Students in Bunia report lacking basic sanitation—no handwashing basins and no mask mandates—highlighting weak preventive measures in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 動画｜エボラ疫情が拡大 コンゴ民主共和国の医療システムが圧迫下にある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認・疑い患者644例、死亡131例という深刻な公衆衛生影響（IHR基準該当）。医療システムの崩壊的逼迫、不十分な対策、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確である（WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当）。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイトゥリ州・ブニア市のエボラ感染症の急速な拡大、医療施設の深刻な逼迫（医療従事者不足、医薬品・PPE不足、患者受け入れ不可）を報告。患者数644例（確認・疑い含む）、死亡131例は重篤な状況を示す。市場の混雑、高い人口移動性、基本的衛生施設の欠落が感染拡大を加速。国際的な医療支援の急速な必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 'We're working on it': HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on Ebola, hantavirus response - Delta Daily News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo includes an American infected; the CDC says a small number of Americans are directly affected. HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. told ABC News the administration is 'working on it' as it coordinates the response. The CDC confirms no Ebola cases in America, and U.S. hantavirus activity is being monitored: there are no confirmed hantavirus cases linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship, with 18 passengers under observation at the University of Nebraska. Kennedy noted the CDC has been addressing the outbreak since day one, while Deputy Assistant Heidi Overton reiterated there are no Ebola cases in America. The report emphasizes ongoing international outbreaks with domestic surveillance and public messaging.

triage.headline_ja: 「対応を進めています」：HHS長官ロバート・F・ケネディ・ジュニアがエボラ出血熱、ハンタウイルス対応について語る - Delta Daily News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつエボラ出血熱という高危険病原体の国際的発生とアメリカへの波及が報道されており、社会・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱発生を主題とし、アメリカ国内への波及（アメリカ人感染者1名、ハンタウイルス調査中）を報告している。ハンタウイルスはネブラスカ州で報告されているが、これは対象国外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。高度な政治的関心（HHS長官の公式コメント）と国際的な対応体制が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: KKM perkukuh kesiapsiagaan hadapi risiko Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KKM strengthens preparedness to face Bundibugyo ebolavirus risk
article.articleSummary: Malaysia's Health Ministry (KKM) strengthened preparedness against Bundibugyo ebolavirus risk after outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 16 May, WHO reports eight laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths in Ituri, DRC, with two laboratory-confirmed cases in Kampala, Uganda, including one death, involving travellers from DRC. Malaysia is monitoring travelers entering from Uganda and DRC, including transits through Dubai, Doha, and Singapore, noting there are no direct flights from these countries to Malaysia. Enhanced surveillance at international entry points, early detection, and health-facility readiness for isolation and management of suspected cases are being implemented. PPE stocks, diagnostic capacity via collaboration with the Institute for Medical Research and National Public Health Laboratory, and coordination with WHO are reinforced. Travellers with travel history to affected countries should seek care within 21 days of symptom onset and rely on official sources for information.

triage.headline_ja: マレーシア保健省がブンディブギョエボラウイルスのリスクに対する態勢強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ確認事例、国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での監視強化がIHR基準を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常/予想外性、重症度、流行可能性が確認でき、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はマレーシアの準備状況を扱っているが、実際のエボラ確認事例はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri地域）とウガンダ（Kampala）に限定される。Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域にはUAE、Qatar、Singaporeなどの監視対象国が含まれているが、サマリーでは「direct flights」がなく「transit」のみの言及であるため、これらの国での実際の発生確認はない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCとウガンダのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉持续在刚果肆虐 世卫警告疫情不会短期内结束 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to ravage the Democratic Republic of the Congo as WHO warns the outbreak will not end anytime soon.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) worsens in eastern provinces, with authorities reporting over 500 suspected Ebola cases and about 130 suspected deaths, but only 30 laboratory-confirmed. Uganda has two imported Ebola infections. WHO says patient zero is not identified and cautions the outbreak could persist for months as the virus has spread to two provinces; test kits are being shipped to eastern DRC to improve confirmation. UNICEF-supplied disinfection gear, PPE, and water purification are arriving in Ituri’s Bunia to support response. Local NGOs are setting up treatment tents for Ebola patients, though the outbreak remains uncontained. President Tshisekedi and the premier discussed the crisis; WHO will convene a technical advisory group to prioritize vaccines, including Ervebo (for Zaire ebolavirus), though deployment would take about two months. The United States plans funding for up to 50 treatment centers in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国で継続的に猛威を振るっており、WHOは疫情が短期内に終わらないと警告している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は死亡例を伴う多数の疑い例が報告されており、複数州への拡大、国際的な二次感染（ウガンダ）が確認されている重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州（ブニア市を含む）であることが確認される。ウガンダについては二次感染（輸入例2件）が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRC内での拡大に焦点が当たっている。USの治療センター資金は対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo エボラウイルスの特定株、患者ゼロ未確認、複数州への拡大、検査確認率の低さ（30/500以上）、予防接種展開に2ヶ月要するなど管理上の課題が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Apakah Kucing yang Memangsa Tikus Bisa Ikut Tularkan Hantavirus?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can cats that prey on mice also transmit hantavirus?
article.articleSummary: Cats that prey on hantavirus-infected mice may themselves become infected but are not known to transmit the virus to other animals or humans, according to BRIN researcher Ristiyanto; cats are dead-end hosts, similar to humans, with antibodies neutralizing the virus. Human transmission of hantavirus is rare, except for the Andes strain which requires very close contact. Hantavirus is primarily carried by rodents; human infection typically occurs via contact with infected rat urine, feces, or saliva, with inhalation of dried particles increasing risk. Prevention centers on rodent control rather than traps alone, plus improved sanitation, sealing entry points, and community-wide measures. BRIN surveillance indicates about 20% of captured rats carry hantavirus or leptospirosis. Environmental health standards aim for rodent density below 1% in settlements, but observed averages are around 5%. Rodenticide use should be monitored, and sustained, collaborative control is needed.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミを捕食する猫はハンタウイルスを伝染させることができるか？
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるハンタウイルスおよびレプトスピラ症に関する情報提供記事。BRIN調査により地域でのげっ歯類感染率が確認されているが、現在の記事は主に啓発・予防情報であり、新規発生事例や流行の報告ではない。継続的な疫学監視情報として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはハンタウイルス・レプトスピラ症の疾病啓発・予防情報であり、現在の流行事例や異常な症例集積の報告ではない。ただしBRIN調査データによるげっ歯類キャリア率（約20%）の継続的監視と、定着したげっ歯類密度管理課題（目標1%、実績5%）が示唆されている。インドネシアにおけるげっ歯類関連感染症の地域的課題として継続観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Viruserkrankung: Warum ein Ebola-Patient in Berlin behandelt werden soll
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Illness: Why an Ebola Patient Should Be Treated in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected American is being treated in a specialized isolation unit at Berlin's Charité after contracting the virus during an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. U.S. authorities requested Germany’s help to shorten the flight time. The patient poses no threat to the public, as he is admitted to a dedicated station fully separated from regular hospital operations. Wastewater is collected in tanks, treated and neutralized; used protective gear and waste are disposed of by a specialized company; the building’s exhaust is filtered by two systems before release. Charité’s isolation unit is the largest in Germany and the only one combining infectious disease care with intensive care; it can isolate up to 20 people and trains staff twice monthly. Initial assessment and diagnostics, aided by proximity to the Robert Koch Institute and a specialized laboratory, allow tailored treatment. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with infected individuals or body fluids, with early symptoms resembling flu or diarrhea, potentially progressing to multiorgan failure; mortality has fallen from ~60% to ~20–30% with new treatments.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス疾患：なぜエボラ患者がベルリンで治療されるべきなのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認症例であり、国際的な患者搬送（DRC→ドイツ）を伴う。IHR基準において異常性・国際的拡大リスク・重症度の観点で複数基準に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準においても重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性で複数基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ感染症例はDRC での発生事例であり、患者が医療目的でドイツ（ベルリン）に搬送された事案と解釈される。DRCが対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。ドイツ（ベルリン）は対象国外のため除外。本事案は国際的な感染症対応（患者搬送、感染管理、多国間協力）を伴う為、フルRRA進行の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Did Nazi Elon Musk, his soulless DOGE boys and the Trump Regime he bought cause the current Ebola outbreak? Will it spread to and in USA?
article.articleSummary: Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo face a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak, prompting WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern. An American doctor has tested positive; reported cases and deaths have surged, with officials cautioning figures may be higher. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or treatment. Incubation up to 21 days; early symptoms resemble cold/flu, and transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, though some research suggests infectious aerosols may play a role, particularly from the GI/respiratory tracts or medical procedures. Studies warn Ebola could evolve toward respiratory transmission, and current transmission has included unprecedented human-to-human spread in recent months, with reports of superspreaders and an infectious dose as low as about 10 particles. The article additionally claims political actions by Musk/USAID and the Trump administration hindered outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ナチスのイーロン・マスク、彼の無情なDOGE boys、そして彼が買った トランプ政権は現在のエボラ流行を引き起こしたのか？それはUSAに広がり、USA内で広がるのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。WHO国際的懸念宣言、米国での患者報告、ヒト-ヒト感染と超スプレッダーの報告から、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づきウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が主題。米国での医師患者報告があるが、米国（ID 6252001）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法なし、WHO国際的懸念宣言、超スプレッダー報告、気溶胶感染の可能性言及により、高リスク判定。記事の政治的主張部分は信頼性評価の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Границы закрываются: как мир реагирует на новую вспышку Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Borders Are Closing: How the World Is Reacting to a New Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, Ebola outbreaks are prompting sweeping border restrictions and travel bans. In Central Africa, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has confirmed over 350 Ebola cases and at least 136 suspected deaths, with authorities expanding contact tracing and monitoring of transmission foci. Jordan imposes a one-month temporary entry ban on nationals from neighboring states where Ebola cases have been reported. The United States bans entry for foreigners who have visited specified African countries. In Uganda, after two confirmed Ebola cases and one death, officials have temporarily prohibited handshakes nationwide as a social precaution. The article highlights rapid border controls, partial border closures, and intensified tracking efforts as governments react to the evolving outbreak, while border and travel measures aim to slow cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国境が閉鎖される：世界が新たなエボラ熱流行にどう対応しているか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当。エボラ出血熱の多発生地域での大規模流行であり、複数国による国境制限・入国禁止措置が講じられており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として判定される。
triage.notes: DRCの東北部で350例以上の確認症例、136例以上の死亡疑い例が報告されている。記事サマリー上、Uganda、Jordan、United Statesも言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC発生地の流行であり、他国は対応策として言及されているため verified_locations はDRCのみ。発生地域リストのUgandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。配信日時が2026年5月となっているため、将来日付の記事であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo prepares for World Cup despite Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo intersects with DR Congo’s World Cup 2026 preparations in North America. FIFA is monitoring with the Congo DR Football Association and coordinating with the US DHS, CDC, Mexico’s health ministry, Canada’s PHAC, and WHO to ensure a safe tournament. DR Congo canceled a Kinshasa training camp due to health restrictions, while preparations continue in Europe and Houston. The team will base in Houston for the summer, with opening Group K game on June 17 against Portugal in Houston; subsequent matches: June 23 vs Colombia in Zapopan, Mexico, and June 27 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. The US CDC has paused entry for 30 days for travelers who recently visited Ebola outbreak sites (DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan). CDC notes ongoing collaboration with FIFA to ensure safe travel and public safety during the event.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱の流行にもかかわらずワールドカップの準備を進める
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行地（DRC）からの国際的なスポーツイベント参加に伴う国際的な拡大リスク、複数国の保健当局が関与した対応が確認される。IHR基準3つ以上（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに多数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ流行とワールドカップの関連。実際の感染事例の具体的な数字は不明だが、複数国の保健当局（CDC、WHO、カナダPHAC、メキシコ保健省）が関与していることから対応の重要性が高い。ウズベキスタン、スーダン、ウガンダなどがリストに含まれるが、記事サマリーで直接のイベント発生地として言及されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is not connected to COVID-19, says Mumbai doctor amid outbreak concerns
article.articleSummary: Outbreak concerns in Mumbai prompted Dr. Manisha Bhatt of Zynova Shalby Hospital to reiterate that Ebola is unrelated to COVID-19; there is no connection between the diseases, and misinformation fuels fear. Ebola spreads primarily through direct contact with blood or body fluids of infected people and via contact with infected animals such as fruit bats, chimpanzees, gorillas, and monkeys. It is not airborne. Transmission can also occur through contaminated objects and unsafe burial practices. Common symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, abdominal pain, and skin rashes; early symptoms may resemble other viral infections, complicating diagnosis. Timely diagnosis and treatment, strict infection control, and isolation at dedicated centers are critical. Precautions include washing hands, avoiding contact with infected fluids or animal reservoirs, and seeking verified medical guidance and vaccination information. No case counts are provided; the discussion centers on awareness and outbreak concerns as of 2026-05-20.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイの医師がエボラはCOVID-19と無関係と述べる、アウトブレイク懸念の中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの異常/予想外な出現が示唆されているが、具体的な確認症例数や流行規模が記事に記載されていない。情報の不完全性のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は「アウトブレイク懸念」を述べているが、確認患者数、発症者数、死亡数などの具体的な流行指標が記載されていない。医師による啓発記事の性質が強く、実際の流行の規模や重症度は不明。ムンバイを含むマハラシュトラ州での発生と示唆されている。エボラウイルスはWPRO地域では極めて異常な出来事であり、動物由来感染症としても流行性が高い。引き続き確認症例の報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 20多歲男染M痘！疾管署：台灣首見Ib型病毒株　小心5大皮膚症狀 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man in his twenties contracts mpox! Taiwan CDC: Taiwan's first Type Ib viral strain detected; beware of five major skin symptoms | yam News
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) in Taiwan: In May 2026, Taiwan's CDC confirmed two mpox cases—one domestic in a man in his 40s in northern Taiwan with unsafe-sex exposure, and one imported in a man in his 20s who had unsafe sex in Thailand in April. Genotyping identified the imported case as Ib-type (Branch I, sub-branch Ib)—the first Ib-type detected in Taiwan since mpox became a notifiable disease in 2022; other local cases involve II-type strains. Through May 18, Taiwan had 14 mpox confirmations this year (12 domestic, 2 imported), totaling 530 cases (493 domestic, 37 imported) nationwide. Incubation can reach 21 days; transmission may occur 1–4 days before symptoms. Symptoms include skin lesions such as rashes and vesicles, fever, and lymphadenopathy. Two-dose mpox vaccination provides about 90% protection; one dose 40–80%. Free vaccination at 312 clinics; high-risk groups urged to vaccinate. For inquiries, call 1922.

triage.headline_ja: 20代男性がM痘に感染！台湾CDC：台湾初のIb型ウイルス株を検出　5大皮膚症状に注意
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での新規Mpox Clade I Ib型の検出は異常・予想外であり、IHR基準の複数該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に加えてWPRO基準でも複数該当。域内での新型株検出による流行対策強化の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 台湾での新規Mpox Clade I Ib型検出は初となり、域内での新型株の出現と流行の可能性を示唆。タイでの曝露による輸入症例から検出されたため、地域内での動向監視が重要。現在の流行は主にClade II型であるため、新型株の出現は公衆衛生上の重大関心事。台湾は対象国リスト外だが、タイでの曝露が確認されているため検証地域にタイを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Kronologi Pasien Hantavirus Meninggal di RSHS, Kemenkes RI Pastikan Terjadi di 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Timeline of a Hantavirus Patient's Death at RSHS, Indonesian Ministry of Health Confirms It Occurred in 2025
article.articleSummary: On 2025, a 49-year-old male construction worker from Cibeunying Kolot, Bandung, died at Hasan Sadikin Hospital (RSHS Bandung) after being treated for hantavirus and leptospirosis. The Indonesian Ministry of Health confirmed the case occurred in 2025 and stated it is not related to a hantavirus outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise. Initial illness began about six days before admission with intermittent fever, followed by severe right upper quadrant abdominal pain and jaundice one day prior to hospital arrival. He also experienced nausea and vomiting. On admission he had fever, dyspnea, and jaundice; oxygen saturation declined. Chest radiograph showed bronchopneumonia; ultrasound revealed cardiomegaly. The patient, a relatively young man with no prior comorbidities, died after three days of hospitalization; the family declined intubation. No further laboratory confirmation details were provided.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス患者がRSHSで死亡、インドネシア保健省が2025年の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染による死亡例の報告であり、IHR基準で重篤な公衆衛生影響（死亡）と異常性が認められ、国内の保健当局が公式確認している。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（致死例）と流行可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア・バンドン地域（Jawa Barat州）での49歳男性の死亡例を報告している。ハンタウイルスとレプトスピラの混合感染と記載されているが、ハンタウイルスが主要な疾患名として報告されている。インドネシア保健省による公式確認と、MV Hondius クルーズ関連の集団発生との否定的関連付けが記載されており、公的な関心が高い。致死例の報告であるため重症度が高く、ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介であるため流行可能性が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: ÜST Konqo Demokratik Respublikası və Uqandada "Ebola" ilə bağlı fövqəladə vəziyyət elan edib
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has declared a state of emergency in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda regarding Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of May 16, 2026, eastern DRC’s Ituri province reports 8 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections, 246 suspected cases, and 80 deaths, with a new outbreak cluster suspected in North Kivu. In Uganda, two travel-related infections linked to the DRC were confirmed in Kampala, with one death; a separate confirmed case has been identified in Kinshasa, over 2,000 km from the initial focus. The outbreak poses high international risk but does not yet meet pandemic criteria. Contributing factors include ongoing instability and humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC, dense displacement, widespread informal health facilities, and PPE shortages complicating diagnosis and contact tracing. There is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy for this variant. WHO urges intensified surveillance, contact tracing, expanded laboratories, isolation of suspects, and risk communication; borders should not be closed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラに関する国際的健康上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認、複数の死亡者、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態の宣言により、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性で該当し、国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは明確にコンゴ民主共和国のIturi州、North Kivu州、Kinshasa、およびウガンダのKampalで確認と述べられているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2026年の日付記載であり、将来シナリオまたはシミュレーション演習の可能性があるが、イベント情報として処理。

article.articleHeadline: Warum ein Ebola-Patient in Berlin behandelt werden soll
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why an Ebola patient should be treated in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American with Ebola virus disease was flown to Berlin and admitted to a Charité isolation station for containment-based treatment after contracting the infection during an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. German authorities say there is no risk to Charité patients; the unit is separated from the regular hospital, with wastewater collected and neutralized in tanks, protective gear and waste disposed by a specialized company, and building exhaust purified by filter systems before release. Charité’s isolation ward is the largest of its kind in Germany and the only facility combining infectious disease care with intensive care, with capacity for up to 20 patients. Diagnosis and treatment begin with assessment; proximity to the Robert Koch Institute enables blood testing. Modern therapies have reduced Ebola mortality from about 60% to 20–30%. Transmission is mainly via contact with body fluids; early symptoms resemble flu or diarrhea, progressing to multiorgan failure.

triage.headline_ja: なぜエボラ患者がベルリンで治療されるべきなのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク中に感染した患者がドイツに移送された重大なイベントであり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、患者がドイツに移送された事実は対象国外での治療受け入れケースであるため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。ベルリン/ドイツはWPRO対象国外であり評価対象外。高度に管理された医療施設での治療であることから「管理可能性」は評価できず。

article.articleHeadline: ধারণার চেয়েও দ্রুত গতিতে ছড়িয়ে পড়ছে ইবোলা ভাইরাস
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spreading faster than imagined.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has at least 131 deaths, with over 513 suspected cases reported and a related death in neighboring Uganda. Modeling from the MR Center for Global Infectious Disease Analysis suggests under-detection, with more than 1,000 cases likely already occurred. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, underscoring its scale and speed. Authorities believe transmission began weeks before the first identified case on 24 April. There is no vaccine for the Ebola strain driving the spread, though WHO is evaluating other therapeutics. Ituri province, the outbreak’s center, is an extremely insecure area with large population movement, complicating surveillance, investigation, and containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが想像以上の速さで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC主要な発生地を述べており、ウガンダでの関連死の言及もあるが、主要な流行地域はDRC（Ituri州）。サマリーではウガンダでの実際の症例集団発生は報告されておらず、「関連死」のみであるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHOがPHEICを公式に宣言しており、国際的な関心極めて高し。Under-detection により実際症例は1000例以上と推定される。ワクチンなしで感染しやすい状況（不安定地域での大規模人口移動）。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo prepares for World Cup despite Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo plans to compete in the 2026 FIFA World Cup despite an Ebola outbreak affecting the country. FIFA states it is monitoring the Ebola situation and coordinating with the Congo DR Football Association, host-nation governments, WHO, and health authorities to ensure medical and security guidance. The DR Congo squad cancelled a planned Kinshasa training camp due to health restrictions, but training in Europe and Houston continues. The team will base in Houston as its North American hub, with opening Group K match on June 17 in Houston against Portugal; Group games: June 23 vs Colombia in Zapopan, Mexico; June 27 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. The U.S. CDC has paused entry for 30 days for travelers who recently visited Ebola outbreak sites: DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, as part of ongoing precautions. CDC official Satish Pillai said coordination with FIFA is to ensure safe travel and public safety.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行中も2026年ワールドカップに向けて準備を進める
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がコンゴ民主共和国で確認されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当。国際的なスポーツイベント関連の移動制限とWHO連携も示唆される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはメキシコ、米国、ポルトガル、ウズベキスタンなども含まれているが、記事サマリー上でエボラ発生イベント自体はコンゴ民主共和国に限定されており、他国はワールドカップの試合開催地またはCDC渡航制限対象国。Uganda(226074)とSouth Sudan も記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: US Ebola patient admitted to Berlin hospital
article.articleSummary: A US citizen infected with the Ebola virus has been admitted to Charité hospital in Berlin, Germany, into a specialized isolation unit after contracting the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola is spreading rapidly. The patient was transported to Berlin from Uganda on a dedicated aircraft for highly infectious patients and arrived at the hospital shortly before 3 am local time, escorted by police motorcycles, cars, fire brigade vehicles, and ambulances. Charité’s isolation unit is a closed, protected facility separate from regular wards to prevent contact with other patients. Germany’s Health Ministry, citing the US request for assistance, said the patient will receive the best possible care with heightened safety precautions. Ebola is contagious and life-threatening and is transmitted through physical contact and contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人エボラウイルス患者がベルリンの病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な患者移送であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからは、患者がDRC内でエボラウイルスに感染し、ウガンダを経由してベルリンに搬送されたことが明確。DRCでは「Ebola is spreading rapidly」と記載されており、DRCが実際のイベント発生地。ベルリン・ドイツ・米国は患者の移送先・治療地であり、イベント発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Euthanise rabid stray dogs, says Supreme Court amid rise in India dog-bite cases
article.articleSummary: Supreme Court directs euthanasia of stray dogs that are rabid, incurably ill, or demonstrably dangerous to curb rising rabies deaths and dog-bite attacks across India. Tamil Nadu and Karnataka reported more than 200,000 dog-bite cases in Q1 2026, while Delhi International Airport logged about 31 cases in the same period. Authorities may euthanise after veterinary assessment and strictly under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960, the Animal Birth Control Rules, 2023, and other applicable protocols; no FIR or coercive action should be taken against officials for bona fide enforcement. The bench ordered high courts to register suo motu writ petitions as continuing mandamus, with updated compliance affidavits due by August 7, 2026 and consolidated four-monthly reports to the top court. It upheld Animal Welfare Board of India SoPs on securing institutional areas, appointing nodal officers, and removing dogs from specified sites; Maneka Gandhi criticized, saying the court abdicated responsibility.

triage.headline_ja: インド最高裁が狂犬病流行対策として狂犬病の野犬の安楽死を命令
triage.triage_reason: インド全域で犬咬傷事例が急増（タミルナドゥ・カルナタカで200,000件以上）し、狂犬病による死亡が増加している。複数州で同時に公衆衛生的影響が深刻であり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当するため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病自体は既知疾患だが、インド全域での犬咬傷事例の急増（Q1 2026で200,000件超）と政府による緊急対応（最高裁命令による野犬安楽死）は異常事象。デリー国際空港での犬咬傷事例31件も注目。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。社会政治的関心も高い（政治家による批判あり）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola doctor warns outbreak in Congo is 'much bigger' than official figures show
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo exceeds 130 deaths with over 500 suspected cases, signaling potential cross-border spread. Ebola causes fever, vomiting, and catastrophic internal bleeding, with rapid fatality possible. An American exposed to the virus in DR Congo tested positive and was flown to Germany for treatment, currently in a Charité isolation ward in Berlin; six high‑risk contacts are to be transferred to Europe for strict quarantine. Dr. Craig Spencer, who survived the 2014 Guinea outbreak, says the current outbreak is likely larger than official figures suggest, stressing rapid spread and possible undercounting. US aid discussions include plans to establish about 50 clinics to treat Ebola in DR Congo, with reported pledge around £9.7 million (US$13 million); the piece also notes broader WHO-related criticisms and international responses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ医師がコンゴの発生状況は「公式発表より遥かに深刻」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病の多国間への拡大事例であり、死亡例・重症例の多発、国際支援動員の進行状況が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC東部でのエボラ発生であり、130人以上の死亡と500人以上の疑い患者を報告。米国人患者がドイツ（ベルリン）へ搬送されたが、発生地はDRCが主題。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに全項目該当し、死亡率の高さ、公式発表との乖離、国際的な患者移送、支援体制の構築が進行中という点で緊急度が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Novo surto de Ebola na África exige atenção no mundo todo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak in Africa demands worldwide attention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Suspected cases exceed 500 and deaths surpass 130. Bundibugyo has an incubation up to 21 days, enabling asymptomatic travelers to spread the virus. Initial symptoms include fever, aches, and fatigue, progressing to diarrhea, vomiting, and bleeding. There is no vaccine specific to Bundibugyo; about $26.7 million is funding vaccine development by Oxford, Leipzig, and Moderna for Bundibugyo and other strains, and there are discussions to test a Zaire vaccine in this outbreak, with animal data suggesting cross-protection. Containment hinges on rapid contact tracing, community engagement, countering misinformation, and adherence to sanitary measures, especially at funerals. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, a mining region with high traveler flux from gold mining. The United States has barred entry for people who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days (for 30 days).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカにおける新たなエボラ出血熱の流行が世界全体の注意を要求している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として確実にシグナル扱いされるべき事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。Bluedot APIが複数国を列挙しているのは、ワクチン開発地（イギリス、ドイツ、アメリカ）や記事配信元の関連性による誤分類と考えられる。世界保健機関によるPHEIC宣言、500件超の疑い患者、130人超の死亡、ワクチン未開発、米国の入域制限など、複数の深刻な指標が揃っている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the Emergency Committee on Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - 19 May 2026
article.articleSummary: On 19 May 2026, WHO Director-General declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola epidemics in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda, the first PHEIC declared before an Emergency Committee convened. Confirmed: DRC 30 cases; Uganda 2 cases in Kampala, including one death; an American national tested positive and was transferred to Germany. Suspected cases exceed 500 and suspected deaths 130, with urban cases in Kampala, Goma and Bunia. Health workers have died, indicating healthcare-associated transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no vaccines or therapeutics. Instability in Ituri due to conflict since 2025 has caused over 100,000 displacements; population movement and mining activity raise spread risk. Uganda postponed Martyrs' Day celebrations. WHO has deployed responders and approved US$3.4 million extra from the Contingency Fund for Emergencies, bringing total to US$3.9 million.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長によるコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダのエボラ流行に関する緊急委員会での開会発言 - 2026年5月19日
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOがPHEICを宣言した国際的に重大なエボラ流行であり、ただちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでの確認症例2件（Kampala）が明記されているが、Bluedot発生地域にはUganda (226074)が含まれている。ただし、主要流行はDRCのIturi地域が中心であり、ウガンダは隣接国への限定的な流行。verified_locationsはDRCのみとしているが、ウガンダへの流行拡大が既に記録されている点は重要。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、USA・Germanyでも輸入症例が確認されているため、国際的な関心と支援必要性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาล กำชับ สธ. ติดตาม อีโบลา เผย ยังไม่พบระบาดในไทย ขอประชาชนอย่าตื่นตระหนก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government urges the Ministry of Public Health to monitor Ebola, says there is no outbreak in Thailand yet, and asks the public not to panic.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports no Ebola outbreak in the country as of May 20, 2026, while Ebola has been designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to an outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The government asks the Ministry of Public Health to monitor the situation per WHO guidance and to coordinate with relevant agencies to prepare care facilities, isolation rooms, PPE, and laboratory readiness for suspected cases. Ebola is an RNA virus transmitted primarily through blood and body fluids, with infection risk concentrated among family members, healthcare workers, and close contacts; it is not easily spread via airborne routes. Initial symptoms resemble flu-like illness—fever, fatigue, myalgias, nausea, vomiting—with possible bleeding in severe cases and high fatality without proper care. Public guidance emphasizes continuous hygiene practices and avoiding panic while awaiting official updates.

triage.headline_ja: タイ政府が保健省にエボラ出血熱の監視を指示、タイ国内での発生はまだ報告されていないと発表し、国民にパニックを起こさないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の発生が確認されており、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻で異常・予想外の事象であるが、タイではまだ確認症例がなく、社会的・政治的関心は限定的。情報が初期段階であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）が主要であり、タイはモニタリング・備備段階。IHR基準3つ、WPRO基準5つが該当するが、タイで実際の発生症例がないため、DRCでの発生を受けた準備段階と位置付けられる。アジア太平洋地域への国際的拡大リスク評価が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫列埃博拉为关注突发事件　大马加强入境监测防输入风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO lists Ebola as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Malaysia tightens entry screening to prevent importation risks.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-17, the World Health Organization declared Ebola virus disease a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Malaysia reports no Ebola cases to date but has tightened entry screening and traveler monitoring from Ebola-affected regions, notably Uganda and Congo (Ituri Province), including passengers transiting through Dubai, Doha, or Singapore; there are no direct Malaysia flights from these countries. As of 2026-05-16, WHO reports eight laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 246 suspected cases globally, with Congo’s Ituri Province recording about 80 suspected deaths; Uganda’s Kampala reports two laboratory-confirmed cases, one death, all with Congo travel history. Ebola spreads via blood and body fluids; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding. Malaysia has reinforced border screening, early detection, isolation readiness, PPE stocks, and enhanced lab capacity with IMR and MKAK. Return travelers with fever or body pains within 21 days should seek medical care; rely on official sources.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱を国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態に指定　マレーシアが入境スクリーニング強化で輸入リスク防止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO による PHEIC 宣言に伴う重大な国際的リスク。対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確定症例と死亡報告があり、地域検証に基づきPICKUP判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（イツリ州）とウガンダ（カンパラ）。マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないが、対象国での発生と国際的拡大リスクが確認されているため、WPRO地域への情報提供として重要。UAE、カタール、シンガポール、マレーシアは経由地・検出国として記載されているが、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情蔓延 刚果（金）医疗系统承压
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads; DR Congo's healthcare system under pressure.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is grappling with an Ebola outbreak that has reached 644 cumulative confirmed and suspected cases, with 131 deaths, as of May 19, 2026. The Ituri province, especially Bunia, remains the epicenter as the Health Ministry reports the outbreak is still spreading. The healthcare system is overwhelmed: at Ruanpala General Hospital, Medical Director Isaac Mujeni says there is no space to admit patients, tents are being used to isolate them, and there are critical shortages of medicines, PPE, and staff. In Ituri, crowded markets and weak infection-control measures raise transmission risk, since Ebola spreads through contact with infected patients or animal blood, body fluids, secretions, and excretions. University student Evarist notes no handwashing facilities or school masking policies, underscoring poor sanitation and elevated exposure in the outbreak zone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の蔓延、コンゴ民主共和国の医療制度が圧力下に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の中規模アウトブレイク（644例、131死亡）で、医療体制の崩壊と継続的感染リスク。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染が主要経路。DRC医療体制の脆弱性、市場での混雑、衛生設備の不足により継続的曝露リスク高い。国際的な支援・警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 视频丨埃博拉疫情蔓延 刚果（金）医疗系统承压-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | Ebola outbreak spreading; Democratic Republic of the Congo's healthcare system under pressure - International Online
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 644 Ebola cases (confirmed and suspected) and 131 deaths across several locations, with the outbreak continuing to expand per Health Minister Kamba. Ituri Province is the epicenter, notably Bunia, where the healthcare system is under severe strain: hospitals lack beds, essential medicines, protective equipment, and staff; tents have been set up to isolate patients, and more may be needed. The Ebola virus can spread through contact with the blood, body fluids, secretions, or excreta of infected people or animals. Markets are crowded and containment measures are limited; students report no handwashing stations or mask requirements in schools. The situation highlights critical gaps in care and infection control as authorities and partners respond to the ongoing outbreak in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 動画｜エボラ出血熱の流行が蔓延 コンゴ民主共和国の医療制度が逼迫 - 国際オンライン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行拡大、高い死亡率、医療システムの崩壊状態、国際的な支援の必要性が明白。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の継続流行で644例（確定+疑い例）、131死亡。イトゥリ州ブニアが震源地。医療施設の著しい機能低下（ベッド不足、医薬品・防護具・スタッフ欠乏）、市場での混雑、学校での感染制御不備など、流行抑制の困難性が顕著。国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: da origem da infecção à letalidade do surto, veja em 4 pontos o que ainda falta ser respondido sobre a emergência internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: From the origin of infection to the outbreak's lethality, see in four points what still needs to be answered about the international emergency.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has prompted the WHO’s highest alert for the ninth time and the third Ebola-related emergency. On May 5, deaths with unknown cause were reported in Bunia; by May 15, Bundibugyo was confirmed, a strain lacking vaccines or specific antivirals, with 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths recorded. Most patients are 20–39 years old. Diagnostic delays occurred because initial tests for the Zaire strain were negative and local Bundibugyo assays were unavailable; nasal hemorrhage appeared by day 5, with confirmation after sending samples to Kinshasa. Origin remains unclear; the first suspected case was April 24 in a Bunia health worker. Bundibugyo is a zoonosis likely with fruit bats as reservoirs; human transmission follows contact with blood/secretions and contaminated surfaces, amplified by unsafe funerals. Ituri’s Mongbwalu area is implicated; Uganda reports two imported cases and one death. Brazil faces no current risk. Case fatality among suspected cases is about 25%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染の起源から流行の致死性まで、国際的緊急事態について回答が必要な4つのポイント
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola outbreakは既知ウイルスの稀な発生地での新規流行であり、WHO最高レベルの警告が発令された第9番目、第3のエボラ関連緊急事態。国際的な公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus outbreak in Ituri Province. 246 suspected cases, 80 deaths as of May 15, 2026. Two imported cases and one death reported in Uganda. WHO issued highest alert (PHEIC declaration). Diagnostic challenges due to initial negative Zaire strain tests; Bundibugyo strain lacks vaccines and specific antivirals. Brazil mentioned as low-risk location and excluded from verified_locations per instructions. Uganda's imported cases do not constitute primary outbreak location—DRC is the primary event location.

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาลสั่ง สธ. ติดตามอีโบลาใกล้ชิด ย้ำยังไม่พบระบาดในไทย ขอประชาชนอย่าตื่นตระหนก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government orders the Ministry of Public Health to closely monitor Ebola; reiterates that there is no outbreak in Thailand; urges the public not to panic.
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, Thailand's government instructed the Ministry of Public Health to monitor Ebola closely after WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. There is currently no Ebola outbreak in Thailand. Ebola virus disease is a severe, highly infectious illness transmitted via blood and bodily fluids, especially from severely ill patients, healthcare workers, and those in contact with patients' bodies; not readily airborne as measles or COVID-19. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, nausea, and vomiting; some patients experience abnormal bleeding and high mortality without proper care. Authorities highlight contact tracing, isolation, and preparedness, including isolation wards, personal protective equipment, and laboratory readiness for suspected cases. Public guidance urges following health authorities, avoiding panic, and maintaining basic hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: タイ政府が保健省にエボラの厳密な監視を指示 タイでの流行はまだ見つかっていないことを再度強調 国民にパニックに陥らないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において少なくとも2つの基準に該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ集団発生が対象国（DRC）で発生しており、タイも監視体制を強化している状況。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのイトゥリ州で発生したエボラ集団発生（WHO PHEIC宣言）であり、タイはこれに対する監視体制強化と準備状況の報告。DRCが実際の発生地で、タイは監視対応中であるため両国を verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ανησυχία για την έξαρση του Έμπολα, τα συμπτώματα και πώς μεταδίδεται-Καθησυχάζουν αλλά συστήνουν προσοχή οι ειδικοί στην Κύπρο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over the Ebola outbreak, its symptoms and how it is transmitted — experts in Cyprus reassure but urge caution.
article.articleSummary: Mass Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks trigger a WHO red alert after cases are detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with an infection diagnosed in a physician hospitalized in Germany. More than 100 deaths and about 390 suspected cases are reported, mainly in the DRC, prompting emergency measures. Cyprus-based experts reassure but caution against complacency given rapid spread. Ebola, a filamentous member of the Filoviridae family, transmits via very close contact through saliva and other body fluids and is linked to bat reservoirs. Early symptoms include sore throat, headache, muscle pains, and malaise, progressing to minor bleeding and hemorrhagic fever with high fatality (roughly 70–80%). Spillovers may arise from bat-contaminated fruit; Uganda and Congo outbreaks flare intermittently but are rapidly contained by isolation. Genetic sequencing monitors for mutations; due to air travel, surveillance and immediate isolation for suspected cases are emphasized, with GOARN and ECDC considering extra expert deployments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの流行拡大への懸念、症状と感染経路——キプロスの専門家は安心させるが注意を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。複数国での重篤なエボラ流行による深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでエボラが確認されており、ドイツで医師の感染が報告されているが、実際の流行発生国はDRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダとドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO赤色警報の発令、100人以上の死亡、390件以上の疑似症例、高い致死率（70-80%）、複数国への国際的拡大が報告されている。GOARN及びECDCによる専門家派遣検討中。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ് വ്യാപനത്തിന്റെ പശ്ചാത്തലത്തില്‍ പൗരന്മാര്‍ക്ക് യാത്രാ വിലക്കുമായി യുഎസ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US imposes travel ban on citizens in the wake of the Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the United States has imposed Level 4 travel bans on its citizens traveling to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda, with Rwanda under a Level 3 advisory. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is confirmed in Ituri Province, DR Congo, with 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases. The Ebola strain involved is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are currently no approved vaccines or specific antiviral therapies.
