Details on symptoms or infection sources are not provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染拡大を受けて米国が国民への渡航禁止措置を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHOがPHEICを宣言した確定事例のため、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、South Sudan、Uganda、Rwandaでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。DRCではIturi Provinceでの確定事例（131死亡、513疑い例）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株、PHEC宣言済み。South Sudan、Uganda、Rwandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国も対象国リストに含まれず、米国の渡航禁止措置は二次的な反応であり発生地として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Congo reports 134 deaths, 550 active cases; WHO raises alarm as virus spreads rapidly, raising concerns of another pandemic
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: As of 20 May 2026, Congo reports 134 deaths and more than 550 active cases, with about 534 suspected cases and 134 suspected deaths since the new outbreak began—up from roughly 200 cases and 65 deaths when announced on Friday. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns Ebola mortality ranges 30–50% with adequate care, higher when care is late or unavailable. The WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) and is deploying resources to two affected provinces near Uganda. Eastern Congo areas are under rebel control. The currently dominant Bundibugyo virus strain has no approved medicines or vaccines, underscoring the urgent need for intensified surveillance and a coordinated response to curb spread and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者：コンゴが134人の死亡者と550の活発な症例を報告；ウイルスが急速に蔓延するため、WHO が警告を発し、別のパンデミックへの懸念が高まっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で深刻な死亡率、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの迫近），WHOによるPHEIC宣言，医療対策不足による管理困難性が確認され、シグナル化を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの流行が主題であり、ウガンダは「近隣でリスク」として言及されているが、実際の症例発生地は明記されていない。したがって verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。WHOのPHEIC宣言、高い致死率（30～50%以上），承認医療がない現在の優位株（Bundibugyo株），反政府勢力支配下の東部コンゴでの対応困難性など、極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Infectólogo advierte que México no está preparado para enfrentar un brote de ébola | Periódico Zócalo | Noticias de Saltillo, Torreón,  Piedras Negras, Monclova, Acuña
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease specialist warns that Mexico is not prepared to face an Ebola outbreak | Zócalo Newspaper | News from Saltillo, Torreón, Piedras Negras, Monclova, Acuña.
article.articleSummary: Mexico is warned about Ebola risk as an infectious-disease specialist notes the country is more vulnerable than at the start of COVID-19, due to hospital and ICU gaps ahead of World Cup 2026. The tournament begins on June 11 with matches in Mexico, the United States, and Canada, raising concerns about infected arrivals. Ebola mortality is 30–50% and no fully effective specific treatment exists. Active outbreaks are in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with more than 100 deaths and hundreds of suspected cases reported. Incubation can reach 21 days; initial symptoms include fever, muscle pain, malaise, and fatigue, advancing to bleeding and multi-organ failure. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids, not by air. Mexico has activated a travel alert for the DRC and implemented surveillance and clinical guidelines; no Ebola cases in Mexico linked to the current outbreak have been identified. A 21-day quarantine proposal for the Congo team was suggested; fan-related risk deemed the major challenge.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医がメキシコはエボラ出血熱の流行に対応する準備ができていないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。現在DRC・ウガンダで活動的な流行があり、2026年W杯という国際的大イベントによる国際的拡大リスクが顕著。メキシコを含む複数対象国への波及懸念が存在。
triage.notes: 現在のエボラウイルス病の活動的流行はDRCとウガンダで発生しており、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。メキシコ・米国・カナダは対象国外だが、DRCでの活動的流行とそこからの国際的拡大リスク（特に2026年W杯を通じた）が明確に述べられている。記事は警告・準備不足についての内容であり、メキシコでの確定症例はまだ報告されていない。シグナルのピックアップ根拠はDRCにおける現在の活動的流行の存在と、国際的なイベントを通じた波及リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Merebak, WHO Pertimbangkan Pakai Vaksin Eksperimental
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads, WHO considers using an experimental vaccine.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) is escalating, prompting WHO to consider use of experimental vaccines or therapeutics to curb transmission. As of May 15, 2026, authorities report at least 500 suspected Ebola cases and 130 suspected deaths, up from about 200 cases and 65 deaths initially reported. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed deep concern over the outbreak’s rapid spread, noting it led to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 18, 2026, the first time a DG has declared PHEIC before an Emergency Committee convened. Urban transmission and infections among healthcare workers raise the risk of nosocomial spread. Ongoing conflict in Ituri has displaced over 100,000 people, potentially accelerating transmission. Authorities are expanding field operations, including surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory testing, as the situation and case counts evolve.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大、WHOが実験的ワクチンの使用を検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みの重大な感染症イベント。DRC（対象国）での急速な流行拡大、死亡者多数、医療施設での感染、国際的関心極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHO Director-General による PHEIC 宣言（2026年5月18日）済み。500疑似症例、130死亡例。都市部での感染と医療従事者感染による院内感染リスク高い。紛争による10万人以上の流離が伝播加速の懸念。実験的ワクチン・治療薬の投入を検討中。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперт Ермолаева: вирус Эбола может сохраняться у человека месяцами
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert Ermolaeva: The Ebola Virus Can Persist in Humans for Months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus can persist in humans for months after recovery, not in blood but in other fluids. In men, the virus may be detectable in semen for months to years (50% cleared by day 115, 90% by day 394; maximum documented 988 days). In breast milk, the virus has been found up to 500 days post-infection, and in the vitreous humor of the eye for months, posing risks of meningioencephalitis. The current outbreak's epicenter is eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province, bordering Uganda. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for DRC and Uganda on May 17. As of May 20, 2026, DRC reports over 500 suspected Ebola cases with at least 131 deaths. These persistence patterns have implications for transmission and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: エルモラエワ専門家：エボラウイルスは人間に数ヶ月間存続する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが国際保健上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、500件を超える疑い例と131人以上の死亡が報告されているエボラアウトブレイク。DRCとウガンダの両国に影響し、国際的な拡大とトレード制限のリスク高し。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているとおり、エボラアウトブレイクの中心地はDRC東部のイトゥリ州である。ウガンダは「国境接続」として言及されているが、サマリー内でウガンダでの確認された症例報告は明示されていない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ただしWHOがDRCとウガンダ両国に対してPHEIC宣言をしている点は重要。ウイルスの長期存続パターン（精液で最大988日、母乳で500日、眼硝子体で数ヶ月）は感染管理・アウトブレーク対策に重要な示唆を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Tetapkan Darurat Ebola, Kemenkes Perketat Pintu Masuk RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola Emergency, Health Ministry Tightens Entry Points Into Indonesia
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). As of May 20, 2026, Indonesia's Ministry of Health confirms no Ebola cases have been detected within Indonesia. In response to the WHO designation, the government has proactively tightened entry points into the country. Aji Muhawarman, Head of the Public Communications and Information Bureau of the Ministry of Health, states that the emergency designation signals global vigilance, even though the spread of the virus is not yet categorized as a pandemic. The move underscores international alert despite no confirmed domestic cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO エボラ緊急事態を宣言、インドネシア保健省が入国管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEICが公式に発出されており、シグナルとして即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: WHO PHEICの正式発出により確定的なシグナル。DRCでの主発生に対し、インドネシアはまだ国内症例なしも国境対策強化中。WPRO地域における国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Step up border vigilance to keep Ebola at bay
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with eight laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths reported by the WHO; DRC authorities list 131 deaths. A few confirmed cases have been detected in neighbouring Uganda. The WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, warning the true scale may be larger than detected. Kenya calls for stepped-up border vigilance, directing rapid-response activation and intensified screening at airports, seaports, land borders, and transit points. Kenya remains vulnerable due to porous borders and reported shortages of Ebola-specific PPE and dedicated ambulances. Ebola spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, intense weakness, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, and, in advanced stages, haemorrhaging. Emphasis on vigilance, early detection, and strict containment; the United States has enforced enhanced travel screening.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの流行を防ぐために国境警備を強化する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRCで確認されたエボラ感染症の集団発生で、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事態（PHEIC）宣言済み、ウガンダへの越境拡大、国際的な渡航スクリーニング強化措置実施中。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での事例確認も記載されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。米国はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上は渡航スクリーニング実施という反応段階の描写であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での警戒体制強化、既に国境越え事例確認により、極めて重大なシグナル。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Ist das Ausmass weit grösser als bekannt?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Is the extent much larger than previously known?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province (north-east) has 513 confirmed infections and 131 deaths as of May 20, 2026, making it the largest since 2018–2020. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, not Zaire; local tests missed it because standard kits target Zaire, and samples were not promptly sent to Kinshasa for confirmation, delaying recognition. Conflicts in Ituri hinder surveillance and response; Mongwalu is an epicenter, Bunia is the provincial capital, and a case has appeared in Goma. Vaccines and treatments available are mainly for Zaire; Bundibugyo vaccines are unlikely to work. WHO has shipped 12 tons of supplies, with 6 more due; PPE shortages and weak protection for health workers have been reported. Ituri’s instability and delayed detection may mean the true burden is higher.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：その規模は予想より遥かに大きいのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラの大規模流行、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、未知の株（ブンディブギョ）の流行、既知のワクチン・治療が効果不明、複数国境地域への拡大リスクが認識されている。
triage.notes: 2018–2020以降最大規模の流行。Bundibugyo株という通常と異なる株の流行により検査キットでの検出遅延。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。既存ワクチンの有効性が不明。武力紛争による監視・対応の障害。Goma（ゴマ）など国境都市への拡大事例確認。外部支援の急需。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาล กำชับ สธ. ติดตามการระบาด-เฝ้าระวัง 'อีโบลา' แจ้ง ยังไม่พบในไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government urges the Ministry of Public Health to monitor Ebola outbreaks and conduct surveillance, stating that Ebola has not yet been detected in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: On 20 May 2026, the Thai government reports no Ebola cases detected in Thailand, while the WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola is a highly virulent viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted through blood and bodily fluids (blood, saliva, vomit, stool, and other secretions); spread occurs mainly among family members, healthcare workers, and close contacts, and is not airborne. Early symptoms resemble fever, fatigue, muscle aches, nausea, and vomiting; some patients experience abnormal bleeding, and severe illness carries a high fatality rate. The government urges close surveillance, interagency coordination, readiness of isolation wards, personal protective equipment, and laboratory capacity to manage suspected cases, and asks the public to follow health authorities and maintain basic hygiene to avoid panic.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がタイ保健省に対してエボラの流行監視と警戒を指示、タイではまだ検出されていないと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した高致死性疾患の流行であり、複数の地域でのシグナルであるため。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州でエボラの流行が確認されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言している。タイは現在症例報告なしだが、監視体制を強化しており、地域的な拡大リスクが懸念される。Machupoも同時にフラグされているが、記事サマリーではエボラが主体。

article.sourceUrl: http://www.epochtimes.com.tw/n503599/非洲伊波拉疫情蔓延-盧比歐-世衛確認工作慢半拍.html
article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情蔓延　盧比歐：世衛確認工作慢半拍| 台灣大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Africa; Rubio: WHO confirms the response is half a beat behind | Taiwan Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) is spreading to Uganda, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 19, 2026, at least 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths, up from about 200 cases and 65 deaths reported on May 15. Delays in testing contributed to initial spread; the International Rescue Committee notes the outbreak may be larger, with border risks into South Sudan. The laboratory-confirmed driver is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or antiviral exists for this strain. Vaccines exist for Zaire ebolavirus (used in 2023 to vaccinate about 55,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu) but are not applicable to the current outbreak. WHO is convening a technical group to assess diagnostics, vaccines, and therapies. Anne Ancia, WHO DRC representative, expresses pessimism about ending within two months. Taiwan’s CDC reports no cases in Taiwan but stresses importation risk and cautions avoiding bats and primates.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大　ルビオ氏：WHO確認対応に遅れ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済みの既知事象だが、新たな情報（症例数急増、新ウイルス株Bundibugyo、ワクチン適用外）があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ出血熱発生を主題とする。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株という既存ワクチン非適用の新株が確認されており、WHO PHEIC宣言済みながら新情報が含まれる。Bluedot発生地域に含まれるウガンダ・スーダン・台湾は、サマリー上でのみ言及（境界リスク、輸入リスク警告）であり、確認された発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Jordan Bans Entry From Congo, Uganda Over Ebola Concerns | World
article.articleSummary: Jordan imposes a 30-day entry ban on travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda due to Ebola concerns, with Jordanian citizens exempt and the measure taking effect on Wednesday. The policy follows World Health Organization warnings about rapid Ebola spread in the DRC, where there are 136 reported deaths, more than 500 suspected cases, and over 130 deaths linked to the outbreak. Ebola is a severe, often fatal disease transmitted from wild animals to humans and between people via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces. The global case fatality rate averages around 50%, with past outbreaks ranging 25–90%. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and kidney/liver impairment. Historical context notes Central Africa outbreaks and the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic starting in Guinea.

triage.headline_ja: ジョルダン、エボラへの懸念からコンゴとウガンダからの入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行（DRCで136死亡、500以上疑い例）、国際的な渡航制限措置、WHO警告により、IHR基準3項目該当。シグナルとしてフルRRA進行必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCにおけるエボラ流行が主要な主題。ジョルダンはDRCからの入国禁止措置を取った国であり、発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダについても記事では渡航禁止の対象国として言及されているが、記事サマリー上でウガンダでの流行が具体的に述べられていないため、確認済み発生地としては含めない。発生地域フィールドのGuineaは西アフリカ2014-2016流行の歴史的文脈参照のみで、現在の流行は述べられていない。

article.articleHeadline: 월드컵 앞두고 '팬데믹 시즌2' 위기감 고조...커지는 K바이오 역할론 - 이비엔(EBN)뉴스센터
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the World Cup approaches, anxiety over 'Pandemic Season 2' intensifies... The growing case for Korea's bio industry to play a bigger role
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, ahead of the FIFA World Cup in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, Korea’s public health authorities issued an infection alert as multi-pathogen threats rise. Measles outbreaks in Mexico and Andes virus cardiopulmonary syndrome in South America—connected to fatalities on the Atlantic cruise MV Hondius—heighten travel-related risk. Bundibugyo Ebola virus is spreading in the DRC and Uganda, with no approved vaccine or therapy. The convergence of mass gatherings, mobility, and variants is boosting antiviral stockpiling; the global market is projected to reach about $62 billion by 2030. Attention is shifting to universal RNA-virus platforms rather than single-pathogen drugs. Hyundai Biopharma Science reports ready-to-use Jepti (niclosamide) for clinical supply; dengue trials in Vietnam. SK Bioscience and Samsung Biologics contribute vaccine and CDMO capabilities. Realized value hinges on government procurement and international supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップを控え「パンデミックシーズン2」の危機感が高まる...拡大するK-バイオの役割論
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、複数の高リスク病原体（エボラ、麻疹、デング熱）が複数国で並行して発生。国際的な大規模イベント（ワールドカップ）と感染症リスクの組み合わせによる国際拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の感染症イベント（DRC・ウガンダのエボラ、メキシコの麻疹、ベトナムのデング熱、南米のアンデスウイルス）を総合的に扱っている。対象国リストに含まれる確実な発生地はDRC、ベトナム。ワールドカップ（米国・カナダ・メキシコ）を前にした国際的な大規模集会とのリスク組み合わせが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Pasien Hantavirus di RSHS Bandung Meninggal, Begini Kata Kemenkes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus patient at Bandung's RSHS dies; Here's what the Health Ministry said.
article.articleSummary: One hantavirus death in Bandung’s Hasan Sadikin Hospital has been reported. The Health Ministry confirms the patient died from hantavirus type HFRS (hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome) in 2025, not the Andes-virus–associated hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship case monitored at RSPI Sulianti Saroso. The patient, a construction worker, had about a week of fever with right abdominal pain, dark urine, jaundice, muscle pain, and worsening shortness of breath requiring intubation before dying after three days in hospital. The ministry says the MV Hondius case involves Andes virus and is not connected to Bandung. Andes virus can cause HPS (primarily in the Americas); HFRS is more common in Asia and Europe, including Indonesia, with 5–15% fatality versus HPS up to 60%. Transmission is mainly rodent-borne; human-to-human spread is known only for Andes virus. Public health guidance urges hygiene and avoiding rodent contact; no panic.

triage.headline_ja: バンドンのRSHS病院のハンタウイルス患者が死亡、保健省の説明
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）でのハンタウイルス感染症（HFRS）による死亡例の報告。国内での確認された死亡事例であり、重症度が高く（致死率5-15%）、異常な臨床経過を示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、バンドン（西ジャワ州、インドネシア）でのHFRS型ハンタウイルスによる死亡が確認される。スペイン（カナリア諸島）に関連する地名情報はBluedotから付与されているが、記事の主題はインドネシアでの発生であり、スペインは含めない。同時に言及されるMV Hondius号のAndes virus case（米州関連）は異なるウイルス型であり本イベントと区別される。

article.articleHeadline: CDC imposes Ebola travel restrictions as Houston prepares to host World Cup visitors
article.articleSummary: CDC imposes Ebola travel restrictions to prevent re-emerging Ebola virus entering the United States as outbreaks continue in remote areas of Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The restrictions coincide with Houston preparing to host the Congolese national soccer team and supporters for the FIFA World Cup, Congo’s first appearance in more than 50 years. Under the order, non-U.S. citizens who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days may be denied entry; exemptions include U.S. citizens, military personnel, and certain humanitarian cases. The CDC says the risk to the American public and travelers remains low and that screenings are being increased at entry points. The order remains in effect through June 17, the same day Congo opens World Cup play vs Portugal. Congolese organizers and Houston’s Congolese community hope restrictions ease if outbreaks stay contained.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがエボラ出血熱の渡航制限を発令、ヒューストンがワールドカップ来訪者受け入れを準備
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが該当（2以上）。また、スクリーニング基準でも異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が認められ、社会的・政治的関心が高い（国際スポーツイベント、大規模人口移動）ことから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題となるエボラ出血熱の発生地はウガンダとDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bluedot APIが付与した「発生地域」にはアメリカ（ヒューストン）、スーダン、ウガンダなども含まれているが、これらは渡航制限の実施地点または参考地域であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではない。記事は「ウガンダとDRCでの発生を防ぐため、米国がCDC渡航制限を発令」という内容であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases Are Rising Across India Even Before Monsoon Arrives
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, dengue cases are rising across India before the monsoon, signaling a year‑round public health challenge driven by climate change, rapid urbanisation, and environmental shifts. The transmission window has lengthened to about 5.6 months annually (2012–2021), expanding mosquito breeding and sustaining transmission beyond the rainy season. Dengue lacks a specific antiviral; patient management is supportive, making early diagnosis crucial to prevent severe complications. Common symptoms include sudden high fever, intense body aches, pain behind the eyes, nausea, fatigue, headaches, and skin rashes. Rapid dengue blood tests and early platelet monitoring aid timely treatment, with NS1 antigen testing advised within the first three days of symptoms. Prevention via vector control and vaccines remains essential but insufficient; ongoing awareness, vigilance, and prompt medical care are key as cases rise ahead of the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: インドで雨季到来前からデング熱患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の患者数がインド全域で増加しており、気候変動や都市化による構造的な問題を反映している。予防策の不十分性と年通しの公衆衛生課題の懸念から、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動、急速な都市化、環境変化による年通しの公衆衛生課題としてデング熱の増加を報告している。特に雨季到来前のケース増加、伝播期間の延長（年5.6ヶ月）、対症療法のみで特異的抗ウイルス薬がない点が懸念される。ベクトルコントロールと予防の不十分性も指摘されており、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาล กำชับ สธ. ติดตามสถานการณ์ "อีโบลา" ใกล้ชิด ย้ำ ยังไม่พบในไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government directs the Ministry of Public Health to closely monitor the Ebola situation, reiterating that Ebola has not yet been detected in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Thailand's government instructed the Ministry of Public Health to closely monitor the Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, in line with the World Health Organization's declaration that the event constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Thai officials emphasise that Ebola has not been detected in Thailand and urge the public not to panic. The Ministry will maintain vigilant surveillance and coordinate with international guidance to track developments and respond to reports of potential risks. The WHO elevation of the outbreak to an international emergency underscores ongoing international readiness, and Thai authorities will continue to monitor the situation and reinforce readiness while reiterating the absence of domestic cases.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、保健省に「エボラ」状況の厳密な監視を指示 タイではまだ発見されていないことを強調
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO が PHEIC 宣言した DRC エボラ出血熱の流行であり、タイが監視体制を強化している状況は、シグナルとしてピックアップの価値がある。
triage.notes: DRC の Ituri 州におけるエボラ出血熱の流行が記事の主題。タイは発生地域ではなく、DRC での流行を注視している対象国として verified_locations に含める。WHO が PHEIC を宣言しており、国際的な関心度・重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 【独家】香港：已就埃博拉病毒防控联系国家疾控局及广东疾控局 交流防控策略-证券之星
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exclusive: Hong Kong has contacted the National CDC and Guangdong CDC to exchange Ebola prevention and control strategies - Securities Star
article.articleSummary: On May 17, after the World Health Organization designated Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, Hong Kong activated Ebola preparedness at the alert level. The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’s Department of Health maintains close communications with China CDC and Guangdong CDC, establishing regular infectious-disease surveillance, major public health emergency monitoring, and reporting channels. For Ebola prevention, Hong Kong has exchanged prevention and control strategies and the latest outbreak information with national and provincial authorities, and will adjust follow-up and containment measures based on risk assessments. Hong Kong will continue to monitor overseas developments and WHO guidance, staying in close contact with China CDC and Guangdong CDC. Additionally, Hong Kong’s Department of Health and Shenzhen Customs maintain tight border communication; suspected border cases will be handled immediately and reported in real time to enable rapid cross-border containment.

triage.headline_ja: 【独家】香港：已就埃博拉病毒防控联系国家疾控局及广东疾控局 交流防控策略-证券之星
triage.triage_reason: 複数国でのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ）はWHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象(PHEIC)として認定されており、香港が防御準備を開始した段階。対象国では中国のみが記事で明確に検証可能（香港含む）だが、香港本体の症例報告ではなく準備段階のため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC、ウガンダでの既存アウトブレイク（WHO PHEIC認定済み）を背景に、香港が防御準備を開始した状況を報道。香港は中国に含めて扱った。対象国リスト内で検証可能な発生地は中国のみ。DRC（203312）とウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO raises alarm as Ebola deaths in Congo rise to 131
article.articleSummary: Ebola tied to the Bundibugyo strain is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with 131 deaths among 516 suspected and 33 confirmed cases as of Tuesday, 19 May. Uganda has two confirmed infections. There are no approved vaccines for this strain. Two days after the WHO declared Bundibugyo a public health emergency of international concern, the agency, along with the CDC, Uganda, and other countries, are mobilizing response efforts. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned at the World Health Assembly in Geneva that the outbreak's scale and speed are concerning for global health security. This situation underscores global health security concerns.

triage.headline_ja: WHO raises alarm as Ebola deaths in Congo rise to 131（WHO、コンゴでのエボラ死者数が131に増加したことについて警報を発令）
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の東部DRC発生は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認例）を示し、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève（スイス）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダでの発生が主題。Genevaはおそらくセンサーの誤抽出（WHOの本部所在地）。ウガンダの確認例が記載されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Doktor AS dijangkiti Ebola tiba di Jerman untuk rawatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. doctor infected with Ebola arrives in Germany for treatment
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo arrived in Germany on May 20, 2026, for treatment. Peter Stafford, described by the Serge Christian mission as a 'medical evangelist', was confirmed by the German Health Ministry. He will be admitted to an isolation ward at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin, under strict medical and police supervision. Germany was chosen due to its expertise in safe medical evacuations, and because the flight time from Germany is shorter than to the United States. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, rare in eastern DRC, which has caused 131 deaths to date and has been declared a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This represents an imported Ebola case from the DRC to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した米国人医師がドイツに治療のため到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みのブンディブギョ株のエボラウイルスの域外流出事例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ドイツとアメリカは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし記事の主要な感染症発生地がDRCであり、エボラウイルスの流出事例として重大。既にWHOが緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）済みのBundibugyo株による死亡事例（131例）が関連している。患者の医療避難受け入れは国際的に重要な事案。

article.articleHeadline: State Department Stops Visa Services for 3 African Nations Amid Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) has generated at least 500 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths, according to the World Health Organization as of May 19, 2026; later figures confirm 131 fatalities. In response, the United States suspended visa services to Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan for 30 days, banning entry of foreign nationals who visited those countries in the previous three weeks and implementing port-of-entry screening for Ebola symptoms. Visa appointments at U.S. embassies in Juba (South Sudan), Kinshasa (DRC), and Kampala (Uganda) are paused; currently valid visas remain unaffected. The outbreak is centered in Ituri and North Kivu, near Uganda and South Sudan; Rwanda closed its land border with Congo. The UN notes over 2 million internally displaced people in the affected provinces, with healthcare capacity weakened by conflict.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行中、米国務省がアフリカ3国へのビザサービスを停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多数の疑い患者・死亡、国境を越えた拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されており、フルRRAへの進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ流行の主要発生地はDRC東部(Ituri、North Kivu)と明記。UgandaとSouth Sudanは地理的隣接国であり米国の対応対象国であるが、記事の主題となる感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。Rwanda、Uganda、Sudan、USは隣接国または対応国として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: FT社评：埃博拉疫情暴露全球应对大流行病准备不足 - FT中文网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FT Editorial: The Ebola outbreak exposes the world's lack of preparedness for pandemics - FT Chinese
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by a Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, has resulted in at least 131 deaths among more than 500 confirmed or suspected cases. The eastern DRC outbreak has expanded into Kinshasa, about 2,000 km away, and has reached neighboring Uganda. Diagnostic tests for this strain are not easily performed with standard kits, and there are no approved vaccines or antiviral treatments available. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) last weekend. Since 1976, this marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The emergence underscores persistent zoonotic risks driven by deforestation, habitat encroachment, and climate change, highlighting global preparedness gaps for pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: FT社評：エボラ疫情が世界的なパンデミック対応準備不足を露呈
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。WHO がPHEIC宣言、131人以上の死亡、500人以上の確定・疑い患者、国境を超える拡大（ウガンダへの到達）、診断キット・ワクチン・治療法の不在により国際支援必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダへの『到達』と述べられており、主発生地がDRCであることが明確。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。WHO PHEIC宣言済みであり、診断・治療の困難性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 136 dead, no vaccine or cure: WHO chief warns over 'scale and speed' of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, the Congo Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain has reached 136 deaths among 543 suspected cases with 32 laboratory-confirmed and 69 patients being treated in Ebola treatment centres. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at the World Health Assembly. The epicentre is Ituri province, with confirmed cases also in neighbouring North Kivu. The Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccines or specific treatments, unlike the Zaire strain. The outbreak's security context is severe, with ongoing conflict displacing more than 100,000 people and health workers among the fatalities, suggesting possible healthcare-associated transmission. Nearby Rwanda, Burundi and Tanzania are boosting surveillance and border screening; Africa CDC declared a continental PHEIC. Tedros emphasised risk communication and community engagement to curb spread in the absence of a vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 136人死亡、ワクチンや治療法なし：WHO事務局長がエボラ感染症の「規模と速度」について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC指定、136名の死亡、国際的な拡大リスク、予防手段（ワクチン・治療法）の欠如を示唆。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模暴発。WHO PHEIC指定済み。Ituri州およびNorth Kivu州で確認。ワクチン・治療法の欠如、保健医療従事者の被害、セキュリティ危機に伴う10万人以上の避難が懸念される。隣国（ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア）での国境スクリーニング強化中。Africa CDCも大陸規模のPHEIC宣言。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO raises the alarm as death toll hits 131
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of yesterday, more than 513 suspected cases and at least 131 deaths have been reported. Ituri province, the epicentre, is an insecure area with substantial population movement, complicating contact tracing and containment; South Kivu is also affected. Investigations indicate wider transmission, including cross-border spread into Uganda, where one death has been reported. The WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, though it has not reached pandemic emergency status under the International Health Regulations. There is no vaccine for the strain driving this outbreak; authorities are evaluating whether existing drugs could offer some protection. Published May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: WHO警報発令、死亡者数131人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された多死亡アウトブレイク、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染確認）、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「越境感染で1死亡報告」と二次的な言及のみ。主要なアウトブレイク地域はDRC（Ituri Province、South Kivu Province）であり、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。PHEIC宣言済み、ワクチン未利用、治療薬効果不確実という極めて高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫列伊波拉为关注突发事件 大马加强入境监测 - 国内 - 即时国内
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Malaysia strengthens entry screening.
article.articleSummary: On May 17, the World Health Organization designated the Ebola virus disease outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Malaysia has intensified entry screening and surveillance, improving early case detection and isolation of suspected cases. Returning travelers from affected countries with fever, body pains, vomiting, or bleeding within 21 days should seek medical care. Malaysia reports no Ebola cases, while as of May 16 the global picture includes 8 laboratory-confirmed and 246 suspected cases; Congo (Ituri Province) reports 80 suspected deaths; Uganda (Kampala) reports 2 laboratory-confirmed cases with one death, both with Congo travel history. There are no direct flights to Malaysia; transit may occur via Dubai, Doha, or Singapore. Measures include expanded PPE stocks, staff training, and enhanced laboratory capacity through IMR and MKAK, with risk coordination among WHO, AKPS, airlines, and other agencies. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラをIHR国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定、マレーシアが入国検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO正式にPHEIC指定、複数国での確認症例と死亡、国際的な懸念。
triage.notes: 記事はマレーシアの入国検査強化を述べているが、感染症イベント自体の発生地はコンゴ（イトゥリ州）とウガンダ（カンパラ）。マレーシアは対象国(1643084)であるが、記事サマリーに基づく実際の発生地はコンゴとウガンダのみ。UAE、カタール、シンガポール、マレーシアは地理的つながりのある通過地点として言及されるが、ケース報告地ではない。WHO PHEIC指定は極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: de Mongbwalu à Bunia, comment la riposte s'organise face au virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: From Mongbwalu to Bunia, How the Response Is Organized to Tackle the Virus.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, the Ebola outbreak centers on Mongbwalu and the Rwampara mining zones, with the first cases reported last week. Mongbwalu’s district hospital is stretched to capacity; more than 20 people are isolated awaiting confirmation, while a treatment center site has been identified but construction awaits leveling work by a mining company. MSF is deploying triage and isolation materials; the World Food Programme has arrived. Transport is hampered as Mongbwalu’s airstrip remains non-operational. Meanwhile, the population improvises hygiene measures—handwashing stations proliferate in markets, schools, and shops, and many residents wear masks; however, prices for masks and disinfectants have doubled, threatening the vulnerable. Movement continues toward Bunia and North Kivu as Bunia authorities receive more than 16 tons of kits and medicines and broadcast prevention messages. In Goma, three days after the first case, pharmacies are running low on protection kits.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ: モングバルからブニアへ、ウイルスに対抗するための対応がどのように組織されているか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生で、複数の確認事例と疑似例があり、国境を越えた拡大の兆候（ルワンダへの接近、ゴマでの対応開始）が見られる。IHR基準3つ以上該当、国際的対応（MSF、WFP）が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはルワンダ（Kigali Province）も含まれているが、サマリーではルワンダでの確認症例の記述がなく、むしろコンゴ側からの近接リスクとして言及されているのみ。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラは極度に高リスク疾患であり、複数の確認・疑似例、医療施設の逼迫、国際的対応が既に展開されている点から、直ちにフルRRAに進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: الأردن يمنع دخول القادمين من الكونغو الديمقراطية وأوغندا بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jordan bars entry for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Jordan announces a temporary entry ban for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda for 30 days starting 20 May 2026, with Jordanian citizens exempt. The Interior Ministry said the precautionary measure, taken in response to Ebola outbreaks in the two African countries, will be continually assessed in light of global health developments. The World Health Organization has designated both outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing international concern over the speed and scale of transmission. In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities have reported more than 130 deaths linked to Ebola. The ban aims to prevent cross-border importation of cases into Jordan amid ongoing regional transmission; no information on exported/imported cases or domestic transmission is provided.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：エボラ流行による入国禁止措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC指定し、複数国での流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事は主にアフリカでのエボラ流行に対するアラブ地域（ヨルダン）の対応を報道。DRCで130人以上の死亡が報告されており、WHOはPHEIC指定済み。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bluedot APIが検出した地域にはJordan、Uganda が含まれるが、記事の主題はアフリカ域内の流行事象であり、対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉死亡人數突破130例 WHO考慮實驗疫苗 盧比歐批「晚了」 | 鉅亨網 - 國際政經
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 130; WHO considers experimental vaccine; Rubio blasts 'it's too late'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, intensifies as of 2026-05-20 with at least 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths, up from ~200 cases and 65 deaths reported last Friday. The Bundibugyo strain is confirmed; no approved vaccines or therapies exist. WHO is considering experimental vaccines and drugs still under development. Genomic sequences released by DRC and Uganda scientists suggest a spillover from an infected animal, followed by human-to-human transmission. Potential spread to South Sudan is a concern; Uganda urged the public to avoid hugging as preventive measures. Case fatality is reported at 30-50%, higher if treatment is delayed; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal/external bleeding. Health systems face PPE shortages. International experts are evaluating candidate vaccines/therapies, but containment may take months, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since discovery.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が130例を突破 WHOが実験用ワクチンを検討 ルビオ議員は『遅すぎる』と批判
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。致命率30-50%の確認されたエボラ流行で、複数国への拡大リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）での流行を主題としている。ウガンダは確認症例および予防措置の記述があるが、当該国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。南スーダンへの拡大懸念も述べられているが、当該国も対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。確認されたBundibugyo株、高い致命率（30-50%）、ヒト-ヒト感染の確認、PPE不足、治療遅延時の高死亡率など、複合的なリスク要因が存在。

Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: Virusul cu mortalitate mai mare decât COVID-19 și hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus with a higher mortality rate than COVID-19 and hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza is labeled a major pandemic threat by former WHO chief scientist Soumya Swaminathan. It has mortality in humans far exceeding COVID-19 (COVID-19 mortality under 1%, H5N1 markedly higher). The virus was identified again in India across multiple states in early 2025, with last human cases reported December 2023. A key concern is spread to mammals, suggesting possible mutations toward human-to-human transmission that could drive a far more severe pandemic. Avian influenza A primarily affects birds but can infect mammals. Global health agencies say public risk remains low, though vigilant monitoring is essential. Antivirals such as oseltamivir exist, but more research is needed. In April 2026, the first clinical vaccine trials against avian influenza began, marking preparation for potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19およびハンタウイルスよりも高い致死率を持つウイルス
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザはインドで複数州で確認されており、COVID-19を上回る高い致死率と哺乳類への感染拡大により、ヒト-ヒト感染への突然変異可能性がある。IHR基準3項目以上が該当し、WHOの前科学顧問による「パンデミック脅威」との警告も含まれている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてインドでの2025年初期のH5N1確認と2023年12月の人間感染事例が明示されている。哺乳類への感染拡大とヒト-ヒト感染への突然変異リスク、さらに2026年4月の臨床ワクチン試験開始により、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が存在する。WHOの前科学顧問による「パンデミック脅威」との公式評価により、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫列伊波拉为国际公卫事件 我国卫生部暂未接病例|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; China's Ministry of Health has not yet reported any cases | Guanghua Net
article.articleSummary: WHO declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri region, 8 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths have been reported; in Uganda’s Kampala, 2 laboratory-confirmed cases (including 1 death) involve travelers who had visited Congo. China’s Ministry of Health reports no Ebola cases to date and, due to travel risk, is tightening preparedness: monitoring travelers from Uganda and Congo arriving via Dubai, Doha, and Singapore; expanding entry-point surveillance at airports and ports; enhancing early detection through the infectious-disease surveillance system; reinforcing isolation, case management, and PPE readiness; coordinating with IMR and MKAK for viral hemorrhagic fever testing and with WHO and border agencies. Ebola transmits through close contact with blood and body fluids; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding. Travelers returning from affected areas with fever or bleeding within 21 days should seek immediate medical care via official channels.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラをPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言　中国の衛生部はまだ患者報告を受けていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO自ら PHEIC 宣言済みであり、複数国での確認患者と死亡者を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによるPHEIC宣言を報告。DRCのIturi地域で確定患者8例、疑似患者246例、疑い死亡80例；ウガンダのカンパラで確定患者2例（死亡1例）。中国は患者未報告だが、高度な警戒体制を敷いている。ドバイ、ドーハ、シンガポールは渡航者の監視地点として記載されているが、これらの国での実際の発生報告はない。したがって verified_locations は対象国のDRC、Uganda、China のみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Через спалах Еболи в ДР Конго загинула щонайменше 131 людина - Новости Весь Харьков
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, at least 131 people have died - All Kharkiv News
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused at least 131 deaths, with more than 513 suspected cases reported across Nyankunde, Butembo, and the city of Goma. In Uganda, two new confirmed cases and one new death are reported. Among those confirmed are Americans, prompting the United States to consider evacuating its citizens to a safe location during containment. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. The circulating strain is Ebola Bundibugyo, for which there is currently no vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行により、少なくとも131人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した。複数国での拡大、高い死亡率、ワクチンなし、複数国による対応の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国リスト（ID: 203312）に含まれるため含める。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。エボラ・ブンディブギョ株で、ワクチンなし。米国市民の避難も検討中。複数の国際的関心と支援の必要性が明確である。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS advierte sobre la rápida expansión del brote de ébola por la cepa Bundibugyo en África - ContraPunto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns of the rapid spread of the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain in Africa - ContraPunto
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, the WHO warns of rapid spread of Bundibugyo Ebola strain in Africa, mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province and Uganda’s Kampala. Thirty confirmed cases are in Ituri, with two in Kampala linked to travelers from Congo; an American patient infected has been evacuated to Germany. Preliminary figures exceed 500 suspected cases and at least 130 deaths, with numbers likely to rise as surveillance and testing intensify. Healthcare workers are among those infected, indicating possible nosocomial transmission. Widespread displacement in Ituri—over 100,000 people moving recently—and mining-area movement heighten international spread risk. The WHO approved an additional $3.4 million for the Emergency Contingency Fund, bringing total to $3.9 million. The outbreak is a Public Health Emergency of International Concern but not a pandemic per IHR; Africa CDC also declared a continental health-security emergency. Bundibugyo strain is highly contagious, spread mainly through direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカにおけるブンディブギョ株エボラの急速な拡大について警告 - ContraPunto
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、死亡事例、医療従事者への感染、複数国への拡大を確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダに2例の輸入症例が確認されており、DRCが主要な発生地であることを確認。米国患者のドイツへの搬送は医療上の移送であり、ドイツでの患者発生ではないため verified_locations に含めない。ブンディブギョ株の高い感染性、医療従事者への感染、大規模な人口移動（10万人以上）、鉱業地域での活動により国際拡大リスクは極めて高い。WHOが追加資金を承認し、Africa CDCが大陸レベルの健康安全保障緊急事態を宣言していることから、国際支援が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: هشدار بهداشتی در جام جهانی ۲۰۲۶: شیوع بیماری ابولا، زنگ خطر را در فیفا به صدا درمی‌آورد.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health warning at the 2026 World Cup: Ebola outbreak raises the alarm at FIFA.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, Ebola re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak involves a newly identified Bundibugyo strain; current vaccines do not provide complete protection against this variant. Ebola is transmitted by direct contact with bodily fluids, with case fatality rates in some outbreaks ranging from 60% to 80%. The crisis coincides with the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, where thousands of Congolese fans are expected to travel; Congo is in Group K with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan, with matches in Houston, Dallas, and Seattle. UN agencies urge strict airport medical screening, epidemiological surveillance, and contact restrictions for suspected cases. The United States, Canada, and Mexico are drafting emergency protocols. There is no plan to exclude Congo or close borders; players will undergo testing and strict medical protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップでの公衆衛生警告：エボラ出血熱の流行がFIFAで警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、致死率60～80%の重篤性、国際的なスポーツイベント絡みの渡航制限リスクが認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国都市（Houston、Dallas、Seattle、Washington）、メキシコ、ポルトガル、ウズベキスタン、ウガンダ、カナダを発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーの詳細読解では、実際のエボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダに限定されている。米国等の都市名は2026年FIFA World Cupの開催地および試合会場であり、DRCからの渡航リスクが指摘されているもの。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 4大傳染病盛行！民眾陷恐慌　林氏璧：沒一隻能打的｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four major infectious diseases are prevalent! The public is panicking. Lin Shibi: not a single one can fight them | Nextapple News Network
article.articleSummary: Measles in Japan peaks this year, concentrated in Tokyo and the Kanto region; cases have declined recently, with few infections for travelers to Kyushu (Fukuoka), Shikoku, or Hokkaido. High-risk groups are unvaccinated infants under 1 year and pregnant women; Taiwan’s vaccine coverage is about 97%, with immune memory likely even if antibodies wane. Hantavirus in Taiwan is the Seoul strain, with 1–2% mortality; transmission via inhalation of rodent excreta or contact, not human-to-human, so no community spread expected. A New Zealand traveler who cruised during an Andes hantavirus outbreak is asymptomatic on arrival and under enhanced self-monitoring. Ebola virus outbreaks in Congo prompted WHO to declare an international public health emergency; fatality about 30–50%, with no widely effective antiviral. Mpox (monkeypox) variant Ib, imported from Thailand, spreads mainly via close contact, especially sexual activity; mortality under 0.5% in developed countries, vaccines available. None pose a COVID-like global pandemic threat; panic unnecessary.

triage.headline_ja: 4大伝染病が流行！民衆がパニック状態　林氏璧：対抗手段がない
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹（日本・台湾）、ハンタウイルス（台湾）、エボラ（DRC）、Mpox（タイから輸入、台湾で拡大）の複数感染症が同時流行。エボラはIHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスク），WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国のDRCとタイの関係イベントに加え、関連情報として日本も含まれ、社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国にまたがる複数感染症の同時流行を報道。DRCのエボラはWHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており，IHR通知要件を満たす。タイからのMpox輸入症例（台湾での流行拡大に関連）も注視対象。日本の麻疹ピークは同様に重要だが，対象国リストに日本が含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。台湾の情報も対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Médico de EE.UU. con ébola es evacuado a Alemania. Su esposa y sus cuatro hijos permanecen en observación en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor with Ebola evacuated to Germany. His wife and four children remain under observation in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, American surgeon Peter Stafford, who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province, was evacuated by air to Germany for treatment after developing symptoms. Stafford worked at Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri, where the outbreak is concentrated. He had operated on a 33-year-old patient with abdominal pain; the patient died the following day, and Ebola was confirmed later; Stafford tested positive for Ebola on Sunday. His wife, Rebekah Stafford, a fellow physician, and their four young children remain in Congo under observation; another doctor, Patrick LaRochelle, exposed through a second patient, is also under observation, with no symptoms yet. The World Health Organization notes a 21-day incubation period. The outbreak in Central Africa has at least 131 deaths and about 531 infections. The Ebola strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment, with prior fatality 30-50%.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がエボラ出血熱でドイツに搬送。妻と4人の子どもはコンゴで経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大事例であり、医療従事者の感染による業務支障、未認可の病原体株、高い致死率を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の医療従事者の国際搬送ケース。医療施設での二次感染事例あり。Bundibugyo株で既知ワクチンなし。配偶者・子ども・同僚医師が潜在曝露。中央アフリカ地域での既知感染は531例・死亡131例。国際的な管理可能性について高い関心が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Εμπολα: Ο ΠΟΥ εξετάζει υποψήφια εμβόλια και διαθέσιμα σχήματα φαρμακευτικής αγωγής - iefimerida.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO examines candidate vaccines and available treatment regimens - iefimerida.gr
article.articleSummary: WHO is evaluating candidate Ebola vaccines and treatment regimens to curb the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where 131 confirmed deaths have occurred. Uganda has declared an international emergency of concern related to Ebola. A WHO emergency committee is convening to discuss management of this highly transmissible hemorrhagic fever crisis. No vaccines or therapies are approved for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving this outbreak, which has an estimated 40–50% case fatality. A Merck vaccine, Ervebo, developed for the Zaire ebolavirus, has shown some protection in animal studies but is not considered suitable for current outbreak control. Potential use of Ervebo and other options will be on the committee’s agenda for today’s session (May 20, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOが候補ワクチンと利用可能な治療レジメンを検査 - iefimerida.gr
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の確認死亡131例、ウガンダでの国際的懸念事態宣言、高い感染性と40-50%の致命率を有する新規株による大流行。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に列挙されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダが『国際的懸念事態を宣言した』と記述されており、主たる発生地はDRCである。DRCのみを確認済み発生地として列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による新規流行で、既存ワクチン（Ervebo、Zaire株用）の適用性が限定的である点が重大。WHO緊急委員会の即時対応が予定されている。

article.articleHeadline: CIFRA DE MUERTOS POR ÉBOLA ASCIENDE A 136 EN REPÚBLICA DEMOCRÁTICA DEL CONGO, INFORMA MINISTRO DE SALUD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll rises to 136 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Health Minister reports.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues as of May 20, 2026, with the death toll rising to 136. Across the country, 543 suspected cases have been reported, including 32 laboratory-confirmed infections. All reported deaths are classified as probable Ebola cases. Currently, 69 patients are receiving treatment in specialized Ebola centers. Health authorities, speaking in Kinshasa, have intensified detection, isolation, contact tracing, and treatment efforts as the outbreak spreads through affected zones. The figures reflect ongoing surveillance and laboratory confirmation to monitor transmission and guide public health response in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの死者数がコンゴ民主共和国で136人に増加、保健大臣が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（死亡率の高い指定感染症）の確認された流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクがすべて明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC における エボラ流行の継続が主題。Kinshasa はキャピタルで発生地点である。2026年5月現在、136人の死亡、543人の疑似症例、32人の確定症例が報告されており、69人が治療中。当該イベントは対象国リストに含まれるDRCで実際に発生しているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk læge er landet til ebolabehandling i Berlin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor has landed in Berlin for Ebola treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor who worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo during the Ebola outbreak has landed in Berlin, Germany, for Ebola treatment. The American citizen infected with the Ebola virus arrived in Germany’s capital overnight, with Bild and Tagesschau reporting the development. The report confirms the individual's infection and destination but provides few further details about the patient’s clinical status, the infection source, or the hospital arrangements. It situates the event within ongoing Ebola concerns and cross-border medical transfers for high-risk infectious diseases. No specific case counts, travel history beyond the DR Congo link, or public health measures are described in the article. The information is based on German media coverage as of 2026-05-20.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がベルリンでのエボラ治療のために到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染確定者の国際的な医療移送であり、IHR基準2項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴでの流行との関連が確認され、国境を越えた高リスク感染症の移動を示唆するシグナル。
triage.notes: 患者はDRコンゴでのエボラ流行中に感染した米国人医師。ベルリンは治療目的地だが、記事サマリーではDRコンゴが感染源・疾患流行地として記述されている。対象国リストではDRコンゴのみ該当。患者の臨床状態、具体的な入院予定病院、接触者追跡の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolautbruddet - svært alvorlig og komplisert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak - very serious and complicated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, near Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo variant with an estimated case fatality rate of 25–40%. As of May 20, 2026, over 130 deaths have occurred. The WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has voiced deep concern about the scale and speed of the epidemic, which has prompted an international public health emergency declaration. MSF mobilizes a broad response; Hurum, secretary-general of MSF’s Norwegian division, notes the response is hampered by conflict, displacement, distrust of authorities, and limited health care. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids, not airborne, with high risk to caregivers and family members without protection. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, South Sudan, and other eastern Congo provinces. There are no effective vaccines or cures cited; emphasis on community engagement to build trust and the potential for increased support and vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の流行 - 非常に深刻で複雑な状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。WHO緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、対応上の課題等がある。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaおよびSudan が含まれているが、サマリーの主要な発生地はIturi Province（DRC northeast）であり、Ugandaおよび南スーダンへの「拡大」として記載されている。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを含める。エボラウイルス病Bundibugyo株、死亡率25-40%、130人以上の死亡、WHO緊急事態宣言、紛争地域での対応困難が確認される。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak may be spreading faster than first thought, WHO doctor warns - MyJoyOnline
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province has caused 136 deaths with more than 514 suspected cases; one death is reported in Uganda. WHO has declared the outbreak an international emergency. Modelling by the MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis suggests substantial under-detection, indicating the true burden could exceed 1,000 cases. The Bundibugyo strain driving this rise is rare, and there is no vaccine; researchers are evaluating other drugs. The outbreak may have been ongoing for weeks before detection (first identified 24 April). Response includes border measures: Rwanda closed DR Congo borders; Uganda urges caution; Americans exposed are evacuated to Germany and the Czech Republic for monitoring. The crisis is complicated by insecurity, population movement, and strained health systems, with spread reaching South Kivu and the city of Goma and cases in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行はこれまで考えられていたより速く拡大している可能性がある、WHO医師が警告 - MyJoyOnline
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、国境措置の実施）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の事象（PHEIC）を宣言している。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはルワンダ、ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコが含まれているが、サマリーを精査すると：ルワンダは国境閉鎖措置を取っているが症例報告なし；ウガンダは1例の死亡のみ報告；ドイツとチェコはアメリカ人の隔離・監視地として言及されており、発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRCの複数州（Ituri、South Kivu）で確認され、Gomaまで拡大している。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株でワクチンなし、1,000例超の真の症例数推定、周辺国への拡大リスク、セキュリティと保健システム脆弱性の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: 美国务卿鲁比奥：世卫组织对伊波拉疫情反应迟缓
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Secretary of State Rubio: WHO's response to the Ebola outbreak was slow.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighbouring Uganda is expanding. Congo’s health minister reported 136 deaths among 543 suspected Ebola cases since the outbreak began, with 69 patients currently in treatment centers as of May 19. The World Health Organization expressed concern over the scale and speed of transmission; it had last weekend designated the Congo‑Uganda outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic. Secretary of State Rubio said the response would be led by the U.S. CDC and WHO, but criticized WHO for delays in identifying the outbreak. The U.S. State Department announced about $13 million in initial funding to support up to 50 Ebola treatment centers in DRC or Uganda. A senior official said WHO took 10 days to confirm the outbreak, noting a four‑day response that could have begun 14 days earlier, and alleged past WHO failures including a charge of cover‑ups related to COVID‑19 in China; WHO rebutted, urging cooperation with all countries.

triage.headline_ja: 米国務長官ルビオ：WHO のエボラ疫病流行への対応が遅い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染拡大事例であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO が「国際関心事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態」と指定し、複数国での感染、高い致死率、米国による大規模資金支援など、明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot API は Uganda（対象国外）と United States（対象国外）を含めているが、verified_locations では対象国リストに基づき DRC と China のみを採用。記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国でないため除外。WHO による PHEIC 指定、高い死亡率（136/543）、国際的な資金支援と対応体制の構築が確認された重篤なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk læge i Berlin smittet med ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor in Berlin infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor who worked in the Democratic Republic of the Congo during an Ebola outbreak arrived in Berlin, Germany, early Wednesday and is infected with Ebola. The patient was transported to Charité University Hospital for treatment, escorted from the airport by police and fire services around 03:00. The United States has asked Germany for assistance to shorten travel time and to leverage Germany’s experience in treating Ebola patients. This is an imported Ebola case in Germany. The ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has so far caused 131 deaths, with authorities reporting 513 suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がベルリンでエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスの国際越境事例であり、公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確に認められる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはドイツ・ベルリンが含まれているが、記事サマリーによれば患者はDRCでの曝露後にベルリンに移送された輸入症例である。DRCが実際の発生源であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。エボラウイルスの国際越境事例として最高レベルのシグナル価値を有する。

article.articleHeadline: ആഫ്രിക്കയിൽ എബോള പടരുന്നു: കോംഗോ, ഉഗാണ്ട രാജ്യങ്ങളിലേക്ക് യാത്രാവിലക്കേർപ്പെടുത്തി അമേരിക്ക | US Ebola alert for Congo, South Sudan, Uganda; level 3 alert for Rwanda | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Africa: The United States has imposed travel restrictions for Congo and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks span the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan, prompting the United States to issue Level 4 travel advisories for those countries and a Level 3 advisory for Rwanda (travel reconsideration). A cumulative 131 deaths have been reported across affected regions. The US has barred foreign nationals who visited Ebola-affected countries in the last 21 days from entering under Title 42. South Sudan’s health system is severely strained with limited care and evacuation options. In Congo, American missionary Dr. Peter Stafford contracted Ebola while caring for patients; his wife Dr. Rebekah Stafford and their four children are under observation. The US has arranged specialist treatment for Peter Stafford in Germany, endorsed by the German health ministry. Ebola virus spreads via contact with body fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; incubation is 2–21 days, beginning with fever and potentially advancing to severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラが拡大：コンゴ、南スーダン、ウガンダへの渡航レベル4警告、ルワンダへはレベル3警告を米国が発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多国にまたがる発生で累積131死亡、米国の渡航制限発令、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限がある。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が主題となっているが、対象国リストではコンゴ(DRC)のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。南スーダンも対象国リストに含まれていない。ルワンダについては被害国ではなく警告対象国のため含めない。複数国での同時発生、米国による国際的渡航制限、医療従事者の感染報告など、極めて高いリスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Jogja Pastikan Belum Ada Kasus Hantavirus pada 2026  Dinkes Kot
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yogyakarta Health Office Ensures There Are No Hantavirus Cases in 2026 — City Health Office
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus in Yogyakarta City: As of May 2026, Dinas Kesehatan Kota Jogja reports no hantavirus cases in Yogyakarta City; a 2025 case was recorded in Kota Jogja, while 2026 shows no new cases to date. A suspected case under evaluation leaned toward leptospirosis after laboratory testing, and a suspected case in Kulonprogo Regency tested negative. Hantavirus is a rodentborne zoonosis that can affect kidneys, the respiratory system, and the heart, with symptoms overlapping leptospirosis. Transmission occurs from animals to humans via urine, feces, or saliva, and possibly through inhalation of contaminated aerosols; it is not human-to-human. Authorities advise PPE when cleaning rodent-infested areas (garages, attics, damp spaces), environmental hygiene, and rodent control. Residents should seek medical care if fever, respiratory symptoms, or kidney dysfunction develop after exposure. No 2026 cases reported in Jogja City as of May, but vigilance remains.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ保健所、2026年のハンタウイルス症例がないことを確認 — 市保健所
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2026年5月時点でジョグジャカルタ市にハンタウイルス症例がないことを確認する公式声明であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の基本要件を満たさない。疑い症例は検査結果でレプトスピラ症または陰性と判定されており、確定症例がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベントの発生を報告するものではなく、症例がないことを確認する公式否定声明である。疑い症例は他の疾患（レプトスピラ症）または陰性と判定されており、ハンタウイルス症例の実績がない。記事に記載されている過去の2025年1件の症例も2026年内の新規発生ではない。従って、現在のシグナル検出基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : un Américain testé positif, aucun vaccin... Pourquoi l'OMS se dit être "profondément préoccupée" ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: an American tested positive, no vaccine... Why does the WHO say it is 'deeply concerned'?
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda threatens rapid spread of the Bundibugyo virus. As of the report, 131 deaths are presumptively linked, with 516 suspected cases and 33 laboratory-confirmed cases in DRC, and two confirmed in Uganda. No vaccine or treatment is approved for Bundibugyo. The WHO convened an experts' group on May 18 in Geneva to assess vaccination options and strengthen surveillance, contact tracing, and testing, amid concerns about urban transmission in Kampala, Goma, and Ituri Province. Health workers have been affected, indicating nosocomial transmission. Emergency funding: WHO released $3.9 million; the United States has mobilized about $13 million and is pursuing monoclonal antibody therapies through the CDC. An American has tested positive; six exposed citizens were evacuated to Germany. Uganda is imposing border controls; the US advised travelers who stayed there to avoid entry, with exceptions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：アメリカ人が陽性判定、ワクチンなし...WHOが「深刻な懸念」を表明する理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）の多国間流行で、深刻な死亡率（131死亡、516疑い例）、国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国での確認例）、渡航制限など、複数の重大リスク要因が存在。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスイス（ジュネーブのWHO本部）、ドイツ、米国などが含まれていますが、サマリーの主題はDRCおよびウガンダでの流行です。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため excluded。米国での確認例は報告されていますが、米国も対象国リストに含まれていません。したがって verified_locations は DRC のみ。ただし、本イベントは WPRO 地域外（アフリカおよび欧米）を主な発生地とするため、CEPR の対象地域戦略との関連性を考慮し、フルRRA実施時に国際的な広がりと各地域の対応状況を詳細に評価する必要があります。

article.articleHeadline: จ.สุรินทร์ ผนึกกำลังปศุสัตว์-ท้องถิ่น ลงนาม MOU เดินหน้าป้องกันโรคพิษสุนัขบ้า  | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surin Province Teams Up with the Livestock Sector and Local Authorities to Sign an MOU to Advance Rabies Prevention | Daily News
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention milestone in Surin Province: An MOU signed in Si Khrom Phum District by Surin local authorities and the Livestock Office, Public Health Office, and Si Khrom Phum Hospital to implement a coordinated rabies control program under the banner 'Healthy Animals, Safe People.' The agreement unites 16 local governments in Si Khrom Phum with the Surin Livestock Office, Public Health Office, and hospital to monitor, prevent, and control rabies in humans and animals. Local governments will fund vaccines, veterinary supplies, and pet registration in a centralized database, while supporting veterinary volunteers and public awareness campaigns. The Livestock Office will provide training, vaccination and animal population management, and deploy veterinary staff and sterilization teams. Public Health and the hospital will oversee human surveillance, first-aid education, and vaccine services for at-risk populations. This marks a key step toward eradicating rabies in the province and ensuring public health safety.

triage.headline_ja: スリン県が家畜部門・地方自治体と連携し、狂犬病予防推進のためのMOU署名 | デイリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は重要な動物由来感染症だが、本記事は予防強化のための協調枠組み署名であり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。タイにおける狂犬病の現在の流行状況が不明であるため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はスリン県での狂犬病予防協力体制の構築について報じている。現在のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、予防体制強化が主題。狂犬病は人獣共通感染症として流行しやすい病原体であり、地方当局の関心も高いが、具体的な患者数・死亡数・流行状況に関する情報がないため、現時点ではWATCH判定。続報を注視し、実際のアウトブレイク警告が出た場合はPICKUPに昇格。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Penyebaran Virus Hanta Dan Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating the Spread of Hantavirus and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Thermal cameras have been installed at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, Terminal 3, in Tangerang, Indonesia, to screen arriving passengers for fever as a precaution against hantavirus and Ebola transmission. The measure is led by the airport management in collaboration with the Soekarno-Hatta Health Quarantine Center, targeting travelers arriving from the United States, Argentina, Uruguay, Panama, and African nations in response to the Ebola outbreak declared by the World Health Organization. Some passengers were observed passing through the thermal screening on Tuesday, 19 May 2026, ahead of the 20 May 2026 publication date. The initiative aims to enable early detection and ongoing public health surveillance amid cross-border travel.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラウイルスの拡大に対する警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの空港で予防的スクリーニングが実施される動きは検知されるが、イベント自体は発生リスク対策であり、既発生例の詳細や実際の症例数が不明。社会的関心は存在するが、確実な感染症イベント（患者発生）が記事内では明確ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドネシアの空港でのスクリーニング対策措置であり、実際のハンタウイルスやエボラの患者発生が当該国で確認されたことを直接示していない。Bluedot APIが付与した地域（米国、パナマ、アルゼンチン、ウルグアイ、アフリカ全体など）は渡航元/リスク地域として言及されているだけで、これらの国での実際の発生が記事の主軸ではないため、verified_locationsはインドネシアのみに限定。WHOのエボラ宣言が背景にあるが、当該記事ではそのエボラ発生地が明確でない。続報でインドネシア国内の患者確認や、発生地の詳細が明らかになれば段階的なエスカレーションを検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Malaysia tightens Ebola watch after WHO global alert
article.articleSummary: Malaysia tightens Ebola watch after WHO alert. As of May 20, the Health Ministry reports no Ebola cases in Malaysia, but preparedness is intensified after WHO declared a Bundibugyo virus outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The ministry is monitoring travelers from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, including those transiting through Dubai, Doha and Singapore; there are no direct flights from the affected countries. WHO data as of May 16 show eight laboratory-confirmed and 246 suspected Ebola cases in Ituri Province, DRC, with 80 suspected deaths; Uganda reports two confirmed cases, including one death, in Kampala, tied to travel history to DRC. Malaysia is boosting surveillance at entry points, improving early detection, isolation readiness, PPE, staff training, and laboratory capacity with the Institute for Medical Research and the National Public Health Laboratory. Seek medical attention within 21 days of returning if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのグローバルアラート後、マレーシアがエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo virus（エボラウイルス種）がPHEIC宣言され、複数国で確認された重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC（Ituri Province）とウガンダ（Kampala）での確認例が記載されており、WHOによるPHEIC宣言が2026年5月17日に発出されている。マレーシアは確認例なしだが、地域的な監視体制強化と国際的懸念の対象国として含める。Dubai、Doha、Singaporeは経由地として言及されているが、発症例の報告地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 防埃博拉疫情　巴林禁3国旅客入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahrain bans entry of travelers from three countries to prevent an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bahrain bans entry for 30 days for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda to curb an Ebola outbreak; the ban excludes Bahraini nationals and applies to non-Bahraini travelers who have visited these countries within the prior 30 days, prohibiting boarding flights into Bahrain. Bahraini arrivals will be subject to health guidelines on arrival, but details were not provided. The measure follows rising Ebola activity; the World Health Organization has expressed concern and declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, suggesting the crisis could last a long time. This Ebola event concerns the Democratic Republic of the Congo the 17th outbreak there and the third caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The DRC's 2018–2020 outbreak had about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths. The United States urges citizens to avoid travel to these three affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行防止のため、バーレーンが3カ国からの旅客入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言、複数国での旅行制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC、南スーダン、ウガンダでのエボラ活動に対するバーレーンの旅行禁止措置について述べられている。対象国リストから該当するのはDRCのみ（南スーダンとウガンダは対象国外）。WHOがPHEIC宣言している重大な感染症イベントであり、過去の同地域のアウトブレイク（2018-2020年で約3,500症例、2,300死亡）を参照すると、高い重症度と致死率を有する。治療法やワクチンが未承認のBundibugyo ebolavirus による17番目のDRC内アウトブレイク。国際的な旅行制限が実施されており、複数国政府が関与している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO worried about 'scale and speed' of deadly Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (epicenter Ituri province near the Uganda-South Sudan border) has about 543 suspected cases and 136 deaths, with many cases still labelling as suspected due to limited testing. The World Health Organization warned about the scale and speed of this haemorrhagic fever surge and has declared it a public health emergency of international concern. There is no vaccine or therapeutic for Bundibugyo; vaccine candidate Ervebo is being considered but would be available in at least two months. The virus has spread to neighboring provinces and across the border into Uganda, where two Congolese nationals were reported as cases (one infection, one death). Suspected cases appeared in Butembo and Goma (North Kivu). Hospitals report triage and space shortages in Ituri; MSF warns of overwhelmed facilities. Past outbreaks (2018–2020: ~2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases) highlight the risk. Vaccines exist only for Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、致命的なエボラアウトブレイクの「規模と速度」について懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行による重大な公衆衛生危機であり、隣国ウガンダへの拡大とWHOによるPHEIC宣言により、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク。543疑定患者、136死亡（致命率25%）。ウガンダへの越境感染確認（2例）。医療施設の飽和、ワクチン不足。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。過去2018-2020年アウトブレイクで3,500症例2,300死亡を記録した背景から、極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Jawa Tengah Siagakan 8 Rumah Sakit dan 883 Puskesmas Antisipasi Hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Java Prepares 8 Hospitals and 883 Community Health Centers to Anticipate Hantavirus
article.articleSummary: Eight hospitals and 883 community health centers in Central Java have been designated to prevent and anticipate hantavirus, though no cases have yet been reported in the region. Facilities include RS Dr Adhyatma MPH Semarang, RS Prof Dr Margono Purwokerto, and RS Dr Moewardi Surakarta, with an educational program called Jumat Pintar for health workers. Between 2023 and 2025, 50 hantavirus cases were detected at the Demak port area. There is currently no vaccine; rapid detection improves outcomes. Transmission occurs via saliva, urine, and feces of infected rats, direct contact with contaminated materials, or inhalation of dried particles. Early symptoms include fever, chest pain, abdominal pain, urinary problems, and red patches on the conjunctiva; severe illness can involve bleeding and kidney failure. Residents are urged to remain vigilant and seek prompt testing if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: ジャワ中部が8つの病院と883の保健センターを準備し、ハンタウイルスに対応
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症はIHR基準で異常・予想外だが、現在の地域内での症例報告がなく、国際拡大リスクが明確でないため。ただし、過去3年間でDemak港での50例の検出履歴と地域の医療体制整備の動きは注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ジャワ中部でのハンタウイルス対応準備を報じているが、現時点で当該地域での症例報告はなく、過去事例は別の地域（Demak港）での検出。医療体制の整備は準備段階。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・曝露の継続性・流行性がすべて認識されているが、現在の実際の患者発生の規模が不明確。続報を監視し、当該地域での症例確認があればPICKUPへの昇格を検討。

article.articleHeadline: Ce trebuie să știm despre focarul de Ebola care a trezit îngrijorarea Organizației Mondiale a Sănătății
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What we need to know about the Ebola outbreak that has raised the World Health Organization's concern.
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The rare Bundibugyo strain is responsible; there is no strain-specific vaccine yet. By May 20, 2026, 336 infections have been reported across the DRC and Uganda with at least 88 deaths. The outbreak began in the DRC (first detected May 5; confirmed Bundibugyo on May 15) and has spread to Uganda, with two cases in Kampala; a suspected case in Kinshasa is unconfirmed but likely. The true scale may be higher. Fruit bats are natural hosts; human transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, placing healthcare workers at high risk. Symptoms include abrupt fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, kidney/hepatic dysfunction, and possible hemorrhage. Case fatality rate for Bundibugyo is around 40%. Vaccines exist for other strains (Ervebo used in past RDC outbreaks; Zabdeno is two-dose and mainly for contacts), while Bundibugyo vaccines are in preclinical stages. No specific treatment; public health measures focus on surveillance, rapid diagnostics, isolation, contact tracing for 21 days, and safe burials. Epicenter: Ituri, DRC; four health workers have died; borders not closed; RDC and Uganda urged to strengthen tracing and testing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が懸念を表明したエボラアウトブレイクについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱が中央・東アフリカで拡大し、WHO が国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 稀なBundibugyo株による既知のワクチン非対応アウトブレイク。88名の死亡、336名の感染を報告。Kinshasa での疑い症例未確認。医療従事者4名含む死亡者。国境未封鎖。ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高。WHOが PHEIC 宣言。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: Inspeção elimina quase 14 mil criadouros do mosquito da dengue | Diario de Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inspection eliminates nearly 14,000 dengue-carrying mosquito breeding sites | Diario de Cuiabá
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, Brazil. In 2026, municipal health surveillance inspected 425,954 properties and treated 43,788 housing units, eliminating about 13,954 water-holding containers that serve as Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Dengue: 853 notifications, 360 lab-confirmed cases; incidence 42.5 per 100,000; one dengue death, another under investigation. Chikungunya: drastic decline—weekly notifications fell from 591.4 in 2025 to 5.6 in 2026; currently 100 chikungunya notifications with 97 confirmed, no deaths. Zika: stable control; six notifications, one confirmed. The report attributes progress to continuous vector-control activities, house visits, removal of breeding sites, and public education. Dengue vaccination with Qdenga is available for children/adolescents 10–14 in two-dose schedule. Residents are urged to eliminate standing-water receptacles and seek care for fever, body pains, red spots, or malaise; avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: 検査で約14,000のデング熱蚊の繁殖地を排除
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の同時発生を報告しており、複数の蚊媒介疾患のスクリーニング基準を満たすが、記事主題は予防活動の成功と感染減少傾向であり、新興の急速拡大リスクは限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事主題はブラジル・クイアバ市における蚊媒介疾患（デング熱853件通知・360確定例、チクングニア熱100件通知・97確定例、ジカ熱6件通知・1確定例）の報告であり、デング熱死亡1件と別途調査中の事例がある。しかし記事の主軸は2026年の検査活動による繁殖地排除の成功と感染減少傾向（チクングニア熱は週単位で2025年の591.4から2026年の5.6へ大幅減少）を強調しており、危機的な流行状況ではなく予防効果を示すものと解釈される。IHR基準2未満（1のみ）であり、WPROスクリーニング基準は3つ該当するが情報不足と管理可能性の観点から、WATCH判定が適切である。

article.articleHeadline: 德國將接收一名美籍埃博拉病毒感染者　　12:01
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany to receive an American Ebola patient 12:01.
article.articleSummary: Germany will receive an American doctor infected with Ebola virus disease (EVD) from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) for treatment in Berlin. On May 19, the German Health Ministry confirmed, at the United States' request, that the patient will be transported to Berlin's Charité Universitätsmedizin. A US-specialized aircraft will carry the patient to Berlin, where he will be placed in a dedicated isolation ward independent from routine hospital operations to safeguard public safety. In addition to the physician, six close contacts deemed high infection risk will also be evacuated to Germany. The Congo (Kinshasa)–Uganda border region is experiencing a new Ebola outbreak; the DRC health ministry reported 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases as of May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツがエボラウイルス感染者のアメリカ人医師を受け入れへ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的患者移送、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。DRC/ウガンダのエボラ流行と関連した初の先進国への患者輸送事例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはドイツへの患者輸送を記述しており、DRCが流行の発生地域として特定される。ウガンダについても言及されているが、患者輸送の主体はDRCからのため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ドイツ、米国、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ＮＥＷＳＦＬＡＳＨ：テドロス氏、エボラ熱拡大に懸念
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: NEWSFLASH: Dr. Tedros expresses concern about the spread of Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in eastern Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is expanding.
