WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told a Geneva General Assembly on May 19 that he is deeply concerned by the outbreak's scale and speed, while emphasising that the WHO is responding rapidly. The report notes remarks by Tedros on May 17 regarding Ebola virus disease, though the excerpt does not provide further details. The article does not disclose case counts or deaths. The focus remains on eastern Ituri in the DRC, with ongoing international monitoring and measures to contain transmission, and no laboratory confirmation details or infection sources are provided in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: NEWSFLASH：テドロス氏、エボラ熱拡大に懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常性」「国際的懸念」「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」が該当し、WHO事務局長による公式声明と国際的なモニタリング体制が確立していることから、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域に Genève（ジュネーブ）および Switzerland が含まれているが、記事サマリーではエボラ感染症の実際の発生は DRC の東部イトゥリ州に限定されており、ジュネーブでの言及は WHO 事務局長による公式声明の発表地点。したがって verified_locations に含めない。DRC はリスト対象国として含める。事例数・死亡数等は記事に開示されていないため「不明」と評価した項目が複数あるが、WHO 事務局長による公式懸念表明と「拡大」「スケール・スピード」の記述から重大性は明白。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам назвали симптомы лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were told the symptoms of Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: High fever, weakness, and muscle pains signal the onset of Ebola fever, according to Russian epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko. In an interview with Lenta.ru, he notes that diarrhea, abdominal pain and a dry cough leading to dehydration follow initial symptoms; about half of patients develop a hemorrhagic rash and bleeding from gums and nose, with progressive liver and kidney failure. The incubation period ranges from 2 to 21 days. To prevent importation into Russia, Onishchenko urged avoiding travel to West African natural foci, specifically Guinea, Nigeria, Senegal, and the Congo. He emphasized that the simplest import route is boarding a plane. Cases have already been recorded outside Africa—in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Mali, and Italy. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor will, at Uganda’s request, send a team to Kampala to conduct an epidemiological investigation.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人にエボラ出血熱の症状が説明された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い致死率と国際的拡大リスク、および既に複数国での症例確認（米国、英国、スペイン、イタリア）により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。ロシアが調査チームをウガンダに派遣予定であり、国際的な公衆衛生対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに複数国が列挙されているが、サマリーから実際のエボラ発生地は西アフリカ自然焦点地域（ギニア、ナイジェリア、セネガル、コンゴ）であり、対象国リストでは DRC のみが該当。米国、英国、スペイン、イタリア、ロシアは輸入症例が報告されている。ロシアがウガンダのカンパラに調査チーム派遣予定という点から、ウガンダでの感染状況が懸念されているが、記事本体ではウガンダでの実際の発症者の報告は明記されていない（推測による記述は避ける）。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Bengkulu cegah penyebaran PMK jelang Idul Adha - ANTARA News Bengkulu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengkulu City Government Prevents Foot-and-Mouth Disease Spread Ahead of Eid al-Adha - ANTARA News Bengkulu.
article.articleSummary: Bengkulu City government in Bengkulu Province is intensifying surveillance and vaccination to prevent foot-and-mouth disease (FMD/PMK) and Jembrana disease in livestock ahead of Eid al-Adha 1447 Hijriah. Officials say PMK cases in Bengkulu City have leveled off, but authorities continue active monitoring, vaccination campaigns, and inspections at farms to ensure cattle, goats, and buffaloes slated for slaughter are healthy and eligible for halal consumption. Veterinary health teams conduct routine checks at farmer pens and will expand oversight to seasonal livestock stalls selling animals for Eid. Education for farmers covers husbandry, hygiene, and nutritious feeding. Residents are urged to buy animals only from official stalls with a valid Animal Health Certificate (SKKH) issued by Bengkulu City medical staff to prevent disease spread.

triage.headline_ja: ベンクル市政府、イード・アル＝アドハー前に口蹄疫の拡大を防止 - ANTARAニュース ベンクル
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで口蹄疫の事例が報告されており、イード・アル＝アドハーという大規模な畜獣取引の時期を前にした対策が取られている。ただし記事は予防・監視活動に焦点があり、現在の流行状況や深刻度の詳細が不明であるため、情報追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物感染症であり、人間の健康への直接的な脅威は限定的であるが、畜産業への経済的影響と公衆衛生上の関心（食の安全性）が存在する。ベンクル市では「症例が落ち着いている」と述べられているが、イード・アル＝アドハーという季節性の高い畜獣取引イベント前の予防措置が重要となる。進行状況の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk Ebolasmittad landat i Tyskland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American Ebola-infected person has landed in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola has landed in Berlin, Germany. The patient contracted the disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Congo-Kinshasa) and was transported to Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin for care. Ebola is an RNA virus in the Filoviridae family that causes severe hemorrhagic fever. The Bundibugyo variant is implicated in the current Congo-Kinshasa outbreak, and there are no vaccines or approved treatments available for this variant. This represents an imported Ebola case into Germany. The report does not provide information on symptoms, incubation, or transmission beyond this travel-associated case. No death toll or broader outbreak data are detailed in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人エボラ感染者がドイツに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Hemorrhagic Fever）の国際的な症例移動であり、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。ドイツへの輸入症例は公衆衛生への潜在的な深刻な影響を示唆し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはドイツ（Germany）での事例報告ですが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。ドイツはWHO欧州地域事務局管轄。エボラ症例の国際移動（コンゴ→ドイツ）であり、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。症状や接触追跡情報の詳細が不足しているが、重症度と国際的懸念の高さから PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: American Missionary In Africa Tests Positive For Ebola - Conservative Angle
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC has prompted a WHO-wide public health emergency. As of May 19, CDC/DRC Uganda health ministries report 536 suspected Ebola cases, 105 probable, 34 confirmed, and 134 deaths, amid ongoing transmission. A rare Bundibugyo strain has killed about 131 people in the DRC. An American medical missionary, Peter Stafford, working in DRC, tested positive on May 17 after developing symptoms the previous weekend; he is being transported to Germany for treatment. Germany’s Charité University Hospital in Berlin will host him in a special isolation ward, with a team of Ebola-care experts. Six high-risk contacts are traveling to Europe; some to Germany and one to the Czech Republic, under quarantine during monitoring. The CDC, DHS and U.S. authorities coordinated the move; Germany cited prior experience handling Ebola and shorter flight times as rationale. Authorities note case counts are dynamic.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカの宣教師がアフリカでエボラ陽性反応 - アメリカ保守派アングル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀なブンディブギョ株、国際的拡大・複数国での患者/接触者移動、欧米への患者輸送による渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も4項目以上該当。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRC東部でのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク（536疑似例、34確定例、134死亡）の最中、米国人医療宣教師がDRCで感染確認。ドイツ（シャリテ大学病院ベルリン）とチェコへの患者・接触者の国際移送は、重大な国際的広がりリスクを示唆。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当し、即座のフルRRA開始が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Der Tag: Ebola-Patient in Berliner Charité aufgenommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Day: Ebola patient admitted to Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, an American with Ebola virus disease has been admitted to Berlin's Charité Universitätsmedizin for treatment. The patient was placed in the university hospital’s Sonderisolierstation on Campus Virchow-Klinikum, a closed, protected unit separate from regular clinical care to prevent contact with other patients. The Bundesgesundheitsministerium confirms the infection, which the patient acquired in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the Ebola outbreak is spreading strongly. German Health Minister Nina Warken emphasized that the government will assist partners and that Germany maintains a robust care network capable of safely managing highly infectious diseases; the patient will receive optimal care under stringent safety precautions. Ebola is an infectious, life-threatening disease transmitted through direct contact and contact with bodily fluids. The case represents a controlled import of Ebola to Germany with dedicated containment facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのシャリテ病院にエボラ患者が入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な症例報告であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが明確に該当。DRCでの流行と関連し、管理可能性の評価が必要なため。
triage.notes: 患者はアメリカ人でベルリンのシャリテ病院に入院しているが、感染症の発生地はDRCであり、本シグナルトリアージの対象国はDRCのみ。ドイツはWPRO地域外のため対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCでのエボラ流行が背景にあり、国際的な感染症危機として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو | جمعية "أطباء بلا حدود" تدفع بإمدادات طارئة إلى بونيا لمواجهة تفشي فيروس "إيبولا" - قناة المنار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo | Doctors Without Borders pushes emergency supplies to Bunia to confront the Ebola outbreak - Al-Manar TV
article.articleSummary: Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is grappling with an Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu. Doctors Without Borders has delivered heavy emergency medical supplies to Bunia to bolster hospitals, establish advanced isolation units, and intensify patient screening at key facilities and border crossings to curb cross-border spread. The World Health Organization warns of the current wave’s scale and rapid transmission, cautioning that the outbreak could escalate and last longer if vaccines remain scarce. Official counts report 131 deaths with over 500 suspected cases in Ituri and North Kivu. Response efforts prioritize hospital-based isolation, rapid training of responders on Ebola hemorrhagic fever protocols, and border-control measures. This follows a backdrop of weakened local health infrastructure, as teams work to interrupt transmission amid an ongoing outbreak as of May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 | 国境なき医師団がブニアにエボラウイルスの流行に対抗するための緊急医療品を供給
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例と死亡者が存在し、国際的に懸念される病原体であり、複数地域での流行・国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認流行事例。死亡者131名、疑い症例500名以上。Ituri州およびNorth Kivu州で発生。国境なき医師団による国際的な対応が実施中。WHOも流行規模と急速な感染に警告を発出。ワクチン不足による拡大リスク指摘あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO báo động khẩn về Ebola, nhiều nước Đông Nam Á tăng cường biện pháp y tế
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues urgent warning about Ebola as many Southeast Asian countries step up health measures.
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak reports 513 cases and 131 deaths. Southeast Asian nations—Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia—have intensified health measures. Singapore imposes border health checks, 21-day self-monitoring for travelers from affected areas, and electronic health declarations; no direct flights from DRC/Uganda to Singapore. Thailand maintains 21-day arrival surveillance, hospital screening, and readiness with isolation facilities, PPE, and testing. Indonesia tightens port surveillance, routes suspected cases to designated hospitals, and coordinates risk communications via its Ebola portal. Transmission occurs after symptom onset through direct contact with blood or body fluids; incubation is 2–21 days. Bundibugyo strain fatality is 30–50%; no approved treatment or vaccine. Travelers should practice hygiene, avoid contact with the sick or funerals, and avoid bushmeat. WHO chief Tedros warned of rapid spread on May 19.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラについて緊急警告を発表、東南アジア諸国が保健措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラはPHEIC宣言済みで国際的な懸念が極めて高く、複数の対象国で対応強化が行われている。
triage.notes: エボラはPHEIC宣言済みで重篤度が極めて高い。DRCとウガンダでの発生が主であるが、シンガポール・タイ・インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。ベトナムは記事ソースの国だが感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 谭德塞称埃博拉疫情可能扩散 值得高度警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the Ebola outbreak could spread; warrants heightened vigilance.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19, 2026, WHO data show an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda with over 130 suspected deaths and more than 500 suspected cases. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned at the World Health Assembly that factors could drive further spread, noting Bundibugyo ebolavirus and the absence of a vaccine or specific therapy. Suspected cases have been reported in Kampala (Uganda); Goma, capital of North Kivu Province (DRC); and Bunia, capital of Ituri Province. Nosocomial transmission has occurred after health-care workers died. Ongoing conflict in Ituri has displaced more than 100,000 people in two months, increasing transmission risk. The first suspected case was a health-care worker with symptoms on April 24 who died at a Bunia medical center. May 15 confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus; prior alert on May 5 and rapid-response on May 13. Jeremy Konidick, president of the International Organization for Migration, noted that the virus had circulated before confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: テドロス事務局長がエボラ疫情の拡散の可能性を指摘、高度な警戒が必要と述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認事例、130名以上の死亡、500名以上の疑い患者、医療従事者への院内感染、国際的な拡大リスク、WHOの警告により、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダはKampalaで疑い患者が報告されているに留まり、確定症例やアウトブレイク評価の主体はDRC（北キブ州、イトゥリ州）である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外した。ただし、ウガンダでの症例報告も国際的拡大の懸念を増加させる要素となっており、引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch spitzt sich weiter zu: WHO ruft Notlage aus - und bricht damit jahrelanges Vorgehen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to intensify: WHO declares a state of emergency - and breaks with years of longstanding protocol.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, northeast, bordering Uganda and South Sudan) intensifies as the Bundibugyo variant spreads. As of May 19, 2026, 11:02 local time, 513 suspected cases and 131 presumed deaths have been reported, with figures awaiting lab confirmation. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976; Bundibugyo had previously occurred only twice. The World Health Organization declared an international health emergency without awaiting the emergency committee, to mobilize international action. No licensed vaccine or effective treatment exists for this variant, complicating control efforts. The outbreak likely began in the third week of April in Ituri. An infected doctor and contacts are being treated in Germany. Africa CDC regards regional spread as high; Rwanda closed its border with eastern Congo; some governments have issued travel advisories. The 2014–2015 West Africa Zaire outbreak killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が加速：WHO が初めて緊急事態を宣言 - 多年にわたる対応方針を転換
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。WHO による緊急事態宣言と新型変種（Bundibugyo）の出現により、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: DRC（イトゥリ州）での Bundibugyo エボラウイルスの流行。513例の疑い症例、131例の死亡が報告され、ドイツにも感染者が搬送されている。WHO が緊急委員会を待たずに国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言したことが特筆される。ワクチンと有効治療がないため管理が困難。ルワンダが国境を閉鎖するなど地域的拡大への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог рассказал, почему Эбола опаснее хантавируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virologist explained why Ebola is more dangerous than hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is more dangerous than hantavirus due to transmission modes. Virologist Anatoly Altshtein, chief scientist at the Gamaleya Center, told TASS via Day.Az that Ebola and hantavirus differ 'very strongly' in symptoms. Ebola has higher lethality; hantavirus spreads poorly between humans. He noted a May-detected hantavirus variant on the cruise ship MV Hondius exhibits a relatively high fatality rate. In terms of lethality they are comparable, but this hantavirus variant causes fewer hemorrhages and more heart and lung damage. Altshtein noted Ebola is zoonotic, transmitted from animals; human infection occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person and contaminated surfaces. On May 17, WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing international spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者がエボラがハンタウイルスより危険な理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの言及はPHEIC宣言の文脈のみであり、具体的な患者発生報告がないため検証対象外。DRCでのアウトブレイクが主題。2026年5月17日WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ハンタウイルス（MV Hondius船上での検出）も記載されているが、主焦点はエボラアウトブレイクの危険性の説明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Európe: Do Česka prevážajú Američana, ktorý bol v kontakte s nakazenými
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Europe: An American who had been in contact with the infected is being transported to the Czech Republic.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province, near the Uganda and South Sudan borders, has caused about 131 deaths from 513 suspected cases, per the Congolese Ministry of Health. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Diagnostic tests are available to detect the virus, with CDC coordinating rapid isolation, specimen collection, and testing of suspected cases. In Europe, an American who had contact with an infected person is being transported to the Czech Republic for care at Fakultní nemocnice Bulovka, a facility equipped for high-risk pathogens, including isolation rooms, negative-pressure containment, and a dedicated isolation transport box. Germany has already admitted a patient at Charité in Berlin, and six more contacts are being transported to Europe—one to the Czech Republic and the rest to Germany—with quarantine during the monitoring phase.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパでのエボラ：感染者と接触したアメリカ人がチェコに搬送される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクが複数国に国際的に拡大しており、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州でのエボラアウトブレイク（513疑似症例、131死亡）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダ、南スーダン国境地帯が発生地域。ドイツ、チェコへの患者搬送は国際的対応。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ドイツ、チェコでの搬送患者は対象国外（ドイツ=WPRO外、チェコ=対象国外）のため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: يمكن الخلط بينها وبين الإنفلونزا.. تعرف على طرق وقاية وعلاج الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It can be confused with influenza... Learn about Ebola prevention and treatment.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the World Health Organization. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids from an infected person or animal; incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms resemble influenza—fever, fatigue, headache, and muscle pains—progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and jaundice, with bleeding occurring in later stages. There are three Ebola-related viruses: Ebola virus, Sudan virus, Bundibugyo virus; vaccines and treatments are approved only for Ebola virus, while the current DRC outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo virus. Prevention emphasizes handwashing, thorough washing of fruits and vegetables, avoiding contact with the sick, and not sharing towels or bedding. Early medical care and hospital isolation with supportive treatment (IV fluids) improve survival. World Health Organization cites an average case fatality around 50%, with past outbreaks ranging 25–90% depending on detection and healthcare access.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザと混同されることがある...エボラの予防と治療方法について知る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo virus）アウトブレイクがWHOにより国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。重症度（CFR 50%平均、過去は25-90%）、人-人感染、および国際的懸念が明確。
triage.notes: サマリーではDRCでのBundibugyo virusアウトブレイクが明記されており、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・治療は現在のアウトブレイク原因株（Bundibugyo）に対して未承認である点が重要。発生地域フィールドがDRCのみであり、検証済み位置情報と一致。

article.articleHeadline: WHO expresses concern over scale of Ebola outbreak - Businessday NG
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri—Bunia Health Zone) has intensified, with 131 deaths, 33 confirmed cases among 516 suspected. Two confirmed cases have been reported in Uganda, signaling cross-border spread into urban areas such as Kampala. The Bundibugyo strain, designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO, currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting and bleeding; transmission can occur in health facilities. The average fatality rate is about 50% (range 25–90%). WHO is convening an emergency committee, and funding ($3.9 million) has been released to bolster national responses; the US is pursuing a monoclonal antibody therapy. Nigeria’s NCAA has ordered airport/port health surveillance to prevent cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラアウトブレイクの規模と感染速度への懸念を表明 - Businessday NG
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の最重要脅威であり、DRCからウガンダへの越境感染確認、都市部(カンパラ)への拡大、高い致死率(50%)、国際的な公開声明と資金配分がなされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC(Ituri州・Bunia Health Zone)が主要発生地点。ウガンダでの2例の確認症例は報告されているがサマリーの主軸はDRCのアウトブレイク。ナイジェリアの検疫強化は予防的対応であり、実際の発生ではない。米国はWHOと連携する支援国。DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: حجر صحي واسع في أوغندا للحد من انتشار فيروس إيبولا | المصري اليوم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wide-scale quarantine in Uganda to curb the spread of the Ebola virus | Al-Masry Al-Youm
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Uganda imposes quarantine on more than 100 people to curb a rare Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain. The quarantined individuals are under surveillance at an undisclosed site, with medical teams conducting tests and monitoring for symptoms. Officials say the situation remains under control, noting Uganda’s prior outbreak experience has boosted readiness. Alan Kasoga, executive director of the Ugandan Media Centre and Ebola task force communications coordinator, said over 100 people have been quarantined and are receiving care from qualified health teams. The outbreak focus is Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo near the Uganda border, with first warning signals on May 5; DRC authorities report at least 131 deaths and more than 500 suspected cases. The World Health Organization has warned of the scale and speed of spread in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで大規模検疫開始、エボラウイルス拡大を抑制 | Al-Masry Al-Youm
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大が進行中であり、DRCで131人の死亡、500人以上の疑い例が報告されている。ウガンダでの検疫開始は国家間の対応が必要な深刻な感染症危機である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（対象国外）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのIturi州でのエボラ発生を伝えるものであり、ウガンダはその対応地として記載されているのみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHO警告あり、Bundibugyo株による珍しい流行。

article.articleHeadline: Australia battles worst diphtheria outbreak in decades - News | InDaily, Inside Queensland
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria outbreak in Australia reaches 223 cases since March across Northern Territory (133), Western Australia (79), South Australia (6), and Queensland (up to 5), described as the biggest in decades. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; symptoms include sore throat, fever, loss of appetite, and in severe cases breathing trouble, with a less harmful cutaneous form causing sores. Almost all cases involve Indigenous Australians, prompting vaccination campaigns and partnerships with Aboriginal health services; an autopsy in a remote Northern Territory community is awaited for a possible diphtheria-related death. Immunisation remains key: free vaccines under the national program for children at 6 weeks, 4 months, 6 months, 18 months, 4 years, and 12 years, with adults advised to receive boosters every 10 years. Separately, WHO cites 131 Ebola deaths in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, declaring a global public health emergency for the Bundibugyo strain amid urban spread and infections among healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリアが数十年ぶりの最悪ジフテリア流行に対抗 - ニュース | InDaily, Inside Queensland
triage.triage_reason: ジフテリア：IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・深刻な影響）。エボラ：WHO公式の「グローバル公衆衛生上の緊急事態」宣言がある対象国（DRC）での死亡報告。いずれも国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はオーストラリアでのジフテリア流行とDRCでのエボラ流行の両方を言及しているが、オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCではWHOが「グローバル公衆衛生上の緊急事態」を公式宣言しており、131人の死亡が報告されている。ジフテリアについても数十年ぶりの大規模流行（223例）であり、呼吸器飛沫感染による容易な伝播と重症度が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情蔓延！會傳到台灣嗎？ 疾管署揭風險評估 | 生活焦點 | 要聞 | NOWnews今日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading! Will it spread to Taiwan? Taiwan CDC reveals risk assessment | Life Focus | Top News | NOWnews Today's News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expanding in remote provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo, with WHO declaring the DRC/Uganda event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Africa CDC reports at least 100 deaths and over 390 suspected cases; Uganda has 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. A US doctor working in the DRC tested positive and will be treated in Germany. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with infected blood, body fluids, or secretions; avoid attending funerals and contact with the deceased, and minimize wildlife exposure (bats, primates). The case fatality rate is about 50%; there is no licensed vaccine or antiviral therapy. Taiwan’s CDC assesses overall risk to Taiwan as low and has raised travel advisory to Alert Level 2 with strengthened border monitoring. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include high fever, malaise, myalgia, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding; severe disease may involve liver/kidney/CNS damage and shock. Lab testing requires 24-hour reporting and strict infection control; samples are transported in P620 containers to Taiwan CDC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大！台湾に広がるのか？ 台湾疾病管制署がリスク評価を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的移動制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも高い重症度と流行性を示す。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ、台湾、ドイツが列挙されているが、サマリーの主題は「コンゴ民主共和国での発生拡大とウガンダへの限定的な越境」であり、台湾とドイツは「確認/治療地」。対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（203312）のみ該当。WHO PHEIC宣言、100死亡以上、390疑い例以上、ケース致死率50%という極めて深刻な状況。米国医師の陽性確認は国際的拡大リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: RDC et Ebola, un mauvais déjà-vu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC and Ebola, a bad déjà vu.
article.articleSummary: As of May 19 in DRC's Ituri province, there are more than 500 suspected Ebola cases and about 150 deaths, with two confirmed cases in Uganda (one death) and one confirmed in Goma. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, and the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern at the maximal level last Saturday, the eighth time in history. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare species with no vaccine and no approved treatment. Transmission shows multiple, distant chains across Ituri’s Mongbwalu and across the Ugandan and South Sudanese borders; several health workers have died. Diagnostic delays are evident: initial tests missed Bundibugyo, delaying confirmation by nine days. Funeral practices and ongoing conflict hinder response, and access remains constrained. A missionary tested positive and was moved to Germany; the piece situates this amid Geneva’s evolving pandemic-treaty discussions in Annex 12 on pathogen sharing and access to countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: DRC and Ebola, a bad déjà vu（DRCとエボラ、悪い既視感）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による多国間での確認例と国際的拡大リスク、高い死亡率、WHOによる最高レベルのPHEIC宣言があり、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCのIturi州でのエボラ発生を主要テーマとしており、ウガンダとスーダンでの確認例も言及されているが、スーダンの確認例は記事内容に明記されていない。DRC国内での複数チェーン（Mongbwalu、Goma）、ウガンダへの国際的拡大（2確認例うち1死亡）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・承認治療なし）、WHO PHEIC最高レベル宣言（8回目の歴史的宣言）、医療従事者の死亡、診断遅延（9日間）が記載されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが確認された発生地である。

article.articleHeadline: "Je ne pense pas que cette épidémie sera terminée dans deux mois" : les raisons de s'inquiéter, ou non, d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "I don't think this outbreak will be over in two months: the reasons to worry, or not, about Ebola."
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain is unfolding in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. As of 2026-05-20, authorities report 513 suspected cases and 131 deaths, with confirmed cases in Kinshasa and Kampala, hundreds of kilometers from Ituri. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling international coordination without a pandemic designation. The situation is worrying: transmission may have persisted for weeks before official recognition, and surveillance and infection control are hampered by regional insecurity, displacement, and high mobility. The Bundibugyo strain is rare; there is no licensed vaccine or specific approved treatment, and mortality is about one in three. Containment relies on classic public health measures—rapid case finding, isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, safe burials, and community engagement. Greater RDC and Ugandan response capacity and international support via the PHEIC offer cautious optimism; overall global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 「この流行は2ヶ月で終わるとは思わない」：エボラについて心配すべき理由、心配すべきでない理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な影響、予想外の株・拡大、国際的拡大リスク、国際的渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEICを宣言している高リスク事象であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（Uganda）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主体で、ウガンダはKampalで確認例が報告されている二次的な位置づけ。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo株は稀な株系統であり、ワクチンや特定の承認済み治療法がない点が深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Rubio kritiserer WHO for at reagere for sent på ebola-udbrud i Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rubio criticizes WHO for reacting too late to the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio criticizes the World Health Organization for being too slow to declare an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Africa. The outbreak is reported to have killed more than 130 people. Rubio was asked on Tuesday how the United States would respond to the virus, signaling ongoing questions about international action. The article highlights the delay in WHO’s recognition of the outbreak. It does not provide further details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, clinical symptoms, or the management of imported/exported cases within the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: ルビオがアフリカのエボラ流行に対するWHOの対応の遅さを批判
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で確認され、130人以上の死亡者が報告されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な広がりのリスク、および予想外の事象として、IHR基準最低2つ以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。社会的・政治的関心も高い（米国国務長官の発言など）。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国で確認されており、対象国リストに含まれる。記事は米国国務長官による批判という政治的側面を強調しているが、基礎となる公衆衛生事象は明確（130人以上の死亡者）。ただし、記事サマリーでは詳細な流行規模、検査確認状況、感染経路などの詳細情報が不足している。米国は発生地域として列挙されているが、サマリー上では政治的反応の背景であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ein Ebola-Patient soll in Berlin behandelt werden - wie ein Infektiologe das Virus einschätzt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola patient is to be treated in Berlin - how an infectious disease specialist assesses the virus.
article.articleSummary: An imported Ebola case in Germany: a US citizen infected in Congo will be treated at Berlin's Charité. Transport is conducted under strict safety measures and as brief as possible, leveraging Germany’s network of specialized isolation wards and prior Ebola experience. Therapy centers on staff protection and supportive care, as there is no specific antiviral therapy; treatment includes electrolyte and fluid replacement, oxygen therapy, ventilation for respiratory failure, and organ-supportive measures, with intensive care for shock, multiorgan failure, and potential severe bleeding. The Ebola virus reservoir lies in fruit bats in Africa, with spillover to humans and subsequent human-to-human transmission; outbreaks are expected to reoccur, increasingly at shorter intervals due to greater wildlife contact. The current outbreak prognosis is uncertain: there are infected individuals in neighboring countries, and transmission chains with unknown origins, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がベルリンで治療される予定 - 感染症専門家がウイルスをどう評価しているか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。高致命率ウイルスの国際流入事例であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで複数国が言及されている（DRC、ドイツ、米国）が、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。患者の感染源がコンゴであること、および記事の主題がコンゴからのエボラ輸入事例であることから、DRCを verified_locations に含める。ドイツ（Berlin）は治療地点であり、感染発生地ではない。全WPRO基準に該当し、不確実な伝播チェーン、隣接国への感染者存在など、リスク管理上の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den Küresel Alarm: Ebola'nın Ölümcül "Bundibugyo" Türü Afrika'da Hızla Yayılıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Alarm from WHO: the deadly 'Bundibugyo' strain of Ebola is spreading rapidly in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, with up to 40% fatality and high transmissibility, is destabilizing Africa, centering in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, where mining-driven population movements fuel transmission and spillover into Uganda and South Sudan. At the 79th World Health Assembly, WHO Director-General Tedros announced an international health emergency without convening the Emergency Committee, signaling unprecedented urgency. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo; Merck’s Ervebo targets the Zaire strain, and laboratory studies are assessing potential cross-protection. Ongoing conflict and insecurity in DRC hinder access for health teams. In Nyankunde, an American doctor, Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola, with six others exposed and evacuated to Germany. The United States pledges $13 million in emergency aid and to establish 50 treatment clinics, criticizing WHO for delaying the emergency declaration amid funding strains after USAID cuts.

triage.headline_ja: WHOからの世界的警告：エボラウイルスの致命的な「ブンディブギョ」株がアフリカで急速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。高い致死率（40%）、国際的な広がり、緊急宣言、複数国への拡散が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ地域を中心としたブンディブギョ株エボラの発生を報告。ウガンダとスーダンへの越境の可能性が言及されているが、サマリー上で実際の発生が確認されている対象国はDRCのみ。米国とドイツは医療支援・患者受け入れを行っているが、ウイルス発生国ではない。WHO緊急宣言、高い致死率（40%）、採鉱活動に関連した人口移動による感染の拡大、承認済みワクチンの欠如など複数の重大要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱、当初予想より急速に拡大か　WHO専門家が警告 - BBCニュース
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease may be spreading more rapidly than originally expected, WHO experts warn - BBC News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 136 deaths and 514 infections suspected, and Uganda reporting one death. The outbreak centers in Ituri province in the northeast, a high-mobility, insecure region hindering investigation and containment. WHO notes some cases have crossed borders and spread to South Kivu and the city of Goma, which is controlled by anti-government groups backed by Rwanda. A MRC Centre analysis warned that confirmed cases may be significantly undercounted, with estimates exceeding 1,000. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; there is no licensed vaccine for this strain, unlike vaccines for the Zaïre strain. First detected on April 24, 2026. Transmission occurs via blood and bodily fluids; initial symptoms mimic flu, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and bleeding. Displacement from conflict, including over 11,000 South Sudanese refugees and mining-driven migration, worsens transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、当初予想より急速に拡大か　WHO専門家が警告 - BBCニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な国境越え拡大、高い死亡率、推定症例数の大幅な過小計測、ワクチン未対応株の関与は、フルRRA実施の確実な理由である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内での複数地域（Ituri、South Kivu、Goma）への拡大が記載されており、Uganda死亡例の言及があるが、サマリー主題はDRCでのエボラ拡大である。リスク要因として、(1)Bundibugyo株に対するライセンス認可済みワクチンがない、(2)推定症例数がスクリーニング数を大幅に上回る可能性、(3)紛争・難民移動による接触機会増加が挙げられる。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに高い危機度を示す。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲爆發伊波拉疫情　專家：罕見病毒株、嚴防轉機者 | 生活 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in Africa: Experts Warn of a Rare Viral Strain and Strict Prevention of Transmission by Carriers
article.articleSummary: Two-country Ebola outbreak in Africa: the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. In the DRC, as of May 16, more than 80 deaths and 246 suspected cases have been reported; Uganda has confirmed 2 cases who had travelled to the DRC. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, signaling international coordination, though not a pandemic. Bundibugyo mortality is about 30–40%, lower than the Zaire strain’s ~90%. Early diagnostics faced false negatives due to strain differences, with confirmation in early May. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated objects. There is no approved vaccine or therapy; CDC is considering experimental drugs. Taiwan authorities warn of importation risk via travelers and emphasize strict border surveillance and isolation for fever or bleeding symptoms, as the risk to Taiwan remains extremely low but not zero.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱が大流行　専門家：稀なウイルス株、転機者の厳格な予防を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目全て該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの国際的に重大な感染症アウトブレイク。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。ウガンダの2確定例はDRCからの渡航関連であり、主要なアウトブレイク地は対象国外（ウガンダは対象国リスト外）のため verified_locations に含めず。Bundibugyo株による致死率30-40%の多国アウトブレイク。台湾での警告は渡航者経由の輸入リスク対応であり、アウトブレイク地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cachoeira do Sul já teve 42 hospitalizações e um óbito por infecções respiratórias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cachoeira do Sul has already recorded 42 hospitalizations and one death due to respiratory infections.
article.articleSummary: Cachoeira do Sul, in the Central Region of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reports 42 hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) this year, including five cases caused by Influenza A, none by COVID-19, and the remainder by other respiratory viruses. One death from Rhinovirus occurred in April, involving a 64-year-old woman with comorbidities who was not immunized in 2026 against influenza or COVID-19. The current SRAG incidence is 51.50 cases per 100,000 inhabitants. Health authorities urge early diagnosis and reinforced prevention through vaccination and public health measures. SRAG emerges when a flu-like syndrome progresses to dyspnea and reduced oxygen saturation; influenza vaccination aims to reduce hospitalizations, complications, and deaths, and vaccination against COVID-19 remains a key preventive strategy. Preventive measures include respiratory etiquette, proper ventilation, masks, hand hygiene, and avoiding crowded places.

triage.headline_ja: カショエイラ・ド・スル、呼吸器感染症により42件の入院と1件の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの1地域での季節的な呼吸器感染症（SRAG）の報告。Influenza A症例は限定的（5件）でCOVID-19はなし。入院と死亡が報告されているが、規模や異常性は低く、対象国内のローカルな公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断。情報不足のため経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月配信で、ブラジルの単一市（カショエイラ・ド・スル、リオグランデドスル州）での季節的呼吸器感染症報告。IHR基準はすべて該当なし。WPRO基準では重症度（1死亡42入院）、継続的曝露（SRAG継続発生）、流行性（SRAG/influenza）に該当するが、地理的限定性と国内対応可能性から国際的シグナルではなく、続報を注視する段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: По меньшей мере 131 человек погиб в результате вспышки эболы - ВОЗ проводит экстренное совещание
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 131 people have died as a result of an Ebola outbreak — WHO is holding an emergency meeting.
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization convened an emergency meeting over an Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Preliminary reports indicate more than 130 deaths, with the WHO Director-General warning the outbreak's true scale may exceed current estimates. International health authorities fear the virus may have spread beyond detected boundaries; in response, the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola virus disease is highly deadly and spreads via blood and bodily fluids and through close contact with infected humans or animals. The article highlights that health systems in Africa are weak, complicating containment, and stresses that rapid international response is required to prevent wider transmission beyond the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行により少なくとも131人が死亡 - WHOが緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死性を持ち、131人以上の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的な拡大懸念、および地域外への感染拡大による渡航・貿易制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: DRCが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含まれていません。ただし、本イベントはWHOによるPHEIC宣言がなされた極めて重大な感染症危機であり、フルRRA実施の優先度は最高です。

article.articleHeadline: जॉर्डन ने इबोला के फैलाव के चलते डीआरसी और युगांडा से यात्रियों की एंट्री पर लगाई अस्थायी रोक | Jordan bans entry from Congo, Uganda over Ebola concerns
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jordan imposes a temporary ban on entry of travelers from DR Congo and Uganda due to the spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Jordan imposes a temporary entry ban on travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda amid an Ebola outbreak. The measure, effective from Wednesday for 30 days, excludes Jordanian citizens. Jordan’s Interior Ministry said it would monitor developments per global health updates. The World Health Organization has expressed rapid spread and concern in the DRC, reporting about 136 confirmed deaths and more than 500 suspected cases; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak is serious. Ebola is a severe disease affecting humans and some primates, transmitted by contact with blood, body fluids, organs, or surfaces contaminated with these fluids; spillover from wild animals such as bats and certain primates is common. Symptoms include sudden fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and kidney/liver dysfunction. Historical note: initial outbreaks occurred in Central Africa; the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic was the largest.

triage.headline_ja: ジョルダンがエボラの拡大に懸念し、コンゴとウガンダからの入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生（DRCで136人の死亡確認、500人超の疑い例）が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当。WHO事務局長も深刻性を警告しており、国際的対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ、アンゴラが記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主な発生地として言及されており、他国への拡大は記載されていない。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。ジョルダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: La historia del ébola, del primer brote en 1976 a la crisis actual en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The History of Ebola, from the first outbreak in 1976 to the current crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo involves the Bundibugyo strain; the World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency, with uncertain case counts and geographic spread, and no authorized vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo. Ebola’s history began in 1976 with outbreaks in Yambuku, Zaire and Nzara, Sudan; 318 cases and 280 deaths in Zaire (≈88% fatality), linked to hospital transmission and poor infection control. The name comes from the Ebola River, and fruit bats are suspected reservoirs, though the natural cycle remains unresolved. Notable episodes include the 1989 Reston outbreak in Virginia in monkeys from the Philippines (no human symptoms); 1994 Ivory Coast; 1995 Kikwit (DRC). The 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic caused >28,600 cases and >11,300 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone; vaccines exist for the Zaire strain, but Bundibugyo lacks a licensed vaccine. The 2018–2020 Zaire outbreak in DRC: 3,481 cases, 2,229 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの歴史、1976年の最初の流行から現在のコンゴ危機まで
triage.triage_reason: 記事は歴史的なエボラ流行の解説であり、「現在の危機」がDRCで言及されているが、記事サマリーは過去の流行と現在の状況が混在しており、具体的な現在の症例数や地理的拡大の詳細が不明である。
triage.notes: 記事は主にエボラウイルスの歴史的解説であり、現在のDRCにおける流行について「WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言」「Bundibugyo株」「ワクチンなし」が言及されている。ただし記事サマリーから現在の流行に関する具体的な症例数、発症者数、地理的拡大範囲の詳細が不明であるため、WATCH判定とした。続報で現在の流行の詳細情報が提供される場合はPICKUPへ上げることを検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ感染の米国人宣教師、ドイツに移動中＝米ＣＤＣ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected American missionary en route to Germany — U.S. CDC.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, the CDC said an American infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is en route to Germany for treatment. The Congo outbreak involves a rare Ebola virus variant with more than 130 deaths reported locally. Germany’s government said Berlin’s largest university hospital is prepared to treat the patient. CDC Ebola Incident Manager Dr. Satish Pillai said six high-risk close contacts will be relocated to Europe—one to the Czech Republic and five to Germany—and will be quarantined during the incubation period. The U.S. State Department will fund up to 50 treatment facilities in DRC, Uganda, and the outbreak region through CERF. Diagnostic tests are now capable of detecting this variant, and U.S. risk remains low. Entry restrictions apply to travelers who departed from or stayed in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days. African CDC criticized travel bans as not a solution.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の米国人宣教師、ドイツに移動中＝米ＣＤＣ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際的な拡大リスク）。希少なエボラウイルス変異株の発生、複数国への患者移送、国際的な感染リスク管理が必要な状況であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラの実際の発生地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンと明記されている。患者の移送先はドイツ、チェコなど対象国外。verified_locationsはDRCのみ（実際の発生地域として対象国リストに該当）。희少ウイルス変異株、130人以上の死亡、複数国への患者移送という特殊性から極めて高いリスク状態。

article.articleHeadline: US Pledges Major Ebola Aid Surge, Slams WHO Over Delayed Alert In Africa Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in a remote, conflict-affected region of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in Central Africa prompts a major US aid surge, with pledges over $100 million and a nine-figure package to fund up to 50 Ebola treatment centres and clinics. US officials blame the WHO for a roughly 10-day delay in identifying the Ebola strain; outbreak publicly confirmed on May 15. Washington activated a 24-hour State Department task force and deployed a Disaster Assistance Response Team to Kinshasa and Kampala. So far one person linked to US evacuation efforts tested positive, eight more are being evacuated, and others are under monitoring. CDC Title 42 travel restrictions bar foreign nationals who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. The CDC maintains a strong regional footprint (over 100 staff in the DRC, 30+ in Kampala).

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ熱への大規模支援を誓約、アフリカの感染症拡大について世界保健機関(WHO)の遅延した警告を批判
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで確認され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な拡大リスク、米国を含む複数国への影響、WHOの対応遅延による国際的関心の高まり、渡航制限の実施が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCでのエボラ出血熱発生が明確に述べられており、Kinshasa、Kampala、South Sudanへの言及も確認されている。しかし、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。米国の支援誓約とWHOへの批判、CDC渡航制限の実施により、社会政治的関心が極めて高い。複数の死傷者、治療センター整備の必要性、米国市民への影響があることから、優先度の高いシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Hawaii tracks Bundibugyo virus amid WHO Ebola emergency
article.articleSummary: Hawaii Department of Health is actively tracking Bundibugyo virus, a deadly Ebola strain with no licensed vaccine and a fatality rate estimated at 30–50%, currently spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. On May 16, the World Health Organization declared this outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, organ damage and hemorrhaging. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, blood or contaminated surfaces; the virus is not airborne. Hawaii’s risk is considered very low; there are no Hawaii cases and no direct flights from Hawaii to affected regions. Scientists believe natural reservoirs are fruit bats in Central Africa. Travelers are advised to consult healthcare providers before international trips and monitor CDC travel notices. DOH also monitors Andes hantavirus linked to the cruise ship MV Hondius; no Hawaii residents aboard. Ongoing coordination with CDC/WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ハワイがWHOエボラ緊急事態の中でブンディブギョウイルスを追跡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した高リスク感染症の拡大状況である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ株）の流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれる（ウガンダは対象外）。WHOは2026年5月16日に国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、致死率30～50%、ワクチンなしという深刻度が高い。ハワイの直接的リスクは低いと記載されているが、グローバルな脅威と国際的な公衆衛生上の関心の高さから PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola News aktuell: US-Patient in der Nacht in Berliner Charité angekommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola News Update: U.S. patient arrived at Berlin's Charité overnight.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected American arrived in Berlin's Charité overnight and has been admitted to a dedicated isolation ward at the university hospital. The case comes amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda due to the outbreak. The strain involved is the Bundibugyo variant, a rare form for which there is no vaccine. Authorities warn of a substantial risk the virus could spread further across the region. The article does not provide case counts, deaths, or detailed transmission/exposure information. Ongoing updates on Ebola are being reported in the source blog.

triage.headline_ja: エボラニュース速報：米国人患者が夜中にベルリンのシャリテ病院に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、WHOが国際保健上の懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言している。DRC・ウガンダでの流行の中で感染者がドイツに搬送されたケースは、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限の懸念を示す。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカでのエボラ流行（特にDRCとウガンダ）の最中に、感染者がドイツのベルリンに搬送されたケースを報告している。Bundibugyo株はワクチンがない稀なタイプであり、地域でのさらなる拡大リスクが指摘されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ドイツは対象国でないため、DRCのみを検証済み所在地として登録。

article.articleHeadline: Come si è diffusa l'epidemia di ebola - Patient Ligodi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the Ebola epidemic spread - Patient Ligodi
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain is unfolding in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and adjacent Uganda. In Mongwalu, DRC, four of the initial 13 confirmed cases were healthcare workers who died within four days at Mongwalu Hospital. WHO cites critical gaps in infection prevention and control: scarce medicines, rare isolation of patients, inadequate personal protective equipment, and a disproportionately low number of epidimiologists relative to cases. As of May 19, 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 500 cases (33 laboratory-confirmed) and 131 deaths. A WHO emergency committee meeting on the same day recommended prioritizing vaccines for clinical testing, since none are approved for this variant. Cepi analysis will guide vaccine candidate selection, and AI may assist; existing drugs effective against the Zaire variant could inform development. Ebola viruses are believed to transmit from fruit bats and spread via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects, causing hemorrhagic fever with at least 30% fatality.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の拡大方法 - Patient Ligodi
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当。500症例超、131死亡、ウガンダへの越境拡大、ワクチン未承認株など多くの懸念要因あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「隣接するウガンダ」と記述されており、実際の確定症例がウガンダで発生しているか不明確。主たる発生地はDRC（Mongwalu）。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株の未承認ワクチン、IPC体制の不備、医療従事者含む高死亡率など、極めて懸念度の高い事象。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Concerned Over 'Scale And Speed' Of Ebola Outbreak As Congo Reports 134 Dead
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has 134 suspected deaths and over 500 suspected cases, with 30 confirmed infections. Confirmed cases span Bunia (Ituri province), Goma (North Kivu), and Mongbwalu, Nyakunde, Butembo. The virus spread undetected for weeks as testing targeted a different strain; Bundibugyo has no approved medicines or vaccines. WHO Director-General Tedros warns of the scale and speed, including urban transmission and healthcare worker deaths. Two Ugandan confirmed cases, including a Kampala death, are linked to travel from Congo. The outbreak has been declared a public health emergency of international concern, with resources rushed to two affected provinces near Uganda. Experimental vaccines from the US and UK are expected but will take time; Ervebo could be considered but would require about two months. UNICEF delivered 16 tons of relief to three Ituri centers; first death on April 24 with samples sent to Kinshasa on April 26. An American patient tested positive and moved to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ感染症の「規模と速度」に懸念を表明 コンゴが134人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱が東部コンゴで急速に拡大し、500例以上の疑い例と134人の死亡、確定例30例が報告されており、国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言されている。ウガンダへの越境事例2例を含む国際的拡大リスクが実証済みである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでの発生を主軸としている。ウガンダは確定例2例（うち1例はカンパラで死亡）が報告されているが、記事の重点はコンゴでの爆発的な流行にあり、ウガンダ地域はコンゴからの越境事例の報告地点として言及されている。イタリ州、北キブ州など複数の地域での拡大、医療従事者の感染、都市感染（ゴマ）の報告、承認医療品の欠如、PHEICの正式宣言により、高度な懸念が正当化される。米国とドイツで事例報告あるが、これらは二次的な国際的影響である。

article.articleHeadline: La préfecture et l'ARS précisent les mesures de précaution prévues en cas d'importation du virus Ebola à Mayotte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The prefecture and the ARS specify the precautionary measures planned in case of importation of the Ebola virus to Mayotte.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, Mayotte's prefecture and the Regional Health Agency (ARS) outlined precautionary measures for a potential Ebola importation from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). A strengthened surveillance system will identify contacts, with awareness and training for health professionals and partner staff. The Mayotte Hospital Center (CHM) has capacity to hospitalize potentially infected patients in secure conditions; arrangements include dedicated transport and isolated care for other patients, organized sample collection and shipment to a reference center in mainland France, provision of personal protective equipment for caregivers, and specialized management of hospital waste. ARS has national and regional support and can request reinforcements and infectious-disease expertise. Authorities emphasize a very low importation risk, noting a seven-day average incubation, though Congolese entrants may arrive after two to three months, amid reinforced border and migrant-site presence at Tsoundzou.

triage.headline_ja: マイヨット県知事とARS（地域保健庁）がエボラウイルス輸入時の予防措置を明確化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは重大な脅威だが、本記事はDRCでの発生報告ではなく、マイヨット（フランス領）での輸入リスク対策の準備状況に関する報道。実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクではなく、仮定的なシナリオの対策強化の発表であるため、現時点ではWATCHレベルの監視継続が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を前提としているが、DRCでの実際のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、マイヨット（フランス領土、対象国リスト外）での輸入防止対策の準備についての報道。対象国リスト内での実際の発生報告がないため verified_locations は空。DRC（203312）がリスト対象国に含まれているが、本記事はDRCでのイベント報道ではなくマイヨットでの準備状況の報道であるため除外。DRCでの実際のアウトブレイク情報が別途確認された場合、判定を上げる必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wirus Ebola blisko Polski? Czeskie służby w stanie gotowości
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Ebola virus close to Poland? Czech authorities on standby.
article.articleSummary: On 20 May 2026, an American physician who may have been exposed to Ebola in Uganda will be transported to Prague’s Bulovka Hospital in an isolated transport cabin for a three-week observation. The patient is asymptomatic and will remain under strict infection-control measures; Czech Health Minister Adam Vojtěch says he poses no risk to others. The facility specializes in high-risk infectious diseases, equipped with isolation rooms and negative-pressure wards. Six high-risk contacts are expected to be admitted to European hospitals, including the American doctor in Prague. Ebola has been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with at least 131 deaths among 35 confirmed and 543 suspected cases. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern after two Uganda cases. There is no vaccine or approved treatment; transmission occurs via contact with blood, secretions, or excreta. This is the seventeenth Ebola epidemic in DR Congo since 1976, with the 2018–20 outbreak the deadliest in eastern DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスはポーランドに近い？チェコの当局が待機状態にある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、DRC/ウガンダでの流行は異常で国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航制限につながる。EU内での患者搬送・観察開始により国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: BluedotのAPIが返した発生地域にはプラハ・チェコ・米国・ウガンダなど複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は（1）DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行確認、（2）ウガンダでの曝露者である米国医師のプラハ搬送・観察、である。実際の感染症イベント発生地は DRC とウガンダだが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。プラハでの患者搬送は流行地域での発生ではなく対応・監視活動。WHO が PHEIC 宣言済み、死亡者131名以上、WHO監視中。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Česko přijme Američana s podezřením na ebolu. Byli jsme o to požádáni, říká Vojtěch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Czechia will admit an American with suspected Ebola. We were asked to do so, says Vojtěch.
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026 — An American physician who worked in Uganda and had contact with an Ebola patient is being admitted to Czechia for observation. The asymptomatic patient will be transported to Bulovka University Hospital in Prague in a specialized isolation box and kept under strict infection-control procedures for about three weeks. Bulovka is equipped with negative-pressure rooms, a biobox for safe transport, and a trained team for high-risk infections. Authorities say the public is not at risk. The transfer follows a U.S. request; Germany is expected to take care of the patient as he travels there per the U.S. CDC. Six additional high-risk contacts are being prepared to travel to Europe; one such person is reportedly moving to the Czech Republic. The Ebola outbreak is in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with activity since April; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine or proven treatment; Uganda has confirmed two cases. Spread risk in Central and Eastern Africa is high.

triage.headline_ja: チェコがエボラの疑い症例を持つアメリカ人を受け入れ。要請があったと述べられている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な移送に関する記事であり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」と「異常性」に該当。DRCでの公式なPHEIC宣言を伴う活発な流行背景があり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはチェコ、ドイツ、ウガンダ、DRCが含まれているが、サマリーから実際のエボラ流行発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州）とウガンダのみ。チェコとドイツは患者受け入れ国であり感染症の発生国ではない。DRCのエボラ流行は既にWHOからPHEIC宣言されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。本件は複数国を巻き込む国際的な感染症移送イベントとしてシグナルピックアップ対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola, hantavirus y norovirus: las enfermedades que vuelven a preocupar al mundo en 2026 - HSB NOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, hantavirus, and norovirus: the diseases that are once again worrying the world in 2026 - HSB News
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Ebola, hantavirus, and norovirus are generating concern due to rising cases, deaths, and outbreaks across continents. Ebola outbreaks are centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths, including urban transmission; a rare Ebola variant complicates containment and treatment. Hantavirus outbreaks are linked to cruise exposures in southern Argentina and Chile, with Argentine scientists seeking to identify the origin and the implicated rodent species; transmission is mainly via inhalation of rodent urine, saliva, feces, or nests, though some South American variants show limited human-to-human transmission. Norovirus outbreaks are reported on Caribbean cruises and other tourist sites, causing rapid gastrointestinal illness among hundreds of travelers and crew in closed settings. Climate factors and surveillance challenges contribute to spread; authorities say it is not a COVID-19-level crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルス、ノロウイルス：2026年に世界を再び懸念させる疾患 - HSBニュース
triage.triage_reason: 複数の疾患（エボラ、ハンタウイルス、ノロウイルス）が複数大陸で同時発生。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡者、多数症例）と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度、流行しやすさが該当。対象国DRCでエボラが確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてウガンダ、アルゼンチン、チリが挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。記事サマリーではエボラはDRCとウガンダ、ハンタウイルスはアルゼンチン南部とチリ、ノロウイルスはカリブ海クルーズで報告されている。複数疾患の同時多発と国際的な懸念が高く、IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。ただし対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Czechy. Pacjent z podejrzeniem wirusa Ebola. Trafi do szpitala w Pradze
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Czech Republic. A patient with suspected Ebola virus infection will be admitted to a hospital in Prague.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, the Czech Republic is preparing to admit an American physician with suspected Ebola virus disease to Prague's Bulovka University Hospital. The man, who had contact with the virus in Uganda, is currently asymptomatic. He will be transported in a dedicated isolation ambulance to Bulovka, and placed under a three-week observation period in a facility equipped with isolation wards and a room with negative pressure. Bulovka is among Czech centers specialized in highly dangerous infectious diseases. Public health authorities had previously reported that six high-risk individuals were set to be admitted to European hospitals, including Prague. The Ebola outbreak has been reported in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with transmission thought to have started in April. No laboratory confirmation is mentioned in the piece; the Czech case is described as suspected and imported from Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: チェコ共和国。エボラウイルス感染が疑われた患者がプラハの病院に入院予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の輸入症例、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの危険性を持つ一類感染症であり、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: プラハ（チェコ）での患者受け入れ準備が報道されているが、実際の発生地はDRCの北東部であり、チェコは輸入症例の受け入れ地点。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。当該患者はウガンダでの曝露から無症状で、3週間の観察予定であるため、現時点では長期曝露リスク(prolonged_exposure)は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads fast as WHO sounds global alarm | The Citizen
article.articleSummary: Ebola spreads rapidly from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to Uganda, with South Sudan at risk, as of May 20, 2026. More than 130 deaths have occurred in the DRC, prompting the WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). The outbreak highlights the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no vaccine or therapeutic, unlike the Zaire strain that has vaccines. Bundibugyo outbreaks have mortality rates of 30–50% (Uganda 2007; DRC 2012). The DRC’s 2018–2020 outbreak was the deadliest, with about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths. WHO officials in the DRC warn the crisis is unlikely to end within two months, while vaccine candidates are under exploration and may take months to materialize. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed concerns over the outbreak’s speed and scale amid broader global challenges.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が世界的警報を発出する中、エボラが急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WHOが PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。複数国への拡大と高い死亡率を伴う Bundibugyo 株の流行で、国際的支援が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントの主な発生地は DRC（130名以上の死亡、複数州での流行）で、ウガンダへの拡大と南スーダンのリスク言及がある。ただし検証済み対象国リストに Uganda（226074）と Sudan（366755）がないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。WHO による PHEIC 宣言済み、ワクチン・治療薬が限定的（Bundibugyo 株）で管理性が低く、国際的支援要否が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient wird in Deutschland behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola patient is being treated in Germany
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, an Ebola-infected American is being treated at Berlin's Charité – Universitätsmedizin. The patient was admitted to the hospital's special isolation ward, the Federal Ministry of Health confirmed. He contracted the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the outbreak is described as spreading strongly. The case represents an imported infection, with Germany providing isolation and treatment facilities based on the patient’s travel history from an active Ebola area. The report highlights the ongoing Ebola transmission risk in the DRC and the international public health response. The article does not provide details on symptoms, exposure date, or clinical outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がドイツで治療中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準に該当し、高リスク病原体（エボラ）の国際的事例である。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRCで発生中のエボラ流行であり、ドイツの事例は輸入感染（DRCからの発症者）である。対象国リストに基づき、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ドイツは対象国ではないため除外。エボラは高リスク病原体であり、IHR基準全4項目に該当するため即座にPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Pierwszy przypadek zakażenia wirusem Ebola u sąsiada Polski. Ministerstwo wydało oświadczenie - Dziennik.pl
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of Ebola virus infection in Poland's neighbor. The Ministry issued a statement - Dziennik.pl.
article.articleSummary: An American physician who had contact with Ebola virus in Uganda is currently asymptomatic and will be transported to Prague’s Bulovka University Hospital in a dedicated isolation cab, under clearly defined safety and outbreak-control measures, for a three-week observation. Bulovka is a facility specialized in treating highly dangerous infectious diseases, equipped with isolated wards and a negative-pressure room. World agencies had previously noted six people in the risk group to be admitted to European hospitals, including one to Prague. Reports of Ebola in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo appeared on Friday, with transmission likely ongoing since April. The World Health Organization classified the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern after two cases were confirmed in Uganda. There is no vaccine or effective treatment for the circulating variant.

triage.headline_ja: ポーランドの隣国で初のエボラウイルス感染確認。ウガンダの医師がプラハの病院に搬送、チェコ保健省が声明発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の3項目に該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大（DRC→ウガンダ→チェコへの患者搬送）が確認され、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: チェコ（プラハ）への患者搬送は報告されているが、チェコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないが、DRCが対象国として含まれており、DRCでの発生が主要なイベント。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言済み。患者が無症状だが、有効な治療法やワクチンが存在しない危険な変異株である点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: ألمانيا تستقبل مريضا أمريكيا مصابا بإيبولا للعلاج في وحدة عزل خاصة ببرلين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany welcomes an American patient infected with Ebola for treatment in a private isolation unit in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen with Ebola virus disease has been admitted to a private, sealed isolation unit at Charité hospital in Berlin for treatment. The patient contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak is spreading rapidly, and was transported to Germany from Uganda aboard a dedicated medical aircraft, accompanied by a large police and emergency-vehicle escort. The isolation unit is detached from standard hospital operations to prevent contact with other patients. Ebola is highly contagious and life-threatening, transmitted through close physical contact and body fluids. Germany’s Health Ministry emphasized the commitment to provide the best possible care while maintaining strict safety and infection-control measures, following a request from the United States due to the short travel time. Overnight arrival occurred just before 3 a.m. local time. The report highlights coordinated international assistance and stringent containment protocols.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツがエボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人患者をベルリンの専用隔離室で治療するために受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高い致死率・感染力）の国際的な症例移送であり、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当、国際的支援と社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ感染者がコンゴ民主共和国で感染・感染拡大が進行中と明記されている。ベルリン（ドイツ）およびウガンダは患者の移送経路・治療地点だが、主たる発生地は対象国リストのDRCのみ。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。エボラは高い致死率・感染力を有する公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、国際的支援体制が発動されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: de Mongbwalu à Bunia, comment la riposte s'organise face au virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: from Mongbwalu to Bunia, how the outbreak response is organized in the face of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo centers on Mongbwalu in Ituri, with spread seemingly reaching Bunia and North Kivu. In Mongbwalu, the general hospital is stretched; authorities report more than twenty people in isolation as a treatment center awaits construction on ground cleared by a mining company. MSF is deploying triage and isolation materials; WFP has arrived, but logistics remain hampered by Mongbwalu’s non-operational airstrip. Communities improvise with handwashing points in markets, schools, and shops, while civil society urges urgent national government action. In Bunia, the province has received over 16 tonnes of kits and medicines; radios broadcast hygiene messages and schools enforce masks, handwashing, and temperature checks, though price surges for masks and disinfectants threaten the vulnerable and displacement sites. In Goma, capital of North Kivu and under AFC-M23 control, authorities report a first Ebola case as pharmacists face stockouts of protective items.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：モングバワルからブニアまで、ウイルスに対する対応がどのように組織されているか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数地域での拡大（イトゥリ州モングバワル、ブニア、北キブ州ゴマ）が報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する極度に高いリスク。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。複数州での同時発生、医療体制の逼迫、国際支援（MSF、WFP）の展開が報告されている。ゴマはM23勢力下にあり、流動的な政治状況と脆弱な医療インフラが懸念される。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola w Europie? Pacjent z podejrzeniem zakażenia wirusem trafi do kliniki w Czechach
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Europe? A patient with a suspected viral infection will be taken to a clinic in the Czech Republic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease suspected in the Czech Republic: an American physician who had contact with the virus in Uganda arrives to Prague's Bulovka University Hospital in an isolated transport cabin, with the patient reportedly asymptomatic. He is to remain under observation for three weeks. Bulovka specializes in highly dangerous infectious diseases and is equipped with isolated rooms and a negative-pressure ward. World Health Organization (WHO) had noted six high-risk individuals expected to be admitted to European hospitals, including one to Prague. The Ebola outbreak is centered in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Uganda confirming two cases; WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. A currently circulating Ebola variant has no vaccine and no proven treatments. The infection source is exposure in Uganda; potential importation to Europe via this patient.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパでエボラ？ウガンダでウイルスに接触した患者がチェコの診療所に搬送される予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的輸入リスクと高い重症度から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: チェコ共和国での患者報告は疑い患者であり、DRCとウガンダの確認された発生が主要な感染源。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。チェコはEU圏であり国際的な監視対象となっているが、本トリアージではアフリカにおける確認発生地のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Positif Hantavirus Belum Ditemukan di Jateng - Suara Merdeka Banyumas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Positive Hantavirus Cases Found in Central Java - Suara Merdeka Banyumas
article.articleSummary: Central Java health authorities report no positive Hantavirus cases from January–May 2026 in Jawa Tengah. Hantavirus, a rodent-borne zoonosis affecting the kidneys and respiratory system, is treated as a reemerging disease; the last case was in 2023, with no new reports since. Transmission occurs via contact with rodent saliva, urine, or feces, or inhaling dried droppings; ports and other high-rodent areas warrant vigilant monitoring. A prior outbreak occurred in the Demak port area in 2023. Diagnosis relies on PCR and serology at referral hospitals. Eight provincial hospitals are prepared to manage suspected cases; three main referral hospitals are RS Dr Adhyatma MPH, RS Prof Dr Margono, and RS Dr Moewardi. There is currently no vaccine; early recognition and treatment improve outcomes. Public guidance emphasizes hygiene, rodent-proofing homes, handwashing, PPE in rodent-dense areas, and seeking care for fever, abdominal pain, red eyes, or bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワではハンタウイルス陽性例が未発見 - スアラメルデカ バニュマス
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャワ）でハンタウイルス関連の活動報告があるが、記事は「陽性例なし」という否定的内容であり、現在のアウトブレイクではなく監視体制の構築について述べている。ただし、ハンタウイルスは再興感染症として認識されており、2023年に過去の発生があり、継続的な監視が必要な状況のため、経過観察が適切である。
triage.notes: 記事は現在の陽性例がないことを強調しているが、ハンタウイルスが地域で既知の脅威として認識されていること、2023年に港湾地域での発生歴があること、複数の指定病院での対応体制が整備されていることから、今後の発生に備えた準備状況の報告と解釈される。現時点ではアウトブレイク段階にはないため、フルRRAの対象にはしないが、ハンタウイルスの再興リスクがある地域での監視態勢報告として経過観察すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 美, 에볼라 입국제한 속 '월드컵 참가' 민주콩고 대표팀엔 예외 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US allows an exception for the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team to participate in the World Cup amid Ebola entry restrictions.
article.articleSummary: US authorities are applying Ebola entry restrictions that limit foreign nationals from certain African countries, but an exception appears possible for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) national football team, which qualified for the World Cup for the first time since 1974. The DRC team plans to base camp in Houston, Texas, next month and will play their group-stage match against Portugal, with travel between the United States and Mexico on the schedule. An official noted that most players have trained in Europe and are likely outside the entry-restriction targets. Still, individuals with a 21-day residence in the DRC in the prior 21 days would face the same quarantine and testing procedures as U.S. citizens and permanent residents. General spectators traveling to the United States to support the team would also be subject to existing entry restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ入国制限下で『ワールドカップ参加』民主コンゴ代表チームに例外認める
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはエボラの既存の入国制限政策下での例外措置に関する行政ニュースであり、新たな感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。検証可能な疾患確認事例がなく、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威を示す情報に欠ける。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は既存のエボラ入国制限の政策例外に関するもので、新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に記載したが、シグナルとしてはピックアップ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikanac zaražen ebolom prebačen na liječenje u Berlin - Novi list
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American infected with Ebola transferred to Berlin for treatment - Novi List
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola was transferred to Berlin's Charité University Hospital for treatment. The infection originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola is spreading, and the patient was moved into a dedicated isolation unit that is separate from routine care. German Health Minister Nina Warken said assisting partner countries is a natural obligation and stressed Germany's effective care system and strict safety measures for highly infectious diseases. The patient was transported from Uganda to Berlin by a specialized aircraft for highly infectious patients, arriving just before 3:00 a.m. local time and then conveyed by a specially equipped ambulance with police escort and fire department support. The Charité isolation facility is closed and protected from regular hospital activity to prevent contact with other patients. Ebola is highly contagious and transmitted through direct contact and body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染したアメリカ人がベルリンで治療を受けるため移送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性）。エボラウイルス疾患の国際的移送事例であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベント発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、患者の感染源がDRCと明記されている。ウガンダは経由地、ドイツ（ベルリン）は治療地であり、エボラの流行地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。対象国リストのDRC（203312）のみが該当。エボラウイルス疾患の高度な伝染性と国際的な患者移送という要素が判定に影響。

article.articleHeadline: "Amplitud y rapidez" de la epidemia de ébola en Congo preocupa a OMS | El Nuevo Siglo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Breadth and speed" of the Ebola epidemic in Congo concerns the WHO | El Nuevo Siglo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) with 30 laboratory-confirmed cases; two additional confirmed cases in Kampala, Uganda, imported from DRC, and a U.S. citizen evacuated to Germany. The WHO Director-General warned of urban transmission risk in Goma and Kampala as the outbreak expands; health worker deaths signal possible nosocomial transmission. Large-scale displacement in Ituri (>100,000 people) amid insecurity since late 2025 complicates containment. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain lacks a vaccine; authorities emphasize risk communication and community engagement in lieu of vaccination. Uganda postponed Day of the Martyrs celebrations due to outbreak risk. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) on Sunday without an Emergency Committee meeting, planning a future Emergency Committee to issue temporary recommendations. About $3.4 million was released, bringing total funding to $3.9 million for outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行の「広がりと速さ」がWHOを懸念させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ、ドイツ経由米国市民）、都市伝播リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性があり、WHO PHEIC宣言されている。スクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチン非対応。都市伝播リスク（Goma、Kampala）と院内感染の懸念。大規模な人口移動（10万人以上の避難）が封じ込めを複雑化させている。米国市民がドイツに退避しているため国際関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Podejrzany o zakażenie Ebolą transportowany do Czech. Służby w pełnej gotowości
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case transported to the Czech Republic. Emergency services on full alert.
article.articleSummary: A United States citizen, a physician who worked in Uganda and had contact with an Ebola patient, is being transported to Prague in a specialized isolation capsule after a suspected Ebola exposure. He remains asymptomatic and will be observed for about three weeks at University Hospital Bulovka with strict infection-control measures. Czech Health Ministry and US CDC confirmed the case; emergency services, including a bioterror/biological threat unit, are on alert for transport of highly contagious patients. The move follows US criticism of evacuating high-risk individuals to Europe; seven people in total were evacuated to Germany and the Czech Republic. The African outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. In Kinshasa, 131 deaths and 513 people with dangerous symptoms are reported; case fatality is estimated at 30–50%, historically up to 90% in some outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染疑い患者がチェコに搬送。緊急サービスが最大限の警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、アフリカでのエボラ流行の国際的広がりを示唆するシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国市民のチェコ搬送だが、実際のエボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）が中心。WHO PHEICが既に宣言されており、Bundibugyo Ebola virus感染例の国際的輸送事例。チェコ・ドイツへの患者疎開は対象国外のため verified_locations は DRC のみ。ただし国際的関心と WHO 認識に基づきシグナル指定。

article.articleHeadline: Ratusan Warga Pesisir Batang Ikuti Cek Kesehatan Gratis dan Screening TBC Mobile X-Ray
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of residents along the Batang coast participate in free health checks and mobile X-ray TB screening.
article.articleSummary: TB screening and free health checks were conducted for Batang coastal residents in Karanggeneng, Ujungnegoro, and Ponowareng villages at Ponowareng Village Hall. Spanning three days (Monday–Wednesday, May 16–18, 2026), the Batang Health Office collaborated with Bhimasena Power Indonesia (BPI) to offer Cek Kesehatan Gratis (blood pressure, glucose, weight, mental health) and Mobile X-ray TB screening for those with cough or suspected TB. From Karanggeneng and Ujungnegoro, no TB cases were detected; Ponowareng results were not specified. The initiative underscores ongoing TB elimination efforts in Central Java with a target of zero TB by 2030, while TB remains a health challenge in Batang. While screening identified hypertension and diabetes risks warranting further evaluation, the program notably engaged many elderly residents to promote early disease detection and accessible care.

triage.headline_ja: バタン沿岸地域の数百人の住民が無料健康診断と移動型X線結核スクリーニングに参加
triage.triage_reason: 結核スクリーニングプログラムは公衆衛生の肯定的な取り組みであり、異常な流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーンの報告であり、新規アウトブレイク、異常な症例増加、または感染症危機の兆候を示していない。カランゲネン村とウジュンネゴロ村では結核症例が検出されず、ポノワレン村の結果は不明だが、これは検査プログラムの成功を示唆している。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: На карантин из-за вспышки Эболы в Уганде поместили более 100 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 100 people quarantined due to an Ebola outbreak in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts Uganda to quarantine more than 100 people to curb spread. The epicenter is eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, bordering Uganda. Initial signals emerged May 5, and officials say the virus may have circulated locally for weeks before detection. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Congo has reported over 500 suspected Ebola cases and at least 131 deaths; Uganda has recorded one infection and one death, both among Congolese nationals who recently arrived in the country. Authorities isolate contacts and conduct regular symptom checks; Ugandan responses are supported by prior outbreak experience. Cross-border coordination continues, with measures to maintain control while the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行により100人以上が隔離対象に
