triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確認エボラ流行であり、国際的な懸念と対応が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はPHEIC宣言対象疾患。DRCのイトゥリ州が震源で、ウガンダに越境感染確認。500例以上の疑い患者、131例以上の死亡報告。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、国際的な監視・対応体制が既に構築されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: La alerta por ébola pone a prueba la preparación sanitaria de México para el Mundial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola alert tests Mexico's health preparedness ahead of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a serious concern but not a pandemic risk. The Central Africa outbreak has over 500 suspected cases and about 130 deaths; no proven treatment or vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo variant. With the World Cup across 16 cities in Mexico, the United States, and Canada, and a June 23 RDC match in Guadalajara (Group K with Portugal, Colombia and Uzbekistan) at Estadio Akron, Mexican authorities are boosting surveillance. Up to 2.5 million visitors are expected; 100 health-officials will operate at airports/entry points, and about 420 more around Stadium/Fan Fest. Focus on isolation, personal protective equipment, rapid lab testing, and close coordination with FIFA. Some call for a Mexico–US–Canada regional protocol; authorities warn against panic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報がメキシコのワールドカップに向けた保健対応準備を試す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生（500以上の疑い例、約130死亡）とワールドカップ開催国での国際的リスク、異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスクの複合判定によりシグナル該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはメキシコ・米国・カナダなど複数国が含まれているが、実際のエボラ発生は記事サマリーに明記される通りコンゴ民主共和国のみ。メキシコ・米国・カナダはワールドカップ開催国として言及されているが、エボラ感染の実発生国ではないため除外。対象国リスト外のメキシコは verified_locations に含めない。この事象は国際的なメガイベント（ワールドカップ）を背景とした国際的懸念であり、IHR基準4つ全て該当するためPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Infizierter Ebola-Arzt mit Polizei-Eskorte in Berliner Charité angekommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected doctor with police escort arrives at Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-virus–infected American is being treated in Berlin at Charité, escorted by police. The patient was admitted to the university hospital’s dedicated isolation unit after contracting the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak is spreading rapidly. Germany’s Federal Ministry of Health said the patient will receive care in a highly secure setting, reflecting the country’s robust network for treating highly infectious diseases. The United States had requested assistance, and officials thanked the transport and medical staff involved in Charité. Health Minister Nina Warken stressed that Germany will provide the best possible care while maintaining the highest safety precautions. The case underscores international cooperation in responding to Ebola infections and positions Germany as a destination for overseas patients requiring specialized treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症のアメリカ人医師が警察護衛でベルリンのシャリテ病院に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。既知のエボラ流行地（DRC）からの患者国際転送であり、先進国での感染例報告は国際的関心を喚起する重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーより、患者がDRCでエボラウイルスに感染し、ベルリンのシャリテ病院に転送されたことが明記されている。発生地域フィールドに含まれるベルリン・ドイツ・米国は患者の治療地・患者国籍であり、ウイルス発生地ではない。DRCが実際のエボラ流行地である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 3 ülke için 30 gün kısıtlama başladı: Yeni salgın alarmı ciddileşti - Sözcü Gazetesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30-day restrictions started for three countries: The new outbreak alert has intensified - Sözcü Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts Bahrain to suspend entry for non-Bahraini travelers from South Sudan, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Uganda for 30 days, including foreigners who have visited these countries in the past month. Bahraini citizens are exempt but will face stringent health screenings at border crossings. The move follows WHO raising its alert level and the agency declaring an international public health emergency over Ebola, with renewed transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. African CDC reports hundreds of Ebola cases in the DRC and dozens of deaths. First identified in 1976, Ebola is characterized by high transmissibility and mortality; experts say travel restrictions can be critical in outbreak control. The measure targets international travel and aims to prevent cross-border spread while the outbreak persists in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 3カ国に対する30日間の制限が開始：新たな流行警報が深刻化 - Sözcü新聞
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（数百件の症例・数十名の死亡報告）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での確認・国際保健上の緊急事態宣言）、渡航制限実施の4基準すべて該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も5基準全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な緊急事態として、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: バーレーンは記事中で措置実施国として言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCとウガンダ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないが、記事の主題であり感染症イベント発生地として重要なため記録。WHO緊急事態宣言レベルの情報により社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA OPASNA I ZA CEO SVET: SZO upozorava da epidemija vrlo zaraznog virusa predstavlja rizik i za države van Afrike
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Dangerous Even for the Whole World: WHO Warns That the Outbreak of a Highly Contagious Virus Poses a Risk Even to Countries Outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has raised global concern as more than 100 deaths are reported and the epidemic has spilled beyond DRC borders. The Bundibugyo strain has no available treatment, and its full geographic spread remains unknown. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated deep concern over the scale and speed of the outbreak. An emergency committee will be convened to advise on temporary recommendations. French Le Monde cites warnings from a virologist with the French National Institute for Biomedical Research that the outbreak could expand quickly into the region due to high population movement and the need to trace contacts in a relatively isolated region. Although risk to the United States and Europe is currently low, authorities are implementing enhanced screening for air travelers from affected areas, particularly at airports in Belgium and France.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは世界全体にとって危険：WHOが、高い感染性を持つウイルスの流行がアフリカ外の国にも危険をもたらすことを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国間流行で、死亡数100以上、国境越えの拡大が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUSA、Belgium、Franceが記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であり、他国は「スクリーニング強化」「低リスク」の文脈のみ。DRCのみが対象国リスト内。Bundibugyo株は治療法がなく、高い感染性と急速な拡大リスクが指摘されている。WHO事務局長が深刻な懸念を表明し、緊急委員会召集が予定されている。

article.articleHeadline: 世衞組織總幹事對本輪埃博拉疫情表示擔憂 - 香港文匯網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General expresses concern over this round of the Ebola outbreak - Hong Kong Wen Wei Po
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed concern over this round of Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) after WHO designated it an International Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BEBOV), for which there is no targeted vaccine or specific antiviral therapy currently available. The index case has yet to be identified, and the scope of infections and transmission remains highly uncertain. WHO and partners are evaluating available vaccines and treatments, though vaccine access could take about two months. A WHO-led expert group is convening this week to assess whether existing vaccines may offer partial protection against BEBOV. The DRC representative notes ongoing international focus on potential vaccine or treatment options and further research.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、今次エボラアウトブレイクについて懸念を表明 - 香港文匯網
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（重症度の高い疾患、国際公衆衛生上の懸念事項、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。PHEIC指定済み。ワクチン・治療法の欠如と不確実性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病(BEBOV株)、PHEIC指定済み。ワクチンおよび特異的抗ウイルス療法が利用不可。感染スコープと伝播が高度に不確実。WHO事務局長の懸念表明およびWHO専門家グループの召集は国際的な関心の高さを示唆。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Grosser Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo - 13 Antworten zum "Killer-Virus"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Major Ebola outbreak in the Congo - 13 answers to the 'Killer Virus'.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency over a major Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo variant. In Ituri province eight laboratory-confirmed and about 246 suspected cases have been reported; one case has been detected in Kinshasa, and two infected people have traveled from the Congo to Uganda. WHO notes an escalating trend of suspected cases and deaths in Ituri, suggesting the outbreak may be larger than currently reported; Africa CDC lists 336 suspected cases and 88 deaths in the DRC. Bundibugyo is rarer than the Zaire variant and has a case-fatality around 30–50%. Incubation is 8–10 days; initial symptoms include fever, headache, sore throat, muscle and joint pains, followed by nausea, diarrhea, vomiting; bleeding in some; fatal multiorgan failure typically 6–16 days after onset. Bats are reservoirs; control relies on rapid isolation, PPE, fluids, and careful burial practices; urbanization complicates containment. Marcel Tanner provides expert context.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの大規模エボラ出血熱の流行 - 「殺人ウイルス」に関する13の回答
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み、Bundibugyo型エボラによる確認・疑い患者および死亡報告あり。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州、Kinshasa市）とウガンダに言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に記載。Bundibugyo型エボラの確認患者8名、疑い患者246名（Ituri）および88死亡報告、Kinshasa1名確認、ウガンダへの越境2名。WHO による公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。国際的拡大リスク（越境感染）および高い致死率（30-50%）が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情蔓延 卢比欧：世卫确认工作慢半拍 | 班迪布焦 | Bundibugyo | 疫苗 | 大纪元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa spreads; Rubio: WHO confirms the response is half a beat behind | Bundibugyo | Bundibugyo | Vaccine | The Epoch Times.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo virus strain has spread to Uganda, prompting renewed international alert. The WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. As of May 19, at least 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths have been reported, up from about 200 cases and 65 deaths on May 15, with initial under-detection blamed on testing and diagnostic delays. The Ituri Province in the DRC remains the epicenter, and health authorities warn the virus could cross into South Sudan via porous borders. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; vaccines exist only for the Zaire Ebola virus strain, and about 55,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu were vaccinated in 2023. WHO officials express pessimism over a quick end to the outbreak, while Taiwan CDC notes no confirmed cases yet but risk of imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱疫情が蔓延、ルビオ国務長官：WHO確認対応は後手に回っている | バンディブギョ | ワクチン | 大紀元
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言したシグナル。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、複数国への国際的拡散、死亡例の増加、治療法未承認、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に発生地として言及されているのはDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州が主要感染地）とウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。台湾CDCについての言及は、輸入症例のリスク評価であり発生地ではないため除外。南スーダンへの越境リスクも提起されているが、実際の発生報告はない。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、国際的な懸念レベルは最高段階。

article.articleHeadline: ЕБОЛА ОПАСНА И ЗА ЦЕО СВЕТ: СЗО упозорава да епидемија врло заразног вируса представља ризик и за државе ван Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is dangerous even for the entire world: WHO warns that an outbreak of a highly contagious virus poses a risk to countries outside Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola poses a global risk. The Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak has killed more than 100 people and crossed borders, fueling fears of wider spread. Substantial underreporting is suspected, complicating assessments. With no approved treatment for Bundibugy o Ebola, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is deeply concerned and will convene an emergency committee for provisional guidance. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, a pioneer of Ebola research and head of Kinshasa’s National Institute for Biomedical Research, warns population movement could accelerate regional spread and stresses rigorous contact tracing. The United States has begun entry screening for travelers from affected zones; Europe’s risk remains low, though Belgium and France are focused due to inbound flights from Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは世界全体にとって危険である：WHOが警告、アフリカ以外の国にも感染症の流行がリスクをもたらす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の流行がDRC（Kinshasa）で100人以上の死者を出し、国境を超えて拡大。IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。WHO緊急委員会の招集予定など国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（特にKinshasa）での流行を主題としており、米国・ベルギー・フランスは検査強化や対策の対象国として言及されているが、実際の感染者発生地はDRCに限定。Bundibugyo株エボラの承認治療法がない点が管理能力を低下させている。未報告の疑いにより実際の影響はさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sin vacunas ni tratamiento y en zona de conflicto": los motivos por los que este brote de ébola es "muy preocupante
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "No vaccines or treatment and in a conflict zone": the reasons why this Ebola outbreak is "very worrying."
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no vaccines or approved treatments. Cases have jumped from under 100 to more than 500 in four days, with at least 130 deaths. It unfolds in a cross-border area with population movements and limited access due to conflict. MSF warns tools are limited, forcing a focus on early detection, contact tracing, and expanding diagnostic capacity. The Congolese government has opened three treatment centers to treat symptoms while therapeutics develop; breaking transmission hinges on isolating patients and safe burials. The Bundibugyo strain has a fatality rate estimated by WHO at roughly 20–50%. Ituri is endemic to Congo and Uganda; vigilance exists, but the outbreak went unrecognized for over a month. Over 100,000 people have been displaced in 2026, underscoring the need to bolster health services and secure support amid funding cuts.

triage.headline_ja: 「ワクチンも治療法もなく紛争地域」：このエボラ出血熱の流行が「非常に懸念される」理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模で急速に拡大する流行であり、致死率20～50%、4日間で100例未満から500例以上へ急増、130人以上の死亡、紛争地域での限定的な対応能力、国境を越えた人口移動によるリスクがある。
triage.notes: Ituri州はコンゴとウガンダの国境地域であるが、記事の主題はコンゴのIturi州での流行である。ウガンダは「警戒中」と述べられているが、確認された発生地はコンゴのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法不在、紛争による対応困難が重大な懸念。MSFの警告と政府の限定的な対応能力が記事で強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick Tightens Ebola Controls at Kibali Mine After Congo Outbreak - MiningFocus Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has killed at least 131 people, with a higher toll possible as tracing continues. Kibali gold mine in Haut-Uele province, one of Africa's largest, has not reported cases but has intensified prevention: enhanced health monitoring, worker screening, and mandatory travel-history declarations; temperature screening rolled out and to be fully in place by May 20. Some Kibali workers originate from Ituri, highlighting mobility-linked risk in mining regions that complicates containment. Kibali is jointly owned by Barrick Mining (45%), AngloGold Ashanti (45%), and SOKIMO (10%); production was about 673,000 ounces in 2025, with 2026 guidance of 600,000–688,000 ounces. The outbreak underscores vulnerabilities in mining supply chains and drives stronger health surveillance and emergency response in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ地域のエボラ流行を受けてバリック・ゴールドがキバリ鉱山のエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死者131名、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）。DRC における重大なエボラ流行イベントとしてフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイツリ州で発生したエボラ流行（131名死亡）とハウト・ウエレ州のキバリ鉱山での対応を主題としている。クロスボーダーリスク（ハウト・ウエレ、イツリ両地域の労働者移動）と国際的な供給鎖への影響が指摘されており、感染症制御の観点から重要なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: FIFA World Cup 2026  --  Will Ebola outbreak in Africa affect preparations of DR Congo?
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's national football team faces an Ebola outbreak in Africa that could affect FIFA World Cup 2026 preparations. Kinshasa training camp was canceled due to health restrictions, while preparations continue in Europe and Houston, with a Houston North American base planned for the team's June schedule. The opening Group K match is set for June 17 in Houston against Portugal; subsequent games are June 23 vs Colombia in Zapopan, Mexico, and June 27 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. FIFA is monitoring the outbreak and coordinating with the DR Congo Football Association, host-country governments, the CDC, DHS, Mexico's health secretariat, Canada's PHAC, and the WHO to ensure medical and security guidance. The U.S. CDC has paused entry for 30 days for travelers who recently visited Ebola outbreak sites in DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Houston's hosting plans reportedly remain unchanged, with arrival set for June 11.

triage.headline_ja: FIFA World Cup 2026 -- アフリカのエボラ流行がDR コンゴの準備に影響を与えるか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、複数国での確認、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施によりIHR基準3つ該当。加えて国際スポーツイベント（FIFA World Cup 2026）に関連する社会的・政治的関心が高く、複数国政府とWHOが対応調整中であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDR Congoにおけるエボラ流行とFIFA World Cup 2026準備への影響。Uganda、South Sudan、Mexicoでも地理的言及あるが、感染症イベントの実際の発生地はDR Congoが中心。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。CDC渡航制限、複数国政府・WHOの対応調整、国際スポーツイベントとの関連性により、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Imperial College analysis suggests Congo Ebola outbreak undercounted
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) attributed to Bundibugyo virus may be substantially larger than reported. An Imperial College London–WHO analysis of case data through May 17 found that Uganda’s detection of infections in travelers from eastern Congo’s Ituri implies under-ascertainment. The researchers estimate about 400–800 Ebola cases in Congo as of May 17, with substantial uncertainty and a possibility of over 1,000 cases. Since late April, there have been more than 540 suspected cases and dozens of deaths, concentrated in Ituri. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The analysis highlights potential undercounting and the need for intensified surveillance and laboratory confirmation; it does not provide a definitive final tally.

triage.headline_ja: WHO-Imperial College分析が示唆するコンゴのエボラ発生は過小計上されている可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが国際保健上の危機と宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、感染者が実際には報告より大幅に多い可能性が指摘されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事ではIturi州（DRC内）が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダでの旅行者からの感染検出が報告されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内の流行。発生地域にはウガンダが含まれているが、サマリー上では旅行者の検出事例として言及されており、実際の二次流行の報告がないため verified_locations にはウガンダは含めない。WHOが PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、シグナルレベルは最高度。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns Ebola outbreak could spread further in Central Africa | News.az
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa linked to the Bundibugyo strain has caused more than 130 deaths and over 500 suspected cases. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. Cases have emerged in urban areas including Kampala, Goma, and Bunia; infections among healthcare workers raise concerns about in-facility transmission. The conflict in Ituri province, where the outbreak began in early May, has displaced over 100,000 people, heightening the risk of spread. There are no approved vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo; researchers are exploring monoclonal antibody treatments as international teams work to contain the outbreak. Common Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes internal and external bleeding, per WHO and CDC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが中央アフリカでのエボラ出血熱の流行がさらに拡大する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際保健上の脅威であり、130人以上の死亡と500人以上の疑い症例、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ）、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（ゴマ、ブニア、イトゥリ州）が主体であることが明記されている。ウガンダ（カンパラ）は発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではDRCからの「症例の出現」との記述に留まり、ウガンダでの自律的な流行発生を示唆する記述がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外される。Bundibugyo株は特に危険性が高く、ワクチンも治療薬も承認されていない点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ärzte ohne Grenzen: Ebola-Infektionszahlen "dramatisch"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Ebola infection numbers "dramatic."
article.articleSummary: More than 130 deaths have been reported from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as of 20 May 2026. Maximilian Gertler of Doctors Without Borders warns that insecurity in the region complicates outbreak response. A U.S. physician infected with Ebola in the DRC is being treated at Charité in Berlin, arriving shortly after midnight and transported by a dedicated ambulance to an isolation ward. The isolation unit is fully separated from the regular hospital, with its own entrances, airlocks, ventilation, and wastewater systems. The United States has asked Germany for assistance because flight times from the Congo are short, while the virus continues to spread rapidly in the DRC. The case represents an imported/exported exposure, illustrating cross-border transmission dynamics amid ongoing outbreaks in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：エボラ感染者数は「劇的」に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症（WHOで届出対象）の多数死亡、国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダでの流行、米国医師の感染・ドイツへの搬送）、国家間の支援要請。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ流行は主としてDRC及びウガンダで報告されており、DRCは対象国リストに該当。ドイツ（ベルリン）への患者搬送は国際的拡大の証拠だが、搬送先であり発生地ではないため除外。米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WPRO基準が5/5該当し、複数国間での国際支援・超域的な流行パターンを示している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der DR Kongo: WHO warnt vor schneller Ausbreitung und fehlender Impfung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: WHO warns of rapid spread and lack of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak expands with 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases as of May 20, 2026; Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or widely available specific treatment, emphasizing containment, rapid diagnostics, robust contact tracing, and supportive care. Cases are spreading into large urban areas, notably around Goma, complicating logistics and data quality. Travel restrictions and enhanced border screenings are being implemented. Laboratory confirmation supports Bundibugyo attribution. Intervention hinges on infection prevention and outbreak management rather than vaccination, with international partners pressing for data-sharing and cross-border coordination under resource constraints. The episode underscores regional vulnerability and the need for interoperable health-data workflows to quickly inform decisions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：WHOが急速な拡大とワクチン不足を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）は131人の死亡と513例の疑似症例、大都市への拡大、国際的な渡航制限と国境強化スクリーニング実施が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のすべてを満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の大規模流行。ワクチン未承認のため、感染予防と予防接種に依らない患者管理が重要。ゴマなど大都市への拡大により、ロジスティクスと疫学サーベイランス上の課題が顕著。国際的なデータ共有と越境協調の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: В Африке зафиксирована вспышка Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak has been reported in Africa.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; the World Health Organization has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain; there is currently no vaccine or proven effective treatment. Transmission occurs through close contact with the bodily fluids of infected people or animals. Travelers should take precautions, including checking the destination's epidemiological status before travel and practicing strict personal hygiene. After returning, monitor for fever, weakness, or other symptoms and seek immediate medical care, informing clinicians of travel history; do not self-medicate. WHO emphasizes that basic prevention measures reduce infection risk during travel, and that the Bundibugyo strain presents particular challenges due to the lack of vaccines or targeted therapies.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱の流行が報告された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによる国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言されている。エボラ出血熱は極めて重大な感染症であり、DRCとウガンダでの流行は国際的な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、ワクチンなし、Bundibugyo株による流行という医学的に重要な情報が含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疑似病例升至543例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 543.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, have reached 543 suspected cases with 136 deaths among the suspected cases, and 69 patients currently hospitalised in treatment centers as of May 19. The response notes community resistance and rumors delaying reporting; authorities have shipped emergency supplies to Ituri, expanded treatment centers, and intensified case finding, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; currently no vaccine or specific therapy exists. The African CDC will provide funding to support deployment; focus on three candidate vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and accelerated development and evaluation. The World Health Organization had on May 17 declared the DRC and Uganda outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Uganda reported two laboratory-confirmed cases and one death, both with travel history to DRC, but no clear link.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似症例が543例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み、ウガンダへの二次感染確認、アフリカンCDCによる国際支援開始。フルRRA進行要件を十分に満たす。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にDRCおよびウガンダの集団発生をPHEIC宣言。ウガンダでも2例の検査確認例（1死亡）が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCのIturi州での発生であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus起因。コミュニティ抵抗により報告遅延の懸念あり。ワクチン開発・評価が加速中。

article.articleHeadline: 美醫民主剛果開刀感染伊波拉　德國收治隔離治療 | 國際 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US doctors in the Democratic Republic of the Congo perform surgery and contract Ebola; Germany takes in for isolation and treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American medical missionary, Peter Stafford of Serge, infected with Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is being treated in a specialized isolation ward at Berlin’s Charité University Hospital after traveling to Germany. He reportedly operated on a patient with occult Ebola before symptoms appeared. The outbreak in eastern DRC is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, with at least 131 deaths; WHO has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo; Ervebo (Zaire strain) shows partial protection in animal studies. The United States plans to fund up to 50 treatment clinics in DRC, Uganda, and the Republic of Congo to provide screening, triage, isolation, and infection-control perimeter measures, via CERF managed by OCHA. CDC notes diagnostics can identify this strain and overall U.S. risk remains low. Germany has prepared to admit the patient for continued care in Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴの米医師がエボラ感染、ドイツで隔離治療
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、予想外の医療従事者感染、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO PEICの公式宣言済みで優先度が高い。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株による東部DRC発生、米医療宣教師の国際移動による医療現場での感染、複数国での対応準備（米国、ドイツ、ウガンダ、コンゴ共和国）。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみ verified_locations に記載。ベルリン、米国は記事では主要な発生地ではなく，患者移送先・対応国のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 【十字路口】比新冠凶40倍 埃博拉傳播百人病亡 | 漢坦病毒 | 埃博拉病毒 | 川習會 | 新唐人电视台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crossroads: 40 Times Deadlier Than COVID-19; Ebola Spreads to Hundreds, Causing Deaths | Hantavirus | Ebola virus | Xi–Trump meeting | New Tang Dynasty Television
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, New Tang Dynasty Television reports hantavirus outbreaks occurring worldwide, while a major Ebola virus epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) has caused at least hundreds of deaths. The Ebola outbreak is described as spreading overseas, raising concerns about international containment and the potential for a new global pandemic. The Congo (Kinshasa) outbreak is highlighted as particularly challenging due to cross-border transmission. The piece notes concurrent hantavirus threats globally, but provides no laboratory confirmation details or specific symptoms. The report reflects broad public health anxieties over emerging pathogens in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 十字路口：新型コロナより40倍危険 エボラが数百人の死亡を引き起こし伝播 | ハンタウイルス | エボラウイルス | 習近平とトランプの会談 | 新唐人テレビ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：数百人の死亡、異常性：グローバルパンデミックの懸念、国際的な拡大リスク：国境を越えた伝播）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（多数の死亡）と流行しやすさ（国際伝播）に該当。DRCでのエボラウイルス流行は重大なシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサ（DRC）でのエボラウイルスの主要流行を報告。ハンタウイルスは「世界的発生」と述べられているが、サマリーではDRC以外の具体的な国名は明記されていない。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当し、verified_locationsに含めた。記事サマリーから実験室確認情報や詳細な症状記載は不足しているが、死亡数（数百人）と国際伝播の懸念は明確である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, 에볼라 확산 '규모와 속도' 우려
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns about the scale and speed of Ebola's spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) is unfolding rapidly and potentially protracted. As of May 19, 2026, the number of suspected Ebola deaths stands at 136 with about 543 suspected cases, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, marking the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak. On May 16, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Laboratory confirmation remains limited due to inaccessibility of the affected areas, so most figures are based on suspected cases. MSF reports hospitals are at capacity as patients are being moved to facilities. The response includes tens of tons of emergency medical supplies and experts arriving, including infection-prevention kits and tents. There is no approved treatment or vaccine; Ervebo is under review and may be usable in roughly two months, with officials cautioning the outbreak will not end imminently. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged intensified international support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ感染拡大の『規模と速度』に懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべて該当。WHOが国際保健上の危機的状況（PHEIC）を宣言した重大な感染症イベントであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 2026年5月16日にWHOがPHEIC（国際保健上の危機的状況）を宣言。Ituri州での急速な感染拡大、543疑似患者・136死亡、Bundibugyo ebolavirus、医療施設の過密化、限定的な治療・ワクチン選択肢など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が存在。国際的な技術支援・物資支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Félix Tshisekedi instruit le Gouvernement à renforcer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Félix Tshisekedi instructs the government to strengthen.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo prompts President Félix Tshisekedi to order immediate reinforcement of the response in Ituri and North Kivu. In a crisis meeting in Kinshasa on 18 May, the President urged public-health experts to intensify efforts to contain Ebola, ensure rapid care for those affected, and keep the population calm while strictly following preventive measures. Meanwhile, the epidemic is advancing in parts of Ituri and North Kivu, with several suspected cases under investigation to determine links to Ebola. Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba said nearly 513 suspected cases and 131 deaths have been recorded in affected zones, while cautioning that not all deaths are necessarily Ebola and analyses are ongoing to confirm the link. Since the outbreak was officially declared on 15 May, figures were updated on 19 May in Kinshasa, with input from INRB Director Jean-Jacques Muyembe and Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ出血熱：フェリックス・チセケディ大統領が政府に対応強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響（死亡513疑い例、131死亡）、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスクの3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例が多い）、長期曝露（複数州での流行継続）、流行しやすさ（人間への影響、公衆衛生対応の困難性）の複数基準に該当し、かつ大統領が直接関与する高い政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極度の警戒が必要な疾患。2026年5月15日に正式宣言された新規アウトブレイク。イトゥリ州および北キブ州での複数地域での流行進行中。大統領による緊急危機対応会議の開催、複数の閣僚が関与し、政治的優先度が高い。国際的拡大リスクおよび追加的な国際支援が必要な状況と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情「像新冠一樣大規模擴散」？專家曝可能性 | 生活焦點 | 要聞 | NOWnews今日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak could spread as widely as COVID-19? Experts reveal the possibility.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed more than 80 people and prompted 246 suspected cases as of May 16, 2026. Uganda also reports two confirmed cases, both with travel history to the DRC. International risk of major spread remains low; current assessments indicate only regional transmission possible, not a continent-spanning outbreak. In Taiwan, risk is deemed extremely low, primarily corresponding to travel-associated importation. Ebola virus disease spreads through direct contact with infected bodily fluids, not by air. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include high fever, fatigue, muscle pains, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash with petechiae, and bleeding. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. Clinicians should report suspected cases within 24 hours and apply strict infection control. Travelers should avoid outbreak areas and monitor health after returning.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は「新型コロナウイルスのような大規模拡散」の可能性？専門家が可能性を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルス病は極度に危険な一類感染症であり、複数国への広がりと国際的な関心が存在するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのBundibugyo Ebolawirus outbreak（既に80人以上の死亡、246疑似患者）を主題としている。Ugandaでの確認例2件はDRCへの渡航歴があり、secondary case。Taiwanの記事は言語が中国語だが、内容はDRCでの流行とそのグローバルリスクについて論じており、Taiwan自体のイベント発生地ではなく、travel-associated importationのみが言及されている。対象国リストに照らし、実際に流行が発生しているのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。死亡率の高さ、無治療法、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性、国際的拡大懸念がすべて該当し、高リスクシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 美醫民主剛果開刀感染伊波拉　德國收治隔離治療 | 國際焦點 | 國際 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. doctors perform surgery in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on an Ebola-infected patient; Germany admits the patient for isolation and treatment
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, an American physician infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is being treated in Germany. Peter Stafford, a medical missionary with Serge, traveled to Berlin for isolation at Charité University Hospital after diagnosis; reports indicate he was too weak to stand before boarding. The eastern DRC outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with at least 131 deaths, and the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo, though Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) has shown partial protection in animal studies. The United States plans to fund up to 50 treatment clinics in the DRC, Uganda, and the Republic of the Congo to provide screening, triage, isolation, and infection-control measures, via CERF managed by OCHA. The CDC states current diagnostics detect this strain and U.S. risk remains low. The ongoing FIFA World Cup (June 11–July 19) prompts travel-safety coordination with FIFA.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師が民主共和国コンゴでエボラ感染、ドイツで隔離治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態国際的懸念（PHEIC）宣言済み。複数国への拡大実績と国際的支援体制の構築が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる東部DRCアウトブレイク。少なくとも131人の死亡、WHOがPHEIC宣言。米国医師の感染・国際移送、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、米国による50臨床施設支援計画、FIFAワールドカップ開催時期（6月11日〜7月19日）との重複による旅行リスク増加が懸念される。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみだが、グローバルリスク評価としては高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Singapore, Japan, South Korea boost Ebola screening after WHO alert
article.articleSummary: Singapore, Japan and South Korea are boosting Ebola screening after a WHO alert as Asia tightens border controls and quarantine preparedness to contain a growing outbreak in Central Africa. Governments across the region have expanded screening and reporting requirements for travelers arriving from affected countries, while officials say the likelihood of local transmission remains low and no cases have been publicly confirmed in Asia. As of May 18, travelers arriving in mainland China from affected regions who have been in contact with a known Ebola case or who exhibit symptoms such as fever or nausea must declare themselves to authorities. The measures underscore enhanced border checks and rapid reporting to curb cross-border spread, with continued monitoring and guidance expected from international health authorities. No confirmed imported cases in Asia to date.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポール、日本、南韓がWHO警告後にエボラ出血熱スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の中部アフリカでの流行拡大に伴い、複数の国が国際的な対策を実施。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも流行しやすさ・管理可能性が明らかであり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は中部アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行に対するアジア各国（シンガポール、日本、南韓、中国）の対応。中国のみ対象国リストに該当。シンガポール、日本、南韓は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。WHO警告が発行されており、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ce trebuie să știm despre focarul de Ebola care a trezit îngrijorarea Organizației Mondiale a Sănătății
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What We Need to Know About the Ebola Outbreak That Has Raised the World Health Organization's Concerns.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola (Ortoebolavirus) is driving an outbreak detected in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo. The first case was identified May 5, 2026 and confirmed May 15; the virus has spread to Uganda, with two cases in Kampala, and a suspected case in Kinshasa. WHO warns the outbreak could be larger than reported. The Bundibugyo strain has about a 40% case fatality rate; historically Ebola CFR ranges 25–90% depending on strain and care. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo; two vaccines exist for other strains—Ervebo (Zaire), used in 2018–2020 RDC outbreaks, and Zabdeno (two-dose) for direct contacts and health workers—but Bundibugyo vaccines are still in preclinical studies. Public health measures include rapid diagnostics (PCR, RAT), isolation, contact tracing for 21 days, and safe burial practices. Ituri is a conflict-affected mining region with cross-border movement; at least four health workers have died. No border closures; authorities urge intensified testing and tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行について知るべきこと：世界保健機関の懸念を引き起こした流行について
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ熱（Bundibugyo株）はコンゴ民主共和国で検出され、ウガンダに拡大、致死率40%、ワクチン未開発、国境超過型の拡大リスク、WHO懸念表明。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州、Kinshasa）が主要な発生地です。ウガンダ（Kampala）への拡大も記載されていますが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていません。Bundibugyo株はワクチン開発が進んでいない高リスク株で、紛争地域での流行という複合的リスク要因があります。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya activates KNPHI-led Ebola response amid outbreaks in DRC, Uganda
article.articleSummary: Kenya activates KNPHI-led Ebola preparedness as Bundibugyo-strain outbreaks unfold in DRC and Uganda (as of May 20, 2026). Kenya has not detected any Ebola case linked to the current outbreak. Health authorities activated a robust national Incident Management System through KNPHI, placed Rapid Response Teams on 24-hour standby, and kept Public Health Emergency Operations Centers on alert to prevent importation and ensure rapid detection and response. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC marks it Grade 3 High Risk due to cross-border transmission and lack of licensed vaccines or approved therapeutics for Bundibugyo. In DRC, more than 336 alerts and suspected cases are under investigation with 87 deaths, including two in Uganda; at least 13 laboratory-confirmed cases across DRC and Uganda. Kenya expanded border screening at airports, seaports, and land crossings; by May 18, about 34,500 travellers were screened. Lab capacity enhanced at KEMRI Nairobi/Kisumu, National Public Health Laboratory, and mobile labs; county sample transport and ambulance capacity mapping underway; private hospitals engaged.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがDRC、ウガンダにおけるエボラ流行の中でKNPHI主導のエボラ対応を活性化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重篤な影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言、Africa CDC Grade 3評価、複数国での確定患者発生、そして対象国ケニアの国境警戒態勢激化。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を主題としている。ケニアは対象国外（GeoNames IDなし）のため除外。DRCのみが対象国リスト内の検証可能な発生地。WHOが公式にPHEIC宣言、Africa CDCが最高リスク等級を付与。Bundibugyo株（rare、ワクチン・治療薬なし）の特性が懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Umumkan Darurat Ebola Global, Kemenkes Pastikan Belum Ada Kasus di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Global Ebola Emergency; Ministry of Health Confirms No Cases in Indonesia Yet.
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. Indonesia's Ministry of Health reports no Ebola cases in Indonesia to date and says heightened vigilance. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, DRC, where Ebola virus has caused a high case-fatality and cross-border spread risk. As of May 16, 2026, 246 suspected cases have been reported with 80 deaths. Travel-linked cases have been reported in Kampala, Uganda, and Kinshasa. The agency notes that despite PHEIC status, spread has not been categorized as a pandemic. The international concern underscores need for enhanced surveillance, infection control, and rapid response, with no confirmed cases in Indonesia so far.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ病ウイルス感染症の世界的緊急事態を宣言、保健省はインドネシアでの症例がないことを確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。DRCでのエボラ感染症がPHEICとして宣言され、ウガンダへの渡航関連症例報告と国際的拡大リスクが実証されており、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイツリ州を主要な発生地として述べており、ウガンダのカンパラとキンシャサへの渡航関連症例の報告がある。ただし検証対象国はDRCのみ。インドネシアは記事の主題ではなく、確認対象国として言及されているのみのため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言はシグナル判定を強化する重要な要素。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan passengers to face stricter Ebola scrutiny at US airports
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centered in eastern DRC and Uganda, with over 300 suspected cases and at least 80 deaths; the Bundibugyo strain, identified in Uganda in 2007, drives concern as US CDC imposes stricter screening on Kenyan travelers transiting Nairobi's JKIA who may carry virus before symptoms. Heightened screening, temperature checks and travel-history assessments are implemented at JKIA and other transit hubs (Addis Ababa, Doha, Dubai, Istanbul) to curb international spread through major US gateways; travellers who have visited Uganda, DRC or South Sudan this month may be temporarily barred from entry for at least 30 days. No cases have been confirmed in Kenya, but surveillance is intensified. Symptoms appear 4–10 days after exposure and are flu-like, potentially progressing to diarrhoea, abdominal pain and bleeding; transmission occurs via bodily fluids, contaminated surfaces, unsafe burials and animal contact. No vaccine specifically targeting Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア人乗客は米国空港でエボラに関する厳格な検査に直面する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。対象国内でエボラアウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ）が発生し、複数の主要国際空港での検査強化と渡航制限が実施されている状況。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから返された発生地域にはケニア、エチオピア、カタール、アラブ首長国連邦、トルコ、スーダン、米国が含まれているが、記事サマリーではエボラアウトブレイク自体は東部DRCとウガンダに限定されており、他の国（特にケニア）には確認症例がない。これらは検査強化が実施されている「経由地」であるため、verified_locationsには実際の発生地であるDRCとウガンダのみを列挙した。300以上の疑い症例、少なくとも80人の死亡、Bundibugyo株の特殊性、及び複数国での対応強化により、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS està desenvolupant a correcuita una vacuna contra l'Ebola perquè apunten que el brot 'és molt greu'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO is rushing to develop an Ebola vaccine because the outbreak is deemed 'very serious'.
article.articleSummary: WHO is rushing to develop an Ebola vaccine within two months to halt an outbreak in Africa, with suspected cases reaching 500 and at least 130 deaths across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. A large share of transmissions has occurred in urban areas. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the scale and speed are worrisome, and case counts and fatalities may rise as field operations intensify, with expanded surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory testing. Healthcare workers have died, indicating nosocomial transmission. European-wide epidemic is considered unlikely by epidemiologists. The United States has barred entry for foreigners who have visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. Among the cases is a U.S. citizen missionary in the DRC; German health authorities are preparing to receive and treat this patient.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が「極めて深刻」であるため、2ヶ月以内にワクチンの緊急開発を進めている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。500人の疑い患者、130人以上の死亡、医療従事者の院内感染、都市部での大規模伝播、国際的な渡航制限の実施により、PICKUPとして段階的リスク評価（RRA）に進める。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での発生を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国やドイツは国際的な対応と症例の移送受け入れに関連しているが、発生地ではないため除外。WHO事務局長による警告、都市部での大規模伝播、医療従事者への影響、渡航制限の実施、迅速なワクチン開発試行など、複数の危機管理指標が合致している。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情擴散！ 專家憂「變種病毒」經轉機入境台灣 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading in Africa! Experts fear a 'variant virus' could enter Taiwan via a layover - Liberty Health Net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Africa centers on the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with spread to Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain. DRC reports over 500 suspected cases and about 130 deaths; Uganda has two confirmed cases. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with infected blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated materials; it is not transmitted by mosquitoes or via the air. Early cases included false negatives due to the unusual strain, delaying confirmation of widespread transmission. Vaccines and therapeutics remain under development. Taiwan faces import risk via layovers in third countries despite no direct Africa flights; border surveillance and traveler screening are emphasized, with guidance for febrile travelers returning from affected regions and stringent infection control for healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大！専門家が「変異ウイルス」が経由地を通じて台湾に入境することを懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な株による予想外の広がり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの確定シグナル。
triage.notes: Uganda（対象国リスト外）での2確定例も報告されているが、主要発生地はDRCのため。台湾は記事主題の懸念地だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により確定シグナル。Bundibugyo株による異常な臨床経過（初期段階での偽陰性）が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Panics as Ebola Outbreak Kills 131 People... Here is What You Need to Know About This Deadly Disease
article.articleSummary: As of 19 May 2026, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo reports a deadly Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The DRC tally: 131 deaths, 543 suspected, 33 confirmed; first two confirmed cases in Butembo recorded on Monday. The two confirmed cases have also spilled into Uganda, marking cross-border transmission. WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 16 May 2026. The Bundibugyo strain lacks approved virus-specific therapeutics or vaccines, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. The outbreak emerges amid years of armed conflict in North Kivu, with healthcare facilities crippled; about 14.9 million people in the region need assistance. Ebola symptoms include fever, severe headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and possible bleeding; incubation 2–21 days. Transmission occurs through contact with Bodily fluids, with health workers at high risk without strict infection control. Survival relies on early supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがパニック、エボラ出血熱の流行で131人が死亡...この致命的な病気について知っておくべきことはここにある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当、WHO PHEICが既に宣言されている。DRC北東部でBundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラ出血熱の流行が確認され、ウガンダへの越境伝播も記録されている。
triage.notes: WHO は2026年5月16日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。確認例数33、疑い例543、死亡131。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は特異的な治療薬やワクチンが承認されていない。北キブ州の武装紛争により医療体制が崩壊、1,490万人が支援を必要としている。ウガンダへの越境伝播が確認されているため国際的脅威が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: American tested positive for Ebola in DRC transferred to Germany - WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with export to Germany and cross-border cases. An American doctor working with a medical missionary group in DRC tested positive for Ebola and was transferred to Germany for treatment. Uganda reported two confirmed Ebola cases in Kampala among travelers from DRC, including one death. WHO cites more than 500 suspected cases and about 130 suspected deaths as field operations scale up surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory testing; health workers have died, indicating healthcare-associated transmission. Cases have appeared in urban areas such as Kampala and Goma; Ituri province is insecure with large displacement, mining zones, and high population movement increasing spread risk. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no vaccines or therapeutics. Risk reduction focuses on risk communication and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人医師がDRCでエボラウイルス陽性判定、ドイツに転送 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）のDRC発生、ウガンダへの越境感染、ドイツへの国際転送、500以上の疑い患者と130人以上の疑い死亡がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with confirmed cross-border transmission to Uganda and international transfer to Germany. Large number of suspected cases (500+) and deaths (130+) with healthcare-associated transmission documented. Ituri province insecurity complicates outbreak control. WHO active surveillance involvement confirmed.

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉對台灣風險評估「無法排除境外移入」　疾管署發醫界通函 | ETtoday健康雲 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola risk assessment for Taiwan: cannot rule out importation from abroad; Taiwan CDC issues a medical community circular.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have led WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency. DRC reports 543 suspected and 33 confirmed cases; Uganda reports 2 confirmed. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no specific treatment or vaccine. WHO assesses high regional risk and low risk overall. Taiwan CDC judges Taiwan’s threat as low but cannot rule out imported cases due to international travel; border surveillance is strengthened, and advisories for DRC and Uganda were raised from Watch to Alert. Transmission involves animal reservoirs: fruit bats, primates, forest antelope and porcupine; human-to-human spread occurs via contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated materials, especially through mucous membranes or broken skin. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include high fever, fatigue, myalgia, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding. Clinician circular urges TOCC history and strict infection control.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾に対するエボラ出血熱リスク評価「国外からの流入を排除できない」疾病対策司令部が医療界に通知
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、WHO公式による公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が存在するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生を記述しており、台湾はリスク評価対象国（対象国リストにない）。DRCは対象国リスト内（203312）であるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO による PHEIC 宣言済みで、複数国での確定患者報告、動物・ヒト-ヒト感染経路の存在、高い地域リスク評価などから、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進捗が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Panică în estul RD Congo: Ebola se răspândește rapid, iar autoritățile se tem că virusul a circulat nedetectat - GAZETA de SUD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic in eastern DR Congo: Ebola is spreading rapidly, and authorities fear that the virus has circulated undetected - GAZETA de SUD.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, with hundreds of suspected cases and more than 130 deaths reported; officials say the virus may have circulated undetected for weeks before the first case identified on April 24. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with suspected cases in Goma, Butembo, and South Kivu. Presumed patient zero is a nurse who died in Bunia and was buried in Mongwalu. Symptoms resemble malaria, delaying diagnosis, and Bundibugyo may present fewer signs. Major cities lack functioning Ebola treatment centers days after the declaration. The region faces armed conflict, including M23 in Goma. WHO declared a PHEIC; Save the Children warns of a new massive crisis. The U.S. pledged $13 million in aid for DRC and Uganda; among the infected is an American doctor evacuated to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴ民主共和国でパニック：エボラウイルスが急速に拡大し、当局は未検出の感染流通を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO全基準も該当。WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への波及、高い社会的・政治的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事本文がないため部分的な確認のみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、感染症イベントの主要な発生地。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病で、130人以上の死亡が報告されている。感染者（アメリカ人医師）がドイツに搬送されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの爆発的流行であり、DRC以外の国は二次的。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、国際的関心は極めて高い。武装紛争（M23）が対策の複雑化要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 广州长隆大熊猫"家和"因病去世 致命衣原体何来
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangzhou Chimelong Giant Panda "Jiahe" Dies of Illness; Where Did the Deadly Chlamydia Come From?
article.articleSummary: Giant panda Jiahe at Guangzhou Chimelong Wild Animal World died on May 9 from heart failure secondary to a pulmonary Chlamydia infection. The exact Chlamydia species is under investigation; experts consider Chlamydia psittaci (psittacosis) from birds or Chlamydia pneumoniae (TWAR) from humans. By May 16, Tingzi and Jiahe had shown appetite loss, lethargy, coughing and fever. Multidisciplinary teams from China Agricultural University, South China Agricultural University, and Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital provided diagnosis and treatment. Jiahe’s death occurred at 12:46 on May 9 after rapid deterioration; Tingzi’s condition has temporarily improved and remains relatively stable. Investigations aim to identify the organism and transmission source; no details on imported or exported cases are reported.

triage.headline_ja: 広州チーメロン大パンダ「家和」が病気で死亡；致命的クラミジアの由来は？
triage.triage_reason: 動物（ジャイアントパンダ）での異常な死亡事例であり、Chlamydia psittaci（オウム病）の可能性が指摘されている。ただし、ヒト感染例の報告がなく、人獣共通感染症のリスク評価に情報不足。
triage.notes: 本事例は野生動物園のジャイアントパンダの死亡であり、ヒト感染症への直接的な脅威は現段階では報告されていない。ただし、Chlamydia psittaci（オウム病）はヒト感染の人獣共通感染症であり、感染源の特定と伝播経路の調査が重要。多機関による調査が進行中であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: GMC Jammu Issues Dengue Advisory  - Kashmir Observer
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, GMC Jammu issued a dengue advisory for the Jammu region detailing management and prevention. Dengue is caused by one of four DENV serotypes transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; it is not spread person-to-person except rare maternal‑fetal transmission. Reinfection with a different serotype increases the risk of severe dengue with bleeding and organ damage. Symptoms usually begin 4–10 days after a bite and last 3–7 days: high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pains, nausea/vomiting, rash, and extreme weakness. About 1 in 20 patients may progress to severe dengue after initial symptoms subside; seek urgent care for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, breathing difficulty, gum/nose bleeding, blood in vomit or stool, or extreme fatigue. Testing at GMC, SMGS, and Super Speciality Hospital includes Dengue NS1 ELISA (within 5 days), IgM ELISA (after 5 days), RT-PCR, CBC, hematocrit, and platelets. Emphasis on mosquito control, protective clothing, and water management; dedicated adult and pediatric wards; adequate platelet stock; avoid self-medication and unnecessary transfusions.

triage.headline_ja: GMCジャンムー、デング熱警告を発出 - カシミール・オブザーバー
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャンムー地域でデング熱の公式警告が発出されているが、現在のところ具体的な症例数、死亡、異常な流行パターンの報告がなく、情報が限定的である。地域別対応強化に関する通知レベルの段階であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はジャンムー地域の公式保健機関（GMC Jammu）による予防・管理にかかるアドバイザリーであり、確定症例数や死亡報告、疫学的な異常性についての具体的情報がない。デング熱は蚊媒介感染症として季節的・地域的に周期的に発生する疾患であり、行政による予防警告は通常の対応である。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、社会的・政治的関心の深さが不明確であり、IHR基準の該当がないため、現段階ではWATCH（要経過観察）と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Вакцинасы да, нақты емі де жоқ: Эболаның өршуіне байланысты министрлік қазақстандықтарға үндеу жариялады
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is neither a vaccine nor a definitive treatment: The ministry has issued an appeal to the people of Kazakhstan amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 2026-05-20: Kazakhstan's Ministry of Health issued a travel advisory amid a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared an international emergency over the outbreak, which has caused 246 infections and 65 deaths in the affected region. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Transmission occurs through close contact with an infected person or animals and their bodily fluids. Citizens planning international travel should review the destination's epidemiological situation, maintain strict personal hygiene, and take precautions during trips. After returning, monitor health and promptly seek medical care if symptoms appear, while reporting travel history to the doctor. Do not attempt self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンもなく、確実な治療法もない：エボラの流行に関連して、保健省はカザフスタン国民に呼びかけを発表した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスは極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCとウガンダでの爆発的な流行は異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク高く、WHOが国際緊急事態宣言を発出。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行であり、カザフスタンはこれに対する渡航勧告を発出している二次的な動き。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations に追加しない。WHOによる国際緊急事態宣言があり、極めて高いリスク案件。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola odnela 130 života: Strah od širenja van granica Konga, SZO hitno traži rešenje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has claimed 130 lives: Fear of spread beyond Congo's borders, WHO urgently seeks a solution.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. By May 20, 2026, at least 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths, more than double the figures reported when it was announced (≈200/65). Laboratory-confirmed cases total 30 in Ituri, with one case and one death in Kampala, Uganda; one American citizen tested positive and evacuated to Germany. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. No approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo; existing Zaire ebolavirus vaccines cannot be used in the current response, while experimental candidates are under evaluation. The IRC warns the true burden may be higher; the border with South Sudan is porous. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; case fatality rate averages around 50% (historical range 25–90%). This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが130人の命を奪う：コンゴの境界を越えた感染拡大の懸念、WHOが緊急対応を模索
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、国境を越えた感染拡大の高い危険性と国際的な対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: ウガンダで1例・1死亡が報告されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主疫学的焦点。ウガンダはBluedot発行地域に含まれるも、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ドイツの患者搬送はevacuationであり発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus に対する有効なワクチン・治療法がないことが国際的な懸念として特筆されている。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ Ebola aşı adaylarını değerlendiriyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Evaluates Ebola Vaccine Candidates.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease due to Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts WHO to evaluate candidate vaccines. As of May 20, 2026, at least 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths have been reported. Mortality for Bundibugyo disease can reach 30–50% even with available care. There is no approved vaccine or treatment specifically for the Bundibugyo strain. Genetic data published by the Democratic Republic of Congo authorities and Ugandan scientists indicate initial spillover from an infected animal to humans, followed by human-to-human transmission. WHO's Congo representative Anne Ancia noted that current vaccines and therapies may not be applicable to this outbreak and stressed the need for further study. Internationally, teams are reviewing existing vaccine candidates and therapies to determine potential usefulness in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスワクチン候補を評価中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo株による大規模アウトブレイク（500疑似症例、130死亡）で、高い致死率（30-50%）、国際的拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染確認、WHO対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダの両国が言及されているが、ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。ウガンダは科学的データ提供者として言及されており、主要な感染地はDRCであると判断。Bundibugyo株のエボラアウトブレイクは新興感染症として対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient in Berlin gelandet - US-Arzt kommt in Charité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient lands in Berlin — American doctor arrives at Charité.
article.articleSummary: American physician Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived in Berlin on a Gulfstream III flight via a refueling stop in Crete, escorted by a protected transport to Charité hospital. He is placed on a dedicated isolation unit at the Virchow-Klinikum campus, designed to treat up to 20 highly infectious patients with separate access, ventilation, and wastewater systems. Stafford, among six contact persons including possibly family, flew from Uganda to Berlin; authorities say the population faces no danger while the patient is fully isolated. The Congolese health ministry reported 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 suspected deaths. Ebola spreads by direct contact with body fluids. Context notes the 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak (Zaire variant) killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がベルリンに到着—米国人医師がシャリテ病院へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの確認症例がDRCで発生し、国際的な患者移送が行われており、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ疑い患者513名、疑い死亡131名が報告されている。確認症例の米国人医師がベルリンのシャリテ病院に隔離収容されたが、発生の主要地はDRCであり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ドイツ、ギリシャ、ウガンダは患者移送ルート上の国だが、実際のエボラ発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk læge er landet til ebolabehandling i Berlin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American doctor has landed in Berlin for Ebola treatment.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola arrived in Berlin for treatment, transported from the airport to Charité hospital in the German capital around 03:00 local time. The physician, who worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo during the ongoing Ebola outbreak, is being treated at Charité’s dedicated isolation unit. Washington has asked Germany for help to shorten travel time and to draw on Germany’s experience in treating Ebola patients. Germany’s health minister Nina Warken said citizens need not fear and that the patient will receive the best possible care under stringent safety measures. The Democratic Republic of Congo’s outbreak has caused 131 deaths among 513 suspected cases, according to the health ministry. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, with two known cases, one of whom died; the Ugandan case is a person who traveled from DRC. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the situation in DRC is deeply concerning. Only a small portion of suspected cases have been lab-confirmed due to inaccessibility of many areas.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカの医師がベルリンでエボラ治療のため到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外の国際移送、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確定的な患者が複数国で発生し、先進国への治療搬送が行われている。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生地が主題。ウガンダへの拡大も記事で言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ドイツ・米国への患者搬送は発生地ではなく治療地であるため除外。本イベントはフルRRA実施に値する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, cosa sta succedendo davvero: sintomi, contagio, vaccini e il rischio reale per l'Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, what's really going on: symptoms, transmission, vaccines, and the real risk for Italy.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, the WHO declared an international health emergency as Ebola resurges between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with hundreds of suspected cases and over 100 suspected deaths. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer strain than Zaire ebolavirus; there are currently no approved vaccines or specific therapies for Bundibugyo, unlike Zaire Ebola where vaccines and targeted treatments exist. Diagnosis, rapid isolation, contact tracing, and intensive supportive care are central to management. Transmission requires direct contact with blood, vomit, saliva, urine, feces, sweat or other bodily fluids of a symptomatic person, or contaminated materials; it is not airborne. An American doctor infected in Congo was evacuated to Germany for care; EU/Italy risk is considered very low, though unidentified cases and cross-border spread remain concerns. Italy maintains hospital infection-control protocols and airport surveillance to mitigate importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：本当のところ：症状、感染、ワクチン、およびイタリアへの実際のリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ再流行であり、ブンディブギョウイボラウイルス株に対する承認ワクチンがない点で深刻。DRCとウガンダでの複数国感染、EU圏への患者搬送、国際的な感染リスク管理が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダでの発生が主題だが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。イタリア・ドイツの言及は搬送患者の治療地であり、発生地ではないため除外。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、ブンディブギョウイボラウイルスに対するワクチン・治療法の欠如、複数国感染、EU圏への患者搬送という多層的な懸念要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pacijent sa ebolom stigao u Evropu: Pogledajte pod kakvim merama obezbeđenja ga vode u čuvenu bolnicu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with Ebola has arrived in Europe: See under what security measures he is being escorted to the famous hospital.
article.articleSummary: An American physician, Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola in the Congo, arrived in Europe for treatment in Berlin. He disembarked at Berlin Brandenburg Airport at night in full protective gear, assisted by colleagues in coveralls, and was transported by armored ambulance to Charité hospital’s Virchow Clinic. The facility houses a dedicated isolation unit capable of handling up to 20 patients, with separate access, airlocks, specialized ventilation, and closed wastewater processing. The German Health Ministry says there is no danger to the public or other patients; Stafford will be treated under complete isolation. Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 probable deaths. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids. The historical 2014–2015 Zaire outbreak in West Africa killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者がヨーロッパに到着：著名な病院への搬送時のセキュリティ対策を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際移動、欧州への患者搬送という重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはドイツ・ベルリンも含まれているが、記事サマリーでの実際のイベント発生地はコンゴ（患者の感染地）とドイツ（搬送・治療地）である。対象国リストに含まれるのはコンゴ（DRC）のみため、verified_locationsにはDRCを列挙。ドイツはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者が完全隔離下で治療されており、二次感染リスクは管理されているが、エボラの高い致死率と国際的な公衆衛生上の重要性から、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Hantavirus Show World's Risk Preparedness Lagging, Says Pandemic Expert
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, hantavirus outbreaks on the MV Hondius in the Atlantic and a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo underscore lagging upstream risk-informed preparedness despite improvements in crisis responses under the new international health regulations. Three people died of hantavirus linked to the ship's voyage; hantavirus is endemic in the Argentina region where the Hondius departed, raising questions about vessels' awareness of source risks. In DRC's remote province, Bundibugyo Ebola has killed more than 130 people, with testing initially focusing on other strains before Bundibugyo was identified. A US national has a laboratory-confirmed Ebola case, illustrating cross-border exposure risk. The Rodolphe Merieux Laboratory (INRB) in Goma monitored the situation on May 19, 2026. Helen Clark calls for better risk-informed surveillance, early detection, and sustained global solidarity and funding to prevent gaps in preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルスが世界のリスク対応準備の遅れを露呈、パンデミック専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の高危険病原体（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）での同時発生、死亡者発生、米国への交差国境感染確認により緊急性高し。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域には大西洋、アルゼンチン、米国も含まれているが、サマリーの検読結果に基づき、実際の感染症イベント発生国はDRCのみとした。MV Hondius上のハンタウイルス発生（船舶での封閉環境での感染）、DRCでのBundibugyo Ebolアウトブレイク（130人以上死亡）、米国での確定症例（交差国境曝露）が報告されているが、地理的発生地として確認されるのはDRCである。Helen Clarkによるグローバルな準備態勢の必要性呼びかけが含まれており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline:
Ebola death toll rises to 136 in Congo
                            In Congo, the death toll due to the Ebola outbreak has risen to 136. Health Minister Roger Kamba informed this amid the spread of the deadly virus that has gripped the eastern part of the country.
Ac...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has risen to 136 deaths, with 543 suspected cases and 32 confirmed infections, according to Health Minister Roger Kamba on 2026-05-20. This is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which previously triggered outbreaks in 2007 and 2012 and carried about a 30% fatality rate among those infected. Uganda has reported two confirmed cases. The report provides counts of suspected and confirmed cases but does not detail laboratory methods, transmission chains, or clinical symptoms. The information highlights ongoing transmission in the region and the significance of Bundibugyo strain outbreaks in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死者数が136人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患は公衆衛生上深刻な影響を及ぼし、国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、複数国での確認と渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダで2例の確認患者が報告されているが、記事の主題はコンゴでの発生。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株による第17回アウトブレイク。死亡率は約30%。複数の病例カテゴリ（疑い136+543、確定32）が報告されており、東部での継続的な感染伝播が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Чи загрожує світу нова пандемія через хантавірус: вірусолог розставив всі крапки над І
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is a new hantavirus pandemic a threat to the world? A virologist has laid out all the details.
article.articleSummary: Andes hantavirus outbreak on cruise ship MV Hondius is unlikely to spark a world pandemic, according to Alexander Bukreev, UTMB Galveston virologist. While hantavirus can transmit person-to-person, its spread is far slower than measles or COVID-19, and the current outbreak is being contained via quarantine and robust regional health systems. Bukreev notes that severity is high but contagiousness is limited; mass vaccination is not yet necessary as infection risk remains low. His laboratory is developing an mRNA vaccine against hantavirus using the Pfizer/Moderna platform; early hamster studies show vaccinated animals survived exposure, with results published in Nature Communications. If infection arises among travelers, exposure likely occurred in endemic South American regions such as Argentina or Brazil. The scientist also rejects biolab origin rumors and emphasizes strict international controls over virus research. Ukrainians should rely on official medical guidance and avoid panic.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスによる新たなパンデミアは世界に脅威をもたらすか：ウイルス学者がすべてを明らかにした
triage.triage_reason: クルーズ船での限定的なハンタウイルス集団発生であり、専門家は「パンデミアの可能性は低い」と評価。ただし複数疾患（COVID-19、麻しん、ハンタウイルス）の同時言及と、ワクチン開発の進展により、シグナルとしての監視価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地域リストにはコロンビア、アルゼンチン、ウクライナなど複数国が含まれるが、サマリーの主題はクルーズ船上の限定的な集団発生であり、専門家は「人人感染の可能性は低く、パンデミアの脅威はない」と明確に述べている。対象国のうち、エンデミック地域として具体的に言及されているのはBrazilのみ。ハンタウイルスの重篤性は高いが、伝播性が低く、現在の集団発生は隔離により制御されている。ワクチン開発が進行中であることは注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: കണ്ണൂരില്‍ പകര്‍ച്ചവ്യാധികളും,ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിയും പടരുന്നു; ജാഗ്രത പാലിക്കണമെന്ന് ആരോഗ്യ വകുപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kannur, infectious diseases and dengue fever are spreading; the Health Department urges vigilance.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and febrile illnesses are spreading in Kannur district as monsoon begins. A total of 42,376 fever patients sought treatment; 692 were hospitalised. Dengue infections rise to 237 with 3 deaths. Mangattidam Panchayat registers the highest dengue count (22). Dengue fatalities have occurred in Azhikode, Edakkad, and Kunnothuparamba. Other dengue case counts by area: Kannur Corporation 17; Chengalayi 12; Chapparappadav 12; Mattannur Municipality 11; Pinarayi 10; Vengad 9; Thalassery Municipality 8; Aralam 8; Ulikkal 7. Health authorities warn that intermittent rain may elevate transmission and urge prompt mosquito control around homes, including source-level sanitation of waste to prevent breeding.

triage.headline_ja: カンヌール地区でデング熱と感染症が蔓延中、保健局が警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱患者237人、死亡3人、42,376人の発熱患者が治療を求めており、IHR基準では「異常/予想外」および「重症度」に該当。スクリーニング基準では複数項目に該当し、保健部局による公式警告がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてカンヌール地区（ケーララ州）が特定されており、インドのみが該当。季節的な蚊媒介感染症の増加であるが、死亡例と入院患者数の増加により公衆衛生上の懸念が明確。モンスーン期の降雨による更なる拡大の可能性も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: ФИФА поддерживает связь с федерацией ДР Конго на фоне вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA maintains contact with the DR Congo federation amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo's Ituri province near the Uganda border has prompted FIFA to stay in contact with FECOFA to relay safety guidelines as DR Congo prepares for the World Cup group K against Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia. FECOFA canceled a planned training camp in Kinshasa. FIFA says it is coordinating with host nations and the WHO to ensure a safe tournament. The WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. In DR Congo, over 500 suspected cases and at least 131 deaths have been reported; transmission continues. DR Congo will play Portugal in Houston on June 17, Colombia in Zapopan on June 23, and Uzbekistan in Atlanta on June 27.

triage.headline_ja: FIFAはエボラ出血熱の流行を背景にコンゴ民主共和国連盟との連絡を維持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO緊急事態宣言済み、複数国への国際的な懸念、感染症が確認された主要イベント関連の報道。
triage.notes: 2026年5月17日にWHOが公式に国際懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言済み。イトゥリ州での疑い症例500件以上、死亡131件以上を報告。ウガンダとの国境近くでの発生。ワールドカップという大規模国際イベントに関連。Bluedot APIが抽出した多数の米国・メキシコ・ポルトガル・ウズベキスタン・コロンビアの地点は試合開催地として抽出されたもの。サマリーに基づき実際の流行発生地はDRCに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikanac zaražen ebolom prebačen u europsku državu: Smješten je u posebnoj izolacijskoj jedinici
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American infected with Ebola has been transferred to a European country: He has been placed in a special isolation unit.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, an American citizen infected with Ebola has been transferred to Berlin's Charité University Hospital in Germany and placed in a dedicated, high-security isolation unit. The patient, who contracted the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, arrived in Berlin by a specialized aircraft for the transport of highly infectious patients, from Uganda. German Health Ministry spokesperson Nina Warken said assisting partners is natural for Germany, noting the country’s effective care system, including for patients with highly contagious diseases, and that the patient will receive the best possible care while stringent safety measures are maintained. The Charité isolation unit is closed and protected from routine hospital operations to prevent contact with other patients. Ebola is an infectious and life-threatening disease transmitted through physical contact and body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染したアメリカ人がヨーロッパの国に転送：専用の隔離ユニットに収容
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際転送事例であり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。ドイツでの受け入れ体制構築は社会的・政治的関心が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 患者の感染地がDRCであることが確認されている。ドイツとウガンダへの転送経路が記載されているが、記事の主題となっているイベント（感染）の発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラの生物的リスク（致死率、感染力）と国際転送というイベントの異常性により、フルRRA進行が適切と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak made worse by conflicts
article.articleSummary: 130 deaths and >500 suspected Ebola cases in eastern DRC (Ituri and North Kivu) driven by Bundibugyo strain; no approved treatment or vaccine. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expressed deep concern over the scale and speed of the outbreak; surveillance, contact tracing and laboratory testing are hampered by ongoing conflict and mass displacement (>100,000). Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and has an average fatality rate around 50%. The outbreak is in a mining zone rich in gold, tin, and coltan, fueling militias and displacement. The region's minerals attract international interest, with Chinese firms controlling about 80% of DRC's mineral wealth; US/EU partnerships and rail corridors (TAZARA and Lobito Corridor) are cited as geopolitical links. Global health funding pressures persist amid US and EU budget cuts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行が地域紛争により悪化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全5項目該当。大規模死亡例（130死亡、500以上の疑い患者）と紛争による対応困難な状況が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu州）でのエボラ流行が主題。発生地域フィールドに米国と中国が含まれているが、サマリーではこれらの国での発生は記述されておらず、むしろ地政学的な国際関心（中国の鉱物支配、US/EUのインフラ構想）として言及されているのみ。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行、50%の致命率、紛争による防疫困難など高リスク特性が複数確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Угрожает ли миру новая пандемия из-за хантавируса: вирусолог расставил все точки над I
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is a new hantavirus pandemic threatening the world: a virologist has set the record straight.
article.articleSummary: On 20 May 2026, experts say the hantavirus outbreak linked to the cruise ship MV Hondius is unlikely to trigger a pandemic. Alexander Bukreev, professor at the University of Texas Medical Branch, Galveston, told DW that although hantavirus can be lethal, its human-to-human transmission is far slower than COVID-19. Key risk factors are disease severity and spread rate; the current outbreak should be contained by quarantine measures and health systems. His lab is developing an mRNA vaccine against hantavirus using the same platform as Pfizer/BioNTech and Moderna; hamster studies showed vaccinated animals survived exposure, with findings published in Nature Communications. Mass vaccination is not needed yet given the low infection risk; passengers may have acquired infection during visits to endemic South American regions such as Argentina or Brazil. He also rejected biolab conspiracy theories, noting modern technologies do not yet produce new human pathogens and that research is strictly controlled.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスによる新たなパンデミックは世界を脅かすか：ウイルス学者がすべての疑問に決着をつけた
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス集団感染が報告されていますが、専門家の見解として「パンデミック化の可能性は低い」と評価されており、国際的拡大リスクは限定的と判断されます。情報不足を補うため、今後の発症者数推移と地域検証が必要です。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてTexas(米国)とArgentinaが列挙されていますが、対象国リストに含まれているのはBrazilのみです。記事サマリーではGalveston(テキサス州)のクルーズ船に関連した集団感染が主題ですが、米国は対象国外。乗客がArgentinaやBrazilの風土病地域で感染したとされているため、Brazilを含めています。具体的な症例数、死亡数、クルーズ船内の感染状況の詳細が不明であり、さらなる情報が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Leo (78) vliegt tijdens ebola-uitbraak naar Oeganda. 'Ik kreeg wel wat appjes: Goh, moeten we ons zorgen maken?'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leo (78) flies to Uganda during the Ebola outbreak. "Gee, should we be worried?"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo's Ituri province has caused at least 118 deaths and more than 300 suspected infections; neighboring Uganda reports one death and one infection. Dutch journalist Leo van Gelderen (78) and his partner Corinne Abbas (54) are in Kampala, having arrived a day before the WHO declared an international emergency; they have lived in Kampala since early 2024. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, chest pain, and possible bleeding; transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, with over half of patients dying. The outbreak remains localized to Congo’s border area; Uganda has shown vigilance, drawing on past experiences to enforce measures when needed. Leo advises calm, pragmatic precautions rather than panic, while Corinne continues her embassy-related work visiting agricultural sites.

triage.headline_ja: レオ（78歳）がエボラ流行中にウガンダへ飛行。「心配する必要はあるのか？」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確認された死亡数118人、感染者300人以上、WHOが国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事の背景情報として言及されているが、サマリーの主題は東部コンゴ（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ発生。ウガンダは1死亡1感染と限定的であり、DRCが主要な発生国。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情升級 澳洲考慮收緊旅行限制 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak escalates; Australia considers tightening travel restrictions | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, has about 500 cases with 116 deaths, with potential for further spread as medical supplies are sent to affected areas. The United States has barred entry for non-citizens who visited outbreak zones in the prior three weeks, while Australia is considering tighter travel restrictions and is reviewing guidance for Uganda.
