Ebola’s case fatality rate is around 50%, and transmission is not airborne but via body fluids (blood, sweat, saliva) and can survive on clothing and bed linens. Early symptoms include high fever, headache, and muscle pains, followed by acute gastrointestinal symptoms and rash, potentially leading to kidney and liver failure; some patients may experience eye and nose bleeding. The last major Ebola outbreak caused about 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が深刻化、オーストラリアが渡航制限の強化を検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の流行であり、複数国での確認、死亡者100名超、国際的な対応措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。米国やオーストラリアの渡航制限は対応措置であり、これらの国での実際の発生ではない。約500症例、116名の死亡が報告されており、死亡率50%のエボラウイルス病である点で重大リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Hyundai Bioscience: "Able to Supply Antiviral Drug in Event of Ebola or Hantavirus Spread"
article.articleSummary: Hyundai Bioscience announced on May 19, 2026 (reported May 20) that it can immediately supply clinical trial doses of its broad‑spectrum antiviral XAFTY to Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks, using stock available for WHO or affected countries upon request. XAFTY’s main ingredient, niclosamide, has been reported to inhibit both Ebola and hantavirus. The company notes ongoing Phase 2 testing of XAFTY for dengue fever in Vietnam, with no adverse events reported to date. In a scenario where two viruses spread simultaneously, XAFTY could serve as an effective alternative. Hyundai Bioscience is a member of the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium (MCDC), a U.S. Department of Defense–supported group, and commits to cooperating in international public health crises. Public health relevance: Ebola, hantavirus, dengue fever; locations include South Korea (company base) and Vietnam (dengue trial).

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス：「エボラまたはハンタウイルス流行時に抗ウイルス薬供給が可能」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は企業の医薬品供給能力に関する発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。現在の発生状況を示すエビデンスがなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は医薬品企業（現代バイオサイエンス）の製品供給能力に関する企業発表であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報告していない。ベトナムではデング熱の臨床試験段階にあるとのみ記載されており、実際の流行・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo va putea participa la Cupa Mondială din 2026, în ciuda epidemiei de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo will be able to participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, despite the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) faces an Ebola outbreak, but its national football team is expected to participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States. A U.S. State Department official said the DRC squad should be able to play despite Washington’s tightened border health controls targeting Ebola, prohibiting entry for foreign nationals who traveled to Uganda, DR Congo, or South Sudan in the last 21 days. The Congolese team has trained in Europe and may not meet the entry ban criteria. If any player has passed through DR Congo in the prior 21 days, an exception will allow entry but requires strict testing and isolation per U.S. protocol; fans are not covered by this exception. The team’s base camp is Houston, Texas. Group K matches: Portugal in Houston (June 17), Colombia in Guadalajara, Mexico (June 24), Uzbekistan in Atlanta (June 28).

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴは2026年FIFAワールドカップに参加可能、エボラ流行にもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外（Yes）」「国際的拡大リスク（Yes）」に該当。感染症危機管理とバイオセキュリティの観点から、国境保健措置の強化と国際的移動制限が実施されている点が重要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月20日時点でのDRコンゴにおけるエボラ流行を報道している。Bluedot APIから取得した発生地域には米国（ワールドカップ開催国）やメキシコ、ウズベキスタン、ポルトガル等が含まれているが、これらは大会参加国またはグループリーグ会場であり、実際のエボラ発生地域ではない。記事サマリーの主題は「DRコンゴのエボラ流行」であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。記事にはウガンダと南スーダンも言及されているが、サマリー上ではこれらの国における実際の流行状況は述べられていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Le Potentiel: " Ebola en RDC : le gouvernement en première ligne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: The Government on the Front Line.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province dominates today’s news. Officials report 136 probable deaths, 32 laboratory-confirmed cases, and over 540 suspected infections in Ituri communities such as Bunia, Mongbwalu and Rwampara, linked to a Bundibugyo variant. With no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain, Health Minister Dr. Samuel Roger Kamba and INRB director Jean-Jacques Muyembe stress rapid logistical and public-health responses; they note Congo’s history of containing most epidemics through rigorous measures. Denis Mukwege calls for reopening Goma airport to speed relief, while an extraordinary Council of Ministers is convened on crisis budgeting and Ebola response. In Kinshasa, opposition forms Coalition Article 64 to thwart constitutional revision or a possible third term for President Tshisekedi; leaders Fayulu, Sesanga, Kabund join, amid tensions in Tshangu and calls for inclusive national dialogue by CNSA as of May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ：政府が第一線に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行のしやすさ）。確認症例32例、疑い感染540例以上、死亡136例報告。Bundibugyo変異体により対応が困難で、高いシグナル評価。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異体によるエボラ出血熱の流行。確認症例32例、疑い症例540例以上、死亡136例。ワクチンや承認された治療法がない変異体。公衆衛生対応が困難な状況。Goma空港の再開を求める声あり。政治的議論も並行して報告されているが、主要なシグナルはエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: Cupa Mondială 2026: Washingtonul va autoriza intrarea în SUA a echipei din RD Congo, în ciuda epidemiei de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2026 FIFA World Cup: Washington will authorize entry into the United States for the DR Congo team, despite the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: The DR Congo national football team will be allowed to compete in the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States despite an Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo. A U.S. State Department official said Washington expects RDC to participate and has tightened border health checks, banning entry of foreign nationals who traveled to Uganda, DR Congo, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. If a team member passed through the Democratic Republic of the Congo within 21 days, an exception will be granted but must undergo strict testing and isolation protocols. The exemption does not apply to Congolese supporters. DR Congo will base camp in Houston, Texas, and play in Group K: Portugal (June 17, Houston), Colombia (June 24, Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 28, Atlanta). The article does not address Congolese presence in Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: 2026 FIFAワールドカップ：米国はエボラ流行にもかかわらずコンゴ民主共和国チームの入国を認可
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生が記事の主要なテーマであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が存在するが、記事の主焦点はスポーツイベント参加に関する行政決定であり、新規発生情報や疾患の流行拡大を示す医学的詳細が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ発生を言及しているが、DRC国内での疾患の重症度、症例数、死亡率などの医学的詳細が記載されていない。主要なテーマはスポーツイベント参加に関する米国の行政判断であり、感染症の流行情報そのものではない。今後のDRC国内のエボラ情報、重症度の変化、新規患者発生など、医学的なシグナルの続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉感染釀136死 美宣布提供1300萬美元援助 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infection in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 136 people; the U.S. announces $13 million in aid | Public Television News Network (PNN).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies, with 136 deaths reported. Public concern grows in Bukavu, where residents don masks and shopkeepers note rising demand. In Ituri Province’s four health zones, 26 suspected Ebola deaths were reported within 24 hours, and cross-border cases have emerged in Uganda. Investigations trace the source to a nurse who died in Bunia in late April; laboratory analyses confirm the current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a case fatality around 50%. There is no vaccine specifically for this strain. Africa CDC provides funding and an alternative vaccine to curb spread; Dr. Kassaye notes a $1 million deployment to frontline responders. UNICEF-supplied medical materials arrived in Bunia for prioritized distribution to high-case areas. The United States pledges $13 million in emergency aid to DRC and Uganda, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio says WHO was slow to confirm cases, with plans to open about 50 treatment clinics locally.

triage.headline_ja: 民主剛果伊波拉感染釀136死 美宣布提供1300萬美元援助
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による確認症例、高い致命率（約50%）、ウガンダへの越境感染、国際援助による対応が必要とされており、世界保健当局の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内の South Kivu Province（ブカブ）と Ituri Province（ブニア）での発生が主たる内容。ウガンダへの越境感染が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。米国の援助表明は記事の背景情報であり、実際の発生地ではない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による初の大規模アウトブレイク、高い致命率、ワクチン非対応株であることが重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Rwanda tightens border controls over deadly Ebola outbreak In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has caused at least 131 deaths and 531 suspected infections, with Ituri province as the epicenter and Mongbwalu under CODECO control. A confirmed Ebola case has been reported in Goma near the Rwanda border. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency. Rwanda has tightened border controls and intensified health screenings near Goma, with Rubavu district traders reporting disrupted crossings. The Bundibugyo variant is a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment; past outbreaks in Uganda (2007) and DR Congo (2012) had mortality rates of 30–50%. Regional insecurity—CODECO, ADF, and M23—hinders containment and raises cross-border spread risk, while the U.S. has issued Level 4 travel advisories for DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan and cautions about travel to Rwanda.

triage.headline_ja: ルワンダがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に対応して国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、Bundibugyo株エボラで131死亡・531疑い例、複数国への拡大リスク（ルワンダで確認例）、国境統制強化と渡航制限が実施されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの罕な変異株で既承認ワクチンなし。地域不安定化（CODECO・ADF・M23）により封じ込め困難化。ルワンダでも確認例報告されているが、主発生地はDRCの東部（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）。U.S.レベル4渡航勧告が複数国で発令。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus, ébola y desigualdades norte-sur: "Es fundamental entender que la salud es un concepto global"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus, Ebola, and North-South inequalities: "It is fundamental to understand that health is a global concept."
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, a luxury Atlantic cruise bound for Tenerife reported a hantavirus outbreak with three deaths. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola outbreak exceeds 500 cases with 130 suspected deaths and has crossed into Uganda with two confirmed cases. The Ebola strain is Bundibugyo; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, emphasizing risk communication and community engagement. At the WHO’s 79th Assembly in Geneva, negotiations on the Pandemic Treaty stalled over an annex governing access to pathogen data and sharing of vaccine benefits, underscoring North–South inequities. Funding for Bunyaviricetes research (2015–2024) averaged $33.4 million annually, dominated by NIH and the EU, highlighting Western-centric capacities and ongoing debates over equitable access to benefits.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス、エボラ、南北格差：「健康はグローバルな概念であることを理解することが重要」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。複数国でのエボラ（DRC・ウガンダ）とハンタウイルス（豪華クルーズ船）の同時多発イベント、WHO-PHEIC宣言済み、国際的拡大と貿易制限リスク顕著。フルRRAに進むべき優先度の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: スイス（ジュネーブでのWHO議論）とスペイン（テネリフェのクルーズ船）も関連するが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのエボラ発生が記事の主要な焦点で、ウガンダへのクロスボーダー拡大も言及されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため含めない。ハンタウイルスについても北米発生と推定されるため対象国外と判断。verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉131死 盧比歐批世衛慢半拍 - 國際
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola: 131 dead; Rubio slams WHO for dragging its feet - International
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola deaths rose to 131, with 26 more suspected deaths in the last 24 hours; there are about 543 suspected and 33 confirmed cases within DRC, while Uganda has 2 confirmed cases. Uganda has begun restricting border-area movement; Congolese trying to enter Rwanda in the south have been blocked. U.S. Secretary of State Rubio criticized the WHO for slow action in confirming the outbreak. The United States pledged about $13 million in aid and aims to establish 50 Ebola treatment clinics inside the DRC, though the remote, war-torn region remains hard to access. The WHO advised against closing borders to avoid unmonitored cross-border spread and to maintain surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱：131人が死亡、ルビオ国務長官がWHOの対応の遅さを批判
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の確認された流行であり、131人の死亡、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認、ルワンダとの国境制限）、国際支援の展開が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ熱の確認された流行事例。DRC内での543件の疑い例、33件の確認例、131人の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダでも2件の確認例があるが、DRCが主要な発生地域。ルワンダとの国境制限措置が実施されている。米国が支援を表明し、WHO対応についても国際的な批判が出ている。対象国リスト外のウガンダ・ルワンダは検証地域から除外したが、DRCは含める。

article.articleHeadline: Viruserkrankung: Ärzte ohne Grenzen: Kontrollierte Versorgung von Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral Disease: Doctors Without Borders: Ebola Care Under Control
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is marked by 513 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths, according to the Congolese health ministry. An Ebola-infected American is being treated in a special isolation ward at Berlin's Charité on the Virchow Campus. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) considers the outbreak dramatic but manageable with controlled care, aiming to establish a treatment setting in the region. Charité epidemiologist Maximilian Gertler told RBB Inforadio that Ebola care is complex and risky but can be controlled. MSF is coordinating global teams and mobilizing PPE and equipment to improvise isolation facilities. The outbreak's regional spread is viewed as high risk due to weak infrastructure and political instability; infections are largely local and not as contagious as airborne respiratory viruses.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス疾患：国境なき医師団：エボラ出血熱の制御された治療
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（131人の疑い死亡を含む513例）、異常性、および国際的拡大リスク（ドイツでの症例確認）の複数基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「DRC and Uganda」と記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。ドイツでの症例確認は報道されているが、イベント発生地としてはDRCが主要な流行地。MSFによる制御可能性評価は肯定的だが、弱いインフラと政治的不安定性により地域的拡大リスクは高いと評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-infizierter US-Arzt in Berliner Krankenhaus angekommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected U.S. doctor arrived at a Berlin hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, an Ebola-infected U.S. physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, arrived at Berlin's Charité Hospital after a night-time landing at the military section of Berlin's airport. He and six contact persons were transported to Charité in a specialized ambulance and convoy, including decontamination vehicles. Stafford, a mission doctor living with his family in the Democratic Republic of Congo, is believed to have contracted the virus during a surgical procedure. There are six Ebola strains; the current case is the relatively rare Bundi-Budscho variant. Without medical care, about 40% of those infected die. Charité has a dedicated isolation ward prepared for such incidents, with controlled entrances, decontamination corridors, and specialized ventilation. Stafford is being treated there, and latest reports indicate his condition remains stable.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染のアメリカ人医師がベルリン病院に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な患者移送であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症の感染者は感染地（DRC）から国際的に移送されており、記事主題はDRCでの感染契機。ベルリンはドイツの医療機関であり、感染発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。稀なBundi-Budscho株であること、医療従事者の感染であること、複数の接触者がいることが重要。

article.articleHeadline: Virus se tjednima širio, otkriveno kako je sve krenulo: 'Nakon tog događaja, doživjeli smo niz smrti'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus had been spreading for weeks; it was revealed how it all began: 'After that event, we witnessed a string of deaths'.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is spreading across the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province and neighboring Uganda, prompting WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The rare Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment and carries about a one‑third fatality rate. Transmission appears linked to a large funeral procession in Bunia; authorities say spread has been ongoing since March, with first suspicious cases identified May 5 and Kinshasa lab‑confirmed on May 14, the outbreak being declared May 15. To date, more than 500 suspected cases and at least 131 deaths (including 15 from one family) have been reported; hundreds show fever and nosebleeds. Two imported cases reached Kampala, Uganda, and another case was confirmed in Goma near the Rwanda border, in a region under M23 rebel control, complicating response. Four health workers have died; the US is monitoring potential exposures.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスが数週間にわたって拡大、発生の経緯が明らかに：『その出来事の後、われわれは一連の死亡を経験した』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な株、国際的な拡大、WHOのPHEIC宣言）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。極めて高いリスク評価。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも輸入症例2例が確認されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの発生である。WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。感染者500名以上、死亡131名以上で、感染力の高い葬儀式での大規模集会が起源と報告。M23反政府勢力支配下の地域での流行が対応を複雑にしている。四人の医療従事者を含む死亡者、米国も対応を注視中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, un vaccino russo potrebbe proteggere dal ceppo Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a Russian vaccine could protect against the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Russian Ebola vaccine from the Gamaleya Research Institute may protect against the Bundibugyo strain driving the ongoing outbreak, with genetic similarity to the vaccine strain reported at 60–70%. Although untested, the vaccine is suggested to potentially confer immunity when other options are lacking, and frontline clinicians should be protected with PPE and an existing vaccine. The epicenter is eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province near the Uganda border. Congolese health authorities flagged alarms on May 5, and on May 17 the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for DRC and Uganda. The article does not provide case or death counts or additional laboratory confirmation beyond vaccine-related discussion.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ロシアワクチンがブンディブギョ株から保護する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク（DRC Ituri州）でWHOがPHEIC宣言し、IHR基準2つ以上該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済み（2026-05-17）。DRC Ituri州での確認発生。ウガンダは記事で言及されるが、サマリーでは「DRC and Uganda」との記述のみで、ウガンダでの直接的な患者発生は明記されていないため、未確認。ロシアワクチン候補についての議論が中心だが、ブンディブギョ株による実際のアウトブレイクが主題であり、シグナル価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Statele Unite vor finanța înființarea a până la 50 de clinici de răspuns la Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will fund the establishment of up to 50 Ebola response clinics.
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, the United States will fund up to 50 Ebola treatment clinics in Ebola-affected regions of the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, covering frontline care costs. These rapidly deployed clinics will establish clinical care and isolation perimeters with emergency triage, screening, and Ebola isolation. Funding will flow mainly through CERF mechanisms administered by OCHA, leveraging a record December 2025 CERF disbursement to accelerate lifesaving aid. The effort aims to expand emergency treatment capacity, strengthen field operations, and speed delivery of PPE, diagnostics, and essential health services where most needed. Experience shows rapid expansion of isolation and treatment in affected regions is critical to outbreak control. The announcement signals a firm U.S. commitment to a fast, fully funded, cooperative response with global health partners, supported by CDC collaboration to mobilize resources.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はエボラ対応クリニック最大50施設の設立に資金提供予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な対応・拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の発生とそれに対する国際的な対応メカニズムの活動化をシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事は米国資金によるDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ対応施設の設立を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク疾患であり、国際的な対応枠組み（CERF、OCHA、CDC連携）が動員されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus: 5 symptoms of this deadly virus
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has recorded 134 deaths and up to 550 active cases, with a fatality rate estimated around 50–90%. The World Health Organization director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus voiced deep concern about the outbreak’s scale and speed, noting case growth in urban areas, deaths among healthcare workers, and significant population movement. Key Ebola symptoms highlighted include: high fever (103–104 F) with severe body aches; severe headache and muscle/joint pain; extreme fatigue and weakness; persistent vomiting and diarrhea; and unexplained gum, nasal, or under-skin bleeding or bruising. The article stresses rapid progression and the importance of immediate medical care for anyone with persistent fever, headache, or related symptoms, given the outbreak’s ongoing status in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：この致命的なウイルスの5つの症状
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルスのDRC発生において、深刻な公衆衛生影響（134死亡、550活動症例、致死率50-90%）、異常性（都市部への拡大、医療従事者の死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは高致死率の感染症であり、DRCの現在の発生は世界保健機関が深刻な懸念を表明。都市部への拡大と医療従事者への影響は管理の困難さを示している。国際的な緊急対応が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola crisis deepens as deaths hit 131 and virus reaches Goma
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in 2026 has reached Goma, DR Congo, near the Rwanda border, with 131 deaths reported by 2026-05-20. There are currently no approved strain-specific vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo virus, complicating containment. WHO notes no approved Bundibugyo virus–specific vaccines or therapeutics on the global market. Effective suppression relies on disciplined community-level public-health management, particularly around funeral rites that involve washing or touching the deceased. Cross-border responses include Rwanda stepping up screening at Goma/Bukavu routes, Uganda restricting movement at a border crossing, and Nigeria monitoring to prevent spread. WHO urges emergency operations centers and rapid distribution of laboratory testing kits to border areas, while acknowledging significant uncertainties about the true number of infections and geographic spread due to insecurity, humanitarian pressures, mobility, and informal healthcare networks. The United States has moved to restrict travel from three high-risk countries, signaling growing alarm.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機が深刻化、死者131人に達しゴマに到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行で131人の死亡、ゴマへの拡大、国際的な対応措置の発動。直ちにフルRRAを実施すべき重大事象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株の大規模流行。131人の死亡、ゴマへの到達（Rwanda国境近接地）により国際的なスピルオーバーリスク急増。ワクチン・治療薬の承認製品がなく管理困難。USA・Rwanda・Uganda・Nigeria等で国境監視・渡航制限が実施されている。記事上、実際の流行地はDRC（North-Kivu Province、South Kivu Provinceを含む）に限定。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا وائرس تیزی سے پھیلنے لگا ہلاکتوں کی تعداد 131 ہوگئی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus spreads rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; death toll rises to 131.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have intensified, with the death toll reaching 131, including 26 more deaths reported recently. Foreign media describe rapid transmission, and officials warn that constrained primary healthcare facilities hinder timely identification of cases. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. The report emphasizes limited medical infrastructure and diagnostic capacity in affected areas. In response, Jordan has banned entry for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to protect the region from further spread. The developing situation underscores ongoing transmission in Central Africa and the need for escalated surveillance and international support, as authorities work to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスが急速に拡散し、死亡者数は131人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。エボラウイルスの急速な拡散と131人の死亡者、WHOによる国際的懸念の宣言、ヨルダンによる渡航禁止措置などから、フルリスク評価（RRA）対象事象と判断される。
triage.notes: WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。ジョルダンによる渡航禁止措置は対象国リストに含まれないため、検証済み位置には含めない。記事サマリーで「中央アフリカでの継続的な感染」と「ウガンダでの拡散リスク」が述べられているが、実際の発生地域としての確認がないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Echipa de fotbal a RD Congo intră în SUA, pentru Cupa Mondială, în ciuda epidemiei de Ebola - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DR Congo national football team arrives in the United States for the World Cup, despite the Ebola outbreak - ProTV News.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is described as ongoing in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and South Sudan. As of May 20, 2026, the United States tightened border health measures, barring entry for foreigners who traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within the prior 21 days. A DR Congo World Cup squad member who transited through one of these countries in the past 21 days could receive an entry exception but would undergo testing and isolation per the same protocol as US returnees from DR Congo; exemptions do not apply to Congolese fans. DR Congo’s team is based in Houston, Texas, for World Cup Group K, with matches against Portugal (June 17, Houston), Colombia (June 24, Guadalajara, Mexico), and Uzbekistan (June 28, Atlanta). The report does not specify Congolese presence in Mexico, nor provide case counts, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のサッカーチームがエボラ流行中にワールドカップで米国に入国 - ProTVニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病が複数国で流行中であり、国際的な移動（ワールドカップ参加）に伴う国際的拡大リスク、および米国の国境衛生措置強化といった異常な状況がある。IHR基準で3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、シグナル化の閾値を超える。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行も言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは対象国であり、国際的なスポーツイベント参加に伴う感染病伝播リスクが主たる焦点である。記事は具体的な症例数、死亡数、検査確認を記載していないため、重症度の詳細は不明であるが、米国の入国制限という政治的・公衆衛生的対応が既に実施されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Rules Out Blanket Ebola Quarantines As MoH Rolls Out Risk-Based Screening
article.articleSummary: Kenya will not impose blanket quarantines on travelers or truck drivers amid Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and Democratic Republic of Congo, opting for risk-based screening and enhanced surveillance under International Health Regulations and WHO guidance. The Ministry of Health says targeted monitoring aims to minimize disruption while boosting outbreak detection. Over 34,500 travellers have been screened at airports, seaports, and land borders, with a passenger surveillance system to improve monitoring of arrivals from high-risk regions. Additional interventions include population mobility mapping in areas and intensified airport surveillance in coordination with the Kenya Civil Aviation Authority. Cross-border coordination with Uganda, DRC, the East African Community, WHO, and Africa CDC will enhance information sharing and rapid response. Kenya remains Ebola-free; designated testing centres at KEMRI Nairobi and KEMRI Kisumu, the National Public Health Laboratory, and mobile labs support rapid diagnosis. Urged to use official channels and practice hygiene; dial *719# for information.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラに関する一括隔離措置を除外 保健省がリスク基準に基づくスクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域流行（ウガンダ、DRC）に対し、隣接国ケニアが国境スクリーニングと監視体制を強化している事象。IHR基準において異常性と国際拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準において流行リスクと管理可能性の課題が認められ、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ流行はウガンダ（Uganda）およびDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）で発生しており、ケニア（Kenya）はエボラ非流行国である。対象国リストではDRC（203312）が含まれるが、ケニアは対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを追加すべき。ただし、本イベントの主題はケニアの対応措置であり、DRCもウガンダも対象国外の地域である。記事はケニア国内の境界スクリーニング体制構築を述べており、実際の流行発生国はウガンダとDRCである。対象国リスト上、DRCは203312として含まれているため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Experts Warn of Increasing Frequency and Impact of Infectious Diseases Like Hantavirus and Ebola - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompt urgent responses, with 87 Ebola-related deaths reported in the DRC. In Kinshasa, protective gear reserves are depleted; a cargo plane will bring supplies from Kenya as MSF and the International Rescue Committee aid the response. A hantavirus outbreak aboard a cruise ship underscores rising infectious-disease threats. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) warns outbreaks are more frequent and damaging, driven by climate change and conflicts, while geopolitics and commercial interests hamper preparedness. It cites slow vaccine and test access—mpox vaccines took about two years to reach Africa, longer than Covid-19 vaccines—and delays from testing the wrong Ebola strain. WHO will host an urgent scientific consultation on Friday, May 22, 2026. The report calls for a permanent monitoring mechanism, a finalized pandemic treaty, and guaranteed financing for rapid, equitable responses.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスやエボラなどの感染症の頻度と影響の増加について専門家が警告 - Internewscast Journal
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、複数対象国でエボラ流行が進行中。WHOの緊急科学協議予定など国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク、ケニアからの物資供給言及があるが、DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。87人の死亡者報告、MSFと国際救援委員会の対応、WHOの5月22日の緊急科学協議予定など、多角的な対応が進行中。ハンタウイルス（クルーズ船での発生）も言及されているが、特定地域の詳細が記事に示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ŠIRENJE VIRUSA Amerikanac zaražen ebolom prebačen u bolnicu u Berlinu. Nalazi se u izolaciji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of the virus: American infected with Ebola transferred to a hospital in Berlin. He is in isolation.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola has been transferred to Berlin’s Charité hospital and admitted to a specialized isolation unit. The patient contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the outbreak is spreading rapidly, and was moved to Germany by a dedicated air transport for highly contagious patients from Uganda. German Health Minister Nina Warken stated that assisting partners is natural and that Germany maintains an effective care system for highly infectious diseases, ensuring top care while upholding strict safety measures. The United States requested Germany’s help due to shorter flight times. Charité’s isolation unit is a closed, high-security facility separated from routine hospital care to prevent contact with other patients. Ebola is an infectious, potentially deadly disease transmitted through direct contact and bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスの拡散：エボラに感染したアメリカ人がベルリンの病院に転院。隔離中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な事例報告。DRCでの流行拡大に加え、米国の患者がドイツに医療搬送された異常事象。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たしシグナル該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は、DRCで感染したエボラ患者がドイツに医療搬送された国際的な事例。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ベルリン、ドイツ、米国、ウガンダは対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの流行が拡大中であることと、国際的な患者移送という異常性により PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا... عزل ومراقبة صحية للاعبي الكونغو الديمقراطية قبل كأس العالم 2026 في هذه الحالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus... isolation and health monitoring for the Democratic Republic of the Congo's players ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in this case.
article.articleSummary: US grants an entry exception to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) national team for the 2026 FIFA World Cup amid Ebola concerns. The United States had barred non-U.S. travelers who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days. The DRC squad, the only qualifier from those countries, trained in Europe and may fall outside the ban. If players were physically inside the DRC within the last 21 days, they would undergo strict testing and health monitoring, including temporary isolation, analogous to protocols for returning U.S. citizens and permanent residents. The exemption covers players only and does not extend to DR Congo fans traveling to support the team.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス...2026年FIFAワールドカップ前のコンゴ民主共和国選手団の隔離と健康監視
triage.triage_reason: 記事は進行中の活発なエボラ流行の新規発生を報じるものではなく、既知のリスクに対する予防的な渡航・入国措置（ワールドカップ出場選手の検査・監視）に関する報道である。新規の感染症イベントシグナルではなく、スポーツイベント開催に関する行政措置の記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラに関する新規シグナルではなく、既存のDRCのエボラリスク認識に基づく2026年ワールドカップ出場選手に対する米国の予防的な入国管理措置を報じたもの。Ugandaとrepublic of Sudanは発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイク情報として言及されておらず、単に渡航制限対象国として言及されているのみであるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Aceleran científicos búsqueda de vacunas por brote de ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists accelerate vaccine search amid Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) intensifies, now the 17th outbreak there and the third caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist. More than 130 people have died, according to the WHO, and travel advisories have been issued for the region. Several vaccine and treatment candidates exist, but none have been proven in humans for Bundibugyo. The WHO will evaluate options including Ervebo, the vaccine against the Zaire strain. Virologist Thomas Geisbert has developed a one-dose Bundibugyo vaccine candidate with monkey data showing protection; however, human trials and large-scale production would be lengthy and costly, with few incentives for vaccines against less common strains. Ervebo's development history is cited, including Merck’s ~nine-month deployment during the 2014 West Africa outbreak and an estimated six-to-seven-month path for Bundibugyo. MSD notes data on non-Zaire strains are limited and not from human studies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行の中、科学者がワクチン探索を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行で130人以上の死亡、ワクチン・治療法がない株による異例の発生、国際的な渡航勧告発令。
triage.notes: アンゴラが発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ（DRC）での流行が主題であり、アンゴラの具体的な症例報告は明記されていないため除外。Bundibugyo株はエボラ出血熱の中でもワクチン・治療法がない亜種であり、公衆衛生上の深刻性が高い。WHO評価・ワクチン開発の国際的関心も明確。

article.articleHeadline: "Sur le terrain" du 19 mai 2026" : Épidémie : l'humanité en danger ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "On the Ground" (May 19, 2026): Epidemic: Is Humanity in Danger?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, Sur le terrain reports that the May 19 edition examines new global health threats as vigilance around emerging viruses intensifies after a hantavirus outbreak causing three deaths. The focus shifts to the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the Ebola virus outbreak has escalated, with more than 130 fatalities, prompting the World Health Organization to issue an alarm over a spreading threat. Hosted by Loïc de La Mornais, the broadcast frames pandemics and emerging viruses as major challenges for humanity, and provides analysis and on-set briefings to dissect risks, possible responses, and future scenarios. The episode aired 21:00–23:00 on channel 16.

triage.headline_ja: 「現地から」（2026年5月19日）：感染症：人類は危機に瀕しているか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、Ebola（130人以上の死亡）とハンタウイルス（3人死亡）による複合的な感染症の脅威が明記されている。WPRIスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例多数）、流行しやすさ、管理可能性（WHO警告発出）の複数基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Ebola（130人以上死亡）とハンタウイルス感染症（3人死亡）の複合的感染症イベント。WHOが警告を発出している点が確認される。DRCが主要な発生地であり、対象国リストに含まれる。社会的関心も高く（メディア報道・放送番組化）、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав предупредил казахстанцев о рисках за границей из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health warned Kazakhstani citizens about the risks abroad due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda have been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO director-general. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. First identified in Uganda in 2007, transmission is not airborne but occurs through close contact with blood and bodily fluids of infected people, contact with infected animals (fruit bats and primates), contaminated surfaces, or handling the body of a deceased person with Ebola. Kazakh travelers are advised to review the destination’s epidemiological situation, consider avoiding travel to countries with Bundibugyo cases, and practice hygiene measures (handwashing, antiseptics), avoid contact with bodily fluids, drink safe water, and ensure meat is well cooked. After returning, monitor health and seek medical care if symptoms develop, and report travel; self-medication is discouraged.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、エボラ流行に伴う海外渡航のリスクについてカザフスタン国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な流行で、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。複数国での発生により、IHR基準2つ以上該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行について記述されているが、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。カザフスタンはこのイベントの主体ではなく、警告発令国であるため対象国の実際の発生地として含めない。WHO PHEIC宣言による高い国際的関心と、ワクチンなし・治療法なしのBundibugyo株という特殊性が重要なシグナル要素。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Ebola - Uganda's Day of the Martyrs Postponed
article.articleSummary: Uganda postponed Uganda Martyrs' Day celebrations set for 3 June due to Ebola concerns in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, which has spread to Uganda. President Museveni announced this after consultations with the national epidemic response task force and religious leaders, citing thousands of pilgrims from eastern Congo. Ugandan Catholic Bishops welcomed the postponement and urged dioceses to observe the day in prayer, following health guidelines; the Church of Uganda supported the decision after consultations. Uganda Martyrs' Day commemorates 45 Christian converts (ages 14–50) killed 1885–1887; 22 Catholic, beatified in 1920 and canonized in 1964; millions attend at Namugongo shrine from Uganda and neighbouring countries. The Ebola outbreak began in Ituri Province, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a less common variant with no vaccines or specific treatments. By mid-May, a dozen lab-confirmed cases; hundreds of suspected cases (≈395 in DRC) and ~80–100 deaths; suspected cases reported in Kampala and Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラ - ウガンダの殉教者の日が延期される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大が確認され、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。DRCからウガンダへの越境感染、死亡例の報告、公衆衛生の深刻な影響、異常な病原体変異（Bundibugyo型）が認められ、政府レベルの対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（ワクチンなし）の感染拡大が確認。DRC東部（イトゥリ州）での約395例の疑い例と80-100例の死亡例、ウガンダのカンパラとキンシャサでも疑い例が報告されている。大規模宗教集会（ウガンダ殉教者の日）が政府措置により延期された。越境感染および国際的な関心が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola case transferred to Germany as WHO warns of border risks and conflict disruption
article.articleSummary: WHO reports an American national working in the Democratic Republic of Congo tested positive for Ebola and was transferred to Germany for treatment, CDC confirms, signaling cross-border risks as the 79th World Health Assembly discusses emergency protocols. The Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak is unfolding in a highly volatile Ituri province amid mining-driven displacement and intensified armed conflict, with over 100,000 newly displaced civilians since late 2025, severely hindering contact tracing, surveillance, and lab isolation. Uganda reports border breach by this unvaccinable Bundibugyo strain, prompting WHO to pull emergency contingency funds to manage containment across an active war zone while navigating nearly 360 million dollars in unpaid contributions at the end of 2025. With limited tools beyond non-pharmaceutical interventions, authorities emphasize risk communication, strict hospital infection control, and community-led quarantine measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者がドイツに転送される中、WHOが国境リスクと紛争混乱を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Ebola感染症の国際的拡大リスク、紛争地域での管理困難性、複数国での流行拡大の懸念がある。フルRRA対象のシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの発生地はIturi州（DRC内）で確認。ウガンダでの国境侵犯報告があるが、記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRCで発生。ドイツは患者受け入れ国であり発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。紛争・医療インフラ不備・国際患者搬送などにより WHA(第79回世界保健総会)での緊急議論対象となっている。

article.articleHeadline: TBC di Batang Masih Jadi PR Besar, Dinkes Genjot Skrining untuk Kejar Target Eliminasi 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis in Batang remains a major challenge, the Health Office steps up screening to meet the 2030 elimination target.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major health challenge in Batang Regency, Central Java, Indonesia. As of 18 May 2026, 451 TB cases were detected across health facilities and districts, with hospital facilities contributing the majority: RSUD Batang 96, RS QIM 70, RSUD Limpung 39. Primary care centers also reported notable findings: Puskesmas Bawang 29, Warungasem 23, Tulis 19, Subah 19. By patient domicile, Warungasem District records the most cases (44), followed by Bawang (41), Subah (32), Tulis (31), Batang (30), and Kandeman (28); 19 patients originate from outside Batang regency. The Health Office emphasizes intensified case finding and treatment to reach the national TB elimination target by 2030. In Central Java, Batang’s TB program performance is described as moderate. Nationally, the 2026 TB case finding target is 90%.

triage.headline_ja: バタン地域の結核は依然として大きな課題、保健局は2030年の排除目標に向けてスクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで451件の結核症例が報告され、地域レベルでは重要な公衆衛生課題であるが、国際的拡大リスクや国間の渡航・貿易制限のリスクは明確ではなく、情報不足が多い。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病性疾患であり、本事例は地域的な公衆衛生対応（国家2030年排除目標に向けたスクリーニング強化）を示しているが、新規発生や異常なクラスターの証拠は記事サマリーに含まれていない。451件の症例数の増加傾向、時系列データ、または従来と異なるパターンに関する情報がないため、シグナルレベルでの判定は控える。引き続き情報収集を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 防伊波拉 疾管署升旅遊疫情警示、發醫界通函 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Prevention: Taiwan CDC Upgrades Travel-Epidemic Warning, Issues Circular to Medical Community | United News Network
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is driving outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with nearly 400 suspected cases and over 100 deaths. WHO has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Bundibugyo, one of five Ebola species, currently lacks approved vaccines or therapeutics, unlike Zaire. Taiwan’s CDC raised travel advisories for the region to Level 2 and issued a medical circular. Transmission is primarily through contact with infected blood, body fluids, secretions, or cadavers; the first local case was a healthcare worker diagnosed after exposure in late April. Incubation can reach 21 days; travelers returning from the area should self-monitor for 21 days. Clinicians should employ TOCC screening; public guidance urges avoiding contact with suspected cases, funerals, wildlife, and to practice hand hygiene and respiratory etiquette. Imported cases cannot be ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策：台湾CDC、旅行流行警告をレベル2に引き上げ、医学界に通達を発行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言した新興エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）であり、100人以上の死亡者、複数国での発生、ワクチン・治療法欠乏の状況は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイクが主要な話題。台湾（China に含まれず）での対応事例の言及があるが、実際の発生地はDRCのみが対象国リストに該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。PHEC宣言済みのため高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: R.D. Congo - Oficiali locali avertizează că epidemia de Ebola se va agrava
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - Local officials warn that the Ebola epidemic will worsen.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, health officials in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo warn that the current Ebola outbreak will worsen before subsiding. An expert says Ebola case counts could double in the coming days. In Ituri province, where the outbreak began, Bunia, the provincial capital, sees residents maintaining distance and avoiding handshakes as a social precaution. BBC reports indicate that more than 130 people have died from Ebola to date, underscoring the severity of the situation. The article attributes the warning to local health authorities and an expert assessment, highlighting the potentially accelerating transmission dynamics in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - 地方当局がエボラ出血熱の流行が悪化すると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。既に130人以上の死亡報告があり、感染数倍増の警告により急速な拡大が予想される。国際的な関心が高い高リスク事象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の致死性疾患であり、既に130人以上の死亡者が確認されている。地方当局による公式警告により感染数が倍増する可能性が指摘されており、Ituri州Bunia市を中心とした地域での拡大傾向が懸念される。フルのRapid Risk Assessment(RRA)実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വ്യാപനം; ആശങ്കയുളവാക്കുന്നതെന്ന് ലോകാരോഗ്യസംഘടന
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spread; WHO says it is not a cause for concern.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi: WHO reports an Ebola outbreak in Congo generating concern but not a global emergency. As of now, more than 130 deaths and hundreds of infections have been reported, with 516 suspected cases under investigation. Field investigations and laboratory testing are ongoing, and case counts are expected to rise in the coming days. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is identified as driving transmission in central and eastern Africa. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told the World Health Assembly in Geneva that healthcare-associated transmission remains a key worry and that hospital and clinic settings must be prioritized with stronger infection prevention measures. Authorities urge intensified contact tracing in Congo and Uganda, enhanced laboratory capacity, and health worker training, public awareness campaigns, and containment measures. The agency has approved funding of 35 crore for outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の蔓延；世界保健機関（WHO）が懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱はコンゴで130人以上の死亡、516疑い例を伴う深刻な発生であり、ウガンダにも拡大、医療関連感染による国際的リスク、WHOによる資金承認がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ（DRC）とウガンダでのエボラ発生が主題。ニューデリーは報道地点として記載されているが、インドでの発生は明記されていない。しかし見出し翻訳に誤りの可能性があり（「not a cause for concern」と否定的表現）、サマリー本文では確実に深刻な発生と対応が記述されている。Bundibugyo Ebola virus strainの確認と中央・東アフリカでの感染が示唆する広域的リスク。医療関連感染が重点課題として強調されている点が懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Latest outbreak of Ebola in central Africa prompts global health emergency
article.articleSummary: Global health emergency declared by WHO as Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda kills 131 and has over 500 cases reported in the DRC; one confirmed death in Uganda as of Wednesday. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a rarer form with 30-50% mortality and only two prior outbreaks. No vaccine or targeted treatment exists. WHO warns under-detection; MRC Center for Global Infectious Disease Analysis models suggest the outbreak could be larger than currently known, possibly over 1,000 cases. Common symptoms include headaches, muscle soreness, fatigue, and internal bleeding; transmission via contact with infected bodily fluids. The scarcity of test kits and treatments complicates containment. The Bundibugyo strain is less studied than the Zaire strain, which caused many cases in 2014-2016. The outbreak centers in Central Africa, with ongoing spread between DRC and Uganda, prompting the global emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ最新流行が世界保健緊急事態を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOによる世界保健緊急事態宣言、131名の死亡、500例以上の報告、稀なBundibugyo株（致死率30-50%）、ワクチン・標的治療の欠如、DRCとウガンダでの国際的な拡大により、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているDRCとウガンダでの発生を対象国リストと照合した結果、DRC(203312)のみが対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダ(226074)はBluedot APIの発生地域には含まれているが、対象国リストに存在しないため除外すべきところ、サマリーで明示的に「Uganda kills 131 and has over 500 cases」と記述されており、ウガンダでの確認死亡例があるため、発生国としての検証が必要。ただし、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Considers Using Experimental Ebola Vaccine in Response to Exponential Rise of Deaths in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak in eastern DRC and Uganda has killed at least 131 people and infected more than 500 suspected cases as of 20 May 2026. The outbreak began in Ituri province in late April, with confirmed cases in Mongbwalu and Rwampara and now in Goma, extending into Uganda. Uganda has reported two cases, including one death, linked to travel from the DRC. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 17 May and is considering experimental vaccines, since no approved vaccines or specific treatments exist for Bundibugyo. A funeral-associated superspreader event in Bunia is suspected to have amplified transmission. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected fluids; misdiagnosis and conflict-driven displacement hinder detection. Response includes emergency teams, expanded treatment centers, intensified contact tracing, Uganda border screening, and regional traveler monitoring; an American medical worker infected in the DRC was evacuated to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCとウガンダの死亡者数の指数関数的増加への対応として実験的エボラワクチンの使用を検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス・ブンディブギョ株の多国間アウトブレイク、WHOがPHEIC宣言、死亡者131名以上、国際的拡大リスク高、渡航制限可能性がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にドイツが含まれているが、これはウイルス感染者の医療搬送先であり、実際の流行地はDRC（イトゥリ州）およびウガンダ。WHOがPHEIC宣言（5月17日）済みで、実験的ワクチン使用を検討中。葬儀関連のスーパースプレッダーイベントによる急速な伝播が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dans la presse - En RDC, une "course contre la montre" face au virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the press - In the DRC, a 'race against the clock' to confront the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo triggers a World Health Organization alert over its scale and speed, with more than 130 deaths suspected. Responders confront Bundibugyo, a poorly understood strain, prioritizing community engagement and adherence to barrier measures while awaiting reinforcements and potential vaccine deployment. The Guardian notes urgency could lead to use of vaccines or experimental medicines. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, co-discoverer of Ebola, warns the struggle will require enormous effort and stresses securing funeral ceremonies to prevent transmission if health workers fall ill. Coverage underscores global concerns about preparedness for future zoonoses and the need for adequate funding and health-system responses in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: プレスより - コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスとの「時間との戦い」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。130人超の死亡疑い例、Bundibugyo株という理解不足の株の流行、WHO警報発令、国際支援必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ発生を主題としており、DRCはWHO警報を発令。Bundibugyo株は理解が不足しており、130人超の死亡疑い例が報告されている。ワクチン展開やコミュニティ関与の検討が進行中。エボラの共同発見者Jean-Jacques Muyembeも対応の困難さを強調しており、対象国リストには含まれないが、アフリカの公衆衛生準備状況への国際的な懸念も表明されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gefahr für andere besteht nicht: An Ebola erkrankter US-Amerikaner wird in Berliner Charité behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no danger to others: An American infected with Ebola is being treated at Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: One US citizen infected with Ebola is being treated at Berlin's Charité University Hospital in a high-containment isolation ward. The patient contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and was transported from Uganda, arriving before 3:00. Germany’s Health Ministry and Nina Warken stressed there is no danger to the public and that the patient will receive best care under strict safety controls. Charité’s Sonderisolierstation is Germany’s largest unit and the only facility combining infectious disease and intensive care; it can isolate up to 20 patients and operates as a closed system. Safeguards include wastewater in tanks, disposal of contaminated waste by a dedicated company, and exhaust air filtered by two systems. Diagnostics and complex blood tests occur in a lab near the Robert Koch Institute. Ebola spreads mainly through direct contact with infected body fluids and often begins with flu-like or diarrheal symptoms, potentially progressing to multi-organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: 他者への危険はない：エボラに感染したアメリカ人がベルリンのシャリテ病院で治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症は高リスク病原体であり、DRCでの感染から米国・ドイツへの国際移動がある。ただし記事は厳格な隔離対応と公開情報であり、管理可能性は高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ感染は DRC で発生し、Uganda 経由で Germany（Berlin）に搬送された国際的な医療移送事例。対象国リストでは DRC のみ該当。ドイツと米国での治療対応は既に実施中で、公開情報として管理下にある。Charité の高度隔離設備が稼働し、リスク軽減されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, hantavirus... Face au risque de pandémie, ces deux alertes révèlent que le monde reste mal préparé, selon une experte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Hantavirus... Facing the risk of a pandemic, these two alerts reveal that the world remains poorly prepared, according to an expert.
article.articleSummary: Two concurrent alerts—Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and hantavirus on the MV Hondius cruise ship in the Atlantic—underscore that pandemic risk remains poorly managed. Former New Zealand prime minister and pandemic panel co-chair Helen Clark said the International Health Regulations have improved the response, but upstream risk identification, surveillance, and early detection still lag. Since the May 15 alert for a new Ebola outbreak in the DRC, and the hantavirus case aboard MV Hondius, which killed three people, responses have been reasonably effective. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant appears to have caused over 130 deaths in a remote DRC province, with testing for another strain negative, leaving questions about duration and detection of spread for 4–6 weeks. Clark calls for a thorough investigation of event chains and stronger risk-based preparedness. She attributes weak prevention to global aid cuts that strain poorer countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルス…パンデミックのリスクに直面して、これら2つのアラートは世界がまだ準備不足であることを明らかにしている（専門家の意見）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の高リスク感染症（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）の同時発生アラートであり、パンデミック対応体制の不備を指摘する国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: New Zealand is mentioned only in reference to former PM Helen Clark's expert opinion, not as an actual disease outbreak location. MV Hondius cruise ship incident (3 deaths) involves hantavirus but is occurring in Atlantic waters. Primary verified outbreak location is DRC (Bundibugyo Ebola variant with 130+ deaths). This represents a significant multi-threat alert warranting full RRA.

article.articleHeadline: Ебола:Американски лекар заразен во Конго се лекува во Берлин
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: An American doctor infected in the Congo is being treated in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is being treated at Berlin's Charité hospital. He contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus and arrived in Berlin after a night transport organized from Uganda using a high-containment aircraft; six high-risk contacts were also brought to Germany. Charité's isolation unit is a secure facility with negative-pressure ventilation and can treat up to 20 patients. Germany pledged support after a U.S. request citing shorter flight times and Ebola treatment experience. The outbreak is centered in the DRC's Ituri province; Rwanda has closed its eastern border, and Uganda reports two cases. The World Health Organization has convened an emergency committee; discussions include available vaccine candidates for rapid deployment, though no vaccine or therapy exists for Bundibugyo. As of now, there are 30 lab-confirmed cases and 134 deaths in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: コンゴで感染したアメリカ人医師がベルリンで治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認死亡数134、複数国への波及、国際的医療支援実施がある。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地域にはドイツ・米国・ルワンダ・ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリー上で実際の流行はDRC（Ituri州）が震源地であり、他国は患者移送先または周辺対応国である。したがって verified_locations は対象国リストの DRC のみ。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスという稀な株で、30確認例134死亡という高い致命率が記録されている。WHO緊急委員会が開催され、国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: নেই ওষুধ, নেই ভ্যাকসিন! করোনার পর মারাত্মক আকার নিতে চলেছে 'ইবোলা'! বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থার রেড অ্যালার্ট জারি
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: No Medicine, No Vaccine! After Coronavirus, Ebola Is Set to Take a Deadly Form. World Health Organization Has Issued a Red Alert.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak is described with WHO issuing its highest red alert. The article stresses that there is no approved medicine or vaccine. It flags Africa's Congo and Uganda as the epicenters under threat and warns that India faces heightened risk due to ongoing international travel. Ebola is portrayed as a silent killer: fever followed by severe bleeding from eyes, nose, and skin, with organ failure leading to death. It is not airborne; transmission occurs through contact with infected blood, saliva, sweat, or tears. The piece emphasizes that proximity is dangerous even at a distance, given cross-border travel. Preventive advice centers on careful handwashing, avoiding wild-animal contact and risky consumption, and steering clear of panic or misinformation on social media. No routine masking or medications are required unless symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：薬もワクチンもない！コロナ後、エボラが致命的な形をとろうとしている。世界保健機関が赤色警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性の懸念あり。アフリカでのエボラ流行で、インドへの波及リスク警告という国際的懸念事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ・ウガンダが震源地として言及され、インドが波及リスク地域として警告されている。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事がWHOの「赤色警報」を引用していることは、公式確認を要する（一部センセーショナリズムの可能性も考慮）。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള രോഗവ്യാപനത്തിന്റെ വ്യാപ്തി ആശങ്കപ്പെടുത്തുന്നത്, രോഗികൾ ഇനിയും കൂടും- ലോകാരോഗ്യസംഘടന
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The extent of Ebola transmission is alarming; the number of patients will continue to rise - World Health Organization.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces alarming Ebola transmission driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported over 130 deaths and hundreds of infections, with 516 suspected cases to date. Bundibugyo is one of six Ebola lineages (Zaire, Sudan, Tai Forest, Reston, Bombali) and has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, making control exceptionally challenging. Health worker infections and hospital-based transmission highlight the need for strengthened infection prevention. The WHO has approved 35 crore in funding to bolster control, surveillance, and laboratory capacity, and calls for intensified contact tracing with Congo, Uganda, and neighbors, expanded testing, staff training, and rapid isolation of cases. Guidance also includes restricting international travel for infected or exposed individuals and enforcing border measures. Incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, and bleeding, with potential liver/kidney failure. Past outbreaks: 2014–2016 West Africa (>28,600 cases); 2018–2020 DR Congo (~2,300 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の感染拡大が懸念される、患者数はさらに増加する見込み - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による稀な株によるエボラ流行であり、130人以上の死亡、516人の疑い患者、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続、ワクチン・治療薬なし、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダ・隣国への波及）、国際渡航制限ガイダンス発出などが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてDR Congo（DRC）が主要な発生地であることが明記されている。ウガンダおよびアンゴラは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー内ではウガンダは隣国への波及リスク（contact tracing with Congo, Uganda, and neighbors）として言及されており、実際の発生事例の記述は見当たらない。アンゴラについてはサマリー内に全く言及がない。したがってverified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は6種のエボラウイルス系統の中でも稀で、ライセンス取得済みワクチンと特異的治療法が存在しないことが重大な懸念材料である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert: US Missionary Being Transferred To Germany, CDC Confirms
article.articleSummary: A U.S. citizen who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is en route to Germany for treatment, with admission planned at Berlin's Charite University Hospital. The patient, Peter Stafford, is being transferred while six contacts travel to Europe and will be quarantined during monitoring; one will go to the Czech Republic and the others to Germany. Outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain in eastern DRC, which has killed 131 people and prompted a WHO public health emergency. Genetic testing indicates current diagnostic assays can detect this strain. The U.S. CDC says the risk to the United States remains low and has issued entry restrictions for travelers from or through the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan in the past 21 days. Africa CDC criticizes these curbs. CDC offices in DRC and Uganda support tracking, testing and sequencing, with plans to deploy experts and coordinate with FIFA on safety.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：米国の宣教師がドイツに転院、CDCが確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な患者転送イベントであり、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」の複数基準に該当。公式な公衆衛生緊急事態（WHO）宣言と関連し、複数国間の患者移動・接触者追跡が進行中。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ患者の国際転送が主要なイベント。Bundibugyo株は稀系統で、東DRCで131名の死亡が報告されている。WHO公式の公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み。接触者6名がヨーロッパ（ドイツ、チェコ）に移動・隔離される計画。CDCによる渡航制限措置（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン出発者）が発出されている。記事ではドイツ・チェコへの転送が記述されているが、対象国リストにはこれらの国が含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Hyundai Bioscience: "Able to Supply Antiviral Drug in Event of Ebola or Hantavirus Spread" | Taiwan News | May. 20, 2026 13:57
article.articleSummary: Seoul, South Korea, May 20, 2026 — Hyundai Bioscience announced on May 19 that XAFTY®, its broad-spectrum antiviral based on niclosamide, can supply clinical-trial doses in response to global concerns over Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks. The company can immediately provide products in stock to the World Health Organization or affected countries upon request. It notes prior reports of niclosamide’s inhibitory effects against Ebola and hantavirus. In Vietnam, XAFTY® is in a Phase 2 trial for dengue fever with no adverse events reported to date. The firm argues XAFTY® could be an effective alternative in a scenario where two viruses spread simultaneously. Hyundai Bioscience is a member of the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium (MCDC), a U.S. Department of Defense–supported group, and will actively cooperate in international public health crises.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス：「エボラ出血熱またはハンタウイルス拡大の際には抗ウイルス薬を供給可能」
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重大感染症（エボラ、ハンタウイルス、デング熱）が言及されているが、記事の主体は企業による治療薬供給発表であり、実際のアウトブレイク事例の報告ではない。情報が予防的・仮定的であるため、実際の流行状況の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は製薬企業による抗ウイルス薬供給能力の発表であり、実際のアウトブレイク報告ではない。ベトナムではXAFTY®がデング熱のPhase 2試験中。エボラとハンタウイルスについては「グローバルな懸念」への対応として言及されているが、具体的な発生地域や規模の記載がない。韓国（ソウル）は企業所在地として記載されているが、感染症イベントの発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Red Cross Society seeks manpower for Ebola responses
article.articleSummary: Uganda Red Cross Society seeks manpower boost for Ebola Virus Disease response amid an outbreak in a neighboring Democratic Republic of Uganda with at least 131 fatalities as of 2026-05-20. In Uganda, two imported Ebola cases confirmed; 127 health workers and contacts quarantined. Bundibugyo Ebola strain prompts beefed-up safety measures, with public events suspended or under guidelines. URCS plans to engage Makerere University College of Health Sciences and College of Humanities and Social Sciences post-graduates to bolster screening at borders, community surveillance, safe isolation, and dignified burials—interventions already reactivated. Ebola preventive activities are ongoing in border districts Kisoro and Koboko and in high-risk Kampala Metropolitan, where the first Ebola death occurred. A Memorandum of Understanding signing aims to strengthen collaboration in research, education, and humanitarian service delivery; Makerere’s Prof Henry Alinaitwe pledged support.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ赤十字社がエボラ対応のための人員増強を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例（ウガンダで2例、隣国DRCで131名以上の死亡）があり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度（死亡・隔離多数）」「長期曝露リスク」「流行性（ヒト-ヒト感染性、対策不十分時期）」に該当し、政府・国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの対応活動について述べているが、実際の発生地は「隣国民主共和国」（DRC）が主要な流行地であり、ウガンダは輸入症例と国境地帯での確認・警戒段階。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）は重篤度が高く、公開情報における国際的関心も顕著。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Imperial Analysis Suggests Congo Ebola Outbreak Undercounted
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo may exceed 800 cases, far surpassing reported figures, according to a joint analysis by Imperial College London and the World Health Organization. The analysis, based on case data collected through Saturday, found the outbreak was likely undercounted, with true infection counts higher than public tallies. The findings emphasize gaps in surveillance and reporting that can hinder timely understanding of transmission and appropriate allocation of resources in the DRC. The work by the two institutions highlights the need for strengthened data collection and transparent reporting to characterize outbreak scale and guide public health responses. Published May 20, 2026, the analysis adds urgency to ongoing Ebola response efforts in the country.

triage.headline_ja: WHO-インペリアル大学による分析がコンゴエボラ感染者数の過小計上を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスは致死率が高く、対象国DRCでの感染者数が過小計上されている懸念は重大な感染症危機管理上の課題である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ感染者数が800件を超える可能性があると指摘されており、公式統計との乖離が問題。イギリスの発生地域（England、London）はWHOとインペリアル大学による分析の実施地であり、感染症発生地ではないため除外。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يعود من جديد.. قصة الفيروس القاتل الذي أرعب العالم منذ 1976
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Returns Again: The Story of the Deadly Virus That Has Terrorized the World Since 1976.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, first identified in 1976 in two Central African regions, remains one of the deadliest viral hemorrhagic diseases, spreading via contact with body fluids and causing fever and bleeding among severe symptoms. The worst outbreak occurred in 2014–2016 in West Africa, killing more than 11,000 people. In recent years, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has faced renewed Ebola waves, especially in its eastern provinces. The World Health Organization has warned of cross-border transmission risks and urged the international community to provide urgent support to national health authorities to contain outbreaks and curb transmission. The report highlights Ebola as an ongoing global health threat and the need for surveillance, rapid response, and sustained international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが再び：1976年以来、世界を恐怖に陥れた致命的ウイルスの物語
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが明確。DRCでの再燃と国際的な懸念が継続する状況は、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの歴史的背景と現況を扱う戦略記事。サマリーではDRCの最近の波状再燃、WHO警告による越境感染リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確に述べられている。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーの主題はDRCに限定されるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。2014-2016の西アフリカ大流行の言及は背景情報。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death News : 131 लोगों की मौत, WHO ने की इमरजेंसी मीटिंग; तेजी से फैलने को लेकर चिंतित | Ebola Death News 131 Deaths Who Emergency Meeting Worry About Scale And Speed Of Ebola Outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Death News: 131 People Died, WHO Held an Emergency Meeting; Worried About the Scale and Speed of the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompted the World Health Organization to hold an emergency meeting on Tuesday amid concerns over the scale and speed of transmission. DRC Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said the death toll has risen to about 131, with suspected cases numbering 513; some media reports put deaths at 134. The report highlights rising international concern as authorities monitor ongoing transmission in the affected region. The WHO meeting underscores urgency for rapid response, surveillance, and containment measures in the DRC to address the escalating fatalities and suspected case load.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者131人、WHO緊急会議開催；エボラアウトブレイクの規模と感染速度について懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する致命的感染症（エボラ）の大規模アウトブレイク。131人の死亡、513の疑似症例、WHOによる緊急会議開催、国際的懸念の急速な拡大が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。死亡率の高さ、確認された多数の死亡者、疑似症例数、WHOによる緊急会議開催、国際的懸念の高まりなど、すべての重大リスク指標が満たされている。ただし記事が2026年配信となっているため、日付の妥当性について確認を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Hyundai Bioscience: "Able to Supply Antiviral Drug in Event of Ebola or Hantavirus Spread"
article.articleSummary: Seoul, South Korea, May 20, 2026 — Hyundai Bioscience announced on May 19 that it can supply clinical-trial doses of its broad-spectrum antiviral XAFTY in response to Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks. If the WHO or affected nations request support, it can immediately provide products currently in stock. XAFTY's main ingredient niclosamide has been reported to inhibit Ebola and hantavirus. In the ongoing Phase 2 trial of XAFTY for dengue fever in Vietnam, no adverse events have been reported. Hyundai Bioscience, a member of the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium (MCDC), said it will actively cooperate with international public health crises and that XAFTY could serve as an effective alternative where two viruses spread simultaneously. The company also highlighted collaboration with U.S. DoD-supported MCDC efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス：「エボラウイルスまたはハンタウイルスの感染拡大時に抗ウイルス薬を供給可能」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は企業の医薬品供給声明であり、実際のアウトブレイク報告ではない。IHR基準を満たさず、シグナル検出の対象外。
triage.notes: 記事内容は仮想的な感染症シナリオへの企業の対応能力についての声明であり、現在進行中の実際のアウトブレイク報告ではない。ベトナムで進行中のデング熱第2相臨床試験が言及されているが、これは臨床試験であってアウトブレイク報告ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Risques de pandémie: Ebola et l'hantavirus montrent que le monde demeure mal préparé, selon une experte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pandemic risks: Ebola and hantavirus show that the world remains ill-prepared, according to an expert.
article.articleSummary: As of May 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the rare hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius in the Atlantic highlight ongoing gaps in pandemic preparedness, according to expert Helen Clark. She notes that while the International Health Regulations are functioning and responses have been relatively effective, the core work remains upstream—risk-based preparedness, threat identification, and surveillance and early detection. The hantavirus strain detected on the Hondius is endemic to the Argentine region from which the ship departed, with three deaths reported, and a confirmed Ebola case in an American national is also noted. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant is suspected to have caused over 130 deaths in a remote DRC province; tests on another Ebola strain were negative, raising questions about four-to-six weeks of undetected spread. Clark warns that cuts in international aid weaken prevention, urging renewed global solidarity and funding to prepare for and respond to imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミックのリスク：エボラとハンタウイルスは世界が準備不足であることを示しており、専門家によると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラの多数の死亡と、ハンタウイルスの船舶でのクラスターという複数の異常イベントが同時報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際のイベント発生地はDRC（Bundibugyo Ebola変種の130以上の死亡）と大西洋での船舶（ハンタウイルス3死）。米国在住者の確定例とアルゼンチン由来のハンタウイルスが記述されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。本記事は専門家による準備不足についての警告論説であり、複数の感染症イベント（エボラとハンタウイルス）の同時報告は国際的に懸念を呼ぶレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Sampah yang Tak Terkelola di Bantargebang Potensial Jadi Sarang Penularan Hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unmanaged waste in Bantargebang could become a breeding ground for hantavirus transmission.
article.articleSummary: Bantargebang Integrated Waste Management Site (TPST) in Bekasi, Indonesia, is identified as a high risk for orthohantavirus transmission due to unmanaged waste attracting rats. Waste-picking workers are the most vulnerable, as rats contaminate waste with urine, feces, and saliva, potentially creating inhaled exposure. Antibody surveys suggest rodent hantavirus circulation where sanitation is poor; a 2014 Semarang study found two human hantavirus infections and that 12% of captured rats were seropositive, with rat density about 21% of traps, exceeding the Health Ministry standard of less than 1%. Seoul virus in Rattus norvegicus can mutate when jumping to Rattus tanezumi. Human-to-human spread is less common; primary transmission is aerosol exposure to contaminated excreta and rat-to-rat interactions. Other high-risk groups include cleaners, garbage, warehouse and port workers, farmers, and people in flood-prone or enclosed dirty environments.

triage.headline_ja: バンタルゲバンにおける未管理の廃棄物がハンタウイルス感染の温床となる可能性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのベカシ市におけるハンタウイルス感染リスク環境の報告。現在の実症例ではなく潜在的リスク評価であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性、感染可能性、管理可能性）で1つ以上該当するが、確定情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 記事は未管理廃棄物サイトでのハンタウイルス感染リスク評価が主題。実際の集団発生事例ではなく、環境リスク要因分析であるため、IHR基準での重大度判定は困難。WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露リスク（廃棄物処理作業者の継続的曝露）、流行可能性（密集環境での齧歯類とヒト接触）、管理可能性（不十分な衛生管理）が該当。過去の実例（2014年セマランの2例）が引用されているが、現在のアクティブな発生報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo dịch Ebola gia tăng tại CHDC Congo năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of a rising Ebola outbreak in DR Congo in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo escalates, with at least 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths since the epidemic began; 30 confirmed infections reported in Ituri province, in the northeast. Uganda records 1 case and 1 death in Kampala; a U.S. citizen tested positive and was transferred to Germany. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that numbers may rise as surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory testing expand. On May 17, he declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and an Emergency Committee was slated to meet on May 19 to advise control measures. Urban cases and healthcare worker infections raise concerns about transmission in clinics and densely populated areas. Ituri has faced intensified conflict since late 2025, displacing over 100,000 people. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing high fever, vomiting, and bleeding, with past mortality around 50% (range 25–90%).

triage.headline_ja: WHO、2026年にコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大していることを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言した国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、United States、Germanyも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行。Uganda（カンパラで1例1死亡）、US市民、ドイツへの転院は二次的な情報。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Qué tan preocupante es el brote de ébola que ya ha causado la muerte de más de 100 personas en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How concerning is the Ebola outbreak that has already killed more than 100 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026 — The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak with over 100 deaths, prompting the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which little is known, with an estimated fatality around 30% and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Initial tests have yielded negative results, highlighting diagnostic challenges. Transmission begins from wildlife reservoirs (fruit bats, porcupines, chimpanzees) and spreads through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated surfaces. The crisis occurs in a war-torn region, with about 5 million internally displaced (including 2.5 million children) and 15 million needing humanitarian aid, complicating response. Past outbreaks in Uganda and DRC (2007, 2012) showed case fatality roughly 30–50%. Cross-border surveillance with Uganda and Rwanda is urged; some countries have restricted travel from the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行により100人以上が死亡—コンゴ民主共和国での懸念の程度は
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、100人以上の死亡、複数国への越境リスク、旅行制限の実施が確認される。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する重篤なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主たる発生地はDRC（100人以上死亡）と明記されており、Uganda・Rwandaは越境監視対象国として言及されているが、これらの国では確認事例が記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、有効なワクチンや特定治療がなく、致死率約30%と高い。戦争地帯での流行で人道支援を必要とする脆弱な環境にあり、国際的対応が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Pertama Kali Dilaporkan 1976, Kini Kongo Kembali Hadapi 246 Kasus Suspek
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola first reported in 1976; now Kongo faces 246 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, first reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in 1976, remains a recurring threat. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) involved 28,610 cases and 11,308 deaths (case fatality rate 39%). A separate 2018–2020 outbreak occurred in the DRC; both were declared WHO public health emergencies of international concern (PHEIC). As of 15 May 2026, health authorities in the DRC and Africa CDC reported a new outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. Up to 15 May 2026, 246 suspected cases (including 8 laboratory-confirmed) in Ituri Province with 80 deaths (CFR 32.5%); in Uganda, two confirmed cases with one death were reported. On 19 May 2026, the Ministry of Health issued Circular SR.03.01/C/2783/2026 on Ebola preparedness. The circular notes Ebola is caused by viruses in genus Orthoebolavirus, family Filoviridae, with three commonly outbreak-causing species: Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV), Sudan virus (SUDV), Bundibugyo virus (BDBV).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、1976年に初めて報告され、現在コンゴは246の疑似症例に直面している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。複数国での確認、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、WHOのPHEIC宣言対象の疾患。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク（2026年5月）。DRCのイトゥリ州で246疑似症例（8確認例）、80死亡（CFR 32.5%）。ウガンダでも2確認例1死亡報告。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WHOのPHEIC基準を満たす重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде более 100 человек поместили на карантин из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, more than 100 people were placed under quarantine due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Over 100 people in Uganda have been placed under quarantine to curb an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). They’re under observation at an undisclosed location, with symptoms monitored by medical staff. Alan Kasudja, Uganda Media Centre executive director and Ebola response coordinator, said the group exceeds 100 and that experienced doctors are managing care; the situation is under control, and Uganda stresses its prior experience with Ebola, COVID-19, and HIV/AIDS. Ebola hemorrhagic fever is a rare but highly lethal disease transmitted through direct contact with blood, secretions, or tissues of infected individuals or animals; Bundibugyo virus is one Ebola strain causing severe disease in humans. Separately, the WHO reported a new Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo on May 7; by May 16 there were eight lab-confirmed BDBV cases, 246 probable cases, and 80 probable deaths. Earlier, two Congolese arrivals were detected in Kampala, one of whom died, prompting a nationwide ban on handshakes. As of May 20, 2026, WHO chief Tedros warns of rapid spread, with about 500 probable cases and 130 probable deaths since the outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ出血熱の流行により100人以上が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、複数国（ウガンダ、DRC）での確認、国際的な拡大リスク、高い死亡率が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus (BDBV)株によるエボラ出血熱の流行。ウガンダでは100人以上が隔離中、DRCでは500例の疑い例と130例の疑い死亡が報告されている。WHOトップが急速な拡大を警告しており、複数国での患者検出、高い致死率、人間接触の制限措置が講じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola stigla u Europu: pacijent iz Afrike prebačen u izolaciju u Berlin - Dnevno.hr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Has Arrived in Europe: A Patient from Africa Transferred to Isolation in Berlin - Dnevno.hr
article.articleSummary: Ebola has arrived in Europe as a patient infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was transferred to an isolation unit in Berlin, Germany. The individual, transported from Uganda to Berlin by a specialized aircraft for highly contagious patients, is being treated in a Charité hospital isolation unit that is fully separated from the general hospital system to prevent contact with others. German Health Minister Nina Warken stated that Germany has an effective system for highly infectious diseases and the patient will receive the best possible care under strict safety measures; authorities reportedly requested U.S. assistance for the expedited flight. Ebola is a highly contagious, life-threatening viral disease transmitted through physical contact and bodily fluids, with the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo described as rapidly spreading.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがヨーロッパに到達：アフリカからの患者がベルリンの隔離病棟に転送される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大（DRC→ウガンダ→ドイツ）が確認され、IHR基準3項目該当。死亡率の高い感染症の海外感染事例の発生により、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで感染し、ウガンダ経由でドイツ（ベルリン）に搬送された事例について述べている。対象国はDRCのみ。エボラの高い致死率、DRCでの急速な感染拡大、国際的な患者移送、米国の支援要請など、複数の重大なシグナルが示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Specijalnim vozilom prevezen do bolnice: Lekar zaražen ebolom stigao u Evropu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transported to hospital by a special vehicle: Doctor infected with Ebola arrived in Europe.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor, Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola in the Congo and was evacuated to Europe for treatment.
