He and six contacts—likely including his family—were flown to Berlin Brandenburg Airport and then transported by a large convoy with police escort to Charité hospital in Berlin. The hospital’s Virhov Clinic houses a dedicated isolation unit with capacity for up to 20 patients, private access, airlocks, specialized ventilation/filtration, and a closed wastewater system. Germany’s Health Ministry stated there is no public or other-patient risk; the patient will be treated in full isolation on the special ward. The Congo Health Ministry reports 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 presumed deaths. Ebola is transmitted via physical contact and bodily fluids. A historical note references the 2014–2015 Zaire outbreak in West Africa, which claimed over 11,000 lives.

triage.headline_ja: 特殊車両で運搬：エボラに感染した医師がヨーロッパに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な患者移送であり、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。高い社会的・政治的関心が見込まれる重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは発生地域としてドイツ（Berlin、Brandenburg）を含めているが、記事サマリーはエボラ発症地がコンゴであり、ドイツは患者が治療を受ける目的地であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国での検査報告可能性があるが、記事サマリーでは明言されていないため含めない。WPRO対象地域外だが、IHR基準の重大性とDRCの流行状況（513例疑い、131例死亡）により緊急シグナルとして扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient zur Behandlung nach Berlin gebracht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient brought to Berlin for treatment.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient, a U.S. citizen who worked as a physician in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), was transported to Germany for treatment. After initial care in Uganda following infection in the DRC, he arrived at Berlin Brandenburg Airport and was moved under strict security to the Charité hospital's special isolation ward for highly infectious diseases. The transfer, reportedly requested by U.S. authorities due to shorter transport time and personnel experience, underscores international coordination. Charité emphasizes rigorous safety and hygiene protocols to prevent virus spread; for the public, no increased risk is indicated. Ebola can cause high fever, bleeding, and severe organ dysfunction and is transmitted through direct contact with body fluids. Ongoing outbreak in the DRC and Uganda has caused about 130 deaths as of May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者の治療のためベルリンに搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国にまたがるエボラ患者の国際移送であり、DRC およびウガンダでの進行中の流行が報告されている。
triage.notes: 本シグナルは対象国のうちDRCで進行中のエボラ流行に関するものであり、ピックアップ対象。記事はドイツでの患者受け入れについても述べているが、DRCおよびウガンダでの流行が主題。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めていない。米国市民の患者移送という国際的側面が強調されており、複数国間での感染症危機管理の事例として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Liberia: 'Regional Connectivity and Population Movement Put Liberia at Heightened Risk'  --  NPHIL Boss Alerts Over Congo Ebola Virus Crisis - FrontPageAfrica
article.articleSummary: Liberia has no confirmed Ebola cases and no active outbreak, but Acting NPHIL Director-General Dr. Sia Wata Camanor warned that Liberia remains at heightened risk amid Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Liberia is boosting preparedness with surveillance, event-based and routine monitoring, community engagement, rumor tracking, and reporting, plus strengthened port health and border surveillance with screening at airports, seaports, and land borders. Collaboration with immigration and security agencies and engagement with border communities are emphasized, with formalized Points of Entry personnel deemed urgent. Laboratory readiness includes trained personnel, improved specimen collection and transport, and heightened biosafety measures. NPHIL reports over 200 field epidemiologists across 78 of 98 districts, a functioning Incident Management System, and response teams. Public communication is prioritized; citizens are urged to report unusual illness and seek early medical care. Liberia’s past experiences with Ebola, COVID-19, Mpox, Lassa fever, and measles underpin preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: リベリア：『地域的な接続性と人口移動がリベリアを高いリスクにさらす』──NPHIL責任者がコンゴエボラウイルス危機について警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ活動に関連し、隣国リベリアが準備態勢を強化している状況。確認事例はないが地域的リスク評価である。情報不足（DRCとUgandaの具体的な流行規模が不明）のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はリベリアの準備態勢とDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ活動に言及しているが、DRCとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。対象国リストに該当する検証済み位置はDRCのみ。ウガンダの記事主題での言及は対象外。リベリアも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。現在のところ確認症例がないため、WATCHレベルの判定としたが、DRCでの具体的な流行規模や症例数が不明であるため、追加情報により判定変更の可能性がある。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Top 5 Stories Of The Day | WHO Raises Alarm Over Fast-Spreading Ebola Outbreak in Congo " YNaija
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, eastern Congo faces a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Suspected deaths are at least 134 and more than 500 probable cases; WHO confirms 30 laboratory-confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Officials say the outbreak circulated for weeks because early tests focused on a more common Ebola strain and yielded negative results. Congo is awaiting experimental vaccines from the United States and Britain. Neighboring Uganda has reported infections linked to travellers from Congo, including a death in Kampala. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has raised alarm over the rapid spread, highlighting diagnostic challenges and the need for vaccines and containment to prevent cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 本日トップ5ニュース | WHO、コンゴでの急速に広がるエボラ出血熱の流行に警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ重篤感染症で、複数国への国境越え感染が確認されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴでの流行が主題。ウガンダ（Kampala）での感染事例も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国・英国は実験的ワクチン供給源として言及されているが、発生地ではないため除外。WHO事務局長による警告表明など、国際的な注視度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）曾暴发十余次埃博拉疫情，为何谭德塞此次"深感担忧"？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo has experienced more than ten Ebola outbreaks; why is Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus this time deeply concerned?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centers in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), near the Uganda border, with spread to Goma and two Uganda-imported cases in Kampala (one death). As of May 19, DRC reports 131 deaths among 513 suspected cases; laboratory-confirmed deaths may be higher as investigations continue. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, with concern over its scale and rapid spread. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Existing vaccines and therapies (Ervebo for Zaire ebolavirus; Zabdeno/Mvabea; Inmazeb; Ebanga) are not proven for Bundibugyo. Experimental vaccines (Oxford/Mrna) are in early development. Initial detection delays, limited local testing (only Zaïre-detectable strain) and cross-border movement raise concerns of underreporting; estimates suggest actual infections may exceed 1,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国は十数回のエボラ出血熱の流行を経験したことがあるが、テドロス事務局長が今回「深刻な懸念」を示す理由は？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の高い死亡率と規模、国境を越えた拡大と海外症例、PHEIC宣言による渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。5月17日WHO PHEIC宣言の重要な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの輸入症例（Kampala）も記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生にあり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。PHEIC宣言済みで国際関心極めて高い。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株であり既存ワクチンの効果が確認されていない点が懸念される。実際の感染者数が過少報告されている可能性。

article.articleHeadline: WHO records over 500 suspected Ebola cases in DRC amid diagnostic delays
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: WHO records more than 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with only 30 laboratory-confirmed cases to date. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there are no vaccines or therapeutics, is driving the spread as testing capacity lags. Initial detections traced to Bunia in Ituri province, with confirmed cases now in North Kivu, including Butembo and the rebel-held city of Goma. Containment is hampered by widespread displacement—over two million people—and a weakened health system amid ongoing conflict. Clinical symptoms mimic other tropical diseases, and nosebleeds typically appear around day five, delaying field detection. WHO reports a two-month vaccine procurement window and is rushing testing kits to eastern DRC to accelerate case identification and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、診断遅延の中、DRCで500件以上の疑い患者エボラ症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（500+疑い例、130+疑い死亡）で、ワクチン・治療薬なしのBundibugyo株による拡大、国際的に高リスク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（ワクチン・治療薬なし）による大規模アウトブレイクで、確定例30件に対し疑い例500+という検査能力不足が深刻。武装勢力占領地Goma、200万人以上の避難民、保健システム崩壊など複合的な危機要因あり。IHR基準4項目全て、WPRO基準5項目全て該当する最高リスク案件。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Perketat Pengawasan di Pintu Negara Buntut Status Darurat Kasus Ebola yang Sebabkan 80 Kematian di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Tightens Surveillance at Border Entry Points Following Ebola Emergency Status That Has Caused 80 Deaths in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 16 May 2026, Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreaks in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, have 246 suspected cases, including 8 laboratory-confirmed infections and 80 deaths (case fatality rate 32.5%). The outbreak has prompted cross-border concerns, with travel-associated cases reported in Kampala, Uganda, and Kinshasa, reflecting high population movement and limited local healthcare capacity. In response, the Ministry of Health tightened surveillance at border crossing points and reinforced reporting and containment measures following the Ebola emergency status. The data are official through 16 May 2026, with the government tightening border surveillance to curb cross-border transmission amid the Ebola emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、コンゴのエボラ熱感染による80人の死亡に伴う緊急事態ステータスを受けて国境検査所での監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数の死亡例、国際的拡大（ウガンダ、キンシャサでの旅行関連症例）、国境での検査所強化など、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（Ituri Province、Kinshasa）での発生が主題。ウガンダでの旅行関連症例も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる（ID: 203312）。エボラ出血熱の高い致命率（32.5%）と国境越え感染リスクにより、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les commerçants frontaliers étranglés par les restrictions sanitaires
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Cross-border Traders Strangled by Health Restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) triggers cross-border health controls on the Rwanda–DRC frontier, notably in Gisenyi, Rwanda, near Goma. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as the virus spreads from its epicenter in Ituri. First case confirmed in Goma; authorities report about 136 Ebola deaths and more than 540 suspected cases, up from 88 deaths and 336 suspected cases. Border authorities impose temperature screening and increased traveler surveillance, forcing Rubavu traders to reroute shipments and share profits. The outbreak’s security context worsens response; Ituri sees armed clashes, while North Kivu is split between government control and M23 zones, hindering access and coordination. The WHO warns the crisis could endure, potentially lasting years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に見舞われたコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）：越境商人が衛生制限に苦しむ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の事象であり、IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みでシグナルとして明確に識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCを主題としたエボラ出血熱の事象を記述。Rwandaは越境対応の文脈での言及のため、DRCが事象の主要発生地。WHO PHEIC宣言済みであり、死亡136件以上、疑い例540件以上と報告。武装勢力による治安悪化が対応に悪影響を及ぼしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Mayotte face au risque d'une crise sanitaire majeure - Mayotte Hebdo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mayotte faces the risk of a major health crisis - Mayotte Hebdo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Ebola Bundibugyo strain re-emerged in South Kivu, DRC, causing dozens of deaths. The influx of clandestine migrants via the Union of the Comoros to Mayotte—a French 101st department—fuels fear of importation and spread to Mayotte. A Paris hospital virologist warned France faces real contamination risk from Mayotte, while local authorities remain unusually silent and the health system on the island remains fragile, having struggled with mpox, chikungunya, and dengue. Incubation is 7–21 days, fatality 30–50%, few asymptomatic cases; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Africa CDC reports one confirmed case and one death in Uganda, suggesting East African spillover risk. Calls to close borders with the Comoros grow as Tsoundzou migrant camp underscores tensions; Mayotte’s prefecture leader awaits Paris guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：マイヨット島は大規模な衛生危機リスクに直面 - Mayotte Hebdo
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な死亡、予想外の再興、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。複数の高危険度疾患（エボラ・ブンディブギョ、mpox、チクングニア、デング）が同地域で発生し、国際的な移動ルート（セーシェル経由でマイヨット島）を通じた拡大リスク、フランスからの懸念表明あり。
triage.notes: マイヨット島はフランスの領土（洋上県）であり対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。しかし記事の主題は DRC（South Kivu）で再興したエボラ・ブンディブギョ株であり、その流出リスクを論じている。複数高危険度病原体（Mpox, Chikungunya, Dengue）が同じ地域で循環していることが管理複雑化のリスク要因。ウガンダでの1例確認報告は東アフリカへのこぼれ出しリスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Fallzahlen steigen rasant â€" WHO plant Notlage und Impfstoff-Checks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Case numbers rising rapidly — WHO plans a state of emergency and vaccine checks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, centered on the Bundibugyo variant with no approved vaccine or therapy for this form. The Congolese Health Ministry reports 513 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths, prompting the WHO to convene an emergency committee to issue next-step recommendations. International concerns include planning the possible transfer and treatment of an infected US citizen to Germany, highlighting cross-border logistics and biosafety considerations. Germany emphasizes a nationwide high-containment and standardized contact-screening framework to manage potential imported cases. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya cautions against broad travel bans, arguing that rapid, source-focused containment is essential. The outbreak appears to have begun in Ituri in the third week of April and was reported in early May, with Uganda also reporting two cases, signaling regional transmission and the Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：感染者数が急速に増加 — WHOが非常事態と ワクチン検査を計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大、ワクチンなし、国際的な患者移送・渡航制限の懸念、複数国への地域的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国経由）が報告されており、即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変種でワクチン・治療法なし、感染者数513人（疑い例）・死亡131人。WHOが緊急委員会を召集予定。ウガンダでも2例確認され地域的な流行を示唆。米国患者のドイツへの移送検討により国際的な懸念が高まっている。アフリカCDC局長は旅行禁止の代わりに感染源への集中的な封じ込めを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Infizierter US-Arzt in Berlin eingetroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Infected U.S. doctor has arrived in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola was flown from BER to Charité in Berlin. He contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital near Bunia in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveling with six contacts including family. Dr. Peter Stafford and his wife, Dr. Rebekah Stafford, are missionaries with Serge, working in Congo since 2019. Charité houses one of Germany's largest specialized isolation units for high-risk pathogens, fully separated from routine care with dedicated ventilation and wastewater systems. The outbreak has sparked international concern; the WHO declared an international health emergency. U.S. authorities imposed temporary travel restrictions for certain travelers from affected regions. So far, at least 80 deaths; cases confirmed in the DRC and Uganda. The DRC Ministry of Health reports 513 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids; the 2014–15 Zaire variant killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者：感染した米国医師がベルリンに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染者の国際移動、複数国への拡大確認、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、国際的な旅行制限実施等により、フルRRAの実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事中でBunia（DRC内）でのエボラウイルス感染確認、Ugandaへの拡大も言及されているが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Berlin/Germanyでの患者受け入れは対象国でないため除外。DRC主要なエボラ発生地として確認。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、旅行制限実施により政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Une épidémie d'Ebola flambe de nouveau en Afrique centrale : l'OMS déclare l'état d'urgence sanitaire internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak is flaring up again in Central Africa: WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern at the organization’s second-highest alert level on May 17, 2026. The Bundibugyo variant, identified in 2007, may have up to 50% case fatality and has no licensed vaccine for this strain. As of May 20, 2026, 336 suspected cases and 88 confirmed deaths are reported; case confirmation has occurred in two countries, including the DRC and Uganda. The first lab-confirmed case appeared in Goma, a major eastern city near borders with Rwanda and Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission potential. Early samples show high positivity; at least four health-care workers have died. Uganda postponed the Martyrs pilgrimage due to spillover concerns. MSF calls for a large-scale response; WHO cautions substantial uncertainties about true counts and geographic spread amid insecurity and mass displacement. No cases outside Africa to date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が中央アフリカで再び急速に拡大：WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国での確認、高い死亡率、国境越え伝播の証拠がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国での流行を述べているが、ウガンダはサマリー上でケース確認地として言及されており、RwandaはGoma近郊の隣国として地理的リスク言及のみで、実際の患者確認は「DRCとウガンダ」と明記されている。しかし、本トリアージ対象国リストではウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRCは対象国リスト内（GeoNames ID 203312）。この判定は厳格な地域検証ルールに基づいている。

article.articleHeadline: Kiek pavojingas yra Ebolos viruso protrūkis KDR?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How dangerous is the Ebola virus outbreak in KDR?
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) escalates with the Bandibadi Ebola strain, a rare variant with no approved vaccines or drugs. Nearly 250 suspected cases and 80 deaths are reported. First known case was a nurse; confirmation took about three weeks. Diagnostic tests are reportedly ineffective, and treatment relies on optimized supportive care. Incubation is 2–21 days, with initial flu-like symptoms (fever, headache, fatigue) progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. The outbreak poses a cross-border threat to Uganda (two infections, one death) and risks to South Sudan and Rwanda, in a region with high displacement—over 250,000 people flee conflict areas. No widespread immunity exists; past 2014–2016 West Africa outbreaks (28,600 cases) underline potential scale, though current global risk remains low. Rapid case finding, infection control in treatment facilities, and safe handling of bodies are critical.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラウイルス流行はどの程度危険か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の新型株（Bandibadi株）による大規模流行で、250例の疑似症例・80死亡、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に2例1死亡確認）、および移動による越境脅威が明確。
triage.notes: Bandibadi Ebola株は承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない稀な変異株。診断検査の有効性低下、約25万人の国内避難民による越境リスクが高い。ウガンダでの既知感染確認により国際的拡大傾向が明白。対象国リストのDRCのみを verified_locations に含める（Sudan、Angola、Rwanda、Ugandaはサマリー上で主発生地ではなく脅威の二次的対象）。

article.articleHeadline: Rubio dakwa WHO 'agak lambat' kenal pasti wabak Ebola | Berita Harian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rubio accuses WHO of being 'somewhat slow' to identify the Ebola outbreak | Berita Harian
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026 — U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio accuses the World Health Organization of being slow to identify an Ebola outbreak, as Washington plans its response. Rubio and comments reflect broader U.S. criticism of WHO following COVID-19. The United States says it will finance up to 50 Ebola treatment centers in the Democratic Republic of Congo or Uganda with an initial $13 million. The affected areas are hard to access due to conflict. A senior State Department official noted it took about 10 days to confirm transmission, and officials say they are now on day four, within a 14-day window. WHO warns of the scale and speed of Ebola transmission, reporting 136 suspected deaths to date. WHO denies claims of leniency toward China or concealment of COVID-19, emphasizing cooperation with all countries.

triage.headline_ja: ルビオ氏、WHOがエボラ感染症の特定に「やや遅い」と非難 | ベリタ・ハリアン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は多くの死亡が報告され、国境を越えた感染リスクが高く、迅速な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダと明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bluedot APIは米国と中国も発生地域として付与しているが、記事本文ではこれら国での実際の発生は言及されていないため除外。死亡疑い例136例との報告があり、重症度が高い。アメリカが資金提供を計画するなど国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Giám đốc WHO lo ngại dịch Ebola có thể lan rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General warns that the Ebola outbreak could spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus. By May 19, 2026, authorities report over 130 suspected deaths and 540 cases. The outbreak began in Ituri and has spread to North Kivu, Bunia, Goma, Kampala. WHO Director-General Tedros warned of its scale and speed and the risk of widening due to urban transmission, healthcare worker deaths, and displacement amid conflict. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo. Delay in confirmation due to initial tests focusing on Zaire ebolavirus and unsafe burials has driven spread. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Response includes MSF and UNICEF; the U.S. deployed a disaster-response team and evacuated an infected doctor to Germany. CDC Africa cautions against broad travel bans; Imperial College modelling suggests cases could exceed 1,000. Efforts focus on vaccines, monoclonal antibodies, contact tracing, and surveillance; containment could take months.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ感染症が拡大する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで国際対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus亜種による東部DRC及びウガンダのアウトブレイク。2026年5月19日時点で130人以上の疑い死亡、540症例報告。WHO PHEIC既に宣言済み。複数国への感染例（医師の海外搬送など）が報告されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダのイベントであり、該当対象国はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に不含。米国・ドイツは対応国だが感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hyundai Bioscience: 'Able to Supply Antiviral Drug in Event of Ebola or Hantavirus Spread'
article.articleSummary: Hyundai Bioscience announced on May 19, 2026, that it can supply clinical trial doses of its broad‑spectrum antiviral XAFTY®, whose main ingredient is niclosamide, in response to global concerns over Ebola and hantavirus spread. The company said it can immediately deliver products currently in stock to the World Health Organization or affected countries. Niclosamide has been reported to inhibit Ebola and hantavirus. In Vietnam, XAFTY® is in a Phase 2 trial for dengue fever, with no adverse events reported to date. Hyundai Bioscience, a member of the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium (MCDC) supported by the U.S. Department of Defense, said it will cooperate on international public health crises and could position XAFTY® as an effective alternative in a scenario where two viruses are spreading simultaneously.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス：『エボラやハンタウイルス拡大時に抗ウイルス薬を供給可能』
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は企業による医薬品供給能力の発表であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者発生、流行）ではなく、仮定シナリオに基づく製品対応声明である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、ベトナムではXAFTY®がデング熱のPhase 2試験中であることが述べられているため、Vietnamを verified_locations に含める。ただし、本記事の主題は企業の医薬品供給能力発表であり、実際の感染症発生イベントではない。United States は医薬品開発・供給を行う企業所属省庁の関係先であり、イベント発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Hantavirus Show World's Risk Preparedness Lagging: Pandemic Expert
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of hantavirus on the Atlantic-bound MV Hondius and the Bundibugyo strain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo highlight improved crisis response but lagging pandemic risk awareness, according to Helen Clark, co-chair of the Independent Panel for Pandemic Preparedness and Response. Following WHO’s new International Health Regulations, rapid reaction followed alerts for Ebola in the DRC and hantavirus linked to the Hondius, including three deaths. Clark cautions that upstream risk-informed preparedness remains weak: surveillance and early detection must be strengthened, and knowledge of where outbreaks could crop up expanded. The Hondius case notes hantavirus endemic in Argentina near the ship’s departure, while the DRC Ebola outbreak, with more than 130 deaths, went for weeks with testing focused on another strain. She links funding shortfalls to weakened prevention, urging solidarity and financing for preparedness; a confirmed Ebola case appeared in a US national.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルスが世界的なリスク準備態勢の遅れを示す：パンデミック専門家
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱とハンタウイルスの複数地域での同時発生、130名以上の死亡、国際的な拡大リスク（米国での確認患者）、および渡航制限のリスク有り。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラはDRC、ハンタウイルスはアルゼンチン近海のMV Hondius船舶およびUS国内での確認患者を述べている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国とアルゼンチンは対象国外のため除外。DRCでのエボラ流行は130名以上の死亡を報告しており、深刻度は高い。パンデミック準備態勢に関する専門家による国際的な警告も含まれており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Liberia: Dr. Nyan Sounds Alarm as New Ebola Outbreak Emerges in DR Congo - FrontPageAfrica
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces a new Ebola outbreak, prompting Liberia's Dr. Dugbeh Christopher Nyan, former Director General of Liberia's National Public Health Institute, to warn and urge urgent regional action. In an Al Jazeera interview, he recalls Liberia's 2014-2016 Ebola crisis that devastated Liberia, Guinea, and Sierra Leone and credits rapid international and cross-border coordination for containment. The current outbreak involves rarer Ebola strains in Central/East Africa, including neighboring Uganda, complicating response and making vaccines based on the Zaire strain less universally effective. Scientists may adapt vaccines into multivalent forms. He highlights mRNA vaccine potential to accelerate development, while stressing the need for testing and community cooperation. Liberia must strengthen surveillance, health worker training, public awareness, and rapid response, given porous borders and ongoing regional travel. WHO stresses containment at the source; preparedness is essential.

triage.headline_ja: リベリア：ニャン博士がコンゴ民主共和国での新たなエボラ流行警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の病原体、国際的拡大リスク高、渡航制限リスク有）。エボラウイルス疾患は国際的に最も懸念される感染症であり、複数国への地域的拡大と高い重症度を示唆。
triage.notes: サマリーでは新規エボラ流行がコンゴ民主共和国で発生していることが明確。リベリア、ギニア、シエラレオネは過去の2014-2016流行との比較言及のため除外。ウガンダは「隣接」として言及されるが、現在流行の主要発生地としては記述されていないため除外。WPRO対象国リストに該当する DRC のみ verified_locations に含める。WHO および国家レベルの対応要請、複数の新規株による高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: ФИФА следит за ситуацией с вирусом Эбола в ДР Конго и оказывает поддержку сборной перед ЧМ-2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA is monitoring the Ebola virus situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is providing support to the national team ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: FIFA is monitoring the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and providing support to FECOFA ahead of the 2026 World Cup. FIFA states it is aware of the Ebola situation and in close contact with FECOFA to inform the DR Congo team of all safety recommendations. It collaborates with all three host countries and the World Health Organization to ensure a safe tournament, prioritizing the health of all participants. The DR Congo national team canceled a training camp that was to begin May 17 in Kinshasa. At the 2026 World Cup, DR Congo is in Group K with Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia. Earlier, FIFA described a constructive meeting with the Iran Football Federation.

triage.headline_ja: FIFAはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス情況を監視し、2026年ワールドカップ前に代表チームを支援している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生はIHR基準で複数該当の可能性が高いが、記事の主要内容はスポーツイベント（2026年ワールドカップ）の運営対応であり、感染症の流行規模・重症度・伝播状況に関する具体的情報が欠落している。感染症イベント情報として充分な詳細がないため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はスポーツメディア（RT Sport）からのもので、エボラの流行に関する疫学的詳細（症例数、死亡数、発症動向、接触追跡状況等）が記載されていない。FIFAの対応（訓練キャンプ中止、安全勧告）が記述されているが、感染症の公衆衛生的インパクトの評価には不十分。記事に記載されているイラン・ポルトガル・ウズベキスタン・コロンビアはワールドカップのグループ分けの文脈のみであり、これらの国でのエボラ発生は述べられていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。続報でコンゴ民主共和国内の具体的な流行状況が明らかになった場合、PIKKUPに昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Malawi on Ebola high alert - Nation Online
article.articleSummary: Malawi is on high alert for Ebola and prepared to respond to any imported cases. The Ministry of Health updated its response plan after the WHO declared the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a public health emergency of international concern. Malawi has activated surveillance, case management, infection prevention, coordination and logistics, and intensified traveler screening with plans to preposition medical supplies. Standard operating procedures guide actions at different outbreak stages. The strain affecting DRC and Uganda is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache and sore throat, with transmission by direct contact with bodily fluids. In DRC’s Ituri, at least 131 deaths and more than 500 suspected cases; in Uganda, one death and one confirmed case. Malawi has direct flights to Uganda; ports of entry will be vigilant. Public advised: wash hands, avoid bush meat, and not touch an infected person.

triage.headline_ja: マラウイ、エボラ出血熱に高度の警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。DRC・ウガンダでの公衆衛生上の重大な影響、国際的な懸念、地域的な拡大リスクが明確。マラウイは対象国リストに含まれないが、DRCは対象国（203312）。
triage.notes: 記事はマラウイの警戒態勢について報じているが、実際のエボラ出血熱イベントはDRCおよびウガンダで発生中。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）に指定済み。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチン未開発の懸念あり。DRCのIturi州で少なくとも131死亡、500以上の疑い患者。

article.articleHeadline: Brain-eating amoeba: Kerala reports another death from amoebic meningoencephalitis
article.articleSummary: Kerala’s Ernakulam district confirms another primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) death: a 73-year-old woman from Nellikuzhi, Kothamangalam. She developed fever and headache on May 6, was admitted May 8, moved to Aluva the same day as her condition worsened, and died May 15 at a private hospital in Kothamangalam. PAM is caused by Naegleria fowleri, a free-living amoeba thriving in warm freshwater lakes, ponds and rivers, with occasional presence in poorly maintained pools. The patient, a Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme worker, is suspected to have washed her face with canal water. Health officials examined nearly 20 coworkers; none have shown symptoms. In response, water sources including wells in Nellikuzhi were superchlorinated. District authorities urged the public to avoid bathing or swimming in unsafe, particularly stagnant, water sources to prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: 脳を食べるアメーバ：ケーラ州が脳炎患者からの別の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: プライマリアメーバ髄膜脳炎（PAM）による死亡事例であり、予想外の稀な致死的疾患。ケーラ州での複数の関連症例の可能性と公衆衛生上の懸念により、IHR基準2つ以上該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: PAMは極めて稀で致死率が高い感染症（治療なしで死亡率ほぼ100%）。患者はケーラ州エルナクラム地区の複数の場所（ネッリクジ、コッタマンガラム、アルヴァ）で発症・治療されており、地理的に分散。タミルナドゥ州も発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーではケーラ州のみが主題。淡水での暴露リスクが高く、公衆衛生対応（塩素消毒、啓発）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Berlínská nemocnice Charité přijala do péče Američana, který se v Kongu nakazil ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Berlin's Charité hospital has admitted an American who contracted Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An American physician who contracted Ebola in a Congolese hospital has been admitted to Berlin's Charité hospital. A special aircraft landed at Berlin's international airport shortly after midnight, and the patient was escorted by around 60 police to a dedicated isolation unit at the Virchow Clinic in the Wedding district. The high-containment unit can handle highly infectious diseases and potential unclear biological, chemical, or radiological contamination, with separate access, closed-air filtration, and independent wastewater treatment. German Health Minister Nina Warken said Germany will assist partners and has modern equipment, ensuring optimal care and top safety. The Ebola outbreak began in Congo and spread to Uganda, with more than 100 deaths reported as of May 20, 2026. The patient was admitted to Germany at the United States’ request (imported case).

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのシャリテ病院がコンゴでエボラに感染したアメリカ人を受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定患者が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で発生しており、100人以上の死亡が報告されている。これは国際的影響の高い公衆衛生上の重大事象であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ発生地がDRC（コンゴ）とウガンダで報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。ドイツ、米国での患者受け入れは輸入症例であり、発生地ではない。Bluedot APIが付与したベルリンなどのドイツの位置情報は輸入症例の治療地点であるため、実際の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വ്യാപനം മൂന്ന് രാജ്യക്കാർക്ക് ബഹ്റൈനിൽ താൽക്കാലിക പ്രവേശന വിലക്ക് | Bahrain temporarily bans entry for three countries over Ebola outbreak | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahrain temporarily bans entry for three countries over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bahrain temporarily bans entry for foreign travelers from South Sudan, Congo, and Uganda amid an Ebola outbreak in Africa. The ban, effective from Tuesday for 30 days, may be adjusted based on evolving conditions. The precautionary measure aims to protect public health by reducing the risk of importing Ebola cases. The World Health Organization has cautioned about rapidly increasing Ebola cases and rising transmission, underscoring the seriousness of the outbreak. The article notes the decision is driven by ongoing concerns and public health measures; it does not provide local case counts or laboratory details, and there is no explicit indication of domestic transmission at this time.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に伴いバーレーン、3カ国からの入国を一時的に禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的対応、国際渡航制限）。WHO が増加するエボラ症例と伝播の加速を警告しており、複数アフリカ国での発生と地域的な流行制御対応が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは South Sudan、Congo、Uganda からの入国禁止が述べられている。対象国リストから確認できるのは DRC（203312）のみ。Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていない。South Sudan は対象国リストに含まれていない。WHO による警告と複数国でのエボラ発生の報告により、この事象は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll In Congo Rises To 131 As WHO Warns Of Rapid Spread | Investors King
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of Congo rises to 131 as the outbreak spreads in eastern Congo, with more than 500 suspected cases and dozens of confirmed infections across Ituri province. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, underpins containment challenges. The WHO warns of rapid spread, with cases now appearing in densely populated urban centers, including Goma, raising regional transmission risk to neighboring Uganda. The agency has begun deploying emergency supplies—protective equipment for health workers, laboratory materials, and response kits—to bolster testing and surveillance. The Congo–Uganda outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, prompting border screening tightening by Uganda and Rwanda, and limited U.S. travel restrictions. An American missionary infected in Congo was evacuated to Germany; several aid workers remain under observation. Congo’s 17th Ebola epidemic since 1976; international support is critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死者数が131人に増加、WHOが急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高く、フルのRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確定死者131人、疑い症例500人以上。Goma等の都市部への拡大、ワクチン・治療法の不在、ウガンダ・ルワンダへの越境リスク、米国人宣教師の感染・独国への搬送、PHEIC宣言済み。国際的対応が極めて重要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Alemanha: médico dos EUA com Ébola chega a Berlim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany: U.S. doctor with Ebola arrives in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: A U.S. doctor infected with Ebola arrives by air to BER airport and is transported by special vehicle to Charité University Hospital in Berlin, accompanied by six close contacts including family. The patient contracted Bundibugyo Ebola virus while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital near Bunia, in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The couple, missionaries with Serge, have worked in the DRC since 2019. Charité houses Germany’s largest, highly equipped isolation unit for deadly infections, fully separated from the rest of the hospital with dedicated ventilation and wastewater treatment. The outbreak prompted international concern, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and the United States imposing temporary travel restrictions on some passengers from affected regions. At least 80 deaths; confirmed cases in DRC and Uganda; DRC MoH reports 513 suspected cases and 131 probable deaths. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodies or fluids. A Zaire variant outbreak in West Africa (2014–2015) caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ：エボラウイルスに感染した米国医師がベルリンに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染者の国際移動事例で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、米国が渡航制限を実施。重症度が高く、複数国での確認患者・死亡者がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはドイツ・米国・ウガンダ・アンゴラが含まれるが、記事サマリーの検証結果、実際の感染イベント発生地はDRCのBunia近郊（Nyankunde Hospital）。患者はDRCで感染し、ドイツに医療搬送された事例。WPRO地域外の事例だがIHR基準で国際的な保健上の懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ameriški zdravnik, okužen z ebolo, bo premeščen v Nemčijo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American doctor infected with Ebola will be moved to Germany.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) worsens, with over 500 suspected infections and 130 deaths; urban transmission reported in Kampala, Uganda, and Goma, DR Congo. Uganda has two imported cases; more than 100,000 people are displaced, hindering containment. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) strain drives the outbreak, for which there is no vaccine or proven treatment yet. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of risks from urban spread. An American physician, Peter Stafford, infected while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri, will be evacuated to Germany and admitted to Berlin’s Charité in a specialized isolation unit. The United States has closed borders to foreign nationals who traveled through the affected area for 30 days, a measure contrary to WHO guidance. The U.S. is coordinating with the CDC and military, pledging about $13 million for Congo and Uganda. WHO will convene an emergency committee to coordinate further actions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人医師がドイツに移送される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限）。エボラウイルス感染症の確定的なアウトブレイクで、複数国への拡大、死亡者発生、ワクチンなしの危険な株、国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は最重度の公衆衛生脅威。記事はDRC（イトゥリ、北キブ州）とウガンダでの確定的なアウトブレイク、都市部への感染拡大（ゴマ、カンパラ）、国際的な患者輸送と対応を報告。ドイツ・ベルリンへの医師移送は医療支援レベルだが、基盤となるアウトブレイクはDRCとウガンダが主題。米国の国境閉鎖やWHO緊急委員会招集は国際的対応の活発化を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Berlin: Polizei-Eskorte bringt hochinfektiösen Ebola-Patienten aus den USA zur Charité - WELT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Berlin: Police Escort Brings Highly Infectious Ebola Patients from the United States to Charité - WELT
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) patient, a United States physician who contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has been transported to Berlin's Charité – Universitätsmedizin for treatment in Germany's only dedicated high-containment isolation facility. The patient arrived at night, reportedly escorted by police, and was admitted to Charité's special isolation ward. The patient’s identity is reported by Serge, a Christian aid organization, as Dr. Peter Stafford, who lived in the Congo with his wife (also a physician) and three children. German Federal Health Minister Nina Warken (CDU) stated that Germany will support its partners and that the country has a strong nationwide network for highly infectious diseases, ensuring optimal care with the highest safety precautions. The case highlights Germany's capacity to manage imported high-consequence pathogens and collaboration with international organizations.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリン：警察護送により米国からのエボラ患者がシャリテ病院に搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際的な事例であり、コンゴでの感染から欧州への搬送という点で国際的拡大の懸念あり。高リスク病原体の国境を超えた移動。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはドイツ・ベルリンも含まれるが、本記事の主題は『コンゴで感染したエボラ患者がベルリンに搬送された』という事象である。対象国リストに基づきDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ドイツは対象国ではないため除外。患者個人事例であり現在の流行指標ではないが、高リスク病原体の国境移動という観点からシグナル価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情　世卫对"规模和速度"深感担忧
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: WHO deeply concerned about the scale and speed.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province near the Uganda and South Sudan borders, presents a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever with escalating numbers. WHO reports 130 deaths; the DRC health minister cites about 136 suspected Ebola-related deaths and roughly 543 suspected cases. There is no approved vaccine or therapy for this strain; Ervebo is a candidate vaccine under consideration and could take at least two months to roll out. Emergency supplies and expert teams have arrived, but care is hampered by bed shortages and limited laboratory confirmation, with data largely based on suspected cases. The outbreak center is a hospital in Ituri near the Ugandan border; burial practices lack PPE. Uganda has confirmed two Congolese cases (one infection, one death) crossing the border. International travel screening and restrictions are being implemented.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行：WHOが規模と速度に深刻な懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（高致死率）による多数の死亡例（130～136例）と疑い例（543例）、国境を越えた国際的な二次感染確認、渡航・貿易制限の実施、予防接種戦略の欠如など、複合的な懸念要因が認められ、フルRRA実施の優先度は極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（EboBun）は過去にウガンダで確認された株。現在の東部DRC（Ituri Province）での流行は同地域では比較的稀。ウガンダへの国境越え症例確認、医療体制の脆弱性（ベッド不足、検査確認困難）、適切な治療薬・ワクチンの欠如が管理上の重大な課題。WHOが「規模と速度」に懸念を表明していることから、急速な拡大の可能性が高い。Sudan（スーダン）は発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは明確な症例報告がないため、現時点では検証済みロケーションから除外。

article.articleHeadline: В Минздраве оценили риск распространения лихорадки Эбола в России // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health assessed the risk of Ebola fever spreading in Russia // NTV News
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, Russia reports no risk of Ebola fever spreading, per Health Minister Mikhail Murashko, who stated Moscow plans to discuss a domestic Ebola vaccine with the World Health Organization. The Ebola outbreak epicenters are the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with fatalities exceeding 130. A first U.S. case has been reported, contracted while working in Africa. To contain the disease, Jordan and Bahrain have suspended entry from Congo and Uganda; Egypt tightened quarantine controls at Cairo airport. In Uganda, authorities banned handshakes in a preventive move amid the outbreak. The report notes ongoing international responses and vaccine considerations, while Russia maintains no domestic risk and seeks WHO coordination on a Russian-made vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健省、ロシア国内でのエボラ熱の拡大リスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。複数国でのエボラ出血熱の流行が進行中で、既に死亡者130名超、米国での症例確認、複数国による入国制限実施が報告されており、国際的な懸念が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダがエボラ出血熱の流行の震源地として特定されているが、提供されたGeoNames IDリストではコンゴ民主共和国のみが対象国に含まれる。ウガンダは記事に登場するものの対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。エジプト、ヨルダン、バーレーン、ロシア、米国も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本イベントは多くの国を巻き込んだ国際的なエボラ出血熱流行であり、高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Masuk Musim Pancaroba, Dinkes Ingatkan Warga Bahaya Penyakit DBD dan ISPA - Metropolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the Pancaroba season begins, the Health Department reminds residents of the dangers of Dengue fever and Acute Respiratory Infections - Metropolis
article.articleSummary: Batam, Indonesia reports rising dengue fever (DBD), acute respiratory infections (ISPA)/influenza, and diarrhea as the rainy pancaroba season begins. From end-April 2026, DBD total stands at 26 cases; by 19 May 2026, 20 more were reported. Compared with April 2025’s 191 cases, the same period in 2026 shows 142. Highest DBD districts are Sagulung and Batuaji, where standing water and poorer sanitation favor Aedes aegypti proliferation. Authorities link the increase to environmental cleanliness and seasonal transition. To curb spread, Batam Health Department issued Mayor Circular No. 8/2026 on early warning and is intensifying the 3M Plus and One House One Jumantik (G1R1J) programs, plus fogging within 100 meters of detected cases. Fogging is not a primary solution; ongoing PSN and sanitation are emphasized. Health facilities remain prepared, and residents are urged to maintain hygiene, seek care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: パンカロバ季節に突入、保健局がデング熱と急性呼吸器感染症の危険性を住民に警告 - メトロポリス
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのバタムで報告されたデング熱と流行性感冒の増加は地域的関心の対象ですが、IHR基準を満たさず、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生影響の証拠が不明です。情報不足のため経過観察が適切です。
triage.notes: バタム市でのデング熱症例（4月末時点26例、5月19日までに20例追加）と急性呼吸器感染症の増加が報告されています。パンカロバ（雨季）の季節変化に関連した予測可能な疾患増加と見られ、異常・予想外性は低いです。ただし環境因子（スタンディング水、衛生状況）による蚊媒介感染症の継続的曝露リスクが存在します。死亡率や重症者数に関する具体的データがないため重症度は不明です。

article.articleHeadline: التفشّي السريع  لفيروس "إيبولا" يقلق العالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rapid outbreak of the Ebola virus worries the world.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization officials warn of a fast Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with concerns about scale and speed as candidate vaccines and treatments are studied to contain the epidemic. The Trump administration attacked the UN agency after a citizen was confirmed infected with Ebola. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced, during the World Health Assembly, that he declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern before the Emergency Committee convened, citing alarm over outbreak size and transmission. The Congolese health minister said domestic alerting was delayed, attributing it to the belief that Ebola is mysterious and that patients were not brought to hospitals. Security in the DRC hampers response; humanitarian access and coordination with armed groups pose challenges. A WHO representative in Bunia, Ituri, said international bodies are considering candidate vaccines and treatments. The crisis follows funding cuts for UN agencies and NGOs, including the USA’s withdrawal from WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの急速な流行が世界を懸念させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大懸念、渡航制限リスク）。DRCでのエボラ流行は国際関心事であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、発生地域に米国が含まれるが、サマリーではトランプ政権がWHOを攻撃したという政治的背景のみであり、米国内でのエボラ発症は主題でない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、スケール・伝播速度への懸念、セキュリティ問題による対応困難が記述されており、深刻度は高い。

article.articleHeadline:
闻旅
                                买了船票不敢上船：邮轮接连暴发疫情，你还敢坐吗？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bought a cruise ticket but afraid to board: Cruise ships have had successive outbreaks of illness—would you still sail?
article.articleSummary: On the cruise ship Hondius, 11 hantavirus (Andes hantavirus) cases have been confirmed with 3 deaths as of May 14, following the index patient—a 70-year-old Dutch ornithologist who, before boarding in Ushuaia, Argentina, was exposed to rodent excreta at a landfill; he died on April 11. The World Health Organization deems the outbreak low risk for a larger spread, noting Andes hantavirus transmission requires prolonged close contact and is unlikely to spread via central air, dining, or casual interactions. The event is described as a contained chain in an isolated environment. Separately, the Ambition reported a gastroenteritis cluster (likely norovirus/rotavirus) on a ship with ~1,700 people, and the Caribbean Princess saw around 100+ norovirus cases. The episodes amplify cruise-travel anxiety and highlight gaps in pre-boarding risk assessment, isolation capacity, and port-reception agreements. Antarctic cruising remains active; 2025–2026 season hosted about 113,518 visitors, prompting tighter regulation and national Antarctic legislation in China. Continuous emergency-readiness remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 船のチケットを買ったが乗るのが怖い：クルーズ船が相次いで疫病の流行、あなたはまだ乗りますか？
triage.triage_reason: 複数のクルーズ船でハンタウイルス（アンデスハンタウイルス）とノロウイルスの集団感染が報告されているが、WHOは大規模流行のリスクを低いと評価し、情報が限定的。国内での継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはアルゼンチン（Tierra del Fuego Province、Ushuaia）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはクルーズ船での発生を中心に論じており、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は記事末尾で「2025-2026シーズンで約113,518人の訪問者を受け入れ、中国における南極関連法制の強化」という文脈で言及されているため、China (1814991) を verified_locations に含める。IHR基準は2つ以上該当（serious_impact、unusual_unexpected）し、WPRO基準も2つ以上該当（abnormal_unexpected、severity）するが、WHOが大規模流行リスクを「低い」と評価し、感染源が船内の限定環境であるため、直ちにPICKUPではなくWATCHとして継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемията от ебола може да се разпространява месеци наред
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak could spread for months on end.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo could be larger than reported and persist for months. Roughly 130+ presumed deaths and 540+ suspected infections, with only a few dozen confirmed. Case numbers rise as contact tracing expands. Ongoing conflict, mass displacement, and cross-border worker movement, including in mining areas, hinder containment and surveillance; health infrastructure is severely disrupted. WHO officials warn about the speed and scale of spread; past regional outbreaks took years to control. Modelling suggests real cases may exceed 1,000. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, with limited early awareness contributing to spread and unsafe burial practices. No vaccines or targeted treatments exist for this strain. International response teams are delivering aid and diagnostics, but local resources and personnel remain insufficient. Cross-border cases and travel advisories underscore border checks; some governments restrict travel. Officials say containment measures, not travel bans alone, will determine the outbreak pace.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行は数ヶ月間拡大し続ける可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限を伴う。フルRRAを実施すべき。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。推定死者130名以上、疑い患者540名以上だが確認例は少数。モデリングでは実際の患者数は1,000名超の可能性。紛争、大量避難民、越境労働者の移動が封じ込めを困難にしている。保健インフラが著しく破壊されている。国際的な支援と旅行勧告が発出されている。数ヶ月間の継続的な拡大が予想されている。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يدق ناقوس الخطر.. هل يقترب العالم من تهديد وبائي جديد؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola rings the alarm bells... Is the world approaching a new epidemic threat?
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda has reached over 530 suspected cases and 131 deaths as of May 2026. Bundibugyo is rare and highly dangerous; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this strain, unlike Zaire ebolavirus, which has a vaccine. Delayed detection occurred because early tests targeted another Ebola strain, slowing response. Ebola is a zoonosis transmitted from wildlife to humans (bats and some primates) and spreading between people via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pains, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding, with organ failure possible and fatalities ranging widely. The crisis is aggravated by conflict, displacement, and weak health systems; reducing international aid could hinder response. WHO has high alerts without a pandemic declaration; continued global investment in surveillance is essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが警告音を鳴らす...世界は新しい流行の脅威に近づいているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株のエボラ感染症が530例以上・131死亡と深刻で、ワクチンなし、国際的拡大リスク高く、渡航・貿易制限のリスクもある。緊急シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダの発生が述べられているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は評価対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo株は治療法・ワクチン不在であり、紛争と弱い保健体制が対応を困難にしている。WHO高度警戒中（パンデミック宣言なし）。

article.articleHeadline: Apakah Ebola Pernah Ada di Indonesia? Ini Faktanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has Ebola ever been in Indonesia? Here are the facts.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, the WHO elevated Ebola outbreaks in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and in Uganda (Kampala) to Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. The Ituri outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD). Official data through May 16 report 246 suspected cases, 8 laboratory-confirmed, and 80 deaths (case fatality ~32.5%). Travel-related cases have been reported in Kampala and Kinshasa, reflecting high mobility. Indonesia’s Ministry of Health states no Ebola cases have been detected domestically. In 2014, Indonesia ruled out Ebola after a Ghanaian suspect tested negative; malaria was confirmed instead. Ebola’s global fatality can approach 50%. Indonesia is tightening port/airport screening, maintaining 24/7 SKDR/PHEOC monitoring, expanding lab readiness, and issuing public guidance on transmission and precautions.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアではエボラが発生したことがあるか？その事実
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言した多国におけるエボラアウトブレイクであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアでのエボラ発生の有無を扱う記事だが、実際の主要な流行はDRCのIturi Province（Bundibugyo virus disease）およびウガンダで発生。インドネシアは影響国ではなく、スクリーニング強化国として記述。DRCとガーナが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）した重大な多国アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les autorités recensent 543 cas probables dans les communautés en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Authorities report 543 probable cases in communities in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo authorities report 543 probable community cases of Bundibugyo Ebola in Ituri Province, with four health zones affected (Mungbwalu, Bunia, Rwampara, Nyakunde) and additional cases in Butembo and Goma. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May 2026 after INRB confirmation; Bunia samples identified Bundibugyo via genomic sequencing on 14–15 May. The strain is less pathogenic than Ebola Zaïre, but remains dangerous. About 32 positive cases confirmed by INRB; 69 patients are in specialized centers; 131 probable deaths, many before confirmation. A multisectoral response led by the President with health, defense, interior, transport, and finance ministers; 14 tons of medical and protective equipment en route to Bunia. RDC reports a network of laboratories in Bunia, Mbandaka, Kisangani, Kananga for rapid detection. No cases in Kinshasa. Muyembe notes prior Ebola experience; vaccination/treatment candidates may be evaluated; rumor control urged; avoid contact with dead animals; proper cooking of food.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：イトゥリの地域社会で543件の疑いケースが確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当。進行中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、複数地域での拡大、高い死亡率、国家レベルの対応が実施されており、シグナルとして明らかにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に正式宣言されたBundibugyo型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイク。543件の疑いケース、確認症例32件、疑い死亡131件（公式確認前の死亡を含む）。イトゥリ州の4つの保健ゾーン（Mungbwalu、Bunia、Rwampara、Nyakunde）およびButembo、Gomaでも症例が報告されている。国家レベルでの多部門的対応が進行中で、医療機器・保護具が送付されている。Zaïre型より病原性は低いが依然として危険。国際的な感染拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola et l'hantavirus montrent que le monde est mal préparé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and hantavirus show that the world is ill-prepared.
article.articleSummary: Two recent outbreaks—Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and a hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise MV Hondius—show that global pandemic preparedness remains insufficient despite improvements in crisis response under updated International Health Regulations. Since the May 15 alert for a new Ebola flare in DRC, the Bundibugyo Ebola virus is suspected to have caused over 130 deaths in a remote province, while tests on another Ebola strain were negative. On the Hondius, three deaths were linked to hantavirus, a strain endemic to the Argentine region from which the ship departed, though authorities question how aware ship operators were of that risk. A confirmed Ebola case involved an American national. Helen Clark argues that surveillance, early detection, and risk-based preparedness are underdeveloped, and that worldwide aid cuts threaten prevention, calling for deeper investigations and financing aligned with shared interests.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとハンタウイルスは世界が対策不足であることを示している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の異なる疾患による多国にまたがる同時発生、重症度（130人以上の死亡）、国際的な政策提言を伴う高い社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数地域の疾患イベント（DRC内エボラ、クルーズ船ハンタウイルス）を論じているが、対象国リストで実際に該当するのはDRCのみ。米国とアルゼンチンは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。クルーズ船のハンタウイルスはアルゼンチン由来の株だが、事象の主舞台は船（国際水域）であり、アルゼンチンでの現地発生ではないため除外。Helen Clark等の国際的なポリシー言及が高い社会的・政治的関心を示している。

article.articleHeadline: 专家：汉坦病毒伊波拉疫情暴露大流行病认知不足
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts: Hantavirus and Ebola outbreaks expose insufficient understanding of pandemics.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreaks on a Holland America Line luxury cruise ship departing Ushuaia, Argentina, have killed three passengers; the remainder were evacuated and quarantined in affected countries. Concurrently, a fresh Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 136 deaths and 543 suspected cases, with transmission appearing to have progressed for weeks unnoticed. At the World Health Assembly in Geneva, former New Zealand prime minister Helen Clark, co-chair of the Independent Panel for Pandemic Preparedness and Response, warned that despite improvements and functioning International Health Regulations, knowledge of risk-based preparedness remains insufficient. She highlighted gaps in monitoring and early detection. Clark also cited severe reductions in international aid for outbreak response, forcing countries to shoulder what donors previously funded, risking a “perfect storm” where the world's poorest cannot bear costs, undermining public health readiness.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家：ハンタウイルスとエボラの集団発生が不十分なパンデミック認知を露呈
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症イベント（ハンタウイルス、エボラ）が同時並行で報告され、IHR基準で3項目以上該当。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、重症度（死亡例あり）が認められ、WHO主催の国際会議でも言及される社会的・政治的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはアルゼンチン（ウスアイア）でのハンタウイルス集団発生も記載されているが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはエボラ集団発生の報告により対象国として認定。ジュネーブはWHA開催地だが、発生地ではないため除外。複数国にまたがる渡航関連リスク、国際会議での政治的関心、援助削減によるリスク増大が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Reforçada prevenção de ébola a nível fronteiriço, comunitário e de resposta médica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthened Ebola prevention at border, community, and medical response levels
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention strengthened at border, medical, and community levels in Macau. Health Services of Macau (SSM), with the Public Security Police, are reinforcing border screening, medical response, and community actions to prevent importation and transmission. The Conde de São Januário Hospital Center (CHCSJ) activated contingency measures, implemented infection control protocols, and conducted training on triage, notification, lab testing, and PPE use. Border posts now screen travelers from affected regions; symptomatic individuals are transported to CHCSJ for evaluation, while asymptomatic entrants are monitored. Arrival notices urge self-declaration of travel history for those with risk factors. Macau reports enhanced border-inspection mechanism and updated hospital guidelines: clinicians should review travel history within 21 days for suspected cases, and facilities must ensure isolation, patient transfer, and infection-control readiness. Community outreach continues; risk remains low, but vigilance persists. Return travelers should maintain hygiene, avoid contact with fluids and wildlife, and report travel history on return.

triage.headline_ja: マカオでエボラウイルス病の予防強化 - 国境、コミュニティ、医療対応レベルでの対策
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻な病原体であり国際的懸念が高いが、本記事は「マカオでの予防措置の強化」という準備・警戒活動の報告であり、実際の発症例や流行は記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはマカオ（香港特別行政区と同様、中国領土）での予防措置強化を報じており、実際の患者発生や流行は記載されていない。エボラは極めて高リスク病原体だが、現段階では準備活動の報告のみ。「影響を受けた地域からの旅行者をスクリーニング」という記述から周辺地域でのエボラ発生が暗示されるが、具体的な流行国は記事に明記されていない。マカオ=中国に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Σε κατάσταση συναγερμού οι υγειονομικές Αρχές - Έκτακτη σύσκεψη στον ΕΟΔΥ για την επιδημία στην Αφρική (βίντεο)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Health authorities on high alert - Emergency meeting at EODY regarding the outbreak in Africa (video).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak has caused at least 130 deaths, prompting Greece’s Public Health Organization (EODY) to hold an emergency meeting to assess protective measures. Centered in Democratic Republic of Congo and spreading to other African countries, the outbreak has mobilized European and international health authorities. EODY experts, with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC), are evaluating epidemiological data and traveler protections for people from affected regions. Despite global concern, Greek risk is low as there are no direct flights from outbreak areas; coordination session planned. EODY Scientific Council head notes Ebola is not airborne and suspected cases will trigger isolation and quarantine protocols. The United States has tightened border controls for Uganda, Congo, and South Sudan after a confirmed case involving an American citizen in the region. Symptoms: fever, weakness, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, hemorrhaging, multi-organ failure; case fatality ranges from 25% to 90% depending on strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：保健当局が高度警戒態勢に—アフリカにおける流行に関しEODYで緊急会議開催（動画）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（130人以上の死亡）で、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、国際対応の必要性）。対象国DRCで確認されており、WHO通知相当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的に『Democratic Republic of Congo中心に拡大、アメリカがウガンダ・コンゴ・南スーダンへの国境管理を強化』と記載。ウガンダ・スーダン・南スーダンについては記事では対象国リストに該当しないため除外。ただしDRCが対象国として確認されたため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Virus se nezaustavljivo širi, otkriven događaj koji je sve pokrenuo: "Od tada smo doživjeli niz smrti"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus is spreading uncontrollably; a revealed event that started it all: "Since then we have witnessed a string of deaths."
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with 25–50% fatality and no vaccine or therapy. The epidemic has spread to Uganda, with over 130 deaths and more than 500 suspected cases. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and convened an emergency meeting. A mass funeral procession in Bunia, northeastern Congo, is cited as a superspreading event; symptoms began around April 24. Most cases originate in Ituri's Mongwalu and Rwampara, but the virus has reached Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Gome, over 600 km away. Two cases have been confirmed in Uganda; an American doctor infected in Congo was evacuated to Germany, with others evacuated. The US barred entry for travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Transmission starts from wildlife to humans via bodily fluids, then human-to-human spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスが制御不能に拡大、すべての発端となった事象が判明：「それ以来、私たちは一連の死亡を目撃している」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の多国家への拡大、高い致死率（25～50%）、130人以上の死亡と500人以上の疑い例、WHO緊急事態宣言により、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Sudan、Rwanda、United States、Germanyが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ発生であり、ウガンダへの拡大（2例確認）は言及されているものの、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ウガンダでの追加確認があれば情報更新が必要。WHOが国際保健上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、米国による渡航制限も発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hyundai Bioscience: "Able to Supply Antiviral Drug in Event of Ebola or Hantavirus Spread"
article.articleSummary: Hyundai Bioscience announced it can supply clinical trial doses of XAFTY®, its broad-spectrum antiviral, to respond to Ebola and hantavirus outbreak concerns. The company will provide products immediately if the World Health Organization or affected countries request support, drawing from stock on hand. XAFTY® uses niclosamide as its main ingredient, which has been reported to inhibit Ebola and hantavirus. In Vietnam, XAFTY® is in Phase 2 trials for dengue fever, with no adverse events reported so far. The firm contends that in a scenario with two viruses spreading simultaneously, XAFTY® could serve as an effective alternative. Hyundai Bioscience is a member of the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium (MCDC), a U.S. Department of Defense-supported consortium, and will cooperate in international public health crises. Published May 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス：「エボラまたはハンタウイルス拡大の際に抗ウイルス薬を供給可能」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は製薬企業による医薬品供給能力の発表であり、実際の感染症発生や流行を報告するものではない。仮定的シナリオに基づいた企業ニュースであるため、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムでのXAFTY®のデング熱Phase2試験について言及しているが、これは実際の疾患発生イベントではなく臨床試験の進行状況である。米国（ノーフォーク）での企業ニュース配信であるため、感染症危機管理のシグナルとして扱う根拠がない。

article.articleHeadline: Fear grips eastern DR Congo amid deadly Ebola outbreak - RocketNews
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo triggers fear from Bukavu to Kinshasa as cases rise. Residents and street vendors report heightened anxiety, with many wearing face masks while calling for stronger protections against the latest outbreak in DR Congo. The article underscores a deadly Ebola outbreak and a sense of fear of dying among locals, noting that concern stretches across cities hundreds of miles apart. While no exact case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided in the text, the report situates the outbreak in eastern DR Congo and identifies Bukavu specifically, with Kinshasa cited as a distant hub of public worry. Published on 20 May 2026, the piece appears on RocketNews, an aggregator pulling content from multiple providers.

triage.headline_ja: 恐怖がDR Congo東部を襲う：致命的なエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDR Congo（対象国）で確認されており、複数地域（東部からキンシャサまで）への広がりが報告されている。IHR基準のうち少なくとも3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当する。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ出血熱の流行がDR Congo東部（South Kivu州、Bukavu）で発生しており、キンシャサまで懸念が広がっていることが確認される。正確な症例数や検査確認数は記載されていないが、『致命的な流行』『死への恐怖』『強化された対策の要求』などから重症度と社会的関心の高さが伺える。配信日時が2026年5月20日であり、将来の仮想シナリオと考えられるが、評価フレームワークに従い判定を実施した。

article.articleHeadline: Asian countries tighten precautions against Ebola after WHO declaration
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in central Africa threatening Congo’s northeastern Ituri province with more than 540 suspected cases and dozens of deaths since late April; WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern. No cases publicly confirmed in Asia yet. Governments tighten border screening and quarantine readiness; Hong Kong inspects a Lantau Island quarantine facility for potential use if a lab-confirmed case is detected. China’s mainland authorities (as of May 18) require travelers from affected regions who have had contact with a known Ebola case or who exhibit fever or nausea to declare themselves. Singapore, Japan, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Nepal have increased monitoring at ports of entry. South Korea requires travelers from Congo and neighboring Uganda and South Sudan to report health conditions to quarantine officials. India is expanding laboratory preparedness, with the National Institute of Virology in Pune designated as a nodal testing hub.

triage.headline_ja: WHO宣言後、アジア諸国がエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、アジア複数国での警戒体制強化が確認されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: アフリカのコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）での540件以上の疑い患者と複数の死亡事例がWHOにより国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言された。記事サマリーではアジアで確認症例はないが、複数国が検疫施設強化、渡航者スクリーニング強化、実験室診断体制の拡充等の先制的対応を実施している。特にインドのプネの国立ウイルス研究所が検査ハブとして指定されたことが記載されている。対象国外（DRC, Uganda, Sudan等）の主要発生地も記載されているが、verified_locationsには実際の検査・準備体制が確認できる対象国のみを列挙した。

article.articleHeadline: News kompakt: US-Ebola-Patient wird in Berlin behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News in Brief: U.S. Ebola patient is being treated in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached the United States via a physician who contracted the virus there and has been evacuated to Germany. The patient is being treated on a dedicated high-containment isolation unit at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin; six high-risk contacts are also to be treated in Berlin. The isolation ward is described as a self-contained, secure unit with separate access routes, airlocks, negative-pressure ventilation, and closed wastewater processing; authorities say there is no danger to the German public. Ebola is a highly contagious, life-threatening disease transmitted through direct contact with infected blood or other body fluids. This is an imported case to Germany in the context of the Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース速報：米国のエボラ患者がベルリンで治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染チェーンが確認され、複数国にまたがる確定事例である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国で検出された医療専門家の事例について述べているが、その専門家がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラに感染したことが主要なイベントであり、ドイツ（ベルリン）はあくまで治療地点。対象国リストに基づき、実際にアウトブレイクが発生している DRC のみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Expert: South Africans should not panic over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: South Africa's risk remains very low for Ebola as the outbreak continues in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with spread to Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak an international health emergency. As of 20 May 2026, the DRC reports more than 130 deaths and over 500 suspected cases; several cases have been recorded in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain linked to this outbreak has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though a vaccine candidate is under consideration. Transmission requires close contact with bodily fluids, typically within households or in healthcare settings, with healthcare workers affected and at least one death reported. The outbreak is centered in conflict-hit eastern DRC, where violence and cross-border movement hinder response efforts; some countries have implemented travel screening. The DRC’s 2018–2020 outbreak killed more than 2,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家：南アフリカ人はエボラ感染症の拡大について混乱すべきではない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国での死亡・重症例あり。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ感染症の拡大を記述しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。南アフリカは記事で言及されているが、リスク評価の対象地域としてのみで実際の発生地ではない（記事の主題はDRC/ウガンダの現地状況）。WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、130名超の死亡、500件超の疑似症例、ワクチンなし、医療従事者への影響など重篤性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Doctor says Ebola outbreak in Congo 'much bigger' than we think
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 130 people and sickened over 500 suspected cases as of May 20, 2026. The ministry indicates the outbreak likely spread beyond the continent, with one American exposed in DR Congo testing positive after travel and being treated in Berlin’s Charité hospital; six high‑risk contacts are being transferred to Europe for strict quarantine. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, and catastrophic bleeding, with rapid progression and potential death within 24 hours. Dr. Craig Spencer, a physician who survived the 2014 Guinea outbreak and later worked with MSF, says the current outbreak is likely much larger than official figures. triage.headline_ja: 医師がコンゴのエボラ感染症流行は「我々が考えるよりはるかに大きい」と指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行が複数国に拡大（DRC→ドイツ、米国への渡航感染者確認）し、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。国際的な感染拡大リスク、重症度、管理可能性の課題があり、高度な注視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはベルリン、ドイツ、米国、ギニアが含まれるが、記事サマリーによるとイベントの主要な発生地はDRCである。渡航による二次感染（ドイツでの患者発見）は確認されるが、DRC外での実質的な流行発生は述べられていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Фанатов сборной ДР Конго могут не пустить в США из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fans of the DR Congo national team may not be allowed into the United States due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's national football team is cleared to compete in the 2026 World Cup, but fans may be barred from entering the United States amid an Ebola outbreak. FIFA is in contact with FECOFA and WHO to implement safety measures and keep the team informed of recommendations. FECOFA canceled the May 17 training camp in Kinshasa because of the outbreak. The Ebola epidemic was reported last week in Ituri province, near Uganda, with more than 500 suspected cases and at least 131 deaths. On May 17, WHO declared the Ebola event in DR Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo since 1976; the largest occurred 2014–2016 in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, with 28,646 cases and 11,323 deaths. In Group Stage, DR Congo faces Portugal (June 17), Colombia (June 23), Uzbekistan (June 27) in Houston, Guadalajara, and Atlanta.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国代表チームのファンが、エボラ流行のため米国への入国を許可されないおそれ
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準により「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的な拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当（3項目）。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）宣言。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にエボラ関連イベントをPHEIC宣言。イトゥリ州でのアウトブレイク（500例以上の疑い例、131人以上の死亡）。米国への渡航制限のリスク顕在化。Bluedot APIが米国各州や他国を誤抽出しているが、実際の感染イベントはDRCで発生。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Why a rare strain is causing concern and raising vigilance around the world
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, a Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak spanning DR Congo and Uganda has triggered a WHO public health emergency of international concern, with vigilance rising in Asia. With 500+ confirmed cases and 131 suspected deaths, the outbreak is notable for its geographic spread and lack of approved vaccines or drugs for this strain. Bundibugyo, named after Ugandan province, has a 30–40% mortality rate, lower than Zaire's ~90%, and is hard to manage due to limited healthcare access in remote and conflict-affected areas. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, and headache, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, bleeding, organ failure. Initial tests sometimes missed infections because assays weren’t designed for this strain; overlapping malaria and cholera hinder case finding. Limited funding for other diseases weakened surveillance; new funding is being mobilized.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイク：稀な株が懸念を引き起こし、世界中で警戒が高まっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な株、国際的拡大リスク、国際的関心）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。500+確認症例、131死亡疑い例。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC及びウガンダでの発生を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダはリスト外のため除外。WHO PHEIC既に宣言済み。アジアでの警戒上昇も報告されているが、具体的な患者発生は記述されていない。Bundibugyo株は既承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、30-40%の致死率で極めて懸念。医療へのアクセス限定と紛争地帯での管理困難性が特記。

article.articleHeadline: Do Česka mieri pacient, ktorý môže mať veľmi nebezpečné ochorenie. Úrady upokojujú situáciu | interez.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient headed for the Czech Republic who may have a very dangerous disease. Authorities reassure the situation.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen headed to the Czech Republic is under investigation for suspected Ebola virus infection. U.S. CDC first reported the case, later confirmed by the Czech Ministry of Health. Authorities say there is no public risk as procedures are in place; the patient will be transported to Prague's Bulovka University Hospital in a transport box, under strict safety measures. Bulovka operates a high-containment unit with negative-pressure rooms, bioboxes, and modern equipment, with an experienced team following stringent international protocols. The risk of importing Ebola into the Czech Republic is considered low. Separately, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been raised to a public health emergency of international concern by the WHO. Deaths are estimated at 131 among 513 suspected cases. The epicenter is Ituri province, in the northeast near Uganda and South Sudan. The Bundibugyo variant has no available vaccine or proven treatment.

triage.headline_ja: チェコに向かう患者が非常に危険な病気の可能性あり。当局が状況を沈静化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な移動ケース、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）の発表、複数国への拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、アメリカからチェコへの患者移動ケースとDRCでの流行が記載されている。ただし検証対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ（Ituri province での流行）。チェコ、アメリカ、スーダン、ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。DRCでのエボラ流行はWHOによりPHEIC指定されており、死亡131件・疑い症例513件、Bundibugyo変種でワクチンなしとの深刻な状況が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: США развернут 50 временных госпиталей в Африке для помощи в борьбе с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will deploy 50 temporary hospitals in Africa to aid in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026 — The United States will fund up to 50 temporary medical facilities in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda to aid Ebola outbreak response. The State Department says the facilities will deliver patient care and rapid Ebola screening in the most affected regions and support outbreak response operations. Ebola virus transmission occurs from wildlife; initial symptoms are fever, headache, myalgia, and sore throat, followed by kidney and liver dysfunction and, in some cases, internal and external bleeding. The first human Ebola case was recorded in the modern DR Congo in 1976. The largest Ebola outbreak by cases occurred in 2014–2016 in West Africa (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with deaths exceeding 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がアフリカでエボラ対策支援のため50の臨時病院を展開
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での発生が確認され、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」「異常/予想外か」「国際的拡大リスク」の3基準に該当。米国による大規模な国際支援の展開も報告されており、シグナルとしてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、ウガンダ、ギニア、リベリアが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでの現在の発生対応である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。2014-2016年の西アフリカ大流行の歴史的背景も記載されているが、現在の発生地は記事から明確にDRC/ウガンダ。米国による大規模な臨時医療施設展開（50施設）は国際的な公衆衛生対応の重要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic Congo kills 131 as WHO declares emergency - Daily Times
article.articleSummary: 131 people killed in Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with at least 26 new deaths confirmed recently as the epidemic intensifies. WHO has declared a global health emergency, urging surveillance, preparedness, and cross-border monitoring to curb transmission. The outbreak stretches across affected regions amid limited healthcare infrastructure and delayed detection in remote areas, complicating containment. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected bodily fluids; common symptoms include fever, weakness, vomiting, and, in severe cases, internal bleeding. Weak medical systems, shortages of trained personnel, and restricted access to testing hamper timely diagnosis and treatment, especially in rural communities with limited hospital access. Border controls are tightening: Jordan has banned travelers from the DRC and neighboring regions. International health agencies are assisting Congolese authorities to trace contacts, isolate patients, and distribute supplies, but escalation could continue without scaled-up global support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクが131人を殺害、WHOが緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大と高い死亡率は優先的な評価対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのアウトブレイク主体。ジョルダンは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー上ではDRCからの渡航者への対策（渡航禁止）として言及のみ。実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。死亡数131人、最近の新規死亡26人確認。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。医療インフラの脆弱性と辺境地域での検出遅延が管理を複雑化。ヒト-ヒト感染による急速拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pacjent z podejrzeniem Eboli trafi do szpitala w Czechach. Mógł zarazić się w Ugandzie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with suspected Ebola will be admitted to a hospital in the Czech Republic. He could have contracted it in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor who treated a patient with Ebola in Uganda is being transported to Prague, Czech Republic, for evaluation; this is a suspected, not confirmed, case and the patient currently has no symptoms. He will be admitted to Bulovka Hospital, a facility specialized in dangerous infections, after air transport in a secure isolation container, with transport and care following strict safety and international protocols. The move, requested by the American side, aims to ensure isolation and protection of the public. Six people at risk are slated for treatment in European hospitals, including one in Prague.
