Africa CDC and WHO warned of Ebola cases in the DRC and Uganda, and WHO on May 17 declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal and head pain, potentially followed by hemorrhage and multi-organ failure; mortality varies by strain.

triage.headline_ja: チェコの病院に疑い患者が搬送 ウガンダで感染の可能性があるエボラ患者
triage.triage_reason: WHOが5月17日にエボラをPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言しており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。また、DRC及びウガンダにおけるエボラの確認が報告されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはチェコへの搬送ケースを主に述べているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC及びウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、多国間での患者転送・隔離措置が実施されている点から国際的な重要度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫警告：刚果（金） 伊波拉疫情恐持续扩散|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Warns: Ebola Outbreak in Congo (Kinshasa) May Continue to Spread | Guanghua Net
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus continues to spread at a worrying scale and speed. As of May 19, 2026, health authorities report 136 deaths among suspected cases and 543 suspected cases, with 69 patients being treated in Ebola treatment centers. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC over the past five decades. The World Health Organization says the outbreak has been designated as an International Public Health Emergency of Concern, though it has not reached pandemic-level status. The northeast Ituri region faces strained isolation capacity amid ongoing insecurity, raising cross-border risks to neighboring Uganda. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; containment relies on case tracing, isolation, and basic infection control. Uganda has reported one death and one infection among Congolese nationals entering from DRC; no community transmission yet.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関が警告：コンゴ（キンシャサ）のエボラ出血熱の流行が持続的に拡散する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当、高い社会政治的関心。エボラ出血熱のPHEIC認定は明確なシグナルであり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているエボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州）です。ウガンダへの国境越え事例が言及されていますが、実際の継続的な流行はDRCが主体であり、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めます。WHO PHEC認定、543例の疑似患者、136例の死亡、医療施設の収容能力不足、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）という要素すべてが深刻度を示しています。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se nedeljama širila: Svet u panici, otkriveno kako je sve krenulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spread for weeks: The world in a panic, how it all began was revealed.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the DR Congo and Uganda triggers a WHO health emergency. This strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment and kills about a third of those infected. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, DR Congo, including Bunia and Mongbvalua, with spread linked to a large funeral procession. Transmission likely began unseen in March; indicators appeared May 5, positives in Kinshasa on May 14, and WHO declared the outbreak the next day. By May 20, at least 500 suspected cases and around 130 deaths linked to Ebola have been reported; Ituri shows about 131 deaths, including 15 from one family. Two cases crossed into Kampala, Uganda, and another in Goma near Rwanda; M23 dynamics complicate response. Four health workers have died; seven tons of emergency supplies and a 35-member team arrived. The US has withdrawn from WHO, planning traveler screening and visa suspensions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが数週間広がる：世界がパニックに、すべての始まりが明かされた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の発生は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国への国際的拡大とWHO緊急事態認定により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事にはウガンダ（Kampala）とルワンダ（Goma近郊）への症例報告が明記されているが、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。米国のWHO撤退と渡航制限計画が記載されているが、感染イベント自体はDRC・ウガンダが主要な発生地。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）は承認されたワクチンが無く、致死率約33%という高い重症度が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hyundai Bioscience: "Able to Supply Antiviral Drug in Event of Ebola or Hantavirus Spread"
article.articleSummary: as of May 20, 2026, Hyundai Bioscience announced it can supply clinical trial doses of XAFTY®, a broad-spectrum antiviral whose main ingredient niclosamide has been reported to inhibit Ebola and hantavirus, in response to growing global concern over Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks. The company said it can immediately provide products in stock if the World Health Organization (WHO) or affected countries request support. XAFTY® is in Phase 2 for dengue fever in Vietnam, with no adverse events reported to date. In a scenario where two viruses spread simultaneously, XAFTY® could serve as an effective alternative. Hyundai Bioscience notes its membership in the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium (MCDC), a U.S. Department of Defense–supported group, and pledges active cooperation in international public health crises. Contact: Jason Kim.

triage.headline_ja: 現代バイオサイエンス「エボラ出血熱またはハンタウイルス流行時に抗ウイルス薬を供給可能」
triage.triage_reason: 記事は医薬品企業の声明であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。現在の感染症イベント（確認された症例、死亡、流行）に関する具体的な情報がなく、仮定的なシナリオに基づいている。
triage.notes: 記事は医薬品企業（現代バイオサイエンス）による医薬品供給能力に関する企業声明であり、実際の感染症イベント通知ではない。ベトナムでのXAFTY®のデング熱Phase 2臨床試験実施が言及されているが、これは進行中の医学研究であり、新規アウトブレイク警報ではない。Bluedot APIによる「United States」と「Vietnam」の地域付与は、企業声明の内容（仮定的なシナリオと臨床試験実施国）に基づくものと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Christians call for ceasefire amid DRC's Ebola crisis
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province has killed 131 people, with over 500 suspected cases reported in DRC; one death has been recorded in Uganda. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain; there is currently no approved vaccine or therapeutics. The context includes ongoing conflict in the DRC involving government forces, the M23 group, and Islamist militants, with poverty, fragile health systems, displacement and food insecurity heightening vulnerability. World Council of Churches general secretary Rev Jerry Pillay urged ceasefire and a strengthened humanitarian response, including accurate medical information, cross-border cooperation to share treatments and resources, and safe delivery of aid for health workers. He called on all parties to halt fighting to enable access, and on global communities to support the most vulnerable through solidarity and sustained aid.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ危機の中、キリスト教指導者が停戦を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、複数国での発生、死亡者数が増加、既に国境を越えた感染確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（GeoNames ID含まれるが対象国リストに無いため除外）での死亡報告あり。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療薬なし、紛争との複合危機。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。記事は DRC Ituri 州での発生が主題であり、DRC のみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Keluarkan 4 Langkah Waspada Ebola untuk Seluruh Daerah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Issues Four Ebola Alert Measures for All Regions.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Indonesia's Ministry of Health issued four Ebola alert measures for all regions in response to potential cases linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Circular SR.03.01/C/2783/2026 directs provincial and regency/city health offices to implement enhanced surveillance at health facilities, using dengue-like fever syndrome as the trigger for Ebola risk, in line with the Ebola Preparedness Guidelines and the Technical Guidelines for Sentinel Surveillance of Emerging Infectious Diseases in Hospitals. Monitoring will be conducted via event-based surveillance (EBS) utilizing the SKDR Early Warning and Response System app. Guidelines are downloadable at https://s.kemkes.go.id/INFOEBOLA. The circular, signed by Acting Director General for Disease Eradication Andi Saguni on May 19, 2026, emphasizes readiness to detect and respond to cross-border Ebola threats from RD Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ警戒のための4つの対策を全地域に発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラの国際的な越境脅威に対するインドネシアの公式な警戒体制発令であり、異常/予想外の事象、国際的拡大のリスク、管理可能性の観点で複数のスクリーニング基準に該当し、政府レベルの関心が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はインドネシアが発行した公式な警戒体制（Circular SR.03.01/C/2783/2026）であり、DRC/ウガンダからの越境脅威への対応として国家レベルの監視体制強化を示している。イベント監視システムの活用、健康施設での強化サーベイランス、デング熱様症候群をエボラリスク検出のトリガーとすることが記載されている。インドネシアのみが verified_locations 対象国で、DRC（203312）はAPI発生地域に含まれているがサマリー上では脅威源として言及されているため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Η ΛΔ του Κονγκό θα συμμετάσχει στο Μουντιάλ παρά την έξαρση του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo will participate in the World Cup despite the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC to participate in the 2026 World Cup in the United States despite an Ebola outbreak in the country. U.S. authorities tightened border checks, barring entry for foreigners who traveled to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the last 21 days. An unnamed U.S. official said the Congolese team, which has trained in Europe, may not be barred; a member who traveled through the DRC within the 21‑day window could be exempt, but would face the same testing and isolation protocols as Americans returning from the DRC. Congolese supporters are excluded from this exemption. The DRC, based in Houston, Texas, has been drawn into the 11th group and will play Portugal on June 17 in Houston, Colombia on June 24 in Guadalajara, Mexico, and Uzbekistan on June 28 in Atlanta.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国はエボラ流行にもかかわらず2026年ワールドカップに参加する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、予想外の状況（大規模国際スポーツイベント中の発生），および渡航制限の実施によりIHR基準を複数満たす。国際的関心が高く，フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での2026年ワールドカップ開催中にDRCで発生しているエボラ流行に言及している。Bluedot APIから返却された「発生地域」には米国内の都市（ヒューストン，アトランタ）およびメキシコの都市が含まれているが、これらはワールドカップの試合開催地であり、エボラの実際の発生地ではない。記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ流行であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。対象国リスト外の国（スーダン，ウガンダ，ポルトガル，ウズベキスタン，メキシコ，米国，コロンビア）については除外。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي سلالة نادرة من فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو.. وتسجيل 26 وفاة خلال 24 ساعة - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of a rare strain of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 26 deaths recorded within 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain triggers a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In the past 24 hours, authorities reported 26 additional deaths, bringing total fatalities to 131, with 516 suspected cases and 33 confirmed infections in the DRC, plus 2 confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. WHO warns of rapid spread and limited diagnostic capacity (only six tests per hour) and notes that vaccines or therapeutics still under development are being considered for response. Uganda has restricted movement at a Congo–Uganda border crossing; Reuters reports Congolese citizens were blocked from crossing into Rwanda from the towns of Goma and Bukavu. The United States plans to fund up to 50 clinics and care/isolation zones in the DRC and Uganda. Bahrain, UAE, and Jordan have announced precautionary entry measures for travelers from affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの稀な株がコンゴで流行、24時間以内に26人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な国際感染症イベント。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の流行が複数国で確認され、高い死亡率、急速な拡大、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCが主発生地で、ウガンダでも確認例があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsから除外。エボラの稀なBundibugyo株による流行、高い死亡率（131人）、診断能力の不足、複数国での渡航制限措置、国際的な支援体制構築が特徴。Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）レベルの事象。

article.articleHeadline: Pacjent z Ebolą trafił do szpitala u naszych sąsiadów. "Ledwo trzymał się na nogach". Coraz większe niepokoje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with Ebola was admitted to a hospital in our neighboring country. "He could barely stand." Growing concerns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or specific treatment. As of now, at least 131 deaths and 531 suspected infections across Central Africa. On May 19, 2026, WHO convened an emergency committee as the outbreak potentially exceeds official counts; past Bundibugyo outbreaks showed 30–50% mortality. An imported case is highlighted: American surgeon Dr. Peter Stafford contracted Ebola while operating on a 33-year-old patient in the DRC; the patient died the next day. Stafford developed symptoms days before Africa CDC confirmed the outbreak, with a positive test on Sunday. He was treated in Germany on Tuesday; hospital staff wore full PPE, and he appeared exhausted and very ill. Stafford’s wife, Dr. Rebekah Stafford, and their four young children remain in Congo under monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が隣国の病院に入院。「やっと立っていられる状態」。懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、131人の死亡、国際的な症例輸入、WHOの緊急委員会開催により、シグナル認定基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ症例と、米国の医師がドイツで治療を受けた国際的な症例輸入を記述しており、DRCが主要な発生地。米国・ドイツは患者治療地であり、発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による深刻な流行で、WHOが緊急委員会を開催した重大な事象。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă globală! Ebola scapă de sub control: Un pacient infectat a ajuns în Germania - Ziarul Românesc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Alert! Ebola is out of control: An infected patient has arrived in Germany - The Romanian Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, with 513 suspected cases and 131 presumed deaths reported by health authorities; the epicenter is Ituri Province near Uganda and South Sudan. Dr. Stafford, who treated a 33-year-old patient at Nyankunde Hospital, performed abdominal surgery; the patient died the next day and was later considered Ebola-suspected. Stafford developed symptoms and tested positive, then was transported to Berlin’s Charité for isolation, along with six contacts. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern before the emergency committee vote, noting no approved vaccine or effective treatment for Bundibugyo. Africa CDC urges caution on travel bans; Germany issued travel advisories, and Rwanda closed its eastern border with DRC. This marks Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976; the West Africa 2014–2015 outbreak (Zaire variant) remains the deadliest, with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルアラート！エボラが制御不能に：感染患者がドイツに到着 - ルーマニア新聞
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4/4全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC→ドイツ）、WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、死亡例報告、ドイツ・ルワンダによる渡航制限措置等により、複数の重要なシグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生が主要テーマであり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。ドイツ・ルワンダの言及は発生地ではなく対応国であるため除外。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の全てが該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, tasso di mortalità al 50%: l'Oms vede nero, così l'allarme arriva in Italia | Libero Quotidiano.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, mortality rate at 50%: the WHO sees a bleak outlook, this is how the alarm reaches Italy.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with spillover concerns to Uganda and international travel. As of today, the World Health Organization reports 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases in Congo; two cases in Uganda, and a U.S. citizen who tested positive was moved to Germany. The case fatality rate has risen to about 50%, up from 30%, amid widespread displacement of over 2 million people and limited access to basic services, raising transmission risk. Diagnosis arrived roughly three weeks after first cases, suggesting undercounting and potential spread to large cities with international airports. No approved vaccines exist for Bundibugyo; animal studies hint that the Ebola Zaire vaccine may offer some protection, and WHO's emergency committee is considering testing it. Italy has instituted targeted surveillance for health workers and logisticians, pre-departure declarations, and arrival screening; the U.S. has travel bans for recent travelers from affected areas; WHO does not advise travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、死亡率50%：WHOが懸念、このようにしてイタリアに警報が到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の疾患拡大、国際的スピルオーバー、渡航制限検討）。Bundibugyo Ebola（新型）による高致死率・大規模患者集団・複数国への拡大が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダとの国境スピルオーバーが記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみ記載。米国・イタリア・ドイツに発症者がいるが、これらも対象国外。Bundibugyo Ebola virus は稀な株であり、高致死率（50%）、ワクチン未承認、国際的スピルオーバーの実績がありエスカレーション傾向が明白。

article.articleHeadline: От проверок в аэропортах до отмены рейсов: как в Европе реагируют на вспышку Эболы?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From airport screenings to flight cancellations: how Europe is reacting to the Ebola outbreak?
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Europe weighs responses to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, while the United States tightens public-health measures. The article questions whether Europe will implement airport passenger screenings or flight cancellations and assesses potential effectiveness. It notes that the ongoing Ebola flare in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has prompted the US to rethink its historically softer approach to public-health interventions, influencing European debates on travel-related controls and cross-border monitoring. No concrete European measures are detailed in the piece, but travel screenings and disruptions are central considerations in regional risk management and prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 空港での検査から便のキャンセルまで：ヨーロッパはエボラ出血熱の流行にどう対応しているか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な感染症であり、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの流行は国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、複数国での公衆衛生対応が既に発動されているため、IHR基準3つ以上該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では、DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでの流行が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。米国およびヨーロッパは対応国であり、流行発生地ではないため除外。エボラ出血熱は IHR Annex2 基準を完全に満たし、国際的な関心と対応が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Naționala de fotbal a Republicii Democrate Congo va putea participa la Cupa Mondială din 2026, organizată în Statele Unite, în ciuda epidemiei de Ebola care afectează regiunea Africii Centrale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team will be able to participate in the 2026 World Cup, hosted in the United States, despite the Ebola outbreak affecting Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Despite Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa, the Democratic Republic of Congo national football team will participate in the 2026 World Cup hosted by the United States, with special entry derogations for the Congo delegation. A U.S. State Department official said DR Congo will face strengthened border health checks due to Ebola risk; foreign travelers who have recently visited Uganda, DR Congo, or South Sudan in the past 21 days face restrictions, though Congo players who trained in Europe are largely exempt. If any delegation member recently transited DR Congo, entry to the United States may still be granted under a special exemption, contingent on strict health measures, including testing and possible quarantine per protocols applied to Americans returning from Ebola-affected zones. DR Congo will base in Houston and compete in Group K, opening June 17 vs Portugal in Houston, then June 24 vs Colombia in Guadalajara, and June 28 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. The World Cup involves the United States, Canada, and Mexico, with 48 teams.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ流行にもかかわらず、コンゴ民主共和国のサッカー代表団は2026年ワールドカップ（米国開催）に参加可能
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行は中央アフリカで実在するが、本記事の主題は2026年ワールドカップへのコンゴ民主共和国チーム参加という政治・スポーツの話題であり、感染症の公衆衛生的な急性リスク評価ではない。IHR基準は複数該当する可能性があるが、対象国の既知流行と西半球へのスポーツイベント関連の輸入リスク管理の組み合わせであり、続報の監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の地理的標識（米国都市、メキシコ、ウルグアイなど）はスポーツイベント会場の列挙であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。エボラ流行は中央アフリカ（ウガンダ、DRC、南スーダン）で確認されており、DRCが対象国として検証される。ただし記事の焦点はワールドカップ参加資格と国境衛生措置であり、急性感染症危機というより管理可能性・政治的対応の文脈である。IHR基準では国際拡大リスクと渡航制限が該当するが、確認されている流行の規模・重症度・動向が不明確であるため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Suspek Ebola Melonjak Jadi 543 Kasus, 136 Orang Meninggal Tersebar di Wilayah Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola cases surge to 543; 136 people have died, spread across this region.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo reach 543 with 136 deaths, spanning Ituri Province’s Bunia and surrounding areas; 32 cases are laboratory-confirmed as Bundibugyo Ebola. Index case remains unidentified; the outbreak began in April, with a May 5 death in Bunia and funeral-related exposure in Mongbwalu. Genomic sequencing shows the circulating virus is a Bundibugyo variant arising from wildlife spillover, distinct from Ugandan 2007 and 2012 RD Congo strains. Response priorities include rapid detection, patient isolation, health worker protection, and safe burials, amid community resistance in affected areas. WHO technical advisory group meetings will discuss vaccines; Ervebo (Ebola Zaire vaccine) is under consideration and may offer cross-protection against Bundibugyo, though efficacy is unconfirmed. Three vaccine candidates are under review, with potential availability in about two months if approved. Key figures cited include RD Congo Health Minister Roger Kamba, WHO’s Adelheid Marschang Ancia, Africa CDC’s Jean Kaseya, and Jean-Jacques Muyembe.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者が543人に急増、136人が死亡 地域全体に散在
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を持ち、国際的な懸念事項であり、感染確認と死亡例が多数報告されている。フルRRAへの進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo種）の新興アウトブレイク。543疑い例、136死亡、32確認例が報告されている。ウガンダも発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア周辺）であり、ウガンダは歴史的比較参照のみのため verified_locations には含めない。野生動物からの人獣共通感染が原因と考えられ、ワクチン検討含む多角的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikansk ebolasmittad har landat i Tyskland
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American Ebola patient has landed in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American physician who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has arrived in Germany and was transported to Charité University Hospital in Berlin. Ebola is an RNA virus in the Filoviridae family that causes hemorrhagic fever. The Congo-Kinshasa outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo variant, for which the article states there are no vaccines or specific antiviral treatments. The case constitutes an imported infection from the DRC outbreak to Germany; no additional clinical details, diagnostic confirmation, symptoms, incubation period, or case counts are provided in the report. The incident highlights cross-border exposure risk during Ebola outbreaks and the lack of targeted interventions for the Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人エボラ患者がドイツに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際的移入ケースであり、Bundibugyo型に対するワクチン・抗ウイルス薬がないため、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: ドイツはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、イベントの主発生地はDRCであり、ドイツは輸入ケースの受け入れ国である。verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙（対象国リストに含まれるため）。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo型エボラの治療手段の欠如が重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลาระบาดคองโก เสียชีวิตพุ่งแตะ 131 ราย WHO กังวลการระบาดลุกลามรวดเร็ว : อินโฟเควสท์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: death toll surges to 131; WHO worries that the outbreak is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 131, with 543 suspected cases and 33 lab-confirmed infections; neighboring Uganda reports two confirmed cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned at the World Health Assembly in Geneva that the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is large and spreading rapidly. The Bundibugyo strain has previously been deemed a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Experts fear expansion in densely populated and conflict-affected areas. Anne Ancia, WHO representative to Congo, noted diagnostic capacity remains limited, able to screen about six samples per hour. Uganda has begun travel restrictions at the Ishasha–Kyacherro border crossing, though WHO cautions against blanket border closures. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids from infected humans or animals, with an average case fatality around 50%. Congo’s 2018–2020 Ebola outbreaks caused nearly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が流行、死者が131人に急増; WHOが急速な拡大を懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例と死亡者が報告され、隣国ウガンダでも確認例があり、国際的拡大リスクが高い。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。世界的な公衆衛生上の関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはスイス・ジュネーブも含まれているが、これはWHO世界保健総会の開催地言及であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。記事サマリーより実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダであるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsに含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain、限定的検査能力、紛争地域での懸念、50%の致死率などの要因により高リスク。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Μολυσμένος αμερικανός γιατρός φτάνει στο Βερολίνο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: An infected American doctor arrives in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American missionary doctor infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola was flown to Berlin's BER airport and transported by a convoy to Charite University Hospital, one of Germany's leading isolation facilities for highly contagious diseases. Dr. Peter Stafford and his wife Dr. Rebekah Stafford were accompanied by six contacts, including family. The Staffords have worked in Africa since 2019, primarily in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the infection occurred while caring for patients at Nyankunde Hospital near Bunia. The outbreak has sparked international concern; the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and U.S. health authorities have imposed temporary travel restrictions for some travelers from affected areas. In the DRC, 513 suspected cases and 131 probable deaths have been reported; cases have also been confirmed in Uganda. Ebola spreads via direct contact and bodily fluids; earlier Zaire outbreak in West Africa (2014-2015) killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染したアメリカ人医師がベルリンに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO PHEICの宣言、国際的な旅行制限、複数国での確認例、高い重症度（死亡例あり）により、フルのRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（エボラ・ブンディブギョ株）の確認。DRCでの発生地が明確（Bunia近郊のNyankunde Hospital）。ウガンダでの確認例も記載されているが、記事サマリー上は対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。ベルリンへの搬送は輸送事例であり、発生地ではない。WHO PHEICの宣言と米国の旅行制限により社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: دنیا ایک اور تباہ کن وبا کے دہانے پر ہے؟ ایبولا وائرس 131 جانیں نگل گیا - MM NEWS URDU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the world on the brink of another devastating outbreak? The Ebola virus has claimed 131 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged to 131 deaths and 513 suspected cases, with authorities noting rapid case increases and wider geographic spread beyond initial areas to major urban centers like Kampala, Uganda, and Goma in Congo. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; care remains supportive. The World Health Organization has expressed grave concern and labeled the situation extraordinary, signaling potential multi-country risk and the need for a global response. In Ituri Province, 246 people are affected with 65 deaths; overall, at least 80 deaths have been reported, including a patient who died in Uganda. U.S. CDC notes one American doctor infected in Congo and treated in Germany, with six other Americans evacuated or monitored. The United States has introduced enhanced screening and travel bans for travelers from Uganda, Congo, or South Sudan within the past 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 世界は別の壊滅的な流行の危機に瀕しているのか？エボラウイルスが131人の命を奪った
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間発生で、複数国での確認、高い死亡率、国際的対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（North-Kivu、Ituri Province）を主発生地として扱っており、ウガンダでの1例確認も記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。Bundibugyo strain であることが特筆すべき特徴。米国とドイツでの治療事例は輸入症例であり二次発生地ではないため除外。WHOが「extraordinary」と評価している点は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลาระบาดคองโก เสียชีวิตพุ่งแตะ 131 ราย WHO กังวลการระบาดลุกลามรวดเร็ว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: deaths rise to 131; WHO worries the outbreak is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC is expanding; deaths rise to 131, with 26 new fatalities in 24 hours. Suspected cases total 543; 33 lab-confirmed infections; Uganda reports 2 confirmed infections linked to cross-border transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus warned at the WHA in Geneva that the outbreak’s size and speed are worrying. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is involved; the outbreak has been declared a PHEIC previously, underscoring international concern. DRC's screening capacity remains limited (about 6 samples per hour). Uganda has restricted travel at the Ishasha border crossing with the DRC, though broad border closures are discouraged by WHO. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or animals; CFR around 50%. The region's vulnerability is worsened by population density and ongoing conflict; the 2018–2020 outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が流行、死亡者が131人に急増。WHOは感染拡大の急速化を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。死亡131人、国際的拡大（ウガンダ）、WHOがPHEIC警告を発出、公衆衛生上の重大な影響が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにウガンダでの2例の確定患者報告があるが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは二次的な拡大地。Ishasha（DRC側）での国境制限措置が言及されている。スイス（ジュネーブ）はWHA開催地として記載されているが、実際の発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（1995年以来のセロタイプ）、過去PHEIC宣言済み、DRC実験室検査能力の制限（時間6検体）が懸念材料。2018-2020年の先行流行による比較参照（約2,300人死亡）あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana must stay vigilant amid renewed Ebola threat
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared WHO emergencies, raise concern about Ghana. As of May 18, 2026, about 100 deaths and at least 395 suspected cases have been reported. Ghana, which had no confirmed Ebola case in 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, had suspected cases in Kumasi and Tamale that were negative. Preparedness includes surveillance teams, isolation centres, and training of more than 2,000 health workers. Ebola (Zaïre EBOV) is severe and often fatal; incubation 2–21 days. Early symptoms include diarrhoea, fatigue, vomiting, muscle pain, and headaches. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; it is not airborne or mosquito-borne. No universal cure; vaccines and newer treatments are limited. The MOH has intensified border screening and traveler monitoring; the public should practice regular handwashing, avoid contact with fluids from sick persons, and report symptoms promptly. Authorities should bolster surveillance at Accra airport and borders.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナはエボラの再燃の脅威に警戒態勢を維持すべき
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）に該当し、ウガンダ・DRCでの確定宣言と隣接国ガーナの警戒態勢が確立されている。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNamesリストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ガーナとDRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーで両国の状況が主題。ウガンダ・DRC での WHO宣言済み緊急事態が隣接国ガーナへの脅威となっており、国境スクリーニング強化などの対応が既に開始。

article.articleHeadline: Експерименталне вакцине и лекови против еболе у Конгу у фокусу СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experimental Ebola vaccines and drugs in Congo in the WHO's focus.
article.articleSummary: WHO is evaluating experimental Ebola vaccines and therapies for the Democratic Republic of Congo's Bundibugyo outbreak as cases and deaths rise. Since onset, at least 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths have been recorded, more than double the about 200 cases and 65 deaths reported last Friday. Experts are assessing unlicensed Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine and therapy candidates; existing Zaire ebolavirus vaccines cannot be deployed. IRC warns numbers may be iceberg's tip amid fears of cross-border spread to South Sudan. Confirmed 30 cases in Ituri; a case and a death in Kampala, Uganda; an American citizen tested positive and treated in Germany. Tedros declared a public health emergency of international concern. Over 40 experts and 12 tons of protective equipment have been sent. Transmission via contact with fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and bleeding. CFR around 50%, with earlier outbreaks 25–90%. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ実験的ワクチンと医薬品がWHOの焦点
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行で死亡率約50%、国境を越えた拡大懸念、国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模アウトブレイク（500疑い例、130死亡）。ウガンダ（Kampala）での症例確認、南スーダンへの越境拡大懸念、米国市民がドイツで治療されるなど国際的な拡大が既に起きている。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。既存のザイール型ワクチンは使用不可であり、Bundibugyo型ワクチン・治療薬の試験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : le CDC Afrique déclare la nouvelle épidémie d'Ebola comme une urgence de santé publique de portée continentale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: Africa CDC declares the new Ebola outbreak a continent-wide public health emergency.
article.articleSummary: On 20 May 2026, Africa CDC (CDC Afrique) declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a continent-wide public health emergency. About 395 suspected cases and 106 deaths have been reported in the DRC, primarily in Mongwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia, with 2 cases and 1 death in Kampala, Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no specific vaccine exists, raising the risk of regional spread. CDC Afrique Director General Jean Kaseya said the declaration will strengthen regional coordination, mobilize emergency resources, and accelerate preparedness in neighboring countries. The agency warns that intense cross-border movement, insecurity in affected areas, and weak infection prevention could heighten regional transmission risk. Emergency response teams have been deployed to support containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 保健：アフリカCDCが新型エボラ流行をアフリカ大陸規模の公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ流行の大陸規模の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言であり、死亡を含む重大な健康影響、異常な流行状況、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・ルワンダ関連）、ワクチンなしの危険な変異株による渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められ、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）とルワンダ（49518）も列挙されているが、記事サマリーから確認できる感染症イベントの主要発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは2例・1死の限定的な関連である。対象国リストはDRCのみを含むため、ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国外として除外。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行、ワクチン欠如、越境移動による地域的拡大リスク、アフリカCDCによる大陸規模緊急事態宣言という点で極めて高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, un vaccino russo in grado di combattere la variante mortale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a Russian vaccine capable of fighting the deadly variant.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is marked as a public health emergency of international concern by the WHO. The DRC reports more than 500 suspected cases and at least 131 deaths, while Uganda records one imported case and one death with around 100 people in isolation. Alarm signals surfaced on May 5; experts caution the virus may have circulated locally for weeks. There is no proven cure, but a Russian vaccine candidate developed by the Gamaleya Research Institute in Moscow is reported to potentially protect against the Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak, with about 60–70% genetic similarity to the circulating variant. Director Alexander Gintsburg says immunity could be possible, though the vaccine has not been tested; healthcare workers should be protected with PPE and consider using an existing vaccine where available.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、致命的な変異株に対抗できるロシアワクチン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態と認定、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。対象国DRC、ウガンダでの実際の流行であり、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ロシアのワクチン候補開発はニュースの背景情報だが、実際の流行地はDRCである。WHO により国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として認定されており、IHR通知基準を明確に満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Horor virus stigao u Evropu: Dramatične scene na aerodromu, lekar pod punom izolacijom zbog ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Horror Virus Has Arrived in Europe: Dramatic Scenes at the Airport, a Doctor Under Full Isolation Due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor, Peter Stafford, evacuated from Congo, arrived at Berlin Brandenburg Airport overnight with Ebola infection. He was transported in full protective gear—respirator and visor—to Charité University Hospital, with six contacts (likely including family) transported to a high-containment isolation unit at Virhov Clinic designed for high-risk infectious diseases, featuring separate access, air-locks, advanced ventilation and filtration, and a closed wastewater system; capacity up to 20 patients. German authorities say there is no danger to the public or other patients, and the patient will be treated under strict isolation. DR Congo health authorities report 513 suspected Ebola cases and at least 131 deaths to date. Ebola spreads via direct contact with an infected person or their body fluids. The 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak killed more than 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 恐怖ウイルスがヨーロッパに到着：空港での劇的な場面、医師がエボラで完全隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（アフリカ→ヨーロッパ）、確認患者と接触者の存在、死亡を含む重篤な影響、渡航制限のリスク。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Berlin/Germany を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは患者の疎開元がコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、ベルリンへの搬送は医療対応であるため、実際の感染症イベント発生地は DRC とした。ただし、国際的拡大の観点から WHO への通知対象となる。患者は米国人医師であり、アメリカからの搬送経路や接触者追跡も国際的関心の対象。

article.articleHeadline: مدير مركز "غاماليا": لقاح إيبولا الروسي يوفر الحماية حتى ضد سلالة بونديبوغيو النادرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gamaleya Center Director: The Russian Ebola vaccine provides protection even against the rare Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Russian Ebola vaccine developed by the Gamaleya National Research Center is currently in clinical trials and could potentially protect against Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, a rare strain circulating in Africa. The center’s director says the Bundibugyo strain shares 60–70% genetic similarity with the vaccine strain, suggesting protection for frontline healthcare workers with vaccination in addition to PPE, even though the vaccine has not been tested against Bundibugyo. A strain-specific vaccine is still needed, but the institute has no Bundibugyo sample for development. The World Health Organization has designated the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak risk is amplified by Bundibugyo, for which there are no approved medicines or vaccines; the Zaire ebolavirus strain is not driving active transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ガマレーヤセンター所長：ロシアのエボラワクチンはレアなブンディブギオ株にも対抗できる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（IHR指定疾患）であり、DRC及びウガンダでWHOが公衆衛生上の国際的緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している状況。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」が認められ、複数の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC及びウガンダでのエボラ感染症の流行について述べており、WHOがPHEIC宣言を出している状況。Bundibugyo株は承認医薬品やワクチンがなく、管理が困難。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ロシア連邦は単にワクチン開発国であり、イベントの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola znów atakuje w Afryce. Czy podróż do Egiptu jest bezpieczna?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Strikes Africa Again. Is a Trip to Egypt Safe?
article.articleSummary: Ebola, the virus that causes Ebola virus disease, has struck Africa again with outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, urging caution for travelers and public health authorities. The article also considers travel safety to Africa, including Egypt. It explains what Ebola is, outlines its symptoms, and describes how infection occurs—primarily through contact with infected bodily fluids—and discusses whether the disease is curable. With the current date being 2026-05-20, the piece underscores the ongoing uncertainty and the need for vigilance, early medical care, and adherence to evolving guidance and public health advisories for those planning travel to affected regions such as Egypt and nearby areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカで再び猛威を振るう。エジプトへの旅は安全か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれない。エジプトはサマリーで旅行安全性の文脈で言及されているが、実際の発生地ではなく、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み（記事より高い信頼度）。Bundibugyo株による稀な流行。

article.articleHeadline: "O risco não é inexistente": Especialista alerta para eventual chegada do Ébola à Europa. Está Portugal preparado?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The risk is real": A specialist warns of the possible arrival of Ebola in Europe. Is Portugal prepared?
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, the WHO declared an international public health emergency for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, triggering reinforced vigilance in Europe. The Bundibugyo strain currently circulating has no vaccine, complicating local control, and Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, not via aerosols. Early symptoms are nonspecific (fever, muscle pain, fatigue, headache), with vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic signs appearing later; diagnosis can be challenging and no specific antiviral exists. Imported cases via international travel remain possible; emphasis on hand hygiene and proper personal protective equipment. Travelers are advised to avoid known outbreak zones and postpone travel when feasible. Portugal reports prepared protocols and enhanced response capacity, with epidemiological surveillance and guidance to contact health services by phone before presenting to emergencies. Overall pandemic risk is unlikely, but importation cannot be ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: 「リスクは存在する」：専門家がエボラがヨーロッパに到来する可能性について警告。ポルトガルは準備ができているか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言が出されたコンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイクに関連し、欧州への拡大可能性を指摘する報道。シグナルとして識別し、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクとWHO国際保健緊急事態宣言が主題。ポルトガルは欧州への輸入例の可能性を指摘する文脈で言及されており、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン欠如、渡航経由の輸入ケース可能性が強調されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola tuż przy granicy z Polską. Potencjalny chory pojawił się w Czechach
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola near the border with Poland. A potential patient appeared in the Czech Republic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo variant outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda have caused 134 deaths and over 500 suspected cases, with the WHO declaring an international public health concern. Although centered in Africa, the crisis has reached Europe: the CDC evacuated an infected missionary to Charité University Hospital in Berlin, and six high‑risk individuals will be quarantined—five in Germany and one in the Czech Republic. In Prague, an American physician who treated patients in Uganda is hospitalized; transport to the Bulovka University Hospital is in a dedicated isolation unit with a mandatory three‑week stay. No approved vaccine or fully effective therapy exists for Bundibugyo; experimental vaccines are awaited from the UK and US. Western outbreak risk remains low, with international authorities strictly overseeing patient transfers. The Czech situation raises concerns near Poland’s border.

triage.headline_ja: ポーランド国境近くでエボラ出血熱 チェコ共和国に疑わしい患者が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株の流行により134名の死亡と500以上の疑い例があり、WHO国際的懸念宣言済みであり、ヨーロッパへの感染者搬送事例を含む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株のDRコンゴとウガンダでの流行が主題である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。チェコ、ドイツ、ポーランド等の欧州での患者収容・隔離事例は流行の二次的影響であり、原発症事例の発生地域ではない。DRコンゴは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: CDC says American infected with Ebola was sent to Germany for care - UPI.com
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) worsens, with 536 suspected, 105 probable, and 34 confirmed cases and 134 deaths, and nearly 170 new cases in the last 24 hours. An American missionary physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, exposed in eastern DRC, tested positive for Bundibugyo Ebola and is being transferred to Germany for care—the most equipped and proximate location for rapid treatment. Six other Americans identified as high-risk contacts are slated for transfer to Germany for quarantine; one contact will go to the Czech Republic. The WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern the prior weekend. All but two cases have been in DRC; the Uganda cases are confirmed Ebola linked to travel to DRC, including one death. Serge confirms Stafford's evacuation; Dr. Rebekah Stafford, his wife, is among the high-risk contacts.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが米国人患者のエボラ感染を報告、ドイツでの治療のため移送 - UPI.com
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo型）が進行中で、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、死亡者134人、新規症例170例/24時間、複数国への拡大（DRC主要、ウガンダ確認例2、米国人患者の国際移送）
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola型の重篤なアウトブレイク。DRCが主要発生地。ウガンダ2例はDRC関連だが、記事サマリー上「全例がDRC内またはDRC渡航関連」と明記されているため、検証対象国はDRCのみ。ドイツ・チェコへの患者移送は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。WHO PHEIC宣言済みであり、フルRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Reports Another Death Due to Brain-Eating Amoeba
article.articleSummary: Kerala records another death from amoebic brain fever (amoebic meningoencephalitis) in Ernakulam district. An elderly Nellikkuzhi panchayat resident from Kothamangalam died after infection was confirmed by the Health Department from hospital reports. Symptoms reportedly began two weeks before admission to a private hospital in Kothamangalam; she was moved to Aluva for advanced care, then returned to Kothamangalam, where she died during treatment. Two prior Ernakulam cases had recovered; this is the district’s first fatality among recent cases. Across Kerala, 19 amoebic brain fever cases were reported this month; for 2026 the state has logged 115 cases and 20 deaths. Officials screened about 20 coworkers in the rural employment guarantee program and visited roughly 80 nearby homes, with well chlorination as a precaution. No symptoms were found among coworkers.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州が脳食いアメーバによるもう一つの死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: アメーバ性髄膜脳炎による死亡例が確認され、同州で2026年に115症例・20死亡が記録されている。異常・予想外の事象であり、重症度が高く（死亡例）、人口に対する継続的な曝露リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にインドのケーラ州エルナクラム地区での複数のアメーバ性髄膜脳炎症例を報告。2026年の同州における115症例・20死亡という高い症例数と死亡率、および環境スクリーニング（井戸の塩素化、接触者検査）の実施が当局の対応を示唆。水源への曝露リスクが継続している可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor in contact with Ebola patient to be hospitalised in Czech Republic
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026 — A U.S. doctor who came into contact with an Ebola patient is being transferred from Uganda to Prague to be hospitalised as a precaution. The doctor shows no symptoms and will be isolated following a request from the United States, with arrival to the Faculty Hospital Bulovka in Prague expected Wednesday evening. The hospital says the case does not pose a public risk and that established procedures are in place. The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has produced more than 130 deaths, with cases confirmed in neighboring Uganda; the strain is Bundibugyo. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on Saturday, the first such designation announced before an emergency committee convened. A prior Congo outbreak (2018–2020) was the second-deadliest, killing nearly 2,300 people. The article notes this is an imported/exported scenario to the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: 米国人医師がエボラ患者と接触、チェコ共和国での入院のため転院予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準4つ全て該当。WHO緊急委員会前に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されている。エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスクは極めて高い。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ出血熱(Bundibugyo strain)による主要な流行があり、既に130人以上の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダでも確認症例あり。患者がチェコ共和国（対象国外）へ転院予定だが、対象国のうち検証された発生地はDRCのみ。WHOが緊急委員会開催前に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した異例の高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв лихорадки Эбола в Конго возросло до 131, ВОЗ выражает серьезную обеспокоенность
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths from Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 131, and the WHO expresses serious concern.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 131 people, with 543 suspected and 33 laboratory-confirmed cases reported. Authorities recorded 26 new deaths in the past 24 hours. Two additional laboratory-confirmed cases have been detected in neighboring Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission of the Bundibugyo strain, a rarer form of the virus. The World Health Organization previously declared this outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Uganda has started restricting movements across its land border with the DRC to curb spread. Ebola transmission occurs through direct contact with the blood or other bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, with an estimated case fatality rate around 50%. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus voiced deep concern about the scale and speed of the outbreak to the World Health Assembly in Geneva on May 19.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が131人に増加、WHOが深刻な懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公式声明による深刻な国際的懸念が確認されている。DRCでの継続的な人-人感染と隣国ウガンダへの国境越え感染拡大により、国際的な感染症危機管理が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでも確認されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。WHOが既に「国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）」と宣言済み。死亡者数131人、確認症例33例、疑い症例543例と数値が明示されており、Bundibugyo株という稀な変異株の関与が確認されている。ウガンダによる国境移動制限開始により、国際的な対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: '변종 에볼라' 확산하는데...IS·반군 활동에 제대로 구호활동 못하는 민주콩고
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola variant" spreading, but the Democratic Republic of Congo cannot properly carry out relief operations due to IS and rebel activity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid security chaos from IS-linked groups and rebels. The epicenters are northeastern Ituri Province and North Kivu’s capital Goma, where M23 rebels have effectively blocked aid delivery and closed the airport, hindering case finding, isolation, and contact tracing across dozens of checkpoints. In Ituri, violence linked to the ISIS-affiliated Allied Democratic Forces drives ongoing fatalities. The M23 alliance has shown limited cooperation, permitting sample shipments to a government laboratory in Kinshasa and tracing 189 contacts of confirmed cases in the Goma area. Across the DRC, 513 suspected Ebola cases have been reported with 131 deaths. Two confirmed cases were identified in Kampala, Uganda. Since AU CDC’s May 15 update reporting 65 deaths, suspected cases and deaths have more than doubled as of May 19 local time.

triage.headline_ja: 「変異型エボラ」拡散する中で...IS・反政府勢力活動により民主コンゴが適切な支援活動ができない状況
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な公衆衛生危機。DRCで513件の疑似症例と131名の死亡が報告され、ウガンダでも確認例があり、IHR基準を複数満たす。セキュリティ問題により対応能力が著しく制限されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ感染症の急速な拡大を主題としており、ウガンダでの確認例も明記されている。513件の疑似症例、131名の死亡、5月15日以降の数字が2倍以上に増加との報告から、進行中の大規模流行を示唆する。セキュリティ情勢（M23、ADF）により対応・追跡が著しく阻害されている点が特に懸念される。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 중국발 SAT1형 확산 경계...봉화군, 구제역 예방접종 현장 점검 강화 - 전국 | 기사 - 더팩트
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China-origin SAT-1 serotype spread under alert... Bonghwa County strengthens on-site inspections of foot-and-mouth disease vaccination - Nationwide | Article - The Fact
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), serotype SAT-1, linked to outbreaks in China, prompted Korea’s preventive surge. Bonghwa County in North Gyeongsang Province launched targeted vaccination guidance and inspections for 11 livestock farms from May 18–22 to prevent incursion. Amid China-origin SAT-1 spread, the government is conducting nationwide preventive vaccination in border areas from May 13 to June 30. Bonghwa’s livestock quarantine team deployed two staff to verify disinfection facilities, farm entry controls, and vehicle disinfection, and to provide on-site training on vaccination administration and post-vaccination care. Authorities stress rapid self-reporting and strict adherence to basic biosecurity, including barn disinfection and access control, as critical to blocking domestic spread. Farmers are urged to cooperate with these measures to prevent the virus’s entry. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak prevention, biosecurity.

triage.headline_ja: 中国発SAT1型拡散に警戒...봉화군、口蹄疫予防接種現場点検強化 - 全国
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）は動物疾病として重大な経済的影響を持つ異常事象であり、中国由来のSAT-1型が韓国に拡散するリスクがある国際的な懸念事項。政府レベルの予防接種キャンペーン実施により管理可能性の課題も存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中国発のSAT-1型口蹄疫が韓国に拡散するリスクに焦点を当てており、韓国の予防接種強化措置を述べている。韓国（共和国）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外し、実際の発生国である中国のみを記載。動物疾病であるFMDは国際的な動物保健上の重大な懸念であり、複数のWPRO基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 'Always a chance': Ebola expert says 'not impossible' virus infects Australians
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with spread to Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern after 136 deaths and about 543 suspected cases; figures are based largely on suspected cases as few samples have been laboratory-tested. There is no vaccine or therapeutic for Bundibugyo; vaccine candidate Ervebo is under consideration but unlikely to be available for at least two months. Patients typically start with flu-like symptoms that progress to vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal upset, with liver and kidney damage driving most deaths. Remote epicenters and poor infrastructure hinder containment; Ituri hospitals are reportedly overwhelmed. Frontline workers face exposure risks, as illustrated by the 2014 Dr. Ian Crozier case. Australian experts say it is not impossible for the virus to reach Australians.

triage.headline_ja: 「常に可能性がある」：エボラ専門家がオーストラリア人への感染は「あり得ない話ではない」と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な健康被害、予期しない新規感染、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO公衆衛生国際緊急事態宣言が発動されているため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生とウガンダへの拡大を主に述べている。オーストラリアの言及は専門家意見として「不可能ではない」という仮定的コメントであり、実際の発生ではないため対象国リストに含めない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言、136名死亡、543の疑い例、ワクチン・治療薬の不足、医療インフラの脆弱性、医療従事者の曝露リスクなどが指摘されており、強い懸念シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: US Doctor Infected With Ebola In DR Congo Moved To Germany For Treatment
article.articleSummary: US doctor Dr. Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has been evacuated to Germany for treatment and is being cared for at Berlin's Charité. Stafford, based at Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia since 2023, tested positive after treating patients in eastern DR Congo. His wife, Dr. Rebekah Stafford, and another exposed doctor are asymptomatic and in quarantine; the Staffords and their four children have been relocated for monitoring and care. DR Congo reports 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 confirmed deaths. WHO has declared an international public health emergency, warning the outbreak could be larger than documented. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or antivirals. The CDC is evacuating at least six other Americans exposed; the US has approved $14 million in emergency aid for rural clinics. Transmission is via direct contact with infected fluids; symptoms include fever, bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染、治療のためドイツに移送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として、WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、複数国への患者移送、国際支援、ワクチン・治療薬の欠如により、シグナルとしてのピックアップが必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態。記事の主題は DR Congo での発生であり、ドイツへの患者移送は治療目的の移動。対象国リストでは DRC(203312)のみ該当。513例の疑い患者と131例の確定死亡、Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療薬なし、WHO緊急事態宣言済み、米国を含む複数国での接触者隔離・隔離監視が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Širi se epidemija! "Preživel sem ebolo": zdravnik opisal zastrašujoč vidik smrtonosne bolezni, o katerem se malo govori
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An epidemic is spreading! "I survived Ebola": a doctor described a terrifying aspect of a deadly disease that is little talked about.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been declared a public health emergency of international concern by the WHO. About 246 suspected cases and 80 confirmed deaths have been reported; the virus has spread to Uganda with two cases and one death. The current strain has no vaccine. Ebola transmits via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids; airborne spread has not occurred. Early symptoms include high fever and muscle pains, resembling severe flu; later stages cause vomiting, severe abdominal cramps, and uncontrollable bleeding. The case fatality is around 50%. Since 1976, Ebola has caused roughly 40 outbreaks, often amid conflict. Isolation and full PPE are required for care; Brantly calls the isolation a harsh psychological burden for patients. Survivors may suffer post-Ebola syndrome, including chronic pain, headaches, fatigue, vision problems, depression, and stigma.

triage.headline_ja: 流行が拡大中！「私はエボラを生き残った」：医師が致命的な病気の恐ろしい側面を描写、あまり語られていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）し、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはターゲット国（203312）であり記事の主題。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。確認死亡80例、疑い症例246例。ウガンダへの国際的拡大は記述されているが、トリアージ評価対象はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայի հետևանքով մահերի թիվը հասել է 131-ի. ԱՀԿ-ն լուրջ մտահոգություն է հայտնում
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of Ebola-related deaths has reached 131. The WHO expresses serious concern.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 131 deaths, with 26 new fatalities reported in the last 24 hours. The DRC now reports 543 suspected and 33 confirmed Ebola cases; two confirmed cases have been detected in neighboring Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the rare Bundibugyo strain’s outbreak is of international concern. Uganda has begun restricting cross-border movement with the DRC by land. The WHO cautions bordering countries not to seal borders to avoid unmonitored crossings. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals, with an estimated case-fatality rate around 50%. Tedros spoke on May 19 in Geneva to the World Health Assembly, expressing deep concern about the scale and speed of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラによる死亡数が131人に達した。WHOが深刻な懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の希少株での大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、国境制限実施）、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。WHO事務局長による国際的警告と国境措置により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 希少なBundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の発生。131人の死亡、543人の疑い患者、33人の確定患者が報告されている。隣国ウガンダで2人の確定患者が検出され、既に陸路での国境移動制限が実施されている。WHO事務局長が2026年5月19日にジュネーブの世界保健総会で国際的な懸念を表明している点が重要。記事ではGenèveやSwitzerlandの地域情報が含まれているが、これはWHO本部のスピーチ場所であり、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCとウガンダであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Trotz Einreiseverbot: Ebola-Epidemie in Kongo: Nationalteam darf in die USA an die Fussball-WM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Despite entry ban: Ebola epidemic in Congo: National team allowed to travel to the United States for the FIFA World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Despite the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the United States has assured entry for the DR Congo national football team to participate in the FIFA World Cup in Houston, Texas. Non-U.S. citizens who have been in the DR Congo within the last 21 days face an entry ban, but the team is reportedly exempt; players who may have been in the country in the previous three weeks would undergo the same health screenings and isolation testing applied to returning U.S. citizens. The exemption does not extend to fans. DR Congo will play its World Cup game in Houston, marking its second appearance since 1974, with a June 17 match against Portugal. More than 130 people have died in the Congo Ebola outbreak; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned about the outbreak’s scale and speed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行中のコンゴ：入国禁止にもかかわらず、ナショナルチームがFIFAワールドカップでアメリカへの渡航を許可される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の状況、国際的拡大リスク）。130名以上の死亡者を伴うコンゴのエボラ流行と、リスク軽減措置下での国際的人員移動という異例な対応が組み合わさった重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 米国（対象国外）での記事配信だが、コンゴのエボラ流行が主題。WHO事務局長による警告、130名以上の死亡確認、国際的な感染制御対応の複雑性が判定を支持する。発生地域リストにはポルトガルも含まれているが、サマリーではポルトガルでのエボラ発生は述べられていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupa a la OMS la "magnitud y rapidez" de la propagación del ébola; van 134 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO is concerned about the 'magnitude and speed' of the spread of Ebola; 134 deaths so far.
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, the WHO warned about the magnitude and speed of a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 134 deaths suspected and more than 500 possible cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines. The first death occurred in Bunia, Ituri Province; cases have been reported in Bunia, Goma (North Kivu), Mongbwalu, Nyakunde, and Butembo. Uganda reports two confirmed cases, including a death in Kampala linked to travelers from Congo. The WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern; relief is being sent to Ituri and North Kivu. A vaccine called Erbevo, used against another Ebola type, is under study and would take about two months to deploy if approved. UNICEF has shipped 16 tons of supplies for three treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラの「規模と速度」の拡大に懸念；134人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として既に宣言されている。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの新規流行で、治療法・ワクチンがなく、複数国への拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの新規流行が東部DRC（Ituri州・North Kivu州）で発生し、ウガンダへの越境拡大（Kampalで死亡例確認）が報告されている。WHOは既にPHEIC宣言を実施。対象国リストではDRCとウガンダが該当。記事にはKampalaの地理ID(232422)が含まれているが、これはウガンダの首都であり、ウガンダでの症例報告を示す。

article.articleHeadline: What the numbers tell us about the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda prompted WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo strain, lacking a specific treatment or vaccine, has produced more than 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths, with about 30 laboratory-confirmed positives to date. WHO notes a four-week detection gap, with Mongbwalu as the initial alert site in Ituri province. At least one American healthcare worker in the DRC has tested positive and is being treated in Germany; six high-risk contacts are being moved to Europe for monitoring (five to Germany and one to the Czech Republic). Uganda reports two confirmed cases linked to the DRC, one treated in Uganda and the other imported from the DRC; Uganda has activated outbreak control measures. Incubation is 2–21 days, and transmission occurs through direct contact with infected fluids or contaminated surfaces. A patient-zero has not been identified; first confirmed case dated April 24 in Bunia, death on May 5.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの流行が数字で語ること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱の流行で500超の疑い患者、130人の死亡が報告され、WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国、ドイツ、チェコ）と国際的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダ、米国、ドイツ、チェコ共和国も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事態（PHEIC）宣言済み、複数国への二次感染事例あり、治療法・ワクチンなし、4週間の検出遅延があった点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Špeciálne lietadlo, izolácia a desiatky policajtov. Berlín prijal pacienta s ebolou, Česko čaká ďalší transport
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special plane, isolation and dozens of police officers. Berlin received a patient with Ebola; the Czech Republic awaits another transport.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola in a Congolese hospital was transported to Berlin for treatment and placed in a dedicated high-containment isolation unit at Virchow Clinic in Wedding, after a special aircraft landed just after midnight. Sixty police officers escorted the patient to the isolation ward, which has separate entrances, ventilation controls, and its own wastewater treatment. Germany has the latest equipment to care for such cases while maintaining high safety standards. Meanwhile the Czech Republic prepares to admit another American with suspected Ebola; Bulovka Hospital expects admission Wednesday evening, noting the patient shows no symptoms. The outbreak originated in Ituri province, northeastern Congo, and has spread to Uganda, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and reporting over 100 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine or approved treatment, and regional risk remains high; Czech import risk is low.

triage.headline_ja: 特別飛行機、隔離、多数の警察官。ベルリンがエボラ患者を受け入れ、チェコがさらなる患者の移送を待機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際的に拡大するリスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱のPHEIC認定、複数国への患者移送、100名以上の死亡報告がある。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州で発生したエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo variant）の流行。複数国への患者移送が報告されているが、記事サマリーの主題となっているイベント（患者輸送・治療）は欧州における対応であり、実際の感染症発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCだけであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダへの拡大も記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO emergency supplies arrive in Bunia as Ebola death toll reaches 136
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) has caused 136 deaths and about 543 suspected cases as of May 20, 2026. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or treatment, is spreading from Ituri into North Kivu (Butembo; a confirmed case in Goma). WHO delivered 12 tonnes of emergency supplies to Bunia and deployed over 40 medical experts on May 19; MSF footage shows rapid PPE and tent deployment. No approved vaccine; Ervebo candidate under consideration but unlikely available for at least two months. Mortality for this strain ranges 30–50%. Response slowed by insecurity and poor access in conflict areas. Uganda reports two linked cases from cross-border movement; a confirmed case in Goma; calls to reopen Goma airport. International measures include US airport screenings, visa suspensions, and a $13 million pledge to establish up to 50 Ebola treatment clinics in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO緊急物資がブニアに到着、エボラ死亡者数は136人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大なシグナルであり、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）のDRC東部での大規模流行。136人の死亡、543の疑い症例、30-50%の致死率。ウガンダへの越境感染確認、ゴマでの確認症例、国際的な空港スクリーニング・査証停止措置などが実施されている。承認されたワクチンなし、治療法未確立。紛争地域での治安悪化が対応を阻害。複数国への拡大リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: Смерть из Африки. Лечение от Эболы есть, но почему его не применяют?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death from Africa. There is a treatment for Ebola, but why isn't it being used?
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Africa faces an Ebola outbreak with more than 500 cases and 130+ deaths; totals uncertain due to diagnostic challenges. Case fatality is reported at 25–50%. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine. US CDC notes an American who treated DRC patients and will be treated in Germany; early cases among health workers in DRC. Two Congolese patients travelled to Uganda ill. Cross-border risk to about 10 neighboring states, including South Sudan and Rwanda; spread to Europe, the US, or Russia remains unlikely. Transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne. Russian specialists head to Uganda to assist. The article notes some experts advocate early management of disseminated intravascular coagulation (plasma exchange), despite no approved antiviral therapy.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカからの死。エボラの治療法は存在するが、なぜ使用されないのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHOが国際的懸念対象の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、複数国への越境リスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事は500例以上、130名以上の死亡を報告。致死率25～50%。WHO PHEIC宣言。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）。DRC の医療従事者が患者と接触し、米国市民が感染してドイツで治療予定。DRC患者2名がウガンダへ移動。南スーダン、ルワンダを含む約10の隣国への越境リスク。ロシア、米国、ヨーロッパへの拡大は低確率。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する実発生地。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず（記事では患者移動の受け入れ国として言及されているが、新規発生地ではなく続発例）。

article.articleHeadline: Berlin: US-Ebola-Patient wird in der Charité behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Berlin: American Ebola patient treated at the Charité.
article.articleSummary: Ebola-infected US citizen evacuated to Germany for treatment; the patient arrived in Berlin last night and was taken by a special convoy to Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin, placed on an isolation ward at the Virchow-Klinikum campus. The patient is Peter Stafford, a US physician who worked for the Serge mission in the Congo, and the CDC confirmed he was flown to Germany for treatment after testing positive for the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola. Six close contacts who shared the same flight were also brought to Germany for monitoring. Initial details about the treatment location and landing were unclear, but reports later confirmed Charité as the treatment site. Charité operates a dedicated isolation unit at the Virchow-Klinikum campus with capacity for up to 20 patients, featuring separate access, ventilation/filtration, and a closed wastewater system. The identity of the seventh evacuee remains undisclosed.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリン：米国人エボラ患者がシャリテで治療中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染者の国際的移送事例。IHR基準では「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、患者はコンゴでセルジュミッション関連の業務に従事していた米国医師。エボラ感染者の国際的医療搬送事例であり、IHR報告要件を満たす。ベルリンでの治療は二次的な情報であり、ウイルスの原発地はコンゴ民主共和国。6名の接触者も同行搬送されており、国際公衆衛生上の重要シグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ανησυχία ΠΟΥ για την έκταση και διάρκεια της επιδημίας στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO expresses concern about the extent and duration of the outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in eastern DRC prompts WHO to declare a global health emergency and warn of its wide, long-lasting spread. In Ituri’s Bunia, MSF reports overwhelmed hospitals with suspected cases and scarce protective gear as shipments arrive. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever with high mortality, but pandemic risk is limited due to lower transmissibility than measles or COVID-19. DRC health ministry reports 136 deaths and about 543 suspected cases, with very few samples lab-tested. An American physician infected in the DRC is being treated in Germany (Charité) per the CDC; six high-risk contacts are to be moved to Europe for quarantine. In Butembo and North Kivu, violence and access challenges hinder aid; borders are tightened and Uganda reports cases. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no vaccine or therapy; control relies on early detection and isolation. US funding and World Bank assistance accompany response, with travel advisories to avoid DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴでの流行の規模と期間についてのWHOの懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ以上満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国家にわたる流行で、WHOが国際的懸念を表明しており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは複数国言及（ウガンダ、スーダン、米国、ドイツなど）だが、実際の流行発生地はDRC（東部、イトゥリ州ブニア、北キヴ州ブテンボ）。ウガンダは「ケース報告」のみで、DRCがサマリーの主題。WHOが国際的懸念を宣言し、複数国で接触者管理が進行中。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、ワクチンなし、高い致命率が懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Video 136 Kematian Diduga Terkait Wabah Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video 136: Death Allegedly Linked to Ebola Outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with cross-border concern to Uganda. Health authorities report 543 suspected Ebola cases and 32 laboratory-confirmed infections in the DRC, with two confirmed cases detected in neighboring Uganda. In a video, officials state that all deaths announced are suspected to be linked to the virus, noting that most deaths occur in community settings. Active field surveillance is underway, with teams visiting communities to identify losses and understand the circumstances of deaths. The report notes ongoing outbreak monitoring and laboratory confirmation efforts but provides no detail on transmission chains, symptoms, vaccination status, or infection sources. The cross-border confirmed cases underscore regional risk and the need for coordinated public health response between the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行に関連すると考えられる136人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、エボラ出血熱の確認事例と死亡多数、国境を越えた感染確認がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認事例（2件）は記事に言及されているが、当該対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの543疑似患者、32確定患者、死亡多数という深刻な状況。フルRRAへ即座に進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: 136 Deaths, Rare Ebola Strain, No Vaccine: Why The Bundibugyo Outbreak In Congo Is Proving Difficult To Contain
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a rare Ebola strain, has killed 136 people and sickened more than 530 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda. Genetic sequencing confirms the outbreak is due to Bundibugjo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines, therapeutics, or monoclonal antibodies. WHO has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as the epidemic spreads across borders, with authorities warning the true scale may be larger than detected. At least four healthcare workers have died, signaling infection-control gaps. Transmission begins from contact with infected wildlife, but human-to-human spread occurs through direct contact with infectious bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms are flu-like, rapidly progressing to severe gastrointestinal illness and bleeding. Ebola is not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: 136人が死亡、稀なエボラ株、ワクチンなし：コンゴのブンディブギョアウトブレイクが抑制困難な理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHO が国際的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、国境を越えた拡大、確認済みの死亡例（136人）、ワクチン・治療法なしの稀なウイルス株による深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにウガンダの言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを記載。WHO PHEIC宣言、死亡数136人、530以上の疑い例、医療従事者を含む死亡例4人、ワクチン・治療法不在、人間－人間感染の報告あり。国際的な支援が必要な深刻な危機的状況。

article.articleHeadline: بسبب إيبولا.. منتخب الكونغو الديمقراطية يخضع لبروتوكول صارم في كأس العالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to Ebola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team is under a strict protocol at the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, the United States approved an entry-ban exemption allowing the Democratic Republic of Congo national football team to travel to and compete in the World Cup despite a U.S. ban on non-U.S. nationals who had been in Ebola-affected areas (DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan) within the previous 21 days. A senior State Department official noted the DRC squad—the only Ebola-affected nation to qualify—had trained in Europe, potentially placing them outside the ban. If players were physically on Congolese soil in the last 21 days, they would face strict testing and quarantine under a protocol similar to that for returning Americans; the exemption does not extend to DR Congo fans. The Leopards will compete in Group 11 with Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia, at the World Cup starting June 11.

triage.headline_ja: エボラのため、コンゴ民主共和国代表チームはワールドカップで厳格なプロトコルの対象
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染症の新規発生イベントではなく、既知の流行地域の代表チームの国際大会参加に関する入国管理措置についての記事。公衆衛生上の新たな脅威を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラの新規発生や流行状況の悪化ではなく、既知のエボラ流行地域（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）の代表チームがワールドカップに参加する際の行政的な入国手続きと健康プロトコルについて報じたものである。スポーツニュースカテゴリの記事であり、感染症イベントの監視対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: A new Ebola outbreak could be the worst in a decade
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, including Mongbwalu; cases also in Goma, North Kivu) is the 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo since 1976. First detected April 24; by May 19, over 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, the ninth such designation since 2005, signaling potential severity comparable to Congo’s 2018 outbreak (>2,000 deaths) and the 2014–16 West Africa epidemic (11,000). Transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids; Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or rapid diagnostic test. Samples must be flown to Kinshasa (~2,000 km away) with results taking several days. Two Congolese nationals diagnosed in Kampala, Uganda; an American doctor evacuated to Germany. Cases in Goma; Rwanda closed some border crossings; risk to Burundi and South Sudan. Aid cuts and armed-conflict hindrances complicate response; vaccines exist for the Zaire strain but not Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクは過去10年で最悪となる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項として、WHO緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）が発令され、複数国での症例報告と国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱で、ワクチンや迅速診断が利用不可。コンゴ東部（イトゥリ州、ゴマ、北キヴ州）での発生。ウガンダ（カンパラ）での2症例確認およびドイツへの患者搬出により国際的な波及が既に発生している。対象国外（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダン、ブルンジ、ドイツ）での波及についても記述されているが、verified_locationsは対象国リストに基づき DRC のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ste kupili te gobe? Nikar jih ne zaužijte, v njih so našli nevarno bakterijo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did you buy these mushrooms? Do not eat them; a dangerous bacterium has been found in them.
article.articleSummary: Fresh enoki mushrooms (Green Box Limited, 100 g) were found to contain Listeria monocytogenes, prompting a recall of all lots sold from 26 April to 17 May 2026. The alert, distributed via the EU RASFF system, notes the product originated in China, imported by Asia Food Express (Netherlands) and sold in Asia Supermarket Ljubljana, including its online shop. Consumers are advised not to eat the product and to return it to the place of purchase or discard it. Listeria monocytogenes can cause infection, with higher risk for pregnant women, older adults, young children, and people with weakened immune systems. The notice underscores a microbiological risk and retailer- or consumer-facing disposal/return guidance. No other products or brands are implicated.

triage.headline_ja: これらのキノコを購入しましたか？食べないでください。危険な細菌が見つかりました
triage.triage_reason: エノキタケ製品のリステリア汚染による自主回収事案。EU RASFF経由の流通管理措置であり、公衆衛生危機の段階ではなく、対象国内での発生もない。
triage.notes: 本事案はスロベニアおよびオランダで流通していた食品製品の微生物汚染による回収事案であり、感染症の流行やアウトブレイクではない。発生地域に含まれるChinaは製品原産国であり、イベント主体の発生地ではない。対象国（WPRO地域含む）での感染症イベント発生ではないため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Μπλόκο στους ταξιδιώτες από Κονγκό και Ουγκάντα βάζει η Ιορδανία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Jordan imposes a travel ban on travelers from Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Jordan imposes a travel ban on travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda to curb Ebola virus disease amid evolving epidemiology in the two countries. The interior ministry acted on the health ministry’s recommendation, after a Monday briefing with the Directorate of Epidemiology, the National Center for Combating Epidemics and Communicable Diseases, and a WHO representative in Jordan. The measure, under Public Health Law 47/2008, will be continuously reassessed as international health developments unfold. Separately, the US CDC announced entry restrictions for foreigners who traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in the last 21 days, and will strengthen border health screenings for air travelers from affected African countries, along with temporary visa restrictions. The United States reports a citizen infected with Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ヨルダンはコンゴとウガンダからの旅行者に対する移動制限を導入
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、複数国への渡航制限措置、米国の感染者報告により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。シグナルトリアージの対象として詳細なRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUS、Sudan、Jordan、DRC、Ugandaが含まれているが、サマリーの主題は DRC でのエボラ流行と各国の対応措置。対象国リストに該当するのは DRC のみ。Sudan と Uganda は対象国に含まれていないため除外。US の感染者報告があるが、米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、米国での感染者報告とそれに続く CDC の渡航制限措置は国際的な懸念の高さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: What the numbers tell us about the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola drives a fast-spreading outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province (Mongbwalu) and in Uganda; the strain has no specific treatment or vaccine. WHO declares a public health emergency of international concern. More than 500 suspected cases and about 130 deaths reported, with only ~30 laboratory-confirmed infections. One American, Dr. Peter Stafford, tested positive in Bunia and is being transferred to Germany; six high-risk contacts will be moved to Germany and the Czech Republic for monitoring. Uganda has two confirmed cases (one imported from the DRC, the other treated there and died) with outbreak-control measures active. Transmission occurs via fluids, with a 2–21 day incubation. The first confirmed case involved healthcare workers from Mongbwalu; initial Zaire strain tests were negative, bundibugyo confirmation followed after samples were sent to Kinshasa. Funeral exposure from traditional rites contributed to spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生状況が示す数字
