triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国境対策の必要性）。確認済み症例と死亡数が多く、複数国にまたがる流行である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ出血熱の流行は東部DRCのブニア地域及び隣国ウガンダで確認されている。ウガンダはDRCからの輸入症例を2例報告しているが、サマリーの主たる流行地はDRCである。ドイツへの患者搬送は医療避難であり、ドイツでの新規流行の報告ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストからはDRC（203312）のみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola Outbreak, Ituri Province Situation Report #2, May 19, 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 19, 2026, DRC reports more than 500 suspected cases and at least 130 deaths; Uganda has two confirmed cases in Kampala, including one death. The hotspot remains Ituri, with clusters in Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde and Bunia, beginning as a family cluster then progressing to health facility and community transmission. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or therapeutics, so response centers on rapid surveillance, contact tracing, testing, IPC, supportive care, risk communication and cross-border coordination. IPC readiness is severely limited (about 34% at Mongbwalu Hospital; under 7% elsewhere); PPE and trained staff shortages have led to at least four healthcare worker deaths. The outbreak compounds humanitarian needs: Ituri over 1.9 million in need, including 923k IDPs; North Kivu about 2.5 million. International Medical Corps supports Ituri and Goma; Uganda rapid response; South Sudan MoH coordination.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo: Ebola Outbreak, Ituri Province Situation Report #2, May 19, 2026
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクであり、複数国での確認例と国際的な対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、スーダン、ルワンダも列挙されているが、記事サマリー上での主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）であり、ウガンダでは2例のみ確認。対象国リストはDRCのみ含める。PHEIC宣言済みで、ワクチン・治療法が未承認のBundibugyo株であることが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo laut Ã"rzte ohne Grenzen dramatisch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo is dramatic, according to Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is described as dramatic by Doctors Without Borders, with concurrent cases in Uganda and a high regional spread risk. As of May 20, 2026, the Congolese ministry reports 513 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths. MSF says controlled care is possible and aims to establish isolated, well-equipped treatment settings in the region; a U.S. citizen infected with Ebola who contracted the virus in DRC was transported to Berlin’s Charité Virchow-Klinikum in a dedicated isolation unit. The transfer, via Uganda-origin special flight and a fast-response convoy, arrived shortly before 3:00 a.m. The unit is a closed, protected facility separate from regular care. Ebola spreads by contact with body fluids; symptoms include weakness, muscle and head pains, vomiting, and diarrhea. Reservoir is the Congo forests; untreated CFR can reach about 90% per RKI, with 2014–15 West Africa deaths exceeding 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は国境なき医師団によると深刻
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定的な多国間流行（DRC、ウガンダ、ドイツで確認）で、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。高い致命率（最大90%）と地域的拡大リスク、国際的な患者移送が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの流行を主題としており、ウガンダとドイツへの波及は言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。513疑似症例、131疑似死亡が報告されており、MSFの関与と高度な治療施設の設置が進行中。米国市民患者のベルリン移送は国際的対応の実例。WPRO対象地域外のイベントであるが、IHR基準4全該当により高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai 29 tháng tuổi viêm phổi nặng do đồng nhiễm 5 tác nhân gây bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 29-month-old boy with severe pneumonia due to coinfection with five pathogens.
article.articleSummary: A 29-month-old boy from Nguyệt Đức, Phú Thọ province, Vietnam, developed severe pneumonia due to coinfection with five pathogens: Mycoplasma pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Bocavirus, and Human Rhinovirus. Following water aspiration during swimming, he exhibited persistent cough, wheeze, and fever, with no improvement after self‑medicating with Augmentin and an anti‑inflammatory. He was admitted to Thanh Sơn Regional Medical Center for respiratory failure, then transferred to Phú Thọ Provincial Pediatric Hospital. On admission he had respiratory failure grade III and severe pneumonia, requiring intubation, mechanical ventilation, a central venous line, and continuous arterial monitoring. PCR identified the five pathogens; antibiotics were adjusted, and he received intensive respiratory support and nutrition therapy. After four days, respiratory status improved and he was extubated; about a week later he was eating normally and discharged. Parents are advised against self-medication and to seek timely medical care for respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム：29ヶ月の男児が5つの病原体の同時感染による重症肺炎を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単一の重症小児肺炎症例であり、公衆衛生への広範な影響や国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。ただし、複数病原体の同時感染という医学的に注目すべき事例であり、地域での同様の症例の増加がないか経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例は単一の小児患者の症例報告であり、集団発生（アウトブレイク）の兆候がない。複数病原体の同時感染（Mycoplasma pneumoniae、Haemophilus influenzae、Streptococcus pneumoniae、Bocavirus、Human Rhinovirus）という医学的に興味深い事例ではあるが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。水深吸引後の発症という特殊な背景があり、同地域での類似症例の増加の有無を監視することが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : un médecin américain infecté arrive à Berlin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: an American physician infected with Ebola arrives in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola (Bundibugyo strain), arrived in Berlin and was admitted to Charité University Hospital’s high-containment isolation unit. He was evacuated to BER airport and transported by guarded convoy with six contacts, including his wife Dr. Rebekah Stafford, missionaries with Serge active in the Democratic Republic of Congo since 2019. Stafford contracted Ebola while treating patients at Nyankunde Hospital near Bunia, DRC. Charité runs one of Germany’s largest isolation facilities, separated from routine care and equipped with advanced ventilation, airlocks and wastewater treatment. The outbreak has prompted international concern; the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. U.S. travel restrictions for some travelers from affected regions have been instituted. The DRC reports 513 suspected cases and 131 deaths; at least 80 deaths total, with cases also in Uganda. Ebola transmits via direct contact with body fluids. The Zaïre outbreak in 2014–2015 caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行：感染したアメリカ人医師がベルリンに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染事例として深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が認められる。WHO公式宣言（PHEIC）済みで、複数国への拡大と国際支援要請が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（ブニア近郊）でのエボラ感染の原発地を述べている。ベルリンおよび米国への患者輸送は二次的な事象であり、主要な感染発生地はDRC。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。WPRO対象国のうち、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ（対象国リスト内）。ウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Viajes condicionados por el brote de ébola: EEUU toma medidas de cara al Mundial de fútbol
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travel restrictions due to the Ebola outbreak: United States takes measures ahead of the FIFA World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed over 130 people as the DRC football team trains for the World Cup; FIFA says it is monitoring the outbreak and will keep the team informed of medical directives, with arrival in North America planned for June 11. The US CDC has suspended entry for 30 days for travelers who recently visited affected areas—the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. An American patient who contracted Ebola in the DRC, physician-missionary Peter Stafford, is being treated in Berlin at Charité; six high-risk contacts will travel to Europe for quarantine (Germany and the Czech Republic). The US will fund up to 50 treatment clinics in the DRC, Uganda, and the Congo through CERF/OCHA to enhance detection, triage, and isolation. Brussels Airlines flights Kinshasa-Brussels continue as scheduled; crews receive infectious-disease training.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行による渡航制限：FIFA ワールドカップを控えた米国の措置
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ以上満たし（深刻な健康影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）、エボラ出血熱は高優先度疾患。対象地域DRCで確定患者・死亡者があり、複数国への二次拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bluedotが検出した発生地域にはBrussels、Berlin、USA、Sudan、Uganda、Czechiaが含まれているが、記事サマリーを精読するとこれらは患者の搬送先・隔離地・接触者追跡対象地であり、エボラの実際の流行地はDRCのみ。DRCで130人以上の死亡が確認され、ワールドカップという国際的イベントとの関連で各国が入国制限を実施している。高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikanischer Ebola-Patient aus Kongo in Berliner Charité aufgenommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American Ebola patient from Congo admitted to Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, a United States citizen infected with the Ebola virus has been admitted to Berlin's Charité – Universitätsmedizin in a special isolation ward. The patient contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the Ebola outbreak is expanding, and was transported to Germany for treatment, according to the German Federal Ministry of Health. The move underscores ongoing international concern as Congo reports rising numbers of cases. The report confirms the infection and hospital isolation; no further clinical details, dates of symptom onset, or exposure information are provided. This incident highlights ongoing international transmission risk of Ebola from the Congo region to European medical facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴからのアメリカ人エボラ患者がベルリンのシャリテ病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、予想外の事象）。エボラウイルスのWAFR域外への国際的移送は重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行拡大とそこでの患者感染を述べており、DRCのみがverified_locationsに含まれる。ベルリン・ドイツは治療地点だが発生地ではないため除外。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。患者が米国籍であること、ドイツでの受け入れは国際的関心の高さを示すが、本評価ではWPRO対象国のシグナル判定に焦点を当てている。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы: заражённый американский врач прибыл в Берлин
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: an infected American doctor has arrived in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola, Peter Stafford, arrived in Berlin and was transported to Charité University Hospital’s isolation unit. He was accompanied by six contacts, possibly family. Stafford and his wife Rebecca Stafford, mission doctors with Serge, have worked since 2019 in Congo. He contracted a rare Bundibugyo strain while treating patients at Nyankunde hospital near Bunia in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Charité’s specialized isolation setup is among Germany’s largest for highly contagious diseases. The outbreak prompted international alarm; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. U.S. authorities imposed travel restrictions for travelers from affected regions. At least 80 people have died; cases have been confirmed in the DRC and Uganda. The DRC Ministry of Health reports 513 suspected cases and 131 probable deaths. Ebola transmits via direct contact and bodily fluids; the 2014-2015 Zaïre variant outbreak in West Africa killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：感染した米国の医師がベルリンに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言、複数国での確認、高い致死率を示すシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ流行を報道しており、ベルリンへの感染者搬送は輸出症例として記載されている。対象国リストでは、実際の発生地はDRCのみが該当。ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言、国際的な旅行制限、高い致死率（131死亡/513疑い例）がリスク上昇要因。

article.articleHeadline: ZOOM AFRIQUE : la flambée d'Ebola en RDC et en Ouganda suscite une inquiétude généralisée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ZOOM AFRICA: the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda raises widespread concern.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola caused by Bundibugyo strain spreading across DRC and Uganda; as of May 20, 2026, 543 suspected cases, 32 confirmed, 136 suspected deaths in DRC; 30 confirmed cases in Ituri province; two confirmed in Kampala, Uganda, including one death among travelers from DRC. The outbreak declared on May 15 in Ituri, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976; Nord-Kivu also reporting cases; cross-border transmission with international concern. Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. OMS declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); Africa CDC declared continental emergency. Factors fueling spread include urban centers, insecurity, mass population displacement in Ituri (>100,000 newly displaced), and transmission to health workers. Uganda and DRC authorities emphasize lack of vaccine; response includes risk communication, community mobilization, and scaling up treatment sites; neighboring countries Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania increasing surveillance and border controls; Rwanda halted cross-border movements at key Goma-Gisenyi posts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカズーム：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行が広範な懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の多国間流行で543疑似症例、32確定症例、136疑似症死亡、ウガンダ30確定症例、国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）及びウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の多国間流行を主題としており、両国の確定症例、死亡例、国境を越えた感染が明記されている。WHOがPHEIC宣言、Africa CDCが大陸非常事態宣言。ワクチン・承認済み治療法なし。都市部での感染、医療従事者への感染、大規模人口移動（イトゥリで10万人以上新規避難民）が拡大要因。隣国ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニアも監視・国境管理を強化しており、国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв лихорадки Эбола в Конго возросло до 131, среди заболевших - врач из США
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 131, with a doctor from the United States among the infected.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 131, with 513 suspected cases; yesterday’s figures were about 80 deaths and 300 cases. WHO warns transmission may be faster and may have crossed borders into other provinces. MRC modeling suggests cases are undercounted and could exceed 1,000. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain (no licensed vaccine or approved treatment), may have expanded for weeks before detection on 24 April. An American physician working in Congo, Peter Stafford, is infected; two Serge mission doctors, including his wife Dr. Rebecca Stafford, are asymptomatic and quarantined. Uganda reports two cases and one death per CDC; DRC authorities say geographic spread within the country. New infections in Nyakunde (Ituri), Butembo (North Kivu), and Goma. African CDC chief Jean Kaseya urged public-health measures, including safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱の死亡者数が131人に増加、感染者の中に米国人医師も含まれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。死亡131人、疑い例513例、複数州への越境拡大、国際的な医療従事者の感染、及び非承認治療法による高いリスク評価により、直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認・治療法なし。WHO警告で境界を越えた伝播リスクあり。MRCモデルで実際の感染者数が1,000人を超える可能性。米国人医師の感染と家族の隔離により国際的関心が高い。ウガンダへの越境は発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であり、DRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia discutirá con la OMS uso de vacuna contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia to discuss with the WHO the use of the Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Russia will discuss using its Ebola vaccine with the World Health Organization amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, near Bunia) and Uganda. Health Minister Mikhail Murashko said Rospotrebnadzor specialists will assist with vaccines and medicines and will confer with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus in Geneva during the 79th World Health Assembly, prioritizing infectious disease safety. The DRC outbreak has 131 deaths and 513 probable cases; Uganda reports 1 death. The epicenter is Ituri; the first death, a nurse, occurred on April 24, with the outbreak reportedly starting among gold miners near Bunia. Alerts reached health authorities May 5; on May 14 the Bundibugyo virus was identified. On May 17, WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、エボラワクチン使用について世界保健機関と協議へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の危機であり、WHO緊急事態宣言済み。DRCとウガンダで確認された事例は国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクをもたらす。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレークを述べているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていない。ジュネーブとロシアについては、これらは外交・会議の場所であり、実際のイベント発生地ではないため除外した。すでにWHOにより5月17日にPHEIC（国際懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されている。

article.articleHeadline: Berlínská nemocnice přijala Američana nakaženého ebolou, doprovázel ho policejní konvoj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Berlin hospital admitted an American infected with Ebola, who was accompanied by a police convoy.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola in a Congolese hospital in Ituri province was admitted to Berlin’s Virchow Clinic at the U.S. request, cared for in a dedicated high-containment unit with separate air handling and wastewater treatment. German Health Minister Nina Warkenová said Germany provides modern equipment and stringent safety for such cases. The Czech Republic is preparing to receive the patient at Bulovka University Hospital in Prague, where he reportedly has no symptoms; admission was expected Wednesday evening. The Congo outbreak, now affecting northeast Ituri, has persisted since April, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after two confirmed cases in Uganda. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved effective treatment; Central and East Africa face a high spillover risk. Czech hygienists assess the import risk to Czechia as low. Africa has faced multiple Ebola outbreaks, with 25–90% fatality; the 2013 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths, and vaccines do not cover Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンの病院がエボラに感染したアメリカ人医師を受け入れ、警察車両の護衛付きで搬送
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、既にウガンダでも確認例があり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、シグナルとして即座にピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州発生エボラアウトブレークであり、患者がドイツとチェコに搬送された事例である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo株でワクチン未対応、既にウガンダで確認例あり、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Un nuevo brote de ébola podría ser el peor en una década
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola outbreak could be the worst in a decade.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Mongbwalu, DRC (Ituri region) began in April after deaths were attributed to witchcraft before fever and nosebleeds signaled Ebola; transmission is by direct contact with bodily fluids. By May 19, there were over 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths, with Imperial College models suggesting many more infections. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern—the ninth since 2005—warning it could be the worst outbreak since 2018. The Bundibugyo strain, less lethal than Zaire, lacks an approved vaccine or rapid tests. Samples from Ituri must be flown to Kinshasa for confirmation, delaying results by days. Cases have appeared in Kampala, Uganda; Goma, North Kivu; two Congolese diagnosed in Kampala; and a U.S. physician in the area tested positive and evacuated to Germany. Rwanda has closed some border crossings, with concerns about spread to Burundi and South Sudan. Ongoing conflict with M23 complicates response; MSF and IRC operate amid access challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ出血熱の流行が10年で最悪になる可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間拡大、深刻な死亡率、複数国での確認例がある。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みで、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはMongobualu(Ituri region)、Kinshasa、Goma(North Kivu)、Kampalaなど複数の場所を記載しているが、対象国リストの確認により検証地点はDRCのみ。ウガンダ(Kampala)、ルワンダ、スーダン、ブルンジへの拡大リスクが記載されているが、これらの国での確認例はサマリーに明示されていない（ウガンダではKampalaで2名のコンゴ人患者が確認されているのみ）。WHOはすでにPHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)宣言済み。Bundibugyo strain、ワクチン未承認、検査遅延などの管理可能性の課題が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : à Walikale, les autorités renforcent la surveillance aux postes de contrôle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In Walikale, authorities strengthen surveillance at checkpoints.
article.articleSummary: Walikale in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, is tightening Ebola surveillance to prevent spread to neighbouring Ituri. Administrative and health authorities held a meeting on May 18 to strengthen protection at entry points and internal checkpoints along Walikale’s borders with Ituri. Measures include temperature screening, handwashing kits, and prominent awareness messaging about transmission and protective actions. Locally produced messages are broadcast on radio, printed materials sent to schools and churches, and community relay volunteers use megaphones with pre-recorded messages in local dialects to reach residents. The mobilization spans administrative, health, educational, and religious sectors. The objective is to curb the outbreak already causing casualties in neighboring Ituri by informing the population on transmission and protective measures and preventing cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ワリカレで当局が検問所での監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数地域での発生、既に死者が報告されており重症度が高い。隣接地域への国内拡大リスクが明確で、国際的拡大の可能性があるため、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認事例がIturi地域で既に死者を伴う形で発生しており、Walikaleでは予防的措置として境界検問所での監視強化が実施されている。複数行政区域にまたがる発生と国内拡大リスク、および地理的に隣接する複数国への拡大可能性が存在。全5つのWPRO基準に該当し、フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese embassy in Rwanda warns citizens of Ebola risk after DR Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, Ebola fears rise as DR Congo outbreak triggers international alert. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an ongoing Ebola outbreak; the World Health Organization has declared it a public health emergency of international concern. No confirmed cases have been reported in Rwanda. The Chinese Embassy in Rwanda issued a WeChat advisory urging Chinese citizens to stay informed, avoid high-risk areas, and avoid contact with confirmed or suspected patients or high-risk animals; limit unnecessary travel and crowded places; seek immediate medical attention if symptoms appear. Rwandan authorities have stepped up screening and vigilance at border crossings with Congo to prevent cross-border transmission. The embassy emphasizes caution for travelers and residents in Rwanda amid the ongoing Congo outbreak, with emphasis on prevention and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行後、ルワンダ駐在中国大使館が国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要事象はDRC内でのエボラ流行であり、ルワンダは警告受領国。対象国リストではDRCのみが記事の実発生地であるため verified_locations に含める。RwandaとChinaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO緊急事態宣言により高いシグナル優先度。

article.articleHeadline: В Ижевском аэропорту провели учения по выявлению больного холерой // ИА Сусанин - проверенные новости Ижевска и Удмуртии, факты и описания событий.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drills to identify a patient with cholera at Izhevsk Airport.
article.articleSummary: Cholera-focused interagency drills were held at Izhevsk Airport, Udmurtia, to practice identifying a patient with suspected cholera. In the scenario, an ill passenger on a Sochi–Izhevsk flight exhibited symptoms of a dangerous infectious disease and had recently traveled from Delhi, India. The exercise aimed to localize a potential cholera outbreak on the aircraft and prevent its spread within the republic. Participants tested notification procedures, interdepartmental coordination, and readiness for a sanitary-epidemiological emergency, including biosafety rules, steps to locate the outbreak epicenter, collect biological samples, and deliver them to a laboratory. The drills emphasize preparedness for imported cases and rapid containment in transit hubs and border-crossing points in Udmurtia. The information comes from the press service of the Udmurtia Rospotrebnadzor.

triage.headline_ja: イジェフスク空港でコレラ患者の発見訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本件は実際のコレラ発生ではなく、ロシア（対象国外）での訓練演習である。記事サマリーでは架空シナリオ内にインドからの渡航者が登場するが、実際の患者発生や確認例はなく、対象国で実際に発生しているイベントではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Delhi と Indian Federation を発生地域として抽出しているが、記事サマリーを精読すると、本件は架空シナリオを用いたロシア（ウドムルト共和国イジェフスク）での訓練演習であり、実際のコレラ発生事例ではない。対象国内での実際の感染症イベントが確認されないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak worries WHO over 'scale and speed': What do we know about the Bundibugyo strain?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain prompts the WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern as Ebola spreads across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In eastern DRC, 26 additional suspected deaths were reported within 24 hours, bringing total fatalities to 131. The DRC reports 516 suspected cases and 33 confirmed infections; Uganda has two confirmed cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus expresses deep concern over the rapid spread and cross-border risk. The declaration highlights international alarm over the outbreak’s scale and speed, with ongoing transmission in the DRC and potential spillover to Uganda and beyond as authorities pursue containment and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症が世界保健機関を懸念させる「規模と速度」について：ブンディブギョ株について何が分かっているか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が発令されている。DRC・ウガンダでの急速な感染拡大と死亡例の報告により、国際的対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでは過去24時間で26例の追加死亡報告があり、累計131例の死亡が報告されている。WHO事務局長による懸念表明と公衆衛生上の国際的緊急事態宣言により、国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risks in Thailand under watch after Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO declared an Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern DR Congo, an international public health emergency. No outbreak has been reported in Thailand; authorities say to monitor risks and avoid panic. Ebola spreads via blood and bodily fluids, with close contact among family members, medical staff, or those dealing with patients or corpses. Early symptoms mimic fever: high fever, fatigue, body aches, nausea, vomiting; some patients have abnormal bleeding. If untreated, it can be severe with high fatality, but contact tracing and isolation aid control given obvious symptoms. Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health was instructed to monitor the situation and coordinate with agencies; preparations include medical care readiness, isolation rooms, PPE, and laboratory capacity. Public should follow health agencies and maintain hygiene. In related news, DDC issued Nipah virus alert after an outbreak in India, urging One Health coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのアウトブレイク後のタイにおけるエボラのリスク監視
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ出血熱の発生であり、複数国での警戒態勢が確立されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（Ituri州）でのエボラ出血熱の公式なアウトブレイク宣言が主題。タイでは発生報告なく監視段階だが、国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言と関連して警戒態勢が取られている。また記事内でインドでのニパウイルス集団発生にも言及されており、複数の高リスク病原体の動向が同時に報告されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: AS Waspada, Blokir Pelancong dari Zona Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. on Alert, Blocking Travelers from the Ebola Outbreak Zone.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts U.S. travel ban: The United States imposes emergency entry restrictions on foreign nationals who visited the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo), Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days due to Ebola. The move follows DR Congo and Uganda confirming their first Ebola cases on Friday, with the World Health Organization declaring the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. An American working in DR Congo has tested positive for Ebola and is being evacuated to Germany for treatment; six additional Americans exposed to the virus are under medical surveillance. The restrictions exclude U.S. citizens, and authorities are monitoring travel-related risk as outbreaks continue in the three African countries.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が警戒、エボラ感染流行地域からの渡航者をブロック
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数国での確認により国際的拡大リスクが高く、すでに渡航制限が発動されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR Annex2の全基準を満たす。DRCが実際のアウトブレイク発生地として記事サマリーで明記されている。ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。南スーダン（Republic of the Sudan）も対象国リストに含まれない。米国とドイツは患者の移送・治療に関連するが感染流行地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Intensifies Support to DRC's Ebola Outbreak Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, 2026, with WHO intensifying support. More than 35 WHO and Ministry of Health experts deployed; 11.5 tonnes of vital medical supplies and equipment delivered within 72 hours from Kinshasa and regional hubs in Dakar and Nairobi. Additional teams are rolling out disease surveillance, clinical care, infection prevention and control, and community engagement to ensure public health measures. MONUSCO provides airlift support and ground access to boost logistics; Ethiopian Airlines reprioritised flights to accelerate cargo delivery. Supplies include PPE, medical kits, tents, and WASH items. The outbreak is the DRC’s 17th since 1976; the previous Ebola virus disease outbreak ended December 2025. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus disease; response relies on case detection, contact tracing, safe burials, and broad public health measures, under international coordination as a PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ大発生対応への支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準複数該当。DRCでのエボラBundibugyo株の大発生がPHEIC指定され、国際的な対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日にDRC Ituri州でエボラBundibugyo株の大発生が宣言。同年5月20日にPHEIC指定。35名以上のWHO・保健省専門家派遣、11.5トンの医療物資・装備が72時間以内にキンシャサ、ダカール、ナイロビハブから配送。DRCの1976年以降17番目のエボラ大発生。Bundibugyo株にはライセンス化されたワクチンや特異的治療法がないため、症例検出、接触者追跡、安全埋葬、広域公衆衛生措置に依存。MONUSCO、エチオピア航空が支援。国際的調整下でのPHEIC対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosni virus se hitro širi: Okuženega pacienta s posebnim letalom prepeljali v evropsko državo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus is spreading rapidly: An infected patient was airlifted by a special aircraft to a European country.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola was airlifted to Berlin's Charité hospital for treatment in a specialized isolation unit. The patient contracted the deadly virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Ebola is currently spreading rapidly among people. U.S. authorities requested Germany's help, citing the shorter flight time from Uganda, from which rescuers transported the patient. Charité's isolation unit provides dedicated infrastructure to safely treat highly contagious and dangerous infections, with staff working in a fully enclosed, strictly protected area separate from regular hospital operations to prevent contact with other patients or unauthorized personnel. Ebola is highly contagious and deadly, primarily spread through physical contact and exposure to bodily fluids. In the DRC, health workers are intensely trying to curb further transmission as outbreaks continue.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスが急速に拡大：特別な航空機で感染患者がヨーロッパの国に運ばれた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染者がDRCからベルリンに国際移送された事例。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが該当（3/4基準）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、重症度、流行しやすさが該当。国際的なシグナルとしてフルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行が進行中であり、確認患者がベルリンに国際移送された。Bluedot APIが複数の地域（Berlin、Germany、Uganda、USA）を抽出しているが、サマリーから実際のイベント発生地はDRCが主たる流行地。患者のベルリン移送は医療対応であり、当該国でのイベント発生地はDRCである。対象国のうちDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: 中方：高度关注中非地区暴发埃博拉疫情，暂无中国公民疑似感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China is closely monitoring the Ebola outbreak in the Central African region, with no Chinese citizens suspected of infection.
article.articleSummary: May 20, 2026: China is closely monitoring the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, concentrating on the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with no Chinese citizens suspected of infection. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said Beijing will stay in close contact with the affected countries and, based on their needs and international cooperation, provide assistance to help quell the outbreak. The Chinese authorities have published official notices via relevant ministries, and Chinese embassies have issued consular reminders urging Chinese nationals to strengthen preventive measures. There are currently no suspected cases among Chinese citizens overseas. China reiterates its long-standing solidarity with Africa and will mobilize support in line with the evolving situation and the needs of the affected states.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がアフリカ中部のエボラ出血熱の流行を厳密に監視、中国国民の感染疑い例なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を有する指定感染症であり、DRC・ウガンダでの集団発生は IHR(2005) Annex2 の4基準のうち少なくとも3つ以上に該当する。国際的な懸念と支援体制の構築が急速に進むシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の感染症イベントはDRC及びウガンダで発生している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。中国は国際的関心の表明者であり、主要な発生地ではない。エボラ出血熱の流行は極めて高いリスク評価を必要とし、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Niemcy. Pacjent z ebolą już w Berlinie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany. A patient with Ebola is already in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola is being treated in Berlin at Charité in a dedicated isolation unit after transport from the Democratic Republic of Congo, routing via Uganda for a rapid defense. The patient is admitted to the hospital’s largest specialized unit for infectious diseases and intensive care, with capacity to isolate up to 20 patients without disrupting other services. Authorities say there is no public threat; strict procedures include separate waste handling and dual air-filtration systems. Diagnostic workups are prioritized with access to the Robert Koch Institute for advanced blood testing. Mortality from Ebola has decreased from about 60% to roughly 20–30% due to new treatments. Transmission remains by direct contact with infected individuals or fluids; early symptoms resemble flu or diarrhea, progressing to multiorgan failure. WHO declared an international health emergency for outbreaks in DRC and Uganda; this is a rare variant with no vaccine, with Africa CDC noting the outbreak began in late April and was reported in early May.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ。エボラに感染した患者がベルリンに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクに関連し、DRCおよびウガンダでの発生が確認されており、先進国での輸送・治療事例として国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツ・ベルリンでの患者治療事例を報道しているが、実際の感染症アウトブレイク発生地はDRC（late April開始、early May報告）およびウガンダであり、ドイツはトランジット・治療受け入れ国である。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み（DRC、ウガンダのアウトブレイク対象）、新種変異株でワクチン未開発との記載あり。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OMS Alerta Para Falta de Testes no Combate ao Surto na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO warns of a shortage of tests in the fight against the outbreak in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains severe, with at least 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths, and has crossed into Uganda. The World Health Organization warns that a shortage of diagnostic tests delays the response. Twelve tonnes of supplies have been sent, with six more arriving today and a further six expected to arrive on May 26, including PPE for frontline health workers and samples. There is substantial uncertainty about the Bundibugyo strain’s extent, and surveillance/testing capacity is limited (roughly six tests per hour) because many diagnostics target the Zaire strain. BioFire Defense (bioMérieux) is increasing production of the FDA-approved BioFire Global Fever Special Pathogens Panel, capable of detecting multiple Ebola strains including Bundibugyo. Funding shortfalls persist: UN OCHA notes only 34% of the $1.4B appeal funded; despite US withdrawal from the WHO, cooperation continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国での発生流行との戦いにおける検査不足に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は致死性の高い感染症で、DRCで500例以上の疑い患者と130例以上の死亡者を伴う重篤な流行であり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が発生している。検査不足による対応の遅延があり、国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「流行がDRCから越境した」という言及にとどまり、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。検査能力の深刻な不足（時間当たり6検査）が対応を著しく阻害していることが強調されている。Bundibugyo株の不確実性と資金不足も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 공포...우간다 "확산 방지 위해 100명 이상 격리중"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Fear... Uganda: More Than 100 People Quarantined to Prevent Spread.
article.articleSummary: Uganda quarantines more than 100 people to prevent Ebola spread. The Uganda Ebola Task Force, in a May 19, 2026 briefing, said these individuals are being treated by trained medical staff at undisclosed facilities, with officials noting monitoring of symptoms but not specifying whether cases are symptomatic or close contacts. Kampala and nearby areas have heightened surveillance, including border monitoring with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to prevent cross-border transmission. In the DRC, authorities report over 543 suspected Ebola cases and 136 deaths. Two people from the DRC tested positive for Ebola in Uganda, with one death in Kampala. Uganda stresses adherence to public-health guidelines to limit transmission, highlighting its prior experience managing Ebola, COVID-19, and HIV.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の恐れ...ウガンダ「感染拡大防止のため100人以上を隔離中」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当する重篤な状況。DRCで543例の疑い例と136死亡、ウガンダで2例の確定例（1死亡）を報告し、国境を越えた感染拡大が進行中。100人以上の隔離と集中的な監視態勢により、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCで543例の疑い例と136死亡が報告されており、DRCが疫学的な主要な発生地である。ウガンダは国境での確認事例（2例、1死亡）と隔離対応が報告されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行であり、ウガンダは主に国境監視と対応国として位置付けられている。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WPRO地域の対象外であるが、IHR基準4項目全該当と重篤な国際的懸念により、フルRRAへの進行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: What the Deadly Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Means for Ghana and the World - Ghanamma.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in northeastern DR Congo's Ituri province has caused 136 deaths and 514 suspected cases; modelling suggests total may exceed 1,000. The WHO has declared an international emergency. The virus has reached Goma (population 850,000) and crossed into Uganda, with detection delayed, under-detection likely per MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis. Bundibugyo is a rare strain with ~33% fatality; there is no approved vaccine or proven treatment. Traditional outbreak control—contact tracing, isolation, safe burial, community education—remains essential but hampered by war, displacement, and damaged health systems. The Red Cross warns rapid escalation is possible if cases go undetected and systems are overwhelmed. Ghana faces importation risk via travel; lessons from the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak show how quickly travel can spread. WHO has allocated about $4 million; a full-scale response will cost tens of millions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行がガーナと世界にもたらす意味
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行で136死亡、514疑似症例、WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み。ウガンダへの国境越えも確認され、高い国際拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaとAngolaも記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの検出は言及されているものの対象国リストに含まれないため、確認された対象国はDRCとGhanaのみ。Bundibugyo株は稀な株で致死率33%、ワクチンなし。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み。戦争・感染症対応の課題により検査遅延・漏れ検査の可能性が高い。推定患者数は1,000を超える可能性。旅行による輸入リスク存在。

article.articleHeadline: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/Inter/ Ebola en RDC : la sensibilisation communautaire pour briser la chaîne de transmission en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/Inter/ Ebola in the DRC: Community sensitization to break the transmission chain in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, declared May 15, 2026. Since outbreak start, 513 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths reported; 30 laboratory-confirmed cases; 541 contacts under enhanced follow-up. Response teams continue surveillance and community sensitization to break transmission. In border area with Uganda, two positive cases have been reported, including one death. Neighbor provinces North Kivu and Tshopo are on alert. The 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since the 1976 Yambuku incident; the initial outbreak had 318 cases and 280 deaths. Dr Jeanne Alasha notes deaths are Ebola-suspected pending laboratory confirmation. The article emphasizes community-awareness and surveillance efforts in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：イトゥリ州での感染の鎖を断つための地域啓発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患の新規アウトブレイク、既に131人の疑い死亡者と30人の確定症例、ウガンダとの国境地域での拡大確認、国際的な拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Uganda）が含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「国境地域で2人の陽性症例」という言及に留まり、ウガンダでの主要なアウトブレイクは報告されていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。ただし、ウガンダとの国境での確認症例は国際的拡大リスク評価に含める。既に DRC で 17 番目のエボラアウトブレイク（1976 年ヤンブク事件以来）であり、過去の経験による対応体制がある一方、北キブ州やトシポ州が警戒態勢にあることから、更なる地域拡大のリスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Cebu ready for Ebola threat amid global alert - DOH-7
article.articleSummary: Global health authorities have declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over an Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, stoking fears of cross-border transmission via international travel. The Philippines, via DOH-7 in Cebu, has intensified surveillance and readiness; no confirmed Ebola cases have been reported locally. Preparedness builds on COVID-19-era systems, with upgraded surveillance officers in LGUs, ongoing reportable-case reporting, and active monitoring. Ebola spreads by direct contact with infected bodily fluids and presents with fever, body aches, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and potential bleeding; the average fatality rate is about 50% (historical range 25-90%). Authorities emphasize infection control, isolation, and rapid reporting/confirmation of suspected cases, especially for international arrivals. The public is urged to maintain hygiene, protect vulnerable individuals, and promptly report unusual symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ脅威に対するセブの準備 - グローバルアラート中でDOH-7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、Ebola/Bundibugyo特有の高い重症度（致死率50%）、複数国での発生とPHEIC宣言により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのEbola/Bundibugyo発生を言及し、フィリピン（セブ）での準備体制強化が主題。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。PHEIC宣言済みの高致死率病原体であり、国際的移動を通じた伝播リスクが指摘されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: "E furtuna perfectă". Un expert în pandemii trage semnalul de alarmă după focarele de hantavirus și Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's the perfect storm. A pandemic expert sounds the alarm after hantavirus and Ebola outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has grown into a major concern, with 134 suspected deaths and over 500 suspected cases reported. A U.S. citizen was urgently evacuated to Germany for treatment of an Ebola hemorrhagic fever. Separately, hantavirus infections continue in the southern extreme of Argentina, underscoring risk in poorer regions. World Health Organization Director-General warned about the outbreak’s scale and speed, stressing the potential global spillover. The Bundibugyo strain has been implicated; tests focused on another Ebola strain were negative, and authorities note weeks of undetected spread. Experts, including former New Zealand Prime Minister Helen Clark, argue that drastic reductions in global health funding impair prevention and response capabilities, calling for renewed global solidarity and funding for public goods and preparedness, to avert a new pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: 「完璧な嵐」だ。パンデミック専門家がハンタウイルスとエボラの発生後に警報を発する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱による死亡事例・大規模疑い例、国際的な患者輸送（米国市民のドイツへの搬送）、WHO事務局長による警告、数週間の検出されない流行期間があり、国際的拡大とパンデミック化のリスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイクはコンゴ東部で発生していることが明記されており、DRCが主要な発生地。アルゼンチンのハンタウイルス感染は副次的な言及であり、米国市民のドイツへの搬送は医療対応であってドイツでの発生ではない。ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリー上でウガンダの発生は明示されていないため除外。WHO事務局長による警告・元ニュージーランド首相の発言など、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Пациент заразен со ебола пристигна во Европа - Press24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient infected with Ebola arrived in Europe - Press24.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola in Congo was urgently transported to Berlin for treatment on 20 May 2026. Arrival at Berlin Brandenburg Airport occurred at night under extreme security with police escort; the patient, Dr. Peter Stafford, exited a plane in white protective suit, respirator, and face shield, and was taken by specialized ambulances to Charité hospital. Stafford and six close contacts—likely including his family—were conveyed to Berlin for isolation. He is housed in one of the world’s most modern and secure isolation facilities, within the Virchow Clinic, capable of caring for up to 20 patients, with independent ingress, airlocks, dedicated ventilation and filtration, and a closed wastewater system. German authorities say there is no public risk, while Congo health authorities report 513 suspected cases and 131 presumed deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した患者がヨーロッパに到着
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体の国際的な移動と、複数のIHR基準（深刻な影響・予想外・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの感染確認と発症者がドイツ（ベルリン）に搬送された事例が記述されている。Bluedot APIはドイツ・ベルリン・米国を発生地域として付与しているが、実際のエボラ感染イベント発生国はDRCであり、ドイツへの搬送は二次的な移動である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。エボラは高致死率（推定死亡数131/513疑い例）、国際的な感染リスク、渡航制限の可能性が高く、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、全IHR基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Masih Ratusan Kasus Tuberkulosis di Kabupaten Batang Kawasan Pesisir Di-screening
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of tuberculosis cases in Batang Regency's coastal area are still being screened.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) cases in Batang Regency’s coastal area remain high, prompting free health checks (Cek Kesehatan Gratis) and TB screening with Mobile X-ray in Kandeman’s coastal villages Karanggeneng, Ujungnegoro, and Ponowareng. As of May 18, 2026, about 451 TB cases are being treated across facilities in Batang, with ongoing screening to enable early detection. Reported patient loads include RSUD Batang (96), RS QIM (70), RSUD Limpung (39), Puskesmas Bawang (29), Puskesmas Warungasem (23), Puskesmas Tulis (19), and Puskesmas Subah (19). The initiative, undertaken in collaboration with PT Bhimasena Power Indonesia (BPI), aims to accelerate intensive treatment and move toward national elimination goals, targeting zero TB in Batang by 2030. By domicile, Warungasem leads with 44 cases, followed by Bawang (41), Subah (32), Tulis (31), Batang (30), and Kandeman (28).

triage.headline_ja: バタン県沿岸地域の結核症例が依然数百件、スクリーニングが実施されている
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、単一地域での定期的な症例検出・スクリーニングは予期される活動。IHR基準の2つ以上の該当なし。ただしインドネシアは結核高負担国であり、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: バタン県沿岸地域（Kandeman）での結核スクリーニングキャンペーン。451症例が治療中で、複数の医療施設で患者が報告されている。政府とPT Bhimasena Power Indonesiaの協力による2030年までの結核排除目標に向けた取り組みの一環。結核は既知の風土病であり、組織的なスクリーニングは標準的対応のため、PICKUP基準には達しない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: il virus Ebola avanza tra guerra, fame e ospedali allo stremo. L'allarme di Save the Children - insalutenews.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: the Ebola virus advances amid war, famine, and hospitals on the brink. Save the Children warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid ongoing conflict and a severe humanitarian crisis. About 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths have been reported since the outbreak began two weeks ago, per the World Health Organization. The eastern provinces—Nord Kivu, Sud Kivu, and Ituri—with interventions also in Kasai, Kasai Oriental, and Lomami, face the flare-up. The strain is Bundibugyo; initial Zaire-specific tests were negative, and by identification of Bundibugyo, transmission had already spread widely. Save the Children is launching a large-scale response to support health systems, families, and children, including risk communication, and ensuring basic prevention measures and supplies such as chlorine and disinfectants in clinics. WHO calls for urgent global action to contain the virus. DRC hosts about 5.6 million displaced people, ~2.5 million children, and ~15 million in need of humanitarian assistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：戦争、飢饉、限界状態の病院の中でエボラウイルスが拡大。セーブ・ザ・チルドレンが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク、130名の死亡、500の疑い例、複数州での拡大、国際的な懸念と対応要請あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の複数州（Nord Kivu、Sud Kivu、Ituri、Kasai、Kasai Oriental、Lomami）で発生していることが明記されている。Bundibugyo株の確認、戦争と人道危機の中での拡大、WHO及び国際機関による緊急対応要請がある。フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Il paziente zero, i primi test e i centinaia di casi sospetti: così è esplosa l'epidemia di Ebola - Cinque Colonne Magazine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient Zero, the first tests and hundreds of suspected cases: this is how the Ebola epidemic exploded - Cinque Colonne Magazine
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) declared May 15. Since early May, authorities report more than 500 suspected cases and about 130 suspected deaths, with 30 laboratory-confirmed infections. The epidemic spans 10 health zones in Ituri and has crossed into North Kivu with confirmed cases in Butembo and Goma; Uganda has confirmed two imported cases (one death). Initial Bunia tests were negative for the Zaire ebolavirus strain; Bundibugyo confirmation came from Kinshasa laboratories. No licensed vaccines or therapies exist for Bundibugyo; international bodies are evaluating potential vaccines, with Ervebo (Ebola Zaire) cited as a possible option, likely unavailable for about two months. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, diarrhea, vomiting, with bleeding typically starting around day five. Response emphasizes community engagement, risk communication, and respectful funeral practices to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 患者ゼロ、最初の検査、数百の疑い患者：こうしてエボラ出血熱の流行が爆発した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外の新規流行・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、複数国にまたがる確定症例と死亡を伴う。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの重大な流行。500以上の疑い患者、130以上の疑い死亡、30の実験室確定症例を報告。Ituri州10保健地域に広がり、North Kivu州に越境（Butembo、Goma確定症例）。ウガンダへの越国拡大（2輸入症例、1死亡）も確認。ワクチン・治療法が限定的で対応困難。記事配信日が2026年5月という未来日付であるため、データの信頼性に留意が必要だが、イベント内容は典型的なシグナル特性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO records 500 suspected cases, 130 deaths in DRC - Healthwise
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: WHO reports over 500 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths; only 30 confirmed so far. Bundibugyo virus, a strain for which there are no vaccines or therapeutics, confirmed in Kinshasa after initial Bunia tests failed to detect Zaire strain. Cases detected in Ituri's Bunia and spreading to North Kivu’s Butembo and Goma; Uganda reports two imported cases. On May 5, a death in Bunia followed by funeral-related events linked to transmission. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, diarrhoea, vomiting; nosebleeds appear around day five, delaying diagnosis. Sentinel testing required. WHO considering Ervebo (Zaire Ebola vaccine) but expects two months to be available; emphasis on community engagement, sanitary measures, and funeral practices to contain spread. Relief agencies note two million internally displaced in Ituri and North Kivu, with refugees requiring preventive aid; security challenges persist.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOはDRCで500件の疑い症例と130件の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。新規エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の確認、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率（130/500疑い例）、国境越えの事例（ウガンダ2例）があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントの主要な発生地はDRCのブニア（イトゥリ州）、ブテンボ、ゴマ（北キブ州）およびキンシャサであることが明確。ウガンダは輸入例2件の報告のみで、主たる発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ブンディブギョ株の確認は予想外であり、ワクチン・治療薬がない点が懸念。200万人の国内避難民および難民存在により管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Il paziente zero, i primi test e i centinaia di casi sospetti: così è esplosa l'epidemia di Ebola - Rete55
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient zero, the first tests and hundreds of suspected cases: how the Ebola outbreak exploded - Rete55.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province was declared May 15 after eight confirmed cases. By publication, there are more than 500 suspected cases and about 130 suspected deaths, with 30 laboratory-confirmed infections in the DRC. The epidemic spans 10 health zones in Ituri and has reached Nord Kivu (Butembo, Goma) and Uganda (2 imported cases). Initial clues point to a fatal chain beginning with a death on May 5 in Bunia; the body was moved to Mongbwalu and funeral rites may have amplified transmission. Local Bunia tests were negative for the Zaire strain, delaying recognition; Kinshasa-confirmed Bundibugyo virus was ultimately identified. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo; WHO is evaluating potential vaccines, including Ervebo (Zaire strain), which could be available in about two months, though the outbreak may persist longer. Emphasis on community engagement to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 患者ゼロ、最初の検査、および数百の疑似症例：エボラ流行がどのように爆発したか
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラの多国家流行（DRC、ウガンダ）で、IHR基準4項目全て該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが明白。ワクチン・治療法がない状況での制御困難な状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（226074）が列挙されており、記事サマリーでも「Uganda (2 imported cases)」と記載されているが、ウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCのみを記載。本流行は10健康地帯にまたがる多地点流行で、ブンディブギョ株は認可ワクチンなく極めて制御困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Cứu sống bệnh nhân mắc Whitmore nguy kịch sau gần một tháng điều trị tích cực
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient with Whitmore's disease in critical condition saved after nearly a month of intensive treatment.
article.articleSummary: Whitmore's disease (Melioidosis) caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei in Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, was successfully treated in a near-fatal case. Ksor H'Pyệ, 39, from Ia Dom, was admitted 19 April with high fever, coma, severe dyspnea, hypotension, and diabetic ketoacidosis, progressing to septic shock, acute respiratory failure, and multi-organ dysfunction. Blood cultures on 22 April confirmed Burkholderia pseudomallei infection. In intensive care, she required invasive mechanical ventilation, continuous renal replacement therapy, vasopressors, insulin for hyperglycemia, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and specific anti-melioidosis therapy; plasma and red cell transfusions were given for coagulopathy and severe anemia. After nearly a month of treatment, inflammatory markers declined and organ function stabilized. She was discharged on 15 May 2025, with three months of continuing therapy and follow-up advised. Melioidosis is soil- and water-borne, commonly affecting diabetics or immunocompromised individuals; prevention emphasizes hygiene and avoiding contact with mud or contaminated water, seeking care for prolonged fever or breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: ホイットモア病（メリオイドーシス）の重篤患者が約1ヶ月の集中治療後に救命される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の重篤例の治療成功事例であり、疾患は風土病的性質を持つ。現時点では集団発生や国際的拡大のリスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響の直接的な根拠は記事サマリーに見当たらないが、メリオイドーシスは環境由来で免疫低下者に重篤化するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのジア・ライ省での単一の重篤患者の治療成功例を報道。メリオイドーシスは土壌・水由来の風土病であり、免疫低下者（糖尿病患者など）に重篤化する傾向がある。本事例は治療成功事例であり、進行中の集団発生や拡大の証拠は記事に含まれていない。WPRO基準での重症度、長期曝露、流行傾向は満たすが、IHR基準該当なし、社会的関心の程度が不明であるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 27 học sinh nhập viện sau bữa ăn bán trú nghi ngộ độc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 27 students hospitalized after a school meal suspected of poisoning.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-seven students at Kim Đồng Primary School in Sa Đéc Ward, Đồng Tháp Province, Vietnam, were hospitalized on May 19–20, 2026, with fever, vomiting and diarrhea after a lunch on May 18, suspected as food poisoning. Initial reports indicate two severe cases with seizures. The school’s lunch program served 505 students on May 18 and 468 on May 19. By May 20, authorities said the two seriously affected students were stable; the ward ordered a temporary halt to school meals and formed an inter-agency task force with health officials to collect food samples and patient specimens to investigate the cause. The meals are provided by an external contractor that serves Kim Đồng School only. The incident follows a pattern of student food poisoning linked to school meals nationwide, with Salmonella and E. coli commonly implicated.

triage.headline_ja: 27人の学生が学校給食後に入院、食中毒の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 腸内感染症（チフス、パラチフス、大腸菌）の複合シグナルであるが、現時点では食中毒の疑いであり確定診断待ちの段階。公衆衛生上の関心は高いが、国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 複数の腸内感染症病原体が検出されており、確定診断のため食品及び患者検体の検査が進行中。学校給食に関連した類似事象の全国的パターンが指摘されている点は懸念される。ただしIHR基準は2つ以上該当（PICKUP水準）するが、現段階では原因が確定していないため、追加情報と検査結果の報告を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: EUA acreditam na participação da seleção da RD Congo no Mundial2026, apesar do surto de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States believes DR Congo's national team will participate in the 2026 World Cup, despite the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) with over 300 suspected cases and 118 deaths; two additional deaths reported in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), with case-fatality estimates ranging from 25% to 90%. The United States says the DR Congo national football team is expected to participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup hosted across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, and has tightened border health controls to prevent cross-border spread, though no DR Congo-specific measures were disclosed. The tournament’s Group K includes Portugal, DR Congo, Uzbekistan, and Colombia. Portugal opens on June 17 in Houston against DR Congo at 12:00 local (18:00 Lisbon); June 23 vs Uzbekistan in Houston at 12:00 local (18:00 Lisbon); and June 27, the group closes with Portugal vs Colombia in Miami at 19:30 local (00:30 of June 28 Lisbon).

triage.headline_ja: 米国はエボラ流行の中、2026年ワールドカップへのコンゴ民主共和国代表選手団の参加を信じている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（WHO公式PHEIC宣言済み）の複数国への波及、300件以上の疑似患者、118人の死亡、25～90%の致死率という深刻な公衆衛生インパクト。国際的スポーツイベント（2026年FIFA World Cup）への参加に関連した医学的・社会政治的懸念により、複数のIHR基準とWPRO基準に該当。
triage.notes: DRC内での発生地は Ituri および North Kivu（記事サマリーで明示）。ウガンダでの二次的な死亡も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。国際的スポーツイベント（World Cup）の開催地に米国が含まれているが、DRC内のエボラ発生が主要な公衆衛生事象であり、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يدق ناقوس الخطر .. هل يقترب العالم من تهديد وبائي جديد بعد خروج الفيروس عن السيطرة ؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Sounds the Alarm Bells: Is the World Nearing a New Epidemic Threat After the Virus Has Gotten Out of Control?
article.articleSummary: First identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola Bundibugyo strain has triggered a new outbreak in the region with more than 530 suspected cases and 131 deaths, prompting WHO and health authorities to act. Detection lagged due to tests calibrated for a different Ebola strain, producing false negatives and delaying care. Symptoms typically include fever, fatigue, muscle pains, and headache, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and organ failure, with case fatality ranging from about 25% to 90% depending on strain and intervention. Bundibugyo is rare and highly dangerous; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain, unlike Zaire Ebola, for which a vaccine exists post-2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The crisis is intensified by armed conflict, displacement, and weak health systems, hampering containment. Experts from Georgetown and Johns Hopkins warn the outbreak was already large when found and may extend beyond Congo and Uganda. Transmission requires direct contact with infected bodily fluids; airborne spread is not the primary mode. WHO has issued an elevated health alert but not declared a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが危機を鳴らす：ウイルスが制御不能になった後、世界は新たな流行の脅威に近づいているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大リスク）し、エボラ出血熱という高い国際的関心を持つ感染症である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの発生を言及しているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれているため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。本件はエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模集団発生で、530例以上の疑い患者、131死亡が報告されており、極めて深刻。ワクチンや治療薬が不足しており、武装紛争と弱い保健システムが対応を困難にしている。WHOは健康警告を発令しているがパンデミック宣言には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Lo que nos dicen las cifras sobre el brote de ébola - WTOP News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What the figures tell us about the Ebola outbreak - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: WHO reports a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine, and has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of Tuesday, more than 500 suspected cases and about 130 deaths have been reported, with only around 30 confirmed in the laboratory. An American clinician who worked in DRC has tested positive and is being transported to Germany for care, with six high‑risk contacts relocated to Europe (the patient and five others to Germany) and one additional contact to the Czech Republic. In Uganda, two confirmed imported cases from DRC have been identified; one died and the other is being treated. The first Bundibugyo confirmation in Bunia followed four healthcare workers’ deaths in Mongbwalu, Ituri, amid a four‑week detection gap. Incubation is 2–21 days; transmission occurs via contact with infected fluids or contaminated surfaces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行の数字が物語るもの - WTOP News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの多国間流行で、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Germany、Czechiaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主たる流行地はDRCおよびウガンダの輸入症例に限定されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。検査室確認症例は少数（約30件）だが、疑い症例500件以上、死亡130件と重篤。Bundibugyo型の治療法・ワクチン不在で、incubation 2-21日、接触感染。PHEICの宣言により国際関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola alarmı: "İnsanlar çok hızlı ölüyor, gerçekten korkuyoruz" - Medyascope
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Congo: "People are dying very quickly, we are really scared" - Medyascope
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri’s Bunia, spreading to Mongwalu and Rwampara, with spillovers into North Kivu’s Butembo and Goma and cross-border cases in Uganda (one Ebola death). As of Tuesday, authorities reported 514 suspected cases and 136 deaths. The illness is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; while it can cause high fever and severe bleeding, it does not always, delaying diagnosis and allowing community transmission. The putative index case is a nurse who died in Bunia; Mongwalu deaths have been linked to burial beliefs described as the 'tabut phenomenon.' Testing had focused on the Zaire lineage, delaying recognition of Bundibugyo; Save the Children notes it had not been seen in Ituri before. Public health measures such as masking and hand hygiene are poorly implemented in major cities, and five days after the outbreak’s declaration, no city had a fully functioning Ebola treatment center.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ警報：「人々が非常に速く死んでいる、本当に怖い」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo系統）の大規模流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。514疑い患者、136死亡と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）が確認されている。治療センター未整備、診断遅延、埋葬儀式に関連した感染拡大など管理が不十分であり、国際支援が緊急に必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部イトゥリ州ブニア中心の流行を報道。ウガンダへの越境感染確認（1死亡）があるがウガンダは対象国リストに未含。ルワンダのキガリ州も発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーではDRCが主要な流行地であり、ルワンダでの患者報告は記載されていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: احتواء تفشّي "الإيبولا" الجديد سيكون صعباً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Containment of the new Ebola outbreak will be difficult.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-20, a new Ebola outbreak is unfolding in the DRC, with Uganda affected. The Bundibugyo strain is suspected; more than 500 cases and over 130 deaths have been reported, implying substantial undetected transmission for weeks or months. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, notably the mining towns of Mongabwalo and Ruambbara, where irregular health services and high population movement accelerate spread. Early symptoms resemble typhoid and malaria, hindering detection; rapid tests often fail to identify Bundibugyo, delaying confirmation until samples reach central labs in Kinshasa. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. International response has historically included USAID and the CDC coordinated with WHO, but shifting US policies and funding reductions may hinder capacity; the EU has PPE stockpiles ready. Cross-border spread underscores the need for rapid contact tracing and coordinated surveillance; the outbreak could be larger than reported.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ出血熱の流行の封じ込めは困難となるだろう
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目すべて該当。明確な感染症危機である。
triage.notes: サマリーにウガンダの言及があるが、主たる発生地はDRCのIturi Province（Mongabwalo、Ruambbara）と記述されている。ウガンダは「affected」と表現されているが、具体的な症例数などの詳細は記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため確認の対象外。本件は複数の懸念要因を含む（治療法なし、診断遅延、人口移動が多い採鉱地、国際的資金削減）。

article.articleHeadline: Il paziente zero, i primi test e i centinaia di casi sospetti: così è esplosa l'epidemia di Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patient zero, the first tests and hundreds of suspected cases: this is how the Ebola outbreak exploded.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province has surged from eight confirmed cases on May 15 to over 500 suspected cases across 10 health zones, with confirmed cases also in Nord Kivu (Butembo, Goma) and two imported cases in Uganda (one death). The index event appears linked to a May 5 death in Bunia, with funeral practices and population movement driving transmission; local Bunia tests were negative for the Zaire strain, and Kinshasa laboratories subsequently confirmed Bundibugyo virus. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo EBOV; international consideration of vaccines/treatments is ongoing, with Ervebo (Zaire EBOV vaccine) potentially available in about two months, though the outbreak may not be contained by then. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, diarrhea, vomiting, with bleeding typically beginning around day five. WHO’s Anne Ancia emphasizes community engagement and collaboration with authorities to control transmission amid insecurity and displacement. Uganda reports two imported cases (one death).

triage.headline_ja: 患者ゼロ、初期検査、数百件の疑い事例：エボラウイルス流行がこのように爆発した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo EBOV）の多地域同時流行で500件以上の疑い事例、国際的な事例発生、承認治療薬なし、複数国への拡大報告。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo EBOVの流行で、5月15日時点で8件確定例が5月20日には500件以上の疑い事例に急増。北キブ州（ブテンボ、ゴマ）での確定例、ウガンダへの輸入症例（1死亡）報告。葬儀慣行による伝播、人口移動、局所的な不安定性が拡大要因。WHO も対応を強調。国際的なワクチン・治療薬の検討が急務の状況。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : un médecin américain infecté arrive à Berlin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: an infected American doctor arrives in Berlin
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola arrives in Berlin by air and is admitted to Charité University Hospital, escorted by a six-person contact group, possibly family. Dr. Peter Stafford and his wife Dr. Rebekah Stafford are Serge missionaries in Pennsylvania. He contracted the Bundibugyo Ebola strain while caring for patients at Nyankunde hospital near Bunia in DRC. They moved to Africa in 2019 and have worked in DRC. Charité runs Germany's specialized isolation unit for highly contagious diseases, with dedicated access, ventilation, and wastewater treatment, integrated with national and international protection networks. The outbreak prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; U.S. travel restrictions were issued for travelers from affected regions. At least 80 deaths; 513 suspected cases and 131 presumed deaths in DRC, with cases also in Uganda. Ebola transmits by contact with body fluids. The Zaïre variant of 2014-2015 caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行: 感染したアメリカ人医師がベルリンに到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ→ドイツ）、WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、高い死亡率（最低80人以上）、国際的な渡航制限措置実施。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には複数国（ドイツ、米国、ウガンダ等）が含まれているが、記事サマリーより実際のエボラ流行の発生地はDRC（Bunia近郊のNyankunde病院）が主たる流行地であり、ウガンダでも症例がある。ドイツと米国への報告はキャリアの移動に関連したもので、原発地ではない。したがって対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み、渡航制限措置実施済みのため、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Upaya Memperkuat Pengendalian Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Efforts to Strengthen Rabies Control.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Gorontalo Province, Indonesia, launched a mass rabies vaccination program on May 19, 2026, through a collaboration between PROJECT Sulawesi and the Gorontalo Provincial Government. Gorontalo becomes the second Indonesian province to enact a Governor Regulation (PERGUB) prohibiting the trade of dog and cat meat. The move follows a memorandum of understanding between PROJECT Sulawesi and the governor to address rabies prevention and the dog/cat meat trade, viewed as a major barrier to elimination due to movement of unvaccinated animals and increased human exposure, which undermines vaccination coverage. Ramdhan Pade, Head of the Gorontalo Department of Animal Husbandry and Plantations, representing the governor, stated the measure strengthens public health and animal welfare while advancing rabies control and reducing risk to people and animals.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病対策の強化に向けた取り組み
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ゴロンタロ州で狂犬病予防対策（ワクチン接種プログラムおよび犬猫肉取引禁止）が実施されている。これは既存の公衆衛生課題への対応であり、新規の流行事象ではなく、国家レベルでの管理体制確立の段階である。国際的拡大リスクや緊急対応の必要性が明確でないため、今後の進捗を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病制御のための予防的措置（ワクチン接種キャンペーンと規制）の発表であり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。ゴロンタロ州が犬猫肉取引禁止令を制定した第2州となったこと、およびワクチン未接種動物の移動による継続的な曝露リスクが指摘されている。現段階では情報不足（患者数、死亡数、患者発生データ等）のため、WATCHとして経過観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: El avance del ébola provoca restricciones de viajes: Estados Unidos toma una drástica decisión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of Ebola prompts travel restrictions: the United States makes a drastic decision.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is advancing rapidly, with WHO reporting over 500 suspected cases and about 130 deaths attributed to the virus. In response, travel restrictions have been imposed by the United States and Bahrain, prohibiting entry of foreigners who have recently been in Uganda, Sudan, or the DRC for 30 days under the Public Health Service Act of 1944; the U.S. also cautions citizens against travel to those countries. The WHO will allocate $3.9 million from the Emergency Contingency Fund to support response and mobilization. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of the outbreak’s breadth and speed. Spain remains cautious and has not raised its alert level, but the government of Pedro Sánchez asks Spanish citizens to avoid travel to affected countries for now until containment improves. Tom Frieden, an infectious-disease expert, describes the outbreak as severe and potentially devastating.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの拡大が渡航制限をもたらす：米国が抜本的決定を下す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。対象国DRCで500例以上の疑似患者と約130人の死亡が報告され、米国およびバーレーンが渡航制限を実施している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUSA、Sudan、Spain、Bahrainが含まれているが、これらは渡航制限実施国または警戒国であり、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCが主である。サマリーに基づきDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。WHO緊急基金3.9百万ドル配分、Tedros事務局長の警告、専門家による重大性指摘により、社会政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : " La souche Bundibugyo n'a pas encore de vaccin, ni de traitement curatif " (Dr. Muyembe) | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in the DRC: "The Bundibugyo strain does not yet have a vaccine, nor a curative treatment" (Dr. Muyembe) | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak is in Ituri, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Virologist Jean-Jacques Muyembe Tamfum (INRB) states this strain is under-studied in the DRC and currently has no vaccine or curative treatment. Vaccines and monoclonal therapies effective against Ebola Zaire, such as EBANGA and the rVSV-ZEBOV-GP vaccine, are not directly applicable to Bundibugbo. Authorities are cautiously optimistic, with lines of investigation aiming to test candidate vaccines or therapeutic molecules in the coming days. The Bundibugyo strain carries an estimated case fatality around 40%, lower than Ebola Zaire, which can exceed 80%. The DRC has faced 17 Ebola outbreaks, 15 of which have been controlled without vaccines or specific treatments. Core measures remain rapid case detection, isolation of patients, protection of health workers, strict disinfection, and safe burials to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRC(コンゴ民主共和国)でのエボラ出血熱：「Bundibugyo株にはまだワクチンも根治的治療法もない」（Dr. Muyembe）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の新規発生、未知の株系統、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: DRC第17回目のエボラ発生。Bundibugyo株はZaire株に対するワクチン・療法が効果的でなく、推定致死率40%。現在のところIturi地域での確認。DRCの過去16回の発生は特定の医療介入なしに制御されているが、本株に対する未知性と対応手段の欠如が重大なリスク要因。WHO通知・国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ιορδανία: Απαγόρευση εισόδου σε ταξιδιώτες από Κονγκό και Ουγκάντα λόγω Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jordan: Entry ban on travelers from Congo and Uganda due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Jordan bans entry of all travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda due to Ebola, with Jordanian citizens exempt. The restriction takes effect May 20, 2026, for one month. The precaution, announced by the Interior Ministry based on a Health Ministry recommendation, aims to curb Ebola spread amid evolving epidemiology in the two countries. The decision followed a Monday meeting involving the Health Ministry (Epidemiology Directorate), the National Center for Combating Epidemics and Infectious Diseases, and a World Health Organization representative in Jordan. The measure is enacted under Public Health Law No. 47/2008 and amendments, with continuous reevaluation of the situation in light of international health developments.

triage.headline_ja: ヨルダン：エボラのためコンゴとウガンダからの旅行者の入国禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、複数国での発生確認、公式な入国制限措置実施により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot発生地域にはJordan・Uganda・DRCが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生と、それに対するジョルダンの予防措置を主題としている。Ugandaは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー内での言及は限定的であり、記事の主題はDRCでの発生。対象国リスト上でUgandaは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Jordanは対象国でないため除外。2026年5月20日現在の日付で未来日付であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: В Ижевском аэропорту провели учения по выявлению больного холерой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drills at Izhevsk Airport to identify a patient with cholera.
article.articleSummary: Drills at Izhevsk Airport (Udmurtia, Russia) were conducted to test procedures for identifying a patient with suspected cholera. The interagency exercise, published May 20, 2026, uses a scenario on a Sochi–Izhevsk flight in which a passenger exhibits signs of a dangerous infectious disease and had previously visited Delhi, India. The drill focused on localizing an epidemic focus aboard the aircraft and preventing its spread within the republic. Participants validated notification schemes, interagency coordination, and the readiness of sanitary-epidemiological services to respond to a biological incident, along with biosafety rules. They practiced localizing the outbreak, collecting biological material, and transporting samples to a laboratory. The event underscores preparedness for suspected cholera cases through rapid incident management and laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: イジェフスク空港でコレラ患者の発見訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは実際のコレラ発症事例ではなく、ロシアが実施した防災訓練（シミュレーション演習）である。記事サマリーで明示されている「drill」「exercise」「scenario」という表現から、仮定シナリオに基づいた対応能力検証であることが確認される。実在する公衆衛生危機ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した「Delhi」「Sochi」「Izhevsk」はいずれもシナリオの設定地点であり、実際のコレラ発症地ではない。記事は防災訓練の報道であり、確実な感染症イベント（confirmed case）を報告していない。対象国内での実地発症確認がないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Fotbal: CM 2026 - În ciuda epidemiei de Ebola, Washingtonul va permite intrarea echipei RD Congo pe teritoriul său (oficial american)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Football: World Cup 2026 - Despite the Ebola outbreak, Washington will allow the DR Congo team's entry into its territory (according to an American official).
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's national football team (Leopards) will compete in the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States despite an Ebola outbreak in the country. A U.S. State Department official said they expect the Leopards to participate, even as Washington tightens border health screening; entry is denied to foreigners who have traveled in the last 21 days to Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan. The official noted the squad trained in Europe and may not trigger the restrictions, but if any member traveled through the DRC within 21 days, an exception could be granted with strict testing and isolation, though fans are excluded. The team will be based in Houston (Group K). They face Portugal on June 17, Colombia on June 24 in Guadalajara, and Uzbekistan on June 28 in Atlanta; the presence in Mexico was not addressed. This marks the Leopards' second World Cup appearance, following 1974 as Zaire.

triage.headline_ja: サッカー: ワールドカップ2026 - エボラ流行にもかかわらず、ワシントンはコンゴ民主共和国チームの領土への入国を認める（アメリカの公務員）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワールドカップ参加に関する国際スポーツイベントの話題であり、エボラ流行そのものの疫学的情報（新規患者数、死亡数、発生地域の拡大、制御状況）を含まない。エボラは背景情報として言及されているのみで、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響の証拠、異常性の記述、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクなど、IHRまたはWPROスクリーニング基準に該当する具体的な疫学的懸念を示していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は主題がスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）であり、エボラ流行は背景状況として言及されているのみ。疾患の疫学的動向、患者数、死亡数、新規発生地域、制御状況など感染症シグナルの実質的な内容を欠いている。DRCでのエボラ流行の存在は確認されるが、記事自体はシグナルトリアージの対象となる感染症イベント情報ではなく、スポーツニュースである。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta por la rápida expansión del brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns of the rapid spread of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-20, the World Health Organization raised the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to rapid spread amid insecurity and population movement. The outbreak, centered in Ituri province near the Ugandan border, is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a less common strain for which no vaccines or specific therapies are approved. WHO reports over 500 suspected cases and about 130 deaths under investigation, with figures likely to rise as surveillance, contact tracing, and on‑the‑ground testing expand. Cases have crossed into Kampala, Uganda, among people from the DRC, signaling regional risk. Challenges include weak health infrastructure, displacement, and potential nosocomial transmission. No blanket border closures are advised; emphasis on case isolation, contact tracing, cross‑border surveillance, community information, and intensified international coordination; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つ全てが該当し、PHEIC宣言されたエボラ出血熱の国際的拡大事象。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、感染症危機管理上の最優先事項。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域リストにはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーにおいてウガンダは地理的に対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはターゲット国（203312）として確認。Bundibugyo Ebola virusというまれな株であること、ワクチン未承認であること、すでにPHEIC宣言されていることが重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола повторно го запали алармот, редок вид на вирусот се шири во Конго - Навалица
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola again triggers the alarm, a rare strain of the virus is spreading in Congo - Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda has triggered renewed global concern. As of May 2026, more than 500 suspected cases and over 130 deaths are reported, with several laboratory-confirmed cases. This strain, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is rarer than the Zaire lineage, and currently there is no approved vaccine or specific antiviral; management relies on early supportive care, fluids, nutrition, pain control, and treatment of additional infections. Late case detection may mean the virus circulated longer than officially confirmed. Regions affected include mining and trade-connected communities with high mobility, complicating containment. The World Health Organization has declared an International Public Health Emergency, but Europe and broader regions face low current risk; the situation warrants rapid case finding, contact tracing, and safe handling of patients and deceased. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or animals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが再び警報を引き起こし、稀なウイルス株がコンゴで拡大 - アウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。ブンディブギオエボラウイルスの発生は深刻な公衆衛生影響（130名超の死亡、500名超の疑い例）、国際的な広がりリスク（ウガンダまで確認）を示しており、WHOによる国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言もなされている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は希少型であり、ワクチン未承認、抗ウイルス薬なし。採掘・貿易関連コミュニティの高い流動性が封じ込めを複雑化させている。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーの主要な焦点はDRCであり、ウガンダでの具体的な症例数や詳細は記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。
