article.articleHeadline: World Health Organisation Urges Calm Amid Ebola Outbreak - Voice of Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organization. Ebola is a severe, often fatal illness in humans and primates, and the PHEIC aims to boost international coordination and resources rather than induce panic, according to WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi. Authorities are tracing contacts, strengthening surveillance, engaging communities, and deploying response strategies in both countries. As of May 16, DRC reported eight confirmed Ebola cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths; additional cases were reported in Kinshasa, Goma, Beni, and Kampala, with two infected individuals crossing from the DRC into Uganda. WHO warns the outbreak could be larger than detected due to unexplained deaths, high positivity, and limited understanding of transmission, with insecurity, population movement, and weak health systems potentially worsening spread.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラ流行中の冷静を呼びかけ - ナイジェリア・ボイス
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的PHEIC宣言により、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性が明確。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの流行が述べられているが、ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含）への拡大は限定的（2事例の越境）。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。PHEIC宣言により国際的な重要性が高い。不安定な治安、人口移動、弱い保健システムが拡大リスクを高める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Infizierter US-Amerikaner in Charité in Berlin aufgenommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Infected U.S. citizen admitted to Charité in Berlin.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected during the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been admitted to Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin and placed in its special isolation ward. The Federal Ministry of Health confirmed the admission. German Health Minister Nina Warken (CDU) said the government naturally assists its partners. This case is an imported Ebola infection to Germany, with treatment at the Berlin hospital. The report provides no further details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or disease course. Details on travel exposure or prognosis were not disclosed. The incident underscores Germany's role in international outbreak response and patient management within a dedicated isolation facility.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染した米国人がベルリンのシャリテ病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染症の輸入症例であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではコンゴ民主共和国での流行が背景であり、患者はそこで感染した米国市民がベルリンに搬送された輸入症例。対象国リストにおいてはDRCのみが該当。エボラウイルス感染症は高い致死率と国際的懸念を伴う指定感染症であり、輸入症例の発生は重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in DR Kongo und Uganda: Was Reisende jetzt wissen müssen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda: What travelers need to know now.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola cases reported in parts of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and surrounding regions) and Uganda, centering on the rare Bundibugyo variant. Africa CDC notes this is only the third Bundibugyo outbreak; the case fatality rate is about 37% for Bundibugyo, versus up to 90% for the Zaire strain. Ebola is a zoonotic virus; transmission requires direct contact with infected persons or their body fluids, and individuals are contagious only when symptomatic. The incubation period ranges from two to 21 days (averaging six to ten). Early symptoms are nonspecific, often flu-like. Travel advisories urge avoiding non-essential travel to Ituri and nearby areas, and to other parts of Congo including Kinshasa. The article cites RKI, Tagesschau, and Africa CDC, emphasizing precautions, hygiene, and awareness of possible restrictions for travellers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行：旅行者が今知るべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な稀少株の出現、複数国への国際的拡大、旅行制限の実施）。WPRO基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に最優先される感染症。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イツリ州およびキンシャサを含む）での症例を主に述べており、ウガンダは「発生地域」フィールドに含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダでの具体的な新規症例報告には触れていない。稀少なBundibugyo株の出現（これまで3回目の流行）はWHOにとって重大な関心事。症例致死率37%、ヒト-ヒト感染能、渡航制限の実施など、全ての重症度・拡大リスク指標が該当。

article.articleHeadline: Lebensbedrohliche Krankheit: WHO: Zahl der Verdachtsfälle bei Ebola-Ausbruch steigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Life-threatening disease: WHO: number of suspected cases in an Ebola outbreak rises.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, Ebola outbreaks are rising, with 528 suspected cases and 132 suspected deaths reported by WHO. The vast majority (516 suspected cases and 131 deaths) are in the DRC, where the outbreak likely began in the third week of April in Ituri province, near Uganda and South Sudan. Uganda has 12 suspected cases and one confirmed death. The involved Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or therapy, hindering containment. An Ebola-infected American in the DRC has been admitted to Berlin's Charité in a special isolation ward; U.S. authorities have asked Germany for assistance due to shorter flight times. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids. The article recalls a 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak of the Zaire variant, which killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 生命を脅かす疾病：WHO：エボラ出血熱の集団発生における疑い患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。対象国（DRC、Uganda）での確認事例あり、死亡例も報告されており、エボラ出血熱は極めて高いリスクの病原体である。
triage.notes: Ituri province（DRC内）が主要な発生地。ウガンダも12疑い例を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。ドイツ・ベルリンへの患者搬送は医療対応であり、流行地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療がなく、管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Još upitnika pred SP: Nastup im visi zbog epidemije ebole, a FIFA 'prati situaciju'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More questions ahead of the World Cup: Their participation hangs in the balance due to the Ebola epidemic, and FIFA is monitoring the situation.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's national football team navigates an Ebola outbreak at home as it prepares for the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. FIFA states it is aware of and monitoring the Ebola situation and is in close contact with the DR Congo Football Federation to ensure players receive medical and security guidance. A planned training camp in Kinshasa was canceled due to health restrictions, while preparations continue in Europe and Houston. The DR Congo will play its Group K opener in Houston on June 17 against Portugal, with subsequent matches on June 23 against Colombia in Zapopan, Mexico, and June 27 against Uzbekistan in Atlanta. The CDC has imposed a 30-day entry ban for travelers recently visiting Ebola-affected areas (DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan). CDC official Satish Pillai notes active collaboration with FIFA to safeguard travel and public health.

triage.headline_ja: さらに多くの疑問がワールドカップ前に：エボラ出血熱の流行により彼らの参加が危機に瀕しており、FIFAは状況を監視している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で複数該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC での活動的な流行に加え、国際スポーツイベント（2026年FIFA ワールドカップ）を通じた国際的拡大リスク、複数国への渡航による感染リスクがあり、CDCの入国制限措置も実施されている。フルRRA が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域には多数の国が列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行である。DRC が2026年ワールドカップ開催国（米国）への選手団派遣を予定していることにより、国際的な関心と渡航制限リスクが高い。ウガンダ、南スーダンも流行地として言及されているが、記事の焦点はDRC であり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Лихорадка Эбола в ДР Конго: ЮНИСЕФ доставил в республику 16 тонн гуманитарной помощи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease in DR Congo: UNICEF delivered 16 tons of humanitarian aid.
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, UNICEF delivered 16 tons of humanitarian aid to DR Congo's north-eastern provinces amid the Ebola virus disease outbreak. The shipment, flown to Bunia International Airport, includes disinfectants, soap, personal protective equipment, water purification tablets, and water, to be distributed among the three most-affected districts. Separately, over 100 people have been placed in isolation in Uganda to curb cross-border transmission; health workers are monitoring patients for Ebola symptoms. The outbreak began in eastern DR Congo near the Ugandan border. Current figures report about 500 Ebola cases in the DRC with more than 130 deaths; Uganda has reported one death. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：UNICEFが人道支援物資16トンを配送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的な懸念（PHEIC）を宣言。エボラ出血熱の確認症例500例以上、死亡130例以上で重症度が高く、越境感染の可能性がある。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。記事ではUgandaでの隔離事例も言及されているが、本記事の主題はDRC内のアウトブレイクであり、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsから除外。越境感染リスクが高く、東アフリカ地域への拡大監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Пациент заразен со ебола пристигна во Европа - Слободен печат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient infected with Ebola arrived in Europe - Sloboden Pecat
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, an American physician infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo was admitted to Berlin's Charité hospital in the early morning. Germany's Federal Ministry of Health approved treating the patient in Germany rather than the United States, citing shorter air travel from Uganda and Charité's prior experience with Ebola cases. The patient was transported to Berlin by a specialized medical aircraft and then by a specially designed vehicle under police escort. Six contacts who had exposure to the patient were also moved to minimize transmission risk. Charité operates a fully isolated ward for such cases. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids and typically presents with flu-like symptoms or diarrhea before organ failure; mortality with modern treatment and specialist supervision can be reduced from about 60% to 20–30%. Outbreaks have been expanding in Congo and Uganda for weeks prior to alarms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染した患者がヨーロッパに到着 - スロボデン・ペチャット
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、高致死率疾患の国際越境事例、欧州への初期導入の公衆衛生的危機管理需要があり、フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot API発生地域にはBerlin（ドイツ）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRC発症者の欧州への空輸移送』であり、実際の疾患発生地はDRCおよび周辺地域に限定される。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。独・米・ウガンダは医療対応国であり感染症発生地ではないため除外。WPROスクリーニング基準は欧州事例向けであるが、本シグナルの医学的意義（高致死率疾患の国際越境、連鎖感染リスク、対応体制の整備状況）を考慮するとIHR基準が優先される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO weighs experimental vaccines as Congo Ebola outbreak spirals past 500 suspected cases
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 500 suspected cases and at least 130 suspected deaths, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu. Only around 30 cases are laboratory-confirmed; limited testing capacity and malaria/typhoid-like early symptoms hinder ascertainment. The conflict-affected provinces face displacement and fragile health systems, with confirmed infections spreading to Butembo and Goma; Uganda reports imported infections, raising concern for regional spillover to South Sudan. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or targeted treatments. A WHO panel is evaluating options, including Merck’s Ervebo (Zaire strain) for possible cross-protection, though not approved for Bundibugyo. About 2,000 doses are staged by Gavi for emergency use or trials. Initial analyses suggest spillover from an animal source at Mongbwalu, with subsequent human-to-human transmission amid limited laboratory capacity.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが実験的ワクチンを検討、コンゴのエボラアウトブレイクが500件以上の疑い例を超過
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaの大規模アウトブレイク（500+疑い例、130+死亡）、複数国への地域的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの懸念）、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な懸念と対応（WHO介入、ワクチン検討）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはウガンダとスーダンも列挙されているが、記事サマリー上でウガンダは「輸入感染例の報告」であり、スーダンは「地域的懸念」の文脈のため、主要発生地はDRCのみと判定。Bundibugyo Ebolaはマールブルグやザイレ株と異なる株であり、既存ワクチンの有効性が不確実であることが追加的な懸念。限定的な検査能力とマラリア・チフス様症状による診断困難性が報告の信頼性に影響するが、WHOが直接介入・評価している点から信度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavirus: Ebolapatient in Berliner Charité aufgenommen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebolavirus: Ebola patient admitted to Berlin's Charité.
article.articleSummary: US citizen infected with Ebola is admitted to Berlin's Charité for treatment in a dedicated high-containment isolation unit on the Virchow-Klinikum campus after contracting the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where outbreaks are ongoing. The patient was transported from Uganda aboard a specially equipped aircraft for highly infectious patients and arrived at the Charité shortly before 3 a.m., escorted by police, fire services, and ambulances in a specially equipped vehicle. Germany's Federal Health Minister Nina Warken stated that the government would support partners and maintain stringent safety measures, highlighting Germany's capacity to treat highly infectious diseases. Separately, the Czech Republic is also admitting a US citizen doctor who had contact with an Ebola patient, with transfer from Uganda to Prague's Bulovka hospital expected to arrive Wednesday evening, and the public is not at risk. Ebola spreads via bodily contact and body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：ベルリンのシャリテに入院したエボラ患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認・複数患者の輸送、高リスク病原体の国際移動により、フルRRA進行の判断基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの感染が確認される患者がドイツとチェコに搬送された事象を報告。ドイツとチェコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国に該当。既存アウトブレイク継続中のDRCでの感染源、複数国への患者輸送、高度な隔離設備の必要性から国際的インシデント性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cứu sống bé trai viêm phổi nặng do đồng nhiễm 5 tác nhân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors save the life of a boy with severe pneumonia caused by co-infection with five pathogens.
article.articleSummary: In Phu Tho Province, Vietnam, a 29-month-old boy with severe pneumonia and respiratory failure was found to be co-infected with five respiratory pathogens: Mycoplasma pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Bocavirus, and Human Rhinovirus. The child, L.Đ.Đ.K., developed symptoms after suspected water aspiration during swimming and did not improve with initial Augmentin. He was admitted to Thanh Son Regional Medical Center and then transferred to Phu Tho Pediatric Hospital, requiring intubation, mechanical ventilation, a central venous line, and continuous arterial BP monitoring. Multiplex PCR identified all five pathogens, enabling a targeted antibiotic strategy and advanced supportive care, including respiratory therapy and nutrition support. After four days of intensive care, his respiratory status improved, he was extubated, and after about a week he stabilized and was discharged home. Parents are advised to seek timely care for warning signs of pediatric respiratory illness.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が5つの病原体の同時感染による重症肺炎の少年を救命
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例の成功事例であり、流行の兆候や広域的な公衆衛生脅威の証拠が不足しており、単一施設での対応可能な事例と判断される。継続的な監視が推奨される。
triage.notes: 5つの呼吸器病原体の同時感染は臨床的に注目すべき事例であるが、記事は単一の小児患者の治療成功例を報告するものであり、集団発生や広域流行の兆候は見られない。Mycoplasma pneumoniaeとStreptococcus pneumoniaeは季節的に流行することが知られているが、本記事にはそのような兆候の報告はない。今後の類似症例報告の動向に注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolasmittad läkare får vård i Berlin | Sveriges Radio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected doctor receives treatment in Berlin | Swedish Public Radio
article.articleSummary: An American doctor infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been transported to Berlin for specialist care after the United States requested Germany’s help with treatment. The patient has been admitted to Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin. More than 130 people have died so far in the latest outbreak, and on Tuesday the World Health Organization held an emergency meeting. The case underscores international cooperation in addressing Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa, with Germany providing advanced medical care. Global health authorities continue to monitor the situation as the Democratic Republic of Congo faces continued transmission risks and cross-border spread. The patient’s transfer demonstrates ongoing cross-country medical support for Ebola care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者の医師がベルリンで治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WHOが緊急会議を開催したエボラ出血熱の国際的拡大を示す。DRCでの継続的な流行と国際患者移送による越境リスクが明示されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が主題で、患者移送先のベルリン（ドイツ）は医療対応の場所であり発生地ではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHOの緊急会議開催、130人以上の死亡、継続的な越境リスクという複数の懸念要因が存在。フルのRapid Risk Assessmentへの進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 大流行专家：伊波拉汉坦病毒双暴发 凸显全球风险防范滞后 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pandemic experts: Dual outbreaks of Ebola and Hantavirus highlight the lag in global risk prevention.
article.articleSummary: Geneva-based pandemic expert Helen Clark warns that simultaneous Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks reveal a lag in global risk prevention. Despite improved capacity since WHO declared COVID-19 over, upstream risk identification and early detection remain insufficient. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s remote Bundibugyo region has reportedly caused about 130 deaths, with laboratory confirmation of Bundibugyo strain and weeks of circulation undetected. Separately, a hantavirus outbreak on the Hondius cruise ship in the Atlantic, which departed from Argentina, has led to several infections and three deaths; transmission on board is under investigation. A confirmed U.S. citizen has Ebola infection, underscoring border vulnerabilities. Clark calls for a thorough review of the events and lessons, and for renewed funding and risk-based preparedness, warning of a looming 'perfect storm' without global solidarity and sustained aid.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミック専門家：エボラとハンタウイルスの二重発生は世界的リスク予防の遅れを浮き彫りにする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。複数国での同時多発（DRC、米国）、高い死亡率（約130名+3名）、国際的拡大リスク（船舶での感染、国境越え）が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー解析：Bundibugyo地域（DRC）でのエボラ発生（約130死）、大西洋クルーズ船（アルゼンチン発）でのハンタウイルス発生（3死）、米国市民でのエボラ確認が記載。対象国はDRCのみが確実だが、記事ではこれらを含む多国間イベントとして論じられている。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、国際専門家からの公式警告が発出されている重大シグナル。速やかなフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS avertizează asupra ''amplorii'' epidemiei de Ebola din RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns about the 'spread' of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 136 deaths and about 543 suspected cases reported as of May 20, 2026. The outbreak is centered in eastern DRC, notably Ituri province (Bunia), with two suspected cases in Butembo, North Kivu. Hospitals such as Rwampara report saturation and lack isolation facilities, underscoring a chaotic response. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no vaccine or specific treatment; containment relies on infection prevention, rapid case finding, and contact tracing. WHO declared an International Health Emergency; authorities have strengthened border controls and mobilized equipment, though few laboratory confirmations mean counts are provisional. Uganda reports one death and one case linked to travelers from DRC, with no local outbreak. International aid includes U.S.$13 million and World Bank funding pledges, alongside calls to accelerate response and facilitate aid transport, including reopening Goma airport.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRCのエボラ感染症流行の『拡大』について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを全て満たす。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、シグナルとしてフルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株で、ワクチンなし。ウガンダでも1死亡1例の関連患者確認。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。医療施設の飽和と隔離施設不足が深刻。国際支援（米国1300万ドル、世銀融資など）が動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Duits: Berlin: US-Ebola-Patient wird in der Charité behandelt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RT Deutsch: Berlin: American Ebola patient is being treated at Charité.
article.articleSummary: The CDC confirmed an Ebola-infected American citizen was flown to Germany for treatment, with six high-risk close contacts brought to Germany for monitoring. The patient landed in Berlin last night and was transported by a large fire department and police convoy to Charité University Hospital for isolation-bed treatment. The weekend case involves a US doctor in Congo who tested positive for the Bundibugyo variant after direct contact with patients. The CDC stated the American patient was moved to Germany for care, and the six additional close contacts on the same plane were monitored. The precise German landing site and initial treatment location were not initially disclosed. U.S. authorities asked Germany for aid in admitting the patient; Germany’s Federal Ministry of Health noted a nationwide expert network for managing highly pathogenic diseases. By Wednesday morning, rbb reported the Ebola patient had been admitted to Charité in Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: RT Deutsch: ベルリン: アメリカ人エボラ患者がシャリテで治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス感染者の国際的移送、複数の高リスク接触者監視、国家間の支援要請が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国で感染した米国人医師がベルリンに医療搬送された事例を報じている。発生地域にはベルリン・ドイツ・米国が含まれているが、実際のエボラウイルス感染イベントの主要な発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）である。患者の接触者6名が同じ飛行機でドイツに搬送され監視対象となっており、国際的な健康リスク管理の文脈がある。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Enhances Airport Health Surveillance Over Ebola * Okay News
article.articleSummary: As of May 20, 2026, Nigeria's Civil Aviation Authority issued a circular directing domestic and international carriers to heighten health surveillance at all international airports after a fresh Ebola outbreak in East/Central Africa. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo Ebola virus and prompted WHO to declare a PHEIC, with over 300 suspected cases and dozens of deaths regionwide. In DR Congo, a cluster among healthcare workers was identified in Bunia Health Zone, NE DR Congo. No confirmed Ebola case linked to the outbreak has been reported in Nigeria. There is no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo; treatment remains largely supportive. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, abdominal pain, and bleeding. Pilots must report suspected cases to ATC; passengers must submit locator forms. Airlines must stock first-aid, universal precaution kits, and emergency kits, with enhanced crew training. NCAA coordinates with the Federal Ministry of Health, Nigeria CDC, and Port Health Services.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ対策で空港検疫を強化 * Okay News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言、300件以上の疑い例、複数の死亡、DRコンゴでの医療従事者集団発症、ナイジェリアの主要空港での検疫強化という国際的に深刻な対応が明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはナイジェリアの空港検疫強化を論じているが、実際の発生地はDRコンゴ(Bunia Health Zone)である。ナイジェリアはWHO PHEIC宣言を受けた防御的対応をしている国であり、確認済みエボラ症例は報告されていない。verified_locationsはサマリー上で実際の発生が確認されているDRコンゴのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 127 health workers quarantined in Uganda - KMA Updates
article.articleSummary: Two imported cases of Ebola Sudan virus disease were recorded in Kampala, Uganda, on May 20, 2026. The patients, from the Democratic Republic of Congo, are in Kampala at the Mulago Ebola Treatment Unit; the index case died May 14 at Kibuli Muslim Hospital and was repatriated to DRC. Uganda has traced and isolated 127 contacts, mainly health workers who treated the patients and the driver; none have tested positive. No Ugandan resident has contracted Ebola. Preventive measures include postponing Uganda Martyrs' Day and boosting entry-point screening. Incubation for Ebola Sudan virus disease ranges from 2 to 21 days; early symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and red eyes, with progression to sore throat, chest/abdominal pain, diarrhoea, and vomiting after about four days. Public can report suspected cases via toll-free 0800-100-066 or SMS 6767.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: ウガンダで127人の医療従事者が隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある重篤な感染症で国際的な拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクを伴う。
triage.notes: エボラスーダンウイルスの輸入症例であり、複数国境を越えた移動を伴う。医療従事者への曝露が確認され、既に接触者追跡が実施されている。ウガンダは対象国ではないが、DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、患者の起源地がDRCであることと、ウガンダでの二次曝露リスク（医療従事者127人の隔離）が重要。両国での検証が必要。
